examples: Only an imbecile would leave the door open at night. He called himself an imbecile for missing the deadline. The imbecile plan wasted everyone's time. Do not make such imbecile remarks in public.
urduMeaning: بیوقوف، بے عقل شخص، احمق، ایسا شخص جو غیر دانشمندانہ حرکت کرے، ذہنی طور پر کمزور شخص، غلط فیصلے کرنے والا
synonyms: Fool, Idiot, Simpleton, Dolt, Moron, Blockhead, Dunce
antonyms: Genius, Scholar, Sage, Intellectual, Wise person, Prodigy
sindhiMeaning: بيوقوف، بي عقل ماڻهو، پاڳل، اهڙو شخص جيڪو بي ڍنگو ڪم ڪري، ذهني طور ڪمزور شخص، غلط فيصلا ڪندڙ
englishMeaning: A stupid or foolish person. Someone who acts without sense or good judgment. A person of very low intelligence, in older medical usage. Silly or idiotic in nature. Marked by great foolishness.

sindhiMeaning: حقيقتن کي لڪائڻ جي ڪوشش، علم ۽ اصلاح جي مخالفت، ڄاڻي واڻي مبهم ۽ گنجيل انداز اختيار ڪرڻ، ماڻهن کي جهالت ۾ رکڻ جي حمايت، اهڙي طرز جيڪا سمجهڻ ڏکي هجي
examples: The regime was accused of promoting obscurantism. Modern science struggles against religious obscurantism in some regions. His writing is criticized for its intellectual obscurantism. Obscurantism has no place in an open society.
synonyms: Ignorance, Mysticism, Traditionalism, Reactionism, Anti-intellectualism
englishMeaning: The practice of deliberately preventing the facts or full details of something from becoming known. Opposition to the spread of knowledge, reform, or enlightenment. Deliberate vagueness or unclear expression. Support for keeping people in ignorance. A style that makes ideas hard to understand.
antonyms: Enlightenment, Openness, Clarity, Knowledge, Transparency, Progress
urduMeaning: حقائق چھپانے کی کوشش، علم اور اصلاح کی مخالفت، جان بوجھ کر مبہم اور پیچیدہ انداز اپنانا، لوگوں کو جہالت میں رکھنے کی حمایت، ایسا انداز جو سمجھنا مشکل ہو

antonyms: Defend, Support, Exonerate, Excuse, Praise, Absolve
urduMeaning: کسی پر الزام لگانا، کسی کو عوام کے سامنے ذمہ دار قرار دینا، کسی کی طرف مسئلے کا سبب بتا کر اشارہ کرنا، کسی پر تہمت لگانا، کسی کو جواب دہ ٹھہرانا
examples: It is easy to point a finger at others without knowing the facts. The report pointed the finger at senior management. Do not point fingers at your colleagues in public. She refused to point a finger at anyone without evidence.
englishMeaning: To accuse or blame someone for something. To publicly identify a person as responsible for a wrongdoing. To draw attention to someone as the cause of a problem. To make an allegation against a person. To hold someone accountable.
synonyms: Blame, Accuse, Charge, Denounce, Implicate, Fault
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن تي الزام هڻڻ، ڪنهن کي عوام آڏو ذميوار قرار ڏيڻ، ڪنهن ڏانهن مسئلي جو سبب ٻڌائي اشارو ڪرڻ، الزام لڳائڻ، ڪنهن کي جوابدار قرار ڏيڻ
اخلاقي طور، اصولن مطابق، صحيح ۽ منصفاڻي انداز ۾، پيشيوراڻن ضابطن مطابق، ايمانداري ۽ ذميواريءَ سان
antonyms: Immorally, Unethically, Dishonestly, Unfairly, Corruptly, Wrongly
englishMeaning: In a way that follows moral principles. In a manner that is morally right and fair. With regard to accepted standards of conduct. In accordance with the rules of a profession. Honestly and responsibly.
synonyms: Morally, Honestly, Righteously, Fairly, Justly, Honorably
urduMeaning: اخلاقی طور پر، اصولوں کے مطابق، درست اور منصفانہ انداز میں، پیشہ ورانہ ضابطوں کے مطابق، دیانتداری اور ذمہ داری سے
examples: The company must operate ethically to gain public trust. Doctors are expected to behave ethically at all times. He always tries to act ethically, even under pressure. Journalists should report ethically and accurately.

antonyms: Polite, Courteous, Respectful, Civil, Well-mannered, Gracious
urduMeaning: بے ادب، بد تمیز، غیر مہذب، شائستگی سے عاری، دوسروں کا خیال نہ رکھنے والا، اخلاقی سلوک سے محروم
examples: It is impolite to interrupt when someone is speaking. His impolite reply upset the whole family. She apologized for her impolite behavior. Do not ask such impolite questions in front of guests.
sindhiMeaning: بي ادب، بدتميز، غير مهذب، شائستگيءَ کان سواءِ، ٻين جو خيال نه رکندڙ، اخلاقي سلوڪ کان محروم
englishMeaning: Not having or showing good manners. Rude or discourteous in behavior or speech. Lacking respect for social conventions. Ill-mannered toward others. Showing a lack of consideration.
synonyms: Rude, Discourteous, Ill-mannered, Uncivil, Disrespectful, Insolent

sindhiMeaning: اوچتو ننڊ ۾ گم ٿي وڃڻ، ٿڪجي ننڊ ڪري پوڻ، ڪنهن کي زوري سان مارڻ يا بيهوش ڪرڻ، هلڪو ڀاري آواز يا ڌڪ، انتهائي ٿڪجي پوڻ
englishMeaning: To fall asleep suddenly, especially from exhaustion. To hit or strike something with a dull sound. To render someone senseless or unconscious. A dull heavy sound or blow. To become extremely tired.
synonyms: Doze, Crash, Collapse, Sleep, Hit, Thump, Knock out
examples: He zonked out on the sofa after the long journey. The medicine made her zonk almost immediately. The ball zonked against the wooden fence. I usually zonk by ten after a busy day.
antonyms: Awaken, Rouse, Rise, Energize, Refresh, Wake
urduMeaning: اچانک نیند میں چلے جانا، تھک کر سو جانا، کسی کو زور سے مارنا یا بے ہوش کرنا، ہلکی بھاری آواز یا ضرب، نہایت تھک جانا
نہایت تھکا ہوا، گہری نیند میں، نشے کے اثر میں، جسمانی یا ذہنی طور پر بالکل چور، بے حس یا بے ہوش
examples: After the marathon, he felt completely zonked. She was zonked out on the couch by nine. The patient looked zonked from the strong medication. I am too zonked to cook tonight.
synonyms: Exhausted, Drained, Wiped out, Fatigued, Asleep, Groggy
englishMeaning: Extremely tired or exhausted. Deeply asleep, usually from fatigue. Under the strong influence of drugs or alcohol. Completely worn out physically or mentally. Insensible or unconscious.
sindhiMeaning: انتهائي ٿڪل، گهري ننڊ ۾، نشي جي اثر هيٺ، جسماني يا ذهني طور بلڪل ختم، بيحس يا بيهوش
antonyms: Refreshed, Energetic, Alert, Awake, Lively, Active

urduMeaning: گولیوں کی زد میں، شدید تنقید کا نشانہ، سخت دباؤ میں، عوامی طور پر الزامات کی زد میں، حملے یا مخالفت کا شکار
antonyms: Praised, Supported, Applauded, Defended, Protected, Approved
synonyms: Criticized, Attacked, Blamed, Bombarded, Denounced, Targeted
englishMeaning: Being shot at with weapons. Facing strong criticism or attack from others. In a situation of great pressure or scrutiny. Being blamed publicly for something. Exposed to hostile action or comment.
examples: The soldiers came under fire near the border. The minister has come under fire for his recent remarks. Her decisions are under fire from the media. The company is under fire over pollution complaints.
sindhiMeaning: گولين هيٺ، سخت تنقيد جو نشانو، وڏي دٻاءَ ۾، عوامي طور تي الزامن هيٺ، حملي يا مخالفت جي نشاني تي

urduMeaning: منہ سے رال بہنا، لعاب ٹپکنا، کسی چیز کے لیے حد سے زیادہ خواہش یا تعریف کرنا، منہ کا پانی، بیوقوفانہ انداز میں تعریف کرنا، بے جا ستائش
antonyms: Dislike, Ignore, Criticize, Reject, Disapprove, Detest
englishMeaning: To let saliva flow from the mouth. To show excessive desire or admiration for something. Saliva flowing from the mouth. To speak or write in a foolishly enthusiastic way. Silly or excessive praise.
examples: The baby began to drool while teething. Fans drooled over the new sports car at the show. He wiped a bit of drool from the sleeping child. Critics tend to drool over her every performance.
sindhiMeaning: ٿڪ وهڻ، وات مان لعاب ٽمڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ لاءِ گهڻي خواهش يا ساراهه ظاهر ڪرڻ، وات جو پاڻي، بيوقوفيءَ سان ساراهه ڪرڻ، بي مطلب تعريف
synonyms: Slobber, Salivate, Dribble, Gush, Rave, Fawn

antonyms: Sip, Nibble, Taste, Savor, Chew slowly
urduMeaning: جلدی جلدی نگلنا، بڑا گھونٹ پینا یا کھانا، ایک بار میں زیادہ مقدار نگلنا، تیزی سے سانس لینا، جذبات روکنے کے لیے نگلنا، گھبراہٹ سے اچانک نگلنا
synonyms: Swallow, Swig, Guzzle, Quaff, Chug, Draft
englishMeaning: To swallow drink or food quickly or in large amounts. To breathe in air quickly. A large mouthful of liquid or food swallowed at once. To try to hold back tears or emotion. A sudden nervous swallow.
sindhiMeaning: جلدي جلدي ڳيت ڏيڻ، وڏو گهڪ پيئڻ يا کائڻ، هڪ ڀيري ۾ گهڻي مقدار ۾ نگلڻ، تڪڙو ساهه کڻڻ، جذبن کي روڪڻ لاءِ ڳيت ڏيڻ، بيچينيءَ سبب اوچتو نگلڻ
examples: He gulped down the water in seconds. She took a deep gulp of fresh mountain air. The boy gulped nervously before answering the teacher. He drank his tea in a single gulp.

sindhiMeaning: کاڌي جو شوقين، اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو نون طعامن کي آزمائي، ذوقين، کاڌي جي ثقافت جو شوقين، پچائڻ يا کائڻ کي مشغلي طور اختيار ڪندڙ، اعليٰ کاڌن جو محب
antonyms: Non-eater, Ascetic, Faster, Anorexic, Food hater
synonyms: Gourmet, Gastronome, Epicure, Connoisseur, Food lover
urduMeaning: کھانے کا شوقین، ایسا شخص جو نئے پکوان آزماتا رہے، ذوق دار، کھانے کی ثقافت کا دلدادہ، پکانے یا کھانے کو مشغلہ بنانے والا، اعلیٰ کھانوں کا رسیا
examples: As a true foodie, she travels only to try new cuisines. The blog is followed by foodies from around the world. My cousin is a foodie who reviews every restaurant he visits. Foodies filled the streets during the food festival.
englishMeaning: A person who has a strong interest in food, especially in trying and learning about new dishes. A gourmet or lover of fine cuisine. Someone who follows food trends closely. A person who enjoys cooking or eating as a hobby. An enthusiast of culinary culture.

Moved slowly back and forth or side to side. Was influenced or persuaded by someone or something. Changed opinion because of an argument or emotion. Rocked gently by wind or motion. Controlled or dominated by a feeling or force.
antonyms: Steady, Fixed, Unmoved, Firm, Resistant, Unaffected
urduMeaning: جھولا، ادھر ادھر جھومنا، کسی کی رائے یا جذبے سے متاثر ہونا، ہوا یا حرکت سے آہستہ ہلنا، کسی جذبے یا طاقت کے زیر اثر آنا
synonyms: Rocked, Swung, Influenced, Persuaded, Moved, Wavered
sindhiMeaning: لڏي پيو، هيڏانهن هوڏانهن جهومڻ، ڪنهن جي راءِ يا جذبي کان متاثر ٿيڻ، هوا يا حرڪت سبب هوريان لڏڻ، ڪنهن جذبي يا طاقت جي قبضي هيٺ اچڻ
examples: The tall trees swayed in the strong wind. She was swayed by his emotional speech. The dancers swayed gracefully to the music. Voters were not swayed by the false promises.

englishMeaning: In a completely open and shameless way. Very obviously, without any attempt to hide. In a loud or brash manner. Clearly and undeniably. In a way that is impossible to ignore.
urduMeaning: کھلے اور بے شرم انداز میں، بالکل واضح طور پر، بے باکی سے، صاف اور نمایاں انداز میں، جسے چھپایا نہ جا سکے
examples: He blatantly ignored the traffic signal. She blatantly lied in front of everyone. The rules were blatantly violated during the match. The advertisement blatantly copied another brand's design.
synonyms: Openly, Obviously, Flagrantly, Shamelessly, Brazenly, Overtly
sindhiMeaning: کليل ۽ بي شرم انداز ۾، بلڪل ظاهر طور، بي پرواهيءَ سان، صاف صاف نموني، جنهن کي لڪائي نه سگهجي
antonyms: Subtly, Secretly, Discreetly, Quietly, Hiddenly, Slyly

englishMeaning: Occurring at the same time or place. In agreement or harmony with something. Happening together by chance. Corresponding exactly in position or nature. Concurrent or simultaneous.
antonyms: Different, Divergent, Separate, Unrelated, Opposite, Successive
urduMeaning: بیک وقت یا ایک جگہ پر ہونے والا، مطابقت رکھنے والا، اتفاقاً ساتھ ہونے والا، جگہ یا نوعیت میں یکساں، ہم زماں
synonyms: Simultaneous, Concurrent, Matching, Parallel, Corresponding
examples: The two festivals are coincident this year. His views are coincident with those of his teacher. The meeting was coincident with the arrival of the delegation. Their interests happened to be coincident.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ئي وقت يا جاءِ تي ٿيندڙ، مطابقت رکندڙ، اتفاق سان گڏوگڏ ٿيندڙ، جڳهه يا نوعيت ۾ ٺهڪندڙ، همعصر
اتفاق، ٻن يا وڌيڪ واقعن جو بنا ڪنهن سبب گڏ ٿيڻ، عجيب اتفاقي واقعو، حالتن جو غيرمتوقع طور ملڻ، همعصريءَ جي حالت
antonyms: Plan, Design, Intention, Arrangement, Cause, Purpose
synonyms: Chance, Accident, Fluke, Concurrence, Luck, Serendipity
urduMeaning: اتفاق، دو یا زیادہ واقعات کا بغیر کسی وجہ کے ایک ساتھ ہونا، عجیب اتفاقی واقعہ، حالات کا غیر متوقع طور پر ملنا، ہم عصر ہونے کی کیفیت
englishMeaning: A remarkable occurrence of events without an apparent connection. The fact of two or more things happening at the same time by chance. Correspondence in position or nature. An unexpected agreement of circumstances. Simultaneous existence or occurrence.
examples: It was a strange coincidence that we met at the airport. By coincidence, we were both wearing the same shirt. The similarity is only a coincidence, not a copy. What a coincidence to see you here!

antonyms: Differ, Diverge, Disagree, Contrast, Separate, Conflict
englishMeaning: To occur at the same time. To agree or be in accord with something. To occupy the same position in space. To correspond exactly in some respect. To happen together by chance.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ئي وقت ٿيڻ، ڪنهن راءِ سان ٺهڪڻ، ساڳيءَ جاءِ تي هجڻ، بلڪل ملي وڃڻ، اتفاق سان گڏوگڏ ٿيڻ
examples: Our holidays coincide with the school break. His arrival coincided with the beginning of the meeting. Their opinions coincide on most issues. The two lines coincide at this point.
synonyms: Match, Concur, Correspond, Overlap, Agree, Synchronize
urduMeaning: بیک وقت ہونا، کسی رائے سے مطابقت رکھنا، ایک ہی جگہ پر ہونا، بالکل ملنا، اتفاقاً ساتھ ہونا

examples: The court emphasized distributive justice in its ruling. Multiplication has a distributive property over addition. Each and every are distributive words in English grammar. The policy is designed on distributive principles.
englishMeaning: Concerned with the distribution or sharing of something. Relating to a mathematical property of operations. Serving to distribute or spread out. In grammar, referring to members of a group individually. Concerning fair allocation among people.
synonyms: Sharing, Allocative, Dispersive, Divisional, Apportioning
urduMeaning: تقسیم سے متعلق، تقسیم کرنے والا، ریاضی کی ایک خصوصیت سے متعلق، گروہ کے افراد کو الگ الگ ظاہر کرنے والا، منصفانہ تقسیم سے متعلق
sindhiMeaning: ورهاست سان لاڳاپيل، تقسيم ڪندڙ، رياضي جي هڪ خاصيت سان تعلق رکندڙ، گروهه جي ميمبرن کي جدا جدا ظاهر ڪندڙ، منصفاڻي تقسيم سان تعلق رکندڙ
antonyms: Collective, Combined, Hoarding, Gathering, Retentive
Collection, Gathering, Retention, Accumulation, Concentration
englishMeaning: The action of sharing something out among a number of recipients. The way something is spread over an area or among groups. The delivery of goods to shops and customers. The pattern in which something occurs. The mathematical arrangement of values.
sindhiMeaning: ورهاست، ڪنهن شيءِ کي ڪيترن ماڻهن ۾ ورهائڻ، ڪنهن علائقي يا گروهه ۾ پکيڙ، سامان جي دڪانن يا گراهڪن تائين پهچائڻ، ٿيندڙ واقعن جو انداز، انگن اکرن جي ترتيب
synonyms: Allocation, Sharing, Dispersal, Delivery, Spread, Apportionment
examples: The distribution of food began after the flood. The company handles distribution across the region. The distribution of wealth is very unequal. This chart shows the distribution of ages in the class.
urduMeaning: تقسیم، کسی چیز کو کئی لوگوں میں بانٹنا، کسی علاقے یا گروہ میں پھیلاؤ، سامان کی دکانوں یا صارفین تک ترسیل، واقعات کے پیش آنے کا انداز، اعداد و شمار کی ترتیب

examples: Youth is often transitory and precious. His happiness proved to be transitory. Fashions are transitory and keep changing. Life's pleasures can be surprisingly transitory.
synonyms: Temporary, Fleeting, Brief, Passing, Short-lived, Ephemeral
urduMeaning: عارضی، تھوڑی دیر رہنے والا، جلد ختم ہونے والا، ناپائیدار، عارضی نوعیت کا، محدود مدت کے لیے موجود
antonyms: Permanent, Lasting, Eternal, Enduring, Perpetual, Stable
sindhiMeaning: عارضي، ٿورو وقت هلندڙ، جلد ختم ٿيندڙ، ناپائيدار، عارضي نوعيت جو، محدود وقت لاءِ موجود
englishMeaning: Not permanent; lasting for only a short time. Passing quickly into or out of existence. Temporary and short-lived in nature. Brief and fleeting. Existing for a limited period.

urduMeaning: کمی، کسی چیز کو مقدار یا درجے میں کم کرنا، قیمت میں رعایت، مائع کو ابال کر گاڑھا کرنا، چھوٹی نقل، کم ہونے کا عمل
sindhiMeaning: گهٽتائي، ڪنهن شيءِ کي مقدار يا درجي ۾ گهٽ ڪرڻ، قيمت ۾ رعايت، پاڻي کي اُٻاري ڳاڙهو ڪرڻ، ننڍي ڪاپي، گهٽ ٿيڻ جو عمل
antonyms: Increase, Rise, Growth, Expansion, Addition, Boost
synonyms: Decrease, Cut, Diminution, Lowering, Curtailment, Discount
examples: The shop announced a big reduction on winter clothes. There has been a sharp reduction in air pollution. The chef prepared a rich reduction of tomato and wine. A reduction of the original map was printed on the pamphlet.
englishMeaning: The action of making something smaller or less in amount, degree, or size. A decrease in price. The process of concentrating a liquid by boiling. A smaller copy of a picture or map. An act of reducing or being reduced.

sindhiMeaning: اڳواٽ نشاني، آئنده ٿيندڙ واقعي جو اشارو، پيشنگوئي، ايندڙ وقت جي علامت اڪثر خراب، عجيب يا غيرمعمولي شيءِ يا شخص
synonyms: Omen, Sign, Warning, Prophecy, Foreboding, Harbinger, Indication
examples: The dark clouds seemed a portent of a coming storm. Some considered the earthquake a portent of worse to come. His words carried a strange portent of danger. The young musician was seen as a portent of great things.
urduMeaning: پیش گوئی کرنے والی نشانی، آنے والے واقعے کا اشارہ، شگون، مستقبل کی علامت اکثر بُری، عجیب یا غیر معمولی چیز یا شخص
englishMeaning: A sign or warning that something, especially something momentous, is likely to happen. An omen indicating the future. A prophetic indication of coming events. Something that foreshadows a future event, often bad. An amazing or exceptional person or thing.
antonyms: Certainty, Fact, Assurance, Reality, Confirmation

urduMeaning: موٹاپا، جسمانی فربہی، بڑھی ہوئی چربی، جسم کی بھاری بھرکم حالت، جسمانی بھاری پن
antonyms: Thinness, Slimness, Slenderness, Leanness, Skinniness
sindhiMeaning: ٿولهه، جسماني موٽائي، وڌيل چرٻي، جسم جي وڏائي، ڀاري جسم واري حالت
synonyms: Obesity, Fatness, Stoutness, Chubbiness, Plumpness, Heaviness
englishMeaning: The state of being fat or overweight. Excessive bodily fatness. Bulkiness of body. Physical stoutness. A heavy or bulky body condition.
examples: His corpulence made climbing stairs difficult. The doctor warned him about his growing corpulence. She lost some weight and reduced her corpulence. Old paintings often showed kings with noticeable corpulence.

sindhiMeaning: اندر جي طرف، دل يا روح ۾ موجود، اندروني سوچن ۽ جذبن سان تعلق رکندڙ، اندر ڏانهن هلندڙ، ذاتي يا خانگي طور
urduMeaning: اندر کی طرف، دل یا روح میں موجود، اندرونی خیالات و جذبات سے متعلق، اندر کی جانب حرکت کرنے والا، ذاتی یا نجی نوعیت کا
synonyms: Internal, Inner, Interior, Inside, Innermost, Private
examples: He gave an inward sigh of relief. The door opens with an inward push. She has a strong inward sense of peace. His inward struggles were hidden from everyone.
englishMeaning: Directed toward the inside or center. Existing within the mind or spirit. Relating to one's inner thoughts and feelings. Moving toward the interior. In a private or personal sense.
antonyms: Outward, External, Outer, Exterior, Public, Outside

englishMeaning: In a way that is felt or experienced in the mind but not shown outwardly. Privately or secretly within oneself, without expressing it openly. Toward the inside or interior of something. In one's thoughts, feelings, or spirit rather than in visible behavior. In a manner that is directed within oneself.
synonyms: Privately, Secretly, Internally, Silently, Within, Mentally, Spiritually
urduMeaning: اندرونی طور پر، دل ہی دل میں، ظاہر کیے بغیر، خاموشی سے اپنے اندر محسوس کرتے ہوئے، اندر کی جانب، ذہنی یا روحانی طور پر
examples: He inwardly cursed himself for the mistake. She smiled politely but was inwardly furious. Inwardly, he knew the plan would fail. The petals of the flower curl inwardly at night.
sindhiMeaning: اندروني طور تي، دل ۾ ئي، ظاهر نه ڪندي، خاموشيءَ سان پنهنجي اندر ۾ محسوس ڪندي، اندر جي طرف، ذهني يا روحاني طور
antonyms: Outwardly, Openly, Publicly, Visibly, Externally, Overtly

synonyms: Immediate, Prompt, Quick, Sudden, Rapid, Swift, Moment, Second, Flash
examples: The medicine gave him instant relief from pain. At that instant, the phone rang. She prefers instant coffee in the morning. The news spread across the city in an instant.
sindhiMeaning: فوري، هڪدم، بنا دير جي، هڪ لمحو يا وقت جو نقطو، جلدي تيار ٿيندڙ کاڌو يا مشروب، تڪڙو، تمام ٿورو وقت
antonyms: Delayed, Slow, Gradual, Late, Prolonged, Deferred
englishMeaning: Happening or done immediately, without any delay. A precise moment or point in time. Prepared quickly and easily, especially of food or drinks. Urgent and requiring immediate action. Very short in duration.
urduMeaning: فوری، اسی لمحے، بغیر تاخیر کے، ایک لمحہ یا وقت کا نقطہ، جلدی تیار ہونے والا کھانا یا مشروب، ہنگامی، بہت مختصر وقت

synonyms: Immediately, At once, Right away, Promptly, Straightaway, Directly, Quickly
examples: She recognized him instantly. The medicine worked instantly. He instantly regretted his harsh words. The lights turned on instantly when I entered.
sindhiMeaning: فوري طور، هڪدم، بنا دير جي، هڪ لمحي ۾، ترت، جهڙوڪ ئي
antonyms: Slowly, Eventually, Later, Gradually, Belatedly
englishMeaning: At once, without any delay or hesitation. Immediately after something happens. In a very short moment of time. Without waiting or pausing. Right away, on the spot.
urduMeaning: فوراً، اسی وقت، بغیر تاخیر کے، ایک لمحے میں، فی الفور، بلا تاخیر

examples: The initial response to the plan was positive. My initial reaction was one of shock. Please initial each page of the contract. Her initials are S.K.
sindhiMeaning: شروعاتي، پهرين مرحلي وارو، ابتدائي، ڪنهن جي نالي جو پهريون اکر، شروعاتي دستخط ڪرڻ، اڃا حتمي نه
synonyms: First, Beginning, Opening, Early, Primary, Original, Preliminary, Introductory
antonyms: Final, Last, Concluding, Ultimate, Ending, Closing
urduMeaning: ابتدائی، شروع کا، پہلے مرحلے کا، کسی کے نام کا پہلا حرف، ابتدائی دستخط کرنا، غیر حتمی
englishMeaning: Existing or occurring at the beginning of something. Relating to the first stage of a process. The first letter of a person's name. To mark or sign a document with one's initials. Preliminary and not final.

examples: Initially, I did not like the idea. The project was initially planned for six months. She was initially hired as an intern. Initially, the results looked promising.
synonyms: Originally, At first, Firstly, Primarily, At the start, In the beginning
antonyms: Finally, Ultimately, Eventually, Lastly, In the end
urduMeaning: ابتدا میں، شروع میں، پہلے پہل، ابتدائی مرحلے میں، آغاز میں
sindhiMeaning: شروع ۾، ابتدا ۾، پهريان، پهرين مرحلي ۾، اصل ۾ شروع ۾
englishMeaning: At the beginning or in the early stages of something. At first, before things changed. In the initial period of an event or process. At the outset of a situation. Originally, at the start.

synonyms: Make a difference, Have impact, Shift, Influence, Change, Affect, Advance
sindhiMeaning: قابل ذڪر فرق پيدا ڪرڻ، واضح تبديلي آڻڻ، اهم اثر ڇڏڻ، ترقي يا بهتري کي محسوس ڪرائڻ، صورتحال کي معنيٰ خيز طور تبديل ڪرڻ
examples: The new marketing campaign really moved the needle on sales. Small donations alone will not move the needle on poverty. His speech moved the needle in the political debate. We need bold reforms that actually move the needle.
urduMeaning: قابل ذکر فرق پیدا کرنا، نمایاں تبدیلی لانا، اہم اثر ڈالنا، ترقی یا بہتری کو محسوس کروانا، صورتحال میں معنی خیز تبدیلی لانا
englishMeaning: To make a noticeable change or difference in something. To produce a measurable effect on a situation. To have a significant impact on results or outcomes. To cause visible progress or improvement. To shift the current state of affairs in a meaningful way.
antonyms: Stagnate, Stall, Have no effect, Remain unchanged, Be insignificant

examples: Do not bottle up your feelings; talk to someone. He bottled up his anger for years. She tends to bottle up her grief instead of sharing it. Bottling up stress can harm your health.
sindhiMeaning: جذبن کي دل ۾ لڪائي رکڻ، احساسن کي ظاهر نه ڪرڻ، ڪاوڙ يا غم کي اندر ئي دٻائڻ، روڪي رکڻ، پنهنجن حقيقي جذبن کي لڪائڻ
synonyms: Suppress, Repress, Hold back, Conceal, Contain, Hide, Restrain, Stifle
englishMeaning: To hide or suppress one's emotions instead of expressing them. To keep feelings inside without letting them out. To restrain or hold back strong emotions. To prevent something from moving or escaping. To conceal one's true feelings for a long time.
antonyms: Express, Release, Vent, Reveal, Show, Let out, Disclose
urduMeaning: جذبات کو دل میں دبا کر رکھنا، احساسات کو ظاہر نہ کرنا، غصے یا دکھ کو اندر ہی روکنا، روک لینا، اپنے حقیقی جذبات چھپانا

antonyms: End, Conclude, Finish, Cease, Wrap up, Stop, Shorten
urduMeaning: توقع سے زیادہ دیر تک جاری رہنا، بور کرنے والی حد تک طویل ہونا، سست روی سے آگے بڑھنا، غیر ضروری طور پر لمبا ہو جانا، لمبا اور اکتا دینے والا ہونا
examples: The meeting dragged on for three hours. The war dragged on for years. Her speech dragged on and lost the audience. The court case has dragged on since last year.
englishMeaning: To continue for longer than expected or desired. To last for a tediously long time. To proceed slowly and without progress. To extend in duration in a boring way. To be prolonged unnecessarily.
synonyms: Continue, Persist, Linger, Prolong, Extend, Stretch out, Last
sindhiMeaning: توقع کان وڌيڪ وقت تائين جاري رهڻ، ٿڪائيندڙ حد تائين ڊگهو ٿيڻ، سست رفتاريءَ سان اڳتي وڌڻ، بيڪار طور تي وڌيڪ ڊگهو ٿيڻ، ڊگهو ۽ اڪتاهٽ وارو ٿيڻ

englishMeaning: The most advanced or modern stage of development in a field. The forefront of new ideas, technology, or techniques. Extremely innovative and ahead of the current standard. The sharp edge of a blade or tool. Leading a new direction in innovation.
examples: This lab works on cutting edge medical research. Their technology is truly cutting edge. She wears cutting edge fashion designs. The cutting edge of the knife was extremely sharp.
synonyms: Advanced, Innovative, Modern, State-of-the-art, Leading, Progressive, Forefront, Pioneering
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن به شعبي جي جديد ترين ترقي وارو مرحلو، نون خيالن يا ٽيڪنالاجي ۾ اڳيان، انتهائي جديد ۽ اڳوڻي، ڪنهن هٿيار يا اوزار جو تيز ڪنارو، جدت ۾ رهبر
urduMeaning: کسی بھی شعبے کی جدید ترین ترقی کا مرحلہ، نئے خیالات یا ٹیکنالوجی میں سب سے آگے، انتہائی جدید اور نمایاں، کسی آلے کی تیز دھار، جدت میں پیش پیش
antonyms: Outdated, Obsolete, Old-fashioned, Backward, Traditional, Antiquated

englishMeaning: Showing intense and passionate feeling. Very enthusiastic or emotional about something. Burning with strong emotion or belief. Extremely eager and warm in expression. Marked by great warmth of feeling.
sindhiMeaning: شديد جذبي وارو، پرجوش، انتهائي گرمجوشيءَ سان، ڪنهن شيءِ لاءِ نهايت شوق رکندڙ، سخت جذبي سان ڀريل
antonyms: Apathetic, Cool, Indifferent, Unenthusiastic, Cold, Dispassionate
urduMeaning: شدید جذبات والا، پرجوش، انتہائی گرم جوشی سے، کسی چیز کے لیے نہایت شوق رکھنے والا، سخت جذبے سے بھرپور
examples: He gave a fervid speech in support of reform. Her fervid admirers cheered loudly. The poet wrote fervid verses about love. They held fervid discussions late into the night.
synonyms: Passionate, Ardent, Fervent, Zealous, Enthusiastic, Intense, Heated, Impassioned

urduMeaning: مرکزی اختیار کے تحت متحد ریاستوں یا تنظیموں کا گروہ، وفاقی نظامِ حکومت، کلبوں یا یونینز کا اتحاد، ایسا اتحاد بنانے کا عمل، چھوٹے گروہوں کی نمائندہ بڑی تنظیم
sindhiMeaning: مرڪزي اختياريءَ هيٺ متحد ٿيل رياستن يا تنظيمن جو گروهه، وفاقي نظام حڪومت، ڪلبن يا يونينن جو اتحاد، اهڙي اتحاد ٺاهڻ جو عمل، ننڍن گروهن جي نمائندگي ڪندڙ وڏي تنظيم
antonyms: Separation, Division, Independence, Disunion, Split
synonyms: Union, Alliance, League, Confederation, Association, Coalition, Syndicate
englishMeaning: A group of states or organizations united under a central authority. A political system in which power is shared between a central government and regional units. An association of clubs, unions, or societies working together. The act of forming such a union. A large organization that represents smaller groups.
examples: The Russian Federation includes many regions. He is the president of the football federation. A federation of trade unions organized the protest. The federation was formed to protect workers' rights.

antonyms: Disagreement, Discord, Breach, Conflict, Dispute, Rift
urduMeaning: افراد  گروہوں یا قوموں کے درمیان باقاعدہ معاہدہ، عہد نامہ یا معاہدہ، دو فریقوں کے درمیان وعدہ، سنجیدہ عہد، مذاکرات کے بعد ہونے والا سمجھوتہ
englishMeaning: A formal agreement between individuals, groups, or nations. A treaty or contract with binding terms. A promise or arrangement between parties. A solemn commitment made mutually. An understanding reached after negotiation.
synonyms: Agreement, Treaty, Deal, Contract, Accord, Alliance, Covenant, Bond
examples: The two countries signed a peace pact. They made a pact never to reveal the secret. A trade pact was announced last week. The friends made a pact to meet every year.
sindhiMeaning: فرد  گروهه يا قومن جي وچ ۾ باقاعده معاهدو، معاهدو يا معاهدو نامو، ٻن ڌرين وچ ۾ واعدو، سنجيده وچن، ڳالهين کان پوءِ حاصل ٿيل سمجهاڻي

antonyms: Value, Recognize, Retain, Preserve, Uphold, Recover, Credit
urduMeaning: قرض کو ختم کرنا یا نقصان کے طور پر ریکارڈ کرنا، کسی کو ناکام یا بے کار سمجھ کر چھوڑ دینا، گاڑی کو ناقابل مرمت حد تک نقصان پہنچانا، رقم کے ناقابل وصول ہونے کو تسلیم کرنا، مایوس یا بے وقعت سمجھنا
sindhiMeaning: قرض کي ختم ڪرڻ يا نقصان طور رڪارڊ ڪرڻ، ڪنهن کي بيڪار سمجهي ڇڏي ڏيڻ، گاڏي کي ايترو نقصان پهچائڻ جو مرمت لائق نه رهي، پئسا نه موٽڻ جو تسليم ڪرڻ، بيڪار يا اميدون ختم ٿيل سمجهڻ
examples: The bank agreed to write off the loan. Critics wrote off the film as a failure. Do not write him off; he can still succeed. Her car was written off after the accident.
englishMeaning: To cancel a debt or record it as a loss in accounts. To dismiss someone or something as unimportant or a failure. To damage a vehicle beyond repair. To acknowledge that money owed cannot be recovered. To regard as hopeless or worthless.
synonyms: Cancel, Dismiss, Discount, Cross out, Abandon, Disregard, Nullify
Pronounce, Articulate, Declare, Proclaim, State, Voice, Utter, Announce
examples: Teachers should enunciate every word clearly. He enunciated his views on the reforms. The leader enunciated a new policy of tolerance. Please enunciate so the audience can understand.
sindhiMeaning: لفظن کي صاف ۽ چٽيءَ طرح چوڻ، ڪنهن ڳالهه کي واضح انداز ۾ بيان ڪرڻ، ڪنهن نظريي کي طئي ٿيل صورت ۾ پيش ڪرڻ، عوامي طور اعلان ڪرڻ، خيالن کي وضاحت سان ادا ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: الفاظ کو صاف اور واضح طور پر ادا کرنا، کسی بات کو باضابطہ اور واضح انداز میں بیان کرنا، کسی نظریے کو دو ٹوک انداز میں پیش کرنا، عوامی طور پر اعلان کرنا، خیالات کو وضاحت سے بیان کرنا
englishMeaning: To pronounce words clearly and distinctly. To state something formally, clearly, or precisely. To express a theory or idea in a definite way. To announce or proclaim publicly. To articulate thoughts with clarity.
antonyms: Mumble, Slur, Mutter, Suppress, Conceal, Whisper
Insider, Member, Favorite, Accepted, Included, Native
urduMeaning: معاشرے یا گروہ سے نکالا ہوا شخص، ٹھکرایا یا دھتکارا گیا فرد، بے گھر اور لاوارث انسان، برادری سے خارج شدہ، تنہائی میں رہ جانے والا شخص
englishMeaning: A person who is rejected or excluded by society or a group. Someone who has been driven out or shunned. A person without a home, friends, or acceptance. Rejected or cast out from a community. An individual isolated because of behavior, beliefs, or status.
sindhiMeaning: معاشري يا گروهه مان ڪڍيل ماڻهو، ڌڪاريل يا ڦٽڪاريل شخص، بيگهر ۽ لاوارث انسان، برادريءَ مان خارج ٿيل، اڪيلائيءَ ۾ رهجي ويل ماڻهو
examples: He felt like an outcast in his own village. The novel tells the story of a social outcast. She was treated as an outcast for speaking the truth. Refugees often live as outcasts in foreign lands.
synonyms: Exile, Pariah, Reject, Untouchable, Outsider, Stray, Castaway

urduMeaning: بغیر ثبوت کے سچ سمجھا جانے والا خیال یا بیان، اندازے پر مبنی رائے، دلیل کی بنیاد بننے والا مفروضہ، غیر مصدقہ مفروضہ، کسی معاملے کے بارے میں قیاس
antonyms: Fact, Certainty, Proof, Reality, Truth, Knowledge
sindhiMeaning: بغير ثبوت جي سچ سمجهيل خيال يا بيان، اندازي تي مبني عقيدو يا راءِ، دليل جي بنياد طور ورتل مفروضو، اڃا تصديق نه ٿيل نظريو، ڪنهن ڳالهه بابت اٽڪل
examples: His supposition proved to be correct. The theory rests on a false supposition. On the supposition that he will come, we prepared dinner. That is only a supposition, not a fact.
englishMeaning: An idea or statement that is assumed to be true without proof. A belief or opinion based on guesswork. An assumption used as the basis of an argument. A hypothesis or theory not yet confirmed. A conjecture about a fact or situation.
synonyms: Assumption, Hypothesis, Guess, Conjecture, Presumption, Theory, Belief, Notion
Overlap, Layer, Shingle, Superimpose, Tile
sindhiMeaning: ڇت جي ٽائيلن يا مڇيءَ جي ڇلن وانگر هڪ ٻئي مٿان ترتيبوار رکڻ، هڪ ڪناري کي ٻئي مٿان رکڻ، هڪ ٻئي کي ڍڪيندڙ تهه، پرت در پرت ڍڪڻ، ترتيبوار تهه بندي
urduMeaning: چھت کی ٹائلوں یا مچھلی کے چھلکوں کی طرح ایک دوسرے پر ترتیب سے رکھنا، ایک کنارہ دوسرے پر رکھنا، اوپر تلے تہیں لگانا، پرت در پرت ڈھانپنا، منظم تہہ بندی
examples: The scales of the fish imbricate along its body. Roof tiles are imbricated to keep out rain. The petals imbricate to form a tight bud. Artists imbricated colored papers to create the design.
englishMeaning: To arrange or overlap in a regular pattern like roof tiles or fish scales. To lay one edge over another in a series. Having overlapping edges. To cover with overlapping layers. Arranged in a tiled, layered fashion.
antonyms: Separate, Detach, Disjoin, Space apart, Divide

sindhiMeaning: سوراخ جي مٿان حصو ويڪرو ڪرڻ ته جيئن سِڪري جو مٿو سطح جي برابر رهي، اهڙو سوراخ ٺاهڻ وارو ڊرل بٽ، سِڪري يا بولٽ کي سطح کان هيٺ لاهڻ، فاسٽنر لاءِ ٺاهيل هيٺاهون سوراخ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي سطح کان هيٺ رکڻ
examples: He countersunk the screws so they would not stick out. The carpenter used a countersink bit on the wood. The heads of the nails were countersunk into the plank. Countersinking gives the finished surface a smooth look.
englishMeaning: To enlarge the upper part of a drilled hole so that a screw head sits flush with the surface. A drill bit used to create such a hole. To sink a bolt or screw below the surface. The recessed hole itself made for a fastener. To set something in below the level of the surface.
synonyms: Recess, Embed, Sink, Bore, Drill in
antonyms: Protrude, Raise, Elevate, Project, Stick out
urduMeaning: سوراخ کا اوپری حصہ چوڑا کرنا تاکہ پیچ کا سر سطح کے برابر بیٹھ جائے، ایسا سوراخ بنانے والا ڈرل بٹ، پیچ یا بولٹ کو سطح سے نیچے دھنسا دینا، فاسٹنر کے لیے بنی ہوئی نیچی جگہ، کسی چیز کو سطح سے نیچے رکھنا

antonyms: Irrelevant, Unrelated, Inappropriate, Immaterial, Extraneous, Unconnected
urduMeaning: زیرِ بحث موضوع سے متعلق اور مناسب، کسی معاملے سے قریبی تعلق رکھنے والا، موقع کے مطابق، صورتحال کے لیے موزوں، براہِ راست موضوع سے متعلق
sindhiMeaning: بحث هيٺ موضوع سان لاڳاپيل ۽ مناسب، ڪنهن معاملي سان ويجهو تعلق رکندڙ، موقعي مطابق، صورتحال لاءِ موزون، سڌو موضوع سان لاڳاپيل
englishMeaning: Relevant and appropriate to a subject being discussed. Closely connected with a matter or issue. Suitable and to the point. Fitting for the situation. Bearing directly on the topic.
examples: Your comment is not germane to the discussion. She raised a point germane to the case. Please stick to issues germane to the agenda. The evidence was highly germane to the trial.
synonyms: Relevant, Pertinent, Applicable, Appropriate, Related, Fitting, Apt, Material

examples: The rabidity of the mob shocked the whole nation. His rabidity in supporting the team amused everyone. The rabidity of the dog was confirmed by tests. Political rabidity often destroys reasoned debate.
synonyms: Fanaticism, Frenzy, Madness, Fury, Zealotry, Extremism, Wildness
englishMeaning: The state of being extremely fanatical or uncontrolled in behavior. Excessive zeal or fury in support of a cause. The condition of suffering from rabies. Violent or unreasoning intensity. Wild and irrational enthusiasm.
sindhiMeaning: انتهائي جنون يا بيقابو رويي جي حالت، ڪنهن سبب لاءِ حد کان وڌيڪ جوش يا غضب، پاڳل ڪتي جي بيماريءَ جي حالت، بيقابو ۽ بي عقل شدت، ديواني ۽ غير معقول جوش
antonyms: Calmness, Moderation, Composure, Rationality, Reasonableness, Restraint
urduMeaning: انتہائی جنون یا بے قابو رویے کی کیفیت، کسی مقصد کے لیے حد سے زیادہ جوش یا غضب، ریبیز کی بیماری کی کیفیت، بے قابو اور غیر معقول شدت، دیوانہ وار جوش

synonyms: Foreign, Unusual, Unfamiliar, Strange, Alien, Outlandish, Striking, Fascinating
examples: The market was full of exotic fruits from Asia. She wore an exotic dress at the party. They traveled to many exotic destinations. He keeps exotic birds as pets.
sindhiMeaning: پرڏيهي ملڪ کان آيل يا انهي جي خاصيت وارو، ظاهري طور تي عجيب يا غير معمولي، اڻ ڄاڻ هجڻ ڪري دلڪش يا پرڪشش، جتي هجي اتان جو نه هجڻ، رنگين ۽ دلچسپ

examples: Beautiful cumulus clouds filled the summer sky. The pilot flew above the cumulus formations. Children often see shapes in cumulus clouds. A cumulus of documents was piled on the desk.

synonyms: Arrangement, Adjustment, Positioning, Order, Coordination, Association, Affiliation, Union, Agreement

urduMeaning: اندرونی، کسی شخص  جگہ یا چیز کے اندر موجود، اندرونی نوعیت یا کام سے متعلق، ادارے  ملک یا نظام کے اندر، غیر ملکی کے بجائے ملکی معاملات والا، باہر سے نظر نہ آنے والا
examples: He suffered from internal injuries after the accident. The company conducted an internal investigation. Internal affairs are handled by another department. The clock has a complex internal mechanism.
sindhiMeaning: اندرين، ڪنهن شخص  جاءِ يا شيءِ جي اندر موجود، اندرين ڪم يا فطرت سان لاڳاپيل، ادارو  ملڪ يا نظام جي اندر، غير ملڪي بجاءِ ملڪي معاملن وارو، ٻاهرين نظر نه ايندڙ
antonyms: External, Outer, Outside, Foreign, Exterior, Outward, Visible, Superficial, Peripheral

synonyms: Method, Skill, Approach, Procedure, System, Style, Craft, Way, Practice, Manner
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم کي ڪرڻ جو خاص طريقو، فن  راند يا سائنس ۾ ڏک واري مهارت، مشق ذريعي حاصل ڪيل مهارت، نظامي طريقو، ٽيڪنيڪل معاملن سنڀالڻ جو انداز
englishMeaning: A particular way of carrying out a task, especially skillfully. A method of performance in an art, sport, or science. Skill or ability developed through practice. A systematic procedure for accomplishing something. The manner in which a person handles technical details.
examples: She has mastered the technique of oil painting. The coach taught them a new technique. His writing technique is very refined. Modern surgical techniques save many lives.
urduMeaning: کسی کام کو انجام دینے کا خاص طریقہ، فن  کھیل یا سائنس میں مہارت، مشق سے حاصل کی گئی صلاحیت، منظم طریقہ کار، تکنیکی معاملات سنبھالنے کا انداز
antonyms: Clumsiness, Awkwardness, Inability, Amateurishness, Ignorance, Ineptitude

examples: He developed a new method for teaching math. This is the best method to solve the problem. The scientist used a reliable method. There are many methods of learning a language.
synonyms: Way, Procedure, System, Technique, Approach, Process, Manner, Strategy, Practice, Formula
englishMeaning: A particular procedure for accomplishing something. An orderly or systematic way of doing something. A regular manner or established process. The means used to achieve a result. A defined technique used in study or work.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم کي ڪرڻ جو خاص طريقو، منظم ۽ ترتيب وار انداز، رواجي طريقو يا مقرر عمل، مقصد حاصل ڪرڻ جو ذريعو، مطالعي يا ڪم لاءِ مقرر ٽيڪنڪ
urduMeaning: کسی کام کو انجام دینے کا خاص طریقہ، منظم اور ترتیب وار انداز، مقررہ عمل یا معمول، مقصد حاصل کرنے کا ذریعہ، مطالعے یا کام کے لیے متعین تکنیک
antonyms: Disorder, Chaos, Confusion, Randomness, Disorganization, Aimlessness

synonyms: Production, Yield, Result, Product, Turnout, Amount, Quantity, Performance, Product, Delivery
examples: The factory increased its output last year. The computer output was printed on paper. His literary output is impressive. The engine outputs 200 horsepower.
sindhiMeaning: ماڻهو  مشين يا صنعت جي پيداوار، ڪمپيوٽر يا ٻي ڊوائيس مان نڪتل معلومات، ڪنهن عمل جي طاقت يا حاصلات، عمل جو نتيجو، معلومات يا شيون پيدا ڪرڻ
englishMeaning: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry. Information produced by a computer or other device. The power or product delivered by a process. The result of a process or activity. To produce or supply information or goods.
urduMeaning: انسان  مشین یا صنعت کی پیداوار، کمپیوٹر یا آلے سے حاصل ہونے والی معلومات، کسی عمل کی طاقت یا نتیجہ، عمل کا حاصل، معلومات یا اشیاء پیدا کرنا
antonyms: Input, Intake, Insertion, Supply, Absorption

englishMeaning: Occurring continuously without pause. Remaining the same over time. Steadfast and faithful. A quantity that does not change. Something that stays fixed while others vary.
urduMeaning: مسلسل اور بغیر رکے، وقت کے ساتھ تبدیل نہ ہونے والا، وفادار اور ثابت قدم، ایسا مقدار جو تبدیل نہ ہو، مستقل اور دائمی چیز
antonyms: Variable, Changing, Irregular, Intermittent, Unsteady, Inconsistent, Fickle, Occasional, Fluctuating
sindhiMeaning: مسلسل ۽ بغير رڪجي، وقت سان تبديل نه ٿيندڙ، وفادار ۽ ثابت قدم، اهڙو مقدار جيڪو تبديل نه ٿئي، دائم ۽ مستقل شيءِ
synonyms: Continuous, Steady, Unchanging, Persistent, Uniform, Regular, Fixed, Stable, Perpetual, Faithful
examples: He was in constant pain after the injury. Her constant support meant a lot. The speed of light is a constant. There is constant traffic on this road.

synonyms: Inwardly, Inside, Within, Inherently, Domestically, Privately, In-house, Interiorly
examples: The medicine should not be taken internally. The matter will be handled internally. She was bleeding internally. Internally, he was furious but stayed calm.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کے اندر کے حوالے سے، ادارے  ملک یا نظام کے اندر، اندرونی خیالات یا احساسات کے حوالے سے، ظاہری نہیں بلکہ باطنی طور پر، بیرونی نہیں بلکہ اندر سے سنبھالا گیا
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءَ جي اندر جي حوالي سان، ادارو  ملڪ يا نظام جي اندر، اندرين خيالن يا احساسن جي حوالي سان، ظاهري نه پر باطني طور، ٻاهرين نه بلڪه اندرين طور تي سنڀاليل
antonyms: Externally, Outwardly, Outside, Publicly, Openly, Visibly
englishMeaning: In a way that relates to the inside of something. Within an organization, country, or system. Concerning inner thoughts or feelings. Not visibly or outwardly. Handled inside a group rather than externally.

examples: The cream should be applied externally only. Externally, the building looks new. The project is funded externally. She appeared calm externally.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کے باہر کے حوالے سے، ادارے  ملک یا نظام سے باہر، بظاہر یا سطحی طور پر، بیرونی ذرائع سے، بیرونی سطح پر لگایا گیا
synonyms: Outwardly, Outside, Superficially, Apparently, Publicly, Visibly, On the surface, From outside
antonyms: Internally, Inwardly, Inside, Privately, Domestically, Within
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءَ جي ٻاهر جي حوالي سان، ادارو  ملڪ يا نظام کان ٻاهران، ظاهري طور تي، ٻاهرين ذريعن مان، ٻاهرين سطح تي لڳايل
englishMeaning: In a way that relates to the outside of something. Outside an organization, country, or system. In appearance or on the surface. From outside sources. Applied to the outer surface.

sindhiMeaning: ٻاهرين ضابطي يا اثر کان آزاد، ٻئي تي منحصر نه، خودمختيار يا خودڪفيل، ٻين سان لاڳاپي کان سواءِ، آزاد سوچ يا عمل وارو ماڻهو
urduMeaning: بیرونی کنٹرول یا اثر سے آزاد، دوسروں پر منحصر نہیں، خودمختار یا خود کفیل، دوسروں سے غیر متعلق، آزاد سوچ یا عمل والا شخص
antonyms: Dependent, Reliant, Subordinate, Subject, Controlled, Attached, Enslaved, Tied, Restricted
examples: She is a strong and independent woman. Pakistan became independent in 1947. He runs an independent business. Independent thinkers challenge old ideas.
englishMeaning: Free from outside control or influence. Not depending on another for livelihood or opinions. Self-governing or self-sufficient. Not connected with others of the same kind. A person who acts or thinks freely.
synonyms: Free, Self-reliant, Autonomous, Sovereign, Self-governing, Separate, Unattached, Self-sufficient, Individual, Liberated

sindhiMeaning: غير مستقل يا بغير مقرر انداز جو، تبديل ٿيڻ جي قابل، ايترو مقدار جيڪو مختلف قدر وٺي سگهي، بار بار يا اڻ ڏٺو تبديل ٿيندڙ، تبديل ٿيندڙ شيءِ
antonyms: Constant, Steady, Fixed, Unchanging, Stable, Uniform, Regular, Invariable, Consistent
englishMeaning: Not consistent or having a fixed pattern. Able to be changed or adapted. A quantity that may assume different values. Changing frequently or unpredictably. Something that varies or is capable of varying.
examples: The weather has been very variable this week. Prices are variable and depend on demand. In this equation, x is the variable. His mood is highly variable.
urduMeaning: غیر مستقل یا بغیر مقررہ انداز کا، تبدیل کیا جانے کے قابل، ایسا مقدار جو مختلف قدر لے سکے، بار بار یا غیر متوقع طور پر بدلنے والا، تبدیل ہونے والی چیز
synonyms: Changeable, Fluctuating, Unstable, Inconsistent, Adjustable, Shifting, Varying, Uneven, Mutable, Erratic

urduMeaning: کسی چیز میں موجود اجزاء، کتاب  تقریر یا پروگرام کا مواد، کسی چیز میں شامل مقدار، اطمینان یا خوشی کی حالت، کسی چیز کو قبول کرنے پر راضی
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءَ ۾ موجود شيون، ڪتاب  تقرير يا پروگرام جا موضوع، ڪنهن شيءَ ۾ موجود مقدار، خوشي يا اطمينان جي حالت، ڪا شيءِ قبول ڪرڻ لاءِ راضي
antonyms: Discontent, Unhappy, Dissatisfied, Displeased, Empty, Void, Restless, Unfulfilled
synonyms: Substance, Material, Subject, Matter, Satisfied, Happy, Pleased, Fulfilled, Contented, Gratified
englishMeaning: The things contained in something. The subject matter or ideas of a book, speech, or program. The amount of a substance contained in something. A state of satisfaction or happiness. Willing to accept something as adequate.
examples: The content of the book was very informative. She was content with her simple life. Please check the fat content of the food. The website updates its content daily.

urduMeaning: کسی خاص انداز میں عمل کرنے کا سبب، کچھ کرنے کی خواہش یا آمادگی، عمل کے پیچھے محرک قوت، ہدف حاصل کرنے کا جذبہ، لوگوں کو ترغیب دینے کا عمل
synonyms: Inspiration, Drive, Incentive, Enthusiasm, Encouragement, Stimulus, Purpose, Reason, Ambition, Impetus
englishMeaning: The reason or reasons for acting in a particular way. The desire or willingness to do something. A driving force behind actions. Enthusiasm to achieve a goal. The process of inspiring people.
examples: His motivation to succeed was inspiring. She lacks the motivation to study. Money is not his main motivation. The coach provides strong motivation.
antonyms: Discouragement, Apathy, Indifference, Laziness, Demotivation, Disinterest, Reluctance
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن خاص طريقي سان عمل ڪرڻ جو سبب، ڪم ڪرڻ جي خواهش يا لاڙو، عمل جي پوئتان محرڪ طاقت، مقصد حاصل ڪرڻ جو جذبو، ماڻهن کي حوصلا افزائي ڏيڻ جو عمل

synonyms: Local, Provincial, District, Territorial, Area-based, Zonal, Sectional, Native, Geographical, Municipal
examples: They speak a regional dialect. The company opened a regional office. Regional cuisine varies across the country. There is regional cooperation on trade.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن خاص علائقي سان لاڳاپيل، ملڪ جي ڪنهن حصي جي خصوصيت، مقامي معاملن سان تعلق رکندڙ، ڪجهه ملڪن جي هڪ گڏيل علائقي وارو، ڪجهه ضلعن جي خاصيت
englishMeaning: Relating to a particular region or area. Characteristic of a specific part of a country. Concerning local rather than national matters. Involving several countries in one area. Distinctive to certain districts.
urduMeaning: کسی خاص علاقے سے متعلق، ملک کے کسی حصے کی خصوصیت، مقامی معاملات سے تعلق رکھنے والا، کچھ ممالک کے ایک مشترکہ خطے کا، بعض اضلاع کی خصوصیت
antonyms: National, International, Global, Universal, Central, Worldwide, Foreign

examples: She struggled with feelings of insecurity. There is growing insecurity in the region. His insecurity made him overly defensive. Job insecurity affects mental health.
urduMeaning: غیر محفوظ  بے چین یا پریشان محسوس کرنے کی حالت، اپنے آپ یا حالات پر اعتماد کی کمی، خطرے یا نقصان کے سامنے کمزوری، سماجی  معاشی یا سیاسی عدم استحکام، خود پر شک کا احساس
synonyms: Uncertainty, Anxiety, Doubt, Vulnerability, Instability, Fear, Nervousness, Self-doubt, Danger, Worry
sindhiMeaning: غير محفوظ  بيچين يا پريشان محسوس ڪرڻ جي حالت، پاڻ تي يا حالتن تي اعتماد نه هجڻ، خطري يا نقصان ڏانهن ڪمزوري، سماجي  معاشي يا سياسي بي استحڪامي، پاڻ تي شڪ جو احساس
antonyms: Security, Confidence, Certainty, Safety, Stability, Assurance, Trust, Protection, Composure
englishMeaning: The state of feeling uncertain, unsafe, or anxious. Lack of confidence in oneself or one's situation. Vulnerability to danger or threat. Instability in social, economic, or political conditions. A feeling of self-doubt.

examples: The invention of the internet marked the beginning of a new era. We are living in an era of rapid technological change. The Victorian era produced many great writers. His presidency was seen as the end of an era.
urduMeaning: ایک طویل اور مخصوص تاریخی دور، خاص واقعات یا خصوصیات سے پہچانا جانے والا زمانہ، کسی قوم یا شخصیت کی زندگی کا یادگار مرحلہ، کسی اہم واقعے سے شروع ہونے والا شمارِ زمانہ، ارضیاتی وقت کا ایک مخصوص حصہ
synonyms: Age, Epoch, Period, Time, Aeon, Generation, Cycle, Phase, Chapter, Date
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ڊگهو ۽ خاص تاريخي دور، ڪا مخصوص خاصيتن يا واقعن سان سڃاتل زمانو، ڪنهن قوم يا شخصيت جي زندگيءَ جو يادگار دور، ڪنهن اهم واقعي کان شروع ٿيندڙ حساب جو زمانو، ارضياتي وقت جو هڪ مخصوص حصو
antonyms: Moment, Instant, Second
englishMeaning: A long and distinct period of history. A period marked by particular events, characteristics, or developments. A memorable or important stage in the history of a person, group, or civilization. A system of chronology reckoned from a notable event. A significant point in geological time.

sindhiMeaning: ٻيهر شروع ڪرڻ يا بحال ڪرڻ، ڪنهن معاهدي، لائسنس يا رڪنيت جي مدت وڌائڻ، پراڻي شيءَ کي نئين سان بدلائڻ، تازگي، طاقت يا زندگي بحال ڪرڻ، ڪنهن واعدي يا ڪوشش کي ٻيهر دهرائڻ
urduMeaning: دوبارہ شروع کرنا یا بحال کرنا، کسی معاہدے، لائسنس یا رکنیت کی مدت میں توسیع کرنا، پرانی چیز کی جگہ نئی لانا، تازگی، توانائی یا زندگی بحال کرنا، کسی وعدے یا کوشش کو دہرانا
englishMeaning: To resume or begin again after an interruption. To extend the validity of a licence, contract, subscription, or agreement for a further period. To replace something old or worn with something new. To restore freshness, strength, or vitality to something. To repeat or reaffirm a promise, statement, or effort.
antonyms: Cancel, Terminate, End, Discontinue, Stop, Abandon, Expire, Weaken, Exhaust
synonyms: Restore, Revive, Refresh, Extend, Prolong, Resume, Reinstate, Reactivate, Rejuvenate, Repeat
examples: He went to the office to renew his passport. They renewed their vows on their tenth anniversary. The company plans to renew its contract with the supplier. A short holiday helped renew her energy.

antonyms: Exhausted, Weakened, Cancelled, Expired, Abandoned, Discouraged
sindhiMeaning: ٻيهر شروع ٿيل، نئين طاقت يا جوش سان ڀريل، وڌايل مدت وارو، نئين عزم سان دهرايل، پراڻي بهتر حالت ۾ بحال ٿيل
examples: There is renewed interest in electric vehicles. She returned to work with renewed enthusiasm. The two countries signed a renewed peace agreement. The team faced the second half with renewed determination.
urduMeaning: دوبارہ شروع کیا گیا، نئی توانائی یا جوش سے بھرپور، مدت میں توسیع شدہ، نئے عزم کے ساتھ دہرایا گیا، پرانی بہتر حالت میں بحال
englishMeaning: Resumed or started again after a pause. Given fresh strength, energy, or interest. Extended for a further period of time. Repeated or reaffirmed with new commitment. Restored to a former better condition.
synonyms: Refreshed, Revived, Restored, Reinvigorated, Reaffirmed, Extended, Reactivated, Rejuvenated
Request, Appeal, Plea, Application, Entreaty, Supplication, Prayer, Solicitation, Suit
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن اختياريءَ کي پيش ڪيل رسمي درخواست جنهن تي گهڻن ماڻهن جون صحيحون هجن، عدالت ۾ پيش ڪيل رسمي درخواست، رسمي طور تي درخواست ڪرڻ، عاجزيءَ سان گهر ڪرڻ، دعا يا فرياد
examples: Thousands of citizens signed a petition against the new law. The lawyer filed a petition in the high court. The residents petitioned the government to build a new hospital. They petitioned the king for mercy.
antonyms: Demand, Command, Order, Refusal, Denial, Rejection
englishMeaning: A formal written request signed by many people appealing to an authority. A formal application made to a court in writing. To make a formal request to an authority. To earnestly request or plead for something. A solemn or humble request, especially in prayer.
urduMeaning: کسی اتھارٹی کے سامنے پیش کی جانے والی باقاعدہ درخواست جس پر بہت سے لوگوں کے دستخط ہوں، عدالت میں پیش کی جانے والی باقاعدہ درخواست، باقاعدہ طور پر درخواست کرنا، عاجزی سے گزارش کرنا، دعا یا التجا

antonyms: Indecision, Hesitation, Doubt, Uncertainty, Weakness, Problem, Dispute
englishMeaning: A firm decision to do or not to do something. A formal expression of opinion or intention agreed on by a legislative body or committee. The act of solving a problem, dispute, or contentious matter. The quality of being determined or resolute. The degree of detail visible in a photograph or on a screen.
urduMeaning: کسی کام کو کرنے یا نہ کرنے کا پختہ ارادہ، اسمبلی یا کمیٹی کی جانب سے منظور کردہ رسمی فیصلہ، کسی مسئلے یا تنازع کا حل، عزمِ صمیم اور ثابت قدمی، تصویر یا اسکرین کی وضاحت کا معیار
examples: Her New Year's resolution was to exercise every day. The council passed a resolution to increase the budget. We hope for a peaceful resolution of the conflict. The camera captures images in very high resolution.
sindhiMeaning: ڪا ڳالهه ڪرڻ يا نه ڪرڻ جو پڪو ارادو، ڪنهن اسيمبلي يا ڪاميٽيءَ جو رسمي فيصلو، ڪنهن مسئلي يا جهيڙي جو حل، پختو عزم يا ثابت قدمي، تصوير يا اسڪرين تي وضاحت جو معيار
synonyms: Determination, Resolve, Decision, Commitment, Motion, Verdict, Solution, Settlement, Clarity

examples: The company sent a notification about the change in policy. I received a notification on my phone about the meeting. The government issued a notification regarding new tax rules. Please switch off notifications during the exam.
synonyms: Announcement, Alert, Notice, Intimation, Message, Communication, Declaration, Circular, Advisory
englishMeaning: The act of officially informing someone about something. A formal or official written or spoken statement giving information. A message or alert appearing on a phone, computer, or device. An announcement issued by a government or authority.
urduMeaning: کسی کو باقاعدہ طور پر مطلع کرنے کا عمل، معلومات دینے والا رسمی تحریری یا زبانی بیان، فون یا کمپیوٹر پر ظاہر ہونے والا پیغام یا اطلاع، حکومت یا ادارے کی جانب سے جاری کردہ اعلان
antonyms: Concealment, Silence, Suppression, Withholding
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي رسمي طور تي اطلاع ڏيڻ جو عمل، رسمي طور تي معلومات ڏيندڙ لکت يا اعلان، فون يا ڪمپيوٽر تي ظاهر ٿيندڙ پيغام يا اطلاع، حڪومت يا اداري پاران جاري ڪيل اعلان

examples: Please notify the manager if you cannot attend the meeting. The school will notify parents about the new schedule. He notified the police about the missing bag. You must notify the bank of any change of address.
synonyms: Inform, Alert, Announce, Advise, Report, Tell, Warn, Intimate, Declare
antonyms: Conceal, Hide, Withhold, Suppress, Mislead
englishMeaning: To formally or officially inform someone of something. To give notice of or report a fact or occurrence. To bring information to the attention of a person or authority. To announce or publish something officially.
urduMeaning: کسی کو باقاعدہ طور پر مطلع کرنا، کسی واقعے کی اطلاع دینا، کسی اتھارٹی یا شخص کے علم میں لانا، باقاعدہ طور پر اعلان کرنا
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي رسمي طور تي ٻڌائڻ يا اطلاع ڏيڻ، ڪنهن واقعي جي خبر ڏيڻ، ڪنهن اختياريءَ يا شخص جي ڌيان ۾ آڻڻ، رسمي طور تي اعلان ڪرڻ

antonyms: Alleys, Dead-ends, Cul-de-sacs, Byways, Backstreets

englishMeaning: Main roads or public highways connecting one place to another. Busy public streets used for travelling through a town or city. Passages or routes that are open at both ends allowing free movement.
urduMeaning: بڑی سڑکیں یا شاہراہیں جو ایک جگہ کو دوسری جگہ سے ملاتی ہیں، شہر کی مصروف عوامی گزرگاہیں، دونوں سروں سے کھلی گزرگاہیں جہاں سے آسانی سے گزرا جا سکے
synonyms: Highways, Roads, Streets, Avenues, Routes, Boulevards, Passages, Roadways, Arteries

urduMeaning: آئین کے خلاف، ملک یا ادارے کے بنیادی قوانین کے منافی، آئینی اصولوں کے خلاف عمل یا فیصلہ
englishMeaning: Not in accordance with the constitution of a country or organisation. Violating the fundamental principles or rules laid down by a constitution. Contrary to established legal or governing principles.
synonyms: Illegal, Unlawful, Illegitimate, Invalid, Unauthorized, Unwarranted
sindhiMeaning: آئين جي خلاف، ملڪ يا اداري جي بنيادي قانونن جي ابتڙ، آئيني اصولن جي خلاف عمل يا فيصلو
examples: The court declared the new law unconstitutional. Detaining a citizen without charge is unconstitutional. Many experts described the order as unconstitutional. The judges struck down the amendment as unconstitutional.
antonyms: Constitutional, Legal, Lawful, Legitimate, Valid, Authorized

sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ملڪ  اداري يا ماڻهن جي حڪومت ڪرڻ جو عمل يا طريقو، فيصلا ڪرڻ ۽ انهن تي عمل ڪرڻ جو نظام، عوامي معاملن کي هلائڻ ۾ اختيار جو استعمال، اداري کي هلائڻ جي قاعدن ۽ اصولن جو ڍانچو

synonyms: Administration, Management, Rule, Leadership, Control, Authority, Regulation, Direction, Command
urduMeaning: کسی ملک  ادارے یا لوگوں پر حکومت کرنے کا عمل یا طریقہ، فیصلہ سازی اور ان کے نفاذ کا نظام، عوامی امور کے انتظام میں اختیار کا استعمال، ادارے کو چلانے کے قواعد و ضوابط کا ڈھانچہ
englishMeaning: The action, manner, or system of governing a country, organisation, or people. The process of decision-making and the process by which decisions are implemented. The exercise of authority and control in managing public affairs. The framework of rules, practices, and processes by which an institution is directed.
antonyms: Anarchy, Disorder, Chaos, Misrule, Mismanagement, Lawlessness
Discord, Noise, Disharmony, Unbalance, Disturb, Mistune
examples: She hummed a familiar tune while cooking. The guitarist paused to tune his instrument. The mechanic tuned the engine before the long journey. Millions of viewers tune in to the show every week.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ خوشگوار سُر يا راڳ جيڪو آسانيءَ سان ياد رهجي وڃي، ساز کي درست سُر تي آڻڻ، انجڻ يا مشين کي بهتر هلائڻ لاءِ سڌارڻ، ريڊيو يا ٽيليويزن کي ڪنهن مخصوص چينل تي ملائڻ، هم آهنگي پيدا ڪرڻ
synonyms: Melody, Song, Air, Strain, Harmony, Adjust, Regulate, Calibrate, Attune
englishMeaning: A melody, especially one that is easy to remember. To adjust a musical instrument to the correct pitch. To adjust an engine or device so that it runs smoothly and efficiently. To set a radio or television to a particular frequency or channel. To bring into harmony or agreement.
urduMeaning: ایک خوش کن راگ یا دھن جو آسانی سے یاد رہ جائے، ساز کو درست سُر پر لانا، انجن یا مشین کو بہتر چلانے کے لیے درست کرنا، ریڈیو یا ٹی وی کو کسی مخصوص چینل پر لگانا، ہم آہنگی پیدا کرنا

antonyms: Use, Utilise, Employ, Respect, Preserve, Conserve, Cherish
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ جو غلط يا ناجائز استعمال ڪرڻ، ڪنهن سان بدسلوڪي ڪرڻ، غلط يا ناروا استعمال، مقصد کان هٽي ڪري استعمال
examples: The misuse of power leads to corruption. Do not misuse your authority for personal gain. Misuse of antibiotics can be harmful to health. He was accused of misusing government funds.
englishMeaning: To use something in a wrong or improper way. To treat someone or something badly or unfairly. The wrong or improper use of something. Application of something for a purpose other than intended.
synonyms: Abuse, Mishandle, Mistreat, Exploit, Squander, Pervert, Waste, Corrupt
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کا غلط یا ناجائز استعمال کرنا، کسی کے ساتھ برا سلوک کرنا، غلط یا ناروا استعمال، مقصد سے ہٹ کر استعمال کرنا

antonyms: Debt, Deficit, Poverty, Emptiness
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن رياست  اداري يا سماج جو خزانو يا فنڊ، مالياتي ۽ ٽيڪس معاملن جو حڪومتي کاتو، اهو هنڌ جتي قيمتي شيون يا پيسو رکيا وڃن، قيمتي يا وڻندڙ شين جو مجموعو
examples: The treasury announced new measures to reduce the deficit. All revenues are deposited in the national treasury. The museum is a treasury of ancient artefacts. He was appointed head of the state treasury.
urduMeaning: کسی ریاست  ادارے یا معاشرے کا خزانہ یا فنڈ، مالیات اور ٹیکس امور کا حکومتی محکمہ، وہ جگہ جہاں قیمتی اشیاء یا رقم رکھی جاتی ہے، قیمتی یا دلکش چیزوں کا مجموعہ
englishMeaning: The funds or revenue of a state, institution, or society. A government department responsible for finance, budgeting, and taxation. A place where valuable items or money are kept. A collection of valuable or delightful things.
synonyms: Exchequer, Vault, Coffer, Fund, Repository, Storehouse, Reserve, Bank

sindhiMeaning: مضبوط ۽ قائم، جيڪو آسانيءَ سان تبديل يا ڪري نه پوي، جذباتي طور تي مضبوط ۽ متوازن، اهو جاءِ جتي گهوڙا يا ٻيا جانور رکيا وڃن، گهوڙي کي ٿَنڀي ۾ رکڻ
antonyms: Unstable, Shaky, Unsteady, Fragile, Changeable, Volatile, Insecure
synonyms: Steady, Firm, Secure, Fixed, Balanced, Constant, Reliable, Solid, Sound
englishMeaning: Firmly fixed, not likely to move, change, or fail. Not easily upset or disturbed emotionally. A building in which horses or other livestock are kept. To keep or put a horse in a stable.
urduMeaning: مضبوط اور قائم، جو آسانی سے بدلے یا گرے نہیں، جذباتی طور پر پرسکون اور متوازن، وہ عمارت جہاں گھوڑے یا مویشی رکھے جاتے ہیں، گھوڑے کو اصطبل میں رکھنا
examples: The patient's condition is now stable. The country needs a stable government. He keeps three horses in the stable. Prices have remained stable for the past year.

englishMeaning: To charge someone with an offence or crime. To claim that someone has done something wrong. To blame someone for a fault or wrongdoing.
antonyms: Defend, Absolve, Exonerate, Acquit, Clear, Vindicate, Pardon
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن تي ڏوهه يا الزام لڳائڻ، ڪنهن تي غلط ڪم ڪرڻ جو دعويٰ ڪرڻ، ڪنهن کي غلطي يا خطا جو ذميوار قرار ڏيڻ
urduMeaning: کسی پر جرم یا الزام لگانا، کسی پر غلط کام کرنے کا دعویٰ کرنا، کسی کو غلطی یا خطا کا ذمہ دار ٹھہرانا
synonyms: Blame, Charge, Indict, Allege, Denounce, Incriminate, Impeach, Arraign
examples: The police accused him of theft. She was accused of lying to the committee. Do not accuse anyone without evidence. He accused his brother of breaking the vase.

synonyms: Defendant, Suspect, Charged, Alleged offender, Respondent
examples: The accused stood silently before the judge. The accused denied all the charges against him. Two of the accused were released on bail. The lawyer defended the accused with strong arguments.
sindhiMeaning: اهو شخص جنهن تي ڏوهه لڳايو ويو هجي يا مقدمو هلي رهيو هجي، الزام هيٺ آيل، عدالت ۾ رسمي طور تي ملزم قرار ڏنل
urduMeaning: وہ شخص جس پر جرم کا الزام ہو یا مقدمہ چل رہا ہو، الزام کے تحت آیا ہوا، عدالت میں باقاعدہ طور پر ملزم قرار دیا گیا
englishMeaning: A person or people charged with or on trial for a crime. Blamed or held responsible for a fault or offence. Formally charged with wrongdoing in a court of law.
antonyms: Accuser, Plaintiff, Complainant, Innocent, Cleared

examples: The critic gave an acerb review of the play. Her acerb remarks silenced the whole room. He had an acerb wit that few people appreciated. The lemon had an unpleasantly acerb taste.
urduMeaning: ذائقے میں تیز اور تلخ، بات یا مزاج میں سخت اور چبھتا ہوا، طنزیہ اور کاٹ دار اظہار والا

synonyms: Bitter, Sour, Sharp, Harsh, Caustic, Acrid, Biting, Acerbic, Tart
antonyms: Sweet, Mild, Gentle, Pleasant, Kind, Bland, Soothing

urduMeaning: سرکہ، خاص طور پر ادویات یا کیمیا میں استعمال ہونے والا، ایسٹک ایسڈ کا رقیق محلول جو ادویات کے حل کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے

Pain, Hurt, Throb, Soreness, Pang, Yearn, Long, Suffer, Twinge

antonyms: Diminish, Decrease, Erode, Dissolve, Scatter, Reduce

englishMeaning: The lowest part or bottom of something, on which it rests or is supported. A foundation or starting point. A place used as a centre of operations. In chemistry, a substance that neutralises acids. Lacking moral principles; dishonourable. To use as a foundation or starting point.

synonyms: Foundation, Bottom, Support, Ground, Headquarters, Establish, Found, Root

synonyms: Mix, Blend, Combine, Merge, Mingle, Incorporate, Fuse, Stir

examples: The small boat was left adrift in the ocean. After losing his job he felt completely adrift. The ship broke free and drifted adrift in the storm. Without her mentor she was adrift in the new city.
urduMeaning: پانی میں بغیر لنگر یا سمت کے بہتا ہوا، زندگی میں بے مقصد یا بے سمت، بندش سے آزاد شدہ

englishMeaning: Floating without being fastened or steered, especially on water. Without purpose, guidance, or direction in life. Loose from a fastening or moorings.

synonyms: Grown-up, Mature, Fully grown, Of age, Developed, Ripe
englishMeaning: A fully grown and developed person, animal, or plant. Having reached the age of maturity as defined by law. Suitable for or characteristic of mature people. Emotionally and mentally mature.
examples: Only adults are allowed to enter this section. She handled the situation in a very adult manner. An adult ticket costs twice the price of a child's. The film is intended for an adult audience.
urduMeaning: پوری طرح بالغ انسان   جانور یا پودا، وہ شخص جو قانونی طور پر بالغ ہو، بالغوں کے لیے موزوں یا ان کے مزاج والا، جذباتی اور ذہنی طور پر بالغ

urduMeaning: کسی چیز کے ساتھ اضافی طور پر شامل کی گئی چیز، کسی ادارے سے معاون حیثیت میں وابستہ شخص، دوسری چیز سے جڑی ہوئی مگر بنیادی حصہ نہ ہونے والی چیز
synonyms: Addition, Supplement, Accessory, Appendage, Complement, Attachment, Auxiliary
examples: Exercise is a useful adjunct to a healthy diet. She works as an adjunct professor at the university. The new software is an adjunct to the main system. Good sleep is an important adjunct to recovery.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ سان اضافي طور تي شامل ڪيل شيءِ، ڪنهن اداري سان معاون حيثيت ۾ لاڳاپيل شخص، ٻي شيءِ سان جڙيل پر بنيادي حصو نه هوندڙ
antonyms: Essential, Core, Main, Primary, Necessity, Foundation

englishMeaning: Deserving respect, approval, and praise. Worthy of being admired for good qualities or achievements. Excellent or of very high quality.
synonyms: Praiseworthy, Commendable, Laudable, Excellent, Wonderful, Estimable, Worthy, Respected
examples: Her honesty is truly admirable. He showed admirable courage during the crisis. The teacher did an admirable job with the students. Their patience under pressure was admirable.
urduMeaning: احترام، تعریف اور ستائش کے لائق، اچھی خصوصیات یا کامیابیوں کی وجہ سے قابلِ تحسین، بہترین یا اعلیٰ معیار کا حامل
sindhiMeaning: عزت، تعريف ۽ تحسين جي لائق، سٺين خصوصيتن يا ڪاميابين جي ڪري ساراهڻ جي قابل، بهترين يا اعليٰ معيار وارو
antonyms: Contemptible, Deplorable, Blameworthy, Despicable, Poor, Unworthy, Shameful
