urduMeaning: اعلی اخلاقی سماجی یا سیاسی ideals رکھنے والا، عملی حدوں سے زیادہ امیدوں اور اصولوں پر چلنے والا، نیک مگر کبھی غیر حقیقت پسند
sindhiMeaning: اعليٰ اخلاقي سماجي يا سياسي آدرشن وارو، عملي حدن کان وڌيڪ اميدن ۽ اصولن تي هلندڙ، شريف پر ڪڏهن غير حقيقي
synonyms: Visionary, Principled, Noble, Optimistic, Romantic, Utopian, High-minded, Hopeful
antonyms: Practical, Realistic, Cynical, Materialistic, Pragmatic, Worldly, Hardheaded
englishMeaning: Having high moral, social, or political ideals. Guided by hopes and principles more than practical limits. Noble but sometimes unrealistic.

antonyms: Spiritual, Idealistic, Generous, Selfless, Nonmaterial, Altruistic, Simple
sindhiMeaning: پئسي ملڪيت يا جسماني آرام سان گهڻو لاڳاپيل، روحاني اخلاقي يا ذهني شين کان وڌيڪ مادي شين کي اهميت ڏيندڙ
urduMeaning: پیسے جائیداد یا جسمانی آرام سے بہت زیادہ متعلق، روحانی اخلاقی یا ذہنی چیزوں سے زیادہ مادی چیزوں کو اہمیت دینے والا
examples: The story criticizes a materialistic lifestyle. He became less materialistic after traveling. Materialistic values can weaken relationships. She disliked the materialistic tone of the advertisement.
synonyms: Greedy, Possessive, Worldly, Consumerist, Money-minded, Acquisitive, Mercenary, Earthly
englishMeaning: Overly concerned with money, possessions, or physical comfort. Valuing material things more than spiritual, moral, or intellectual matters.

urduMeaning: اپنی قوم سے سخت وابستہ کبھی حد سے زیادہ یا دوسروں کو خارج کرنے والا، قوم پرستی سے متعلق، قومی مفادات اور شناخت کو ترجیح دینے والا
antonyms: Internationalist, Global, Cosmopolitan, Unpatriotic, Anti-national, Universalist
sindhiMeaning: پنهنجي قوم سان سخت وابستگي رکندڙ ڪڏهن حد کان وڌيڪ يا ٻين کي ٻاهر رکندڙ، قوم پرستي سان لاڳاپيل، قومي مفادن ۽ سڃاڻپ کي ترجيح ڏيندڙ
synonyms: Patriotic, Nationalist, Chauvinistic, Jingoistic, Pro-national, Loyalist, Flag-waving
englishMeaning: Strongly devoted to one's nation, sometimes in an extreme or excluding way. Relating to nationalism. Favoring national interests and identity.
examples: Nationalistic speeches filled the campaign. The movement had a nationalistic tone. Nationalistic pride can unite or divide people. The song became a nationalistic symbol.

englishMeaning: A person or team that reaches the final stage of a competition. A competitor selected for the last round. A candidate still eligible for the final decision.
urduMeaning: مقابلے کے آخری مرحلے تک پہنچنے والا شخص یا ٹیم، آخری راؤنڈ کے لیے منتخب امیدوار، آخری فیصلے کے لیے ابھی اہل امیدوار
antonyms: Loser, Eliminated person, Nonfinalist, Beginner, Spectator, Outsider
synonyms: Contestant, Competitor, Qualifier, Candidate, Shortlisted person, Runner-up, Entrant
examples: She was a finalist in the spelling contest. Three finalists will interview tomorrow. The team became a finalist after a close match. Every finalist received a certificate.
sindhiMeaning: مقابلي جي آخري مرحلي تائين پهچندڙ شخص يا ٽيم، آخري رائونڊ لاءِ چونڊيل مقابلي ڪندڙ، آخري فيصلي لاءِ اڃا اهل اميدوار

urduMeaning: بیلسٹک میزائل یا پروجیکٹائل روکنے یا دفاع کے لیے بنایا گیا، بیلسٹک ہتھیاروں کے خلاف، تیز رفتار میزائل روکنے والے نظام سے متعلق
synonyms: Missile-defense, Intercepting, Defensive, Protective, Countermissile, Anti-missile
examples: The country tested an anti-ballistic missile system. Anti-ballistic shields protect against incoming rockets. Engineers improved the anti-ballistic radar. The treaty limited anti-ballistic defenses.
englishMeaning: Designed to stop or defend against ballistic missiles or projectiles. Opposing ballistic weapons. Relating to systems that intercept fast-moving missiles.
sindhiMeaning: بالسٽڪ ميزائل يا پروجيڪٽائل روڪڻ يا بچاءَ لاءِ ٺهيل، بالسٽڪ هٿيارن جي مخالفت ڪندڙ، تيز ميزائل روڪيندڙ نظام سان لاڳاپيل
antonyms: Offensive, Ballistic, Unprotected, Aggressive, Vulnerable, Nondefensive
Complex, Nuanced, Sophisticated, Detailed, Thorough, Subtle, Comprehensive
synonyms: Oversimple, Superficial, Naive, Shallow, Basic, Crude, Reductionist, Plain
englishMeaning: Too simple and ignoring important details. Overly basic or superficial. Treating a complex matter as if it were easy.
sindhiMeaning: حد کان وڌيڪ سادو ۽ اهم تفصيلن کي نظرانداز ڪندڙ، مٿاڇرو يا تمام بنيادي، پيچيده معاملي کي آسان سمجهندڙ
urduMeaning: حد سے زیادہ سادہ اور اہم تفصیلات کو نظر انداز کرنے والا، سطحی یا بہت بنیادی، پیچیدہ معاملے کو آسان سمجھنے والا
examples: The article gives a simplistic explanation of poverty. His solution was neat but simplistic. We should avoid simplistic answers to complex problems. The diagram is useful but somewhat simplistic.

sindhiMeaning: سرمائيداري نظام جو حامي، ڪاروبار ۾ سرمايو رکندڙ يا لڳائيندڙ شخص، نجي ملڪيت ۽ نفعي تي ٻڌل اقتصادي نظام سان لاڳاپيل
englishMeaning: A person who supports capitalism. Someone who owns or invests capital in business. Relating to an economic system based on private ownership and profit.
antonyms: Socialist, Communist, Worker, Anti-capitalist, Collectivist, Laborer
synonyms: Investor, Entrepreneur, Financier, Businessperson, Industrialist, Free-market supporter, Capital owner
urduMeaning: سرمایہ داری کا حامی، کاروبار میں سرمایہ رکھنے یا لگانے والا شخص، نجی ملکیت اور منافع پر مبنی معاشی نظام سے متعلق
examples: The capitalist invested in several factories. Critics questioned the capitalist model. The country adopted capitalist reforms. She wrote about capitalist society and labor.

antonyms: Farm, Market, Fresh shop, Restaurant, Field, Fishery
urduMeaning: کھانا خاص طور پر مچھلی پھل یا سبزیاں ڈبوں میں بند کرنے کا کارخانہ، بند برتنوں میں خوراک محفوظ کرنے کی جگہ
sindhiMeaning: کاڌو خاص ڪري مڇي ميوا يا ڀاڄيون ڊٻن ۾ بند ڪندڙ ڪارخانو، بند برتنن ۾ کاڌو محفوظ ڪرڻ جي جاءِ
englishMeaning: A factory where food, especially fish, fruit, or vegetables, is canned. A place for preserving food in sealed containers.
examples: The old cannery stood near the harbor. Many workers packed salmon at the cannery. The town grew around a fruit cannery. The cannery closed after the fishing industry declined.
synonyms: Food factory, Packing plant, Canning factory, Processing plant, Preserving factory
Pasta, Stuffed pasta, Italian dish, Pasta tubes, Baked pasta, Manicotti
examples: We ordered spinach cannelloni for dinner. Cannelloni is often baked with tomato sauce. She filled the cannelloni with cheese. The restaurant serves homemade cannelloni.
sindhiMeaning: وڏن نلن جهڙي اطالوي پاسٽا جيڪا ڀري ساس سان پچائي ويندي، ڀريل پاسٽا ٽيوبن مان ٺهيل کاڌو
englishMeaning: A type of Italian pasta shaped as large tubes, usually filled and baked with sauce. A dish made with stuffed pasta tubes.
urduMeaning: بڑی نلکیوں جیسی اطالوی پاستا جو بھر کر ساس کے ساتھ پکائی جاتی ہے، بھرے ہوئے پاستا ٹیوبوں سے بنا کھانا
antonyms: Rice, Bread, Soup, Salad, Dessert, Noodles only

sindhiMeaning: ممڪن يا اجازت ڏنل سڀ کان وڏي مقدار عدد يا درجو، سڀ کان مٿانهين حد، حد جو مٿيون ڪنارو
synonyms: Highest, Greatest, Largest, Utmost, Limit, Peak, Ceiling, Top
examples: The maximum speed is eighty kilometers per hour. The room holds a maximum of fifty people. She worked with maximum effort. Temperatures reached their maximum in July.
antonyms: Minimum, Lowest, Least, Smallest, Bottom, Floor, Minimum amount
urduMeaning: ممکن یا اجازت شدہ سب سے بڑی مقدار عدد یا درجہ، سب سے اوپر حد، حد کا بالائی کنارہ
englishMeaning: The greatest amount, number, or degree possible or allowed. The highest limit. The upper boundary of a range.

examples: The minimum age is eighteen. We need a minimum of three volunteers. Keep noise to a minimum. The temperature fell to its minimum at dawn.
urduMeaning: ممکن یا اجازت شدہ سب سے چھوٹی مقدار عدد یا درجہ، سب سے نچلی حد، کم سے کم ضرورت
synonyms: Lowest, Least, Smallest, Minimal, Floor, Limit, Basic requirement
sindhiMeaning: ممڪن يا اجازت ڏنل سڀ کان ننڍي مقدار عدد يا درجو، سڀ کان هيٺين حد، گهٽ ۾ گهٽ گهرج
antonyms: Maximum, Highest, Greatest, Largest, Peak, Excess, Upper limit
englishMeaning: The smallest amount, number, or degree possible or allowed. The lowest limit. The least requirement.

sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي ممڪن حد تائين وڌائڻ جو عمل، قدر فائدي نفعي يا اثر کي وڌ کان وڌ ڪرڻ
antonyms: Minimization, Reduction, Decrease, Limitation, Shrinkage, Diminution
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو ممکن حد تک بڑھانے کا عمل، قدر فائدے منافع یا اثر کو زیادہ سے زیادہ کرنا
synonyms: Increase, Optimization, Enlargement, Expansion, Amplification, Maximizing, Growth, Enhancement
englishMeaning: The act of making something as large, high, or great as possible. Increasing a value, benefit, profit, or effect to the maximum.
examples: The company focused on profit maximization. Maximization of resources requires careful planning. The algorithm performs score maximization. Health should not be sacrificed for maximization of output.

urduMeaning: آواز سے متعلق، منہ سے کہا گیا یا آواز میں ظاہر کیا گیا، اپنی رائے کھل کر بیان کرنے والا، گانے کے لیے پیدا یا استعمال ہونے والا
antonyms: Silent, Quiet, Written, Mute, Unspoken, Inaudible, Tacit
englishMeaning: Relating to the voice. Spoken or expressed aloud. Willing to express opinions strongly. Produced by or used for singing.
synonyms: Voice, Spoken, Oral, Expressive, Outspoken, Singing, Articulate, Verbal
examples: She has strong vocal ability. The group was vocal in its criticism. Vocal exercises helped the singer. The poem has a clear vocal rhythm.
sindhiMeaning: آواز سان لاڳاپيل، وات سان چيل يا آواز ۾ ظاهر ڪيل، پنهنجي راءِ زور سان ٻڌائڻ وارو، ڳائڻ لاءِ پيدا يا استعمال ٿيندڙ

synonyms: Transform, Change, Shift, Convert, Alter, Evolve, Mutate, Metamorphose
englishMeaning: To change gradually from one form into another. To transform in appearance, shape, or character. A changed form or variant in biology or linguistics.
examples: The cartoon face began to morph into an animal. The project morphed into a larger plan. Some insects morph during development. The software can morph one image into another.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ روپ کان ٻئي روپ ۾ آهستي بدلجڻ، صورت شڪل يا ڪردار ۾ تبديل ٿيڻ، حياتيات يا لسانيات ۾ بدلجندڙ صورت يا قسم
urduMeaning: ایک شکل سے دوسری شکل میں آہستہ بدلنا، صورت شکل یا کردار میں تبدیل ہونا، حیاتیات یا لسانیات میں بدلی ہوئی صورت یا قسم
antonyms: Remain, Stay, Preserve, Freeze, Stabilize, Keep, Unchange

synonyms: Opioid, Analgesic, Painkiller, Narcotic, Opiate, Pain medicine
examples: The doctor prescribed morphine after surgery. Morphine must be used carefully. The patient received morphine for severe pain. Misuse of morphine can be dangerous.
urduMeaning: افیون سے بنی یا مصنوعی طاقتور درد کم کرنے والی دوا، شدید درد کے لیے استعمال ہونے والی نشہ آور دوا، اوپیئڈ دردکش جو عادت ڈال سکتی ہے
englishMeaning: A powerful pain-relieving drug made from opium or produced synthetically. A narcotic medicine used for severe pain. An opioid analgesic that can be addictive.
antonyms: Placebo, Nonopioid, Stimulant, Pain, Discomfort, Untreated pain
sindhiMeaning: افيم مان ٺهيل يا مصنوعي طاقتور درد گهٽائيندڙ دوا، سخت درد لاءِ استعمال ٿيندڙ نشيلي دوا، اوپيئڊ دردڪش جيڪا عادت وجهي سگهي ٿي

synonyms: Meaning unit, Word part, Root, Prefix, Suffix, Linguistic unit, Formative
urduMeaning: زبان کی سب سے چھوٹی معنی رکھنے والی اکائی، لفظ کا حصہ جیسے جڑ سابقہ یا لاحقہ جو معنی رکھتا ہے
examples: The word unhappy has two morphemes. A morpheme may be a whole word or a word part. Students identified each morpheme in the sentence. The suffix ed is a past-tense morpheme.
englishMeaning: The smallest meaningful unit in a language. A word part such as a root, prefix, or suffix that carries meaning.
sindhiMeaning: ٻولي جو سڀ کان ننڍو معنيٰ رکندڙ جزو، لفظ جو حصو جهڙوڪ بنياد اڳياڙي يا پڇاڙي جيڪو مطلب رکي
antonyms: Sentence, Paragraph, Sound only, Letter only, Whole text

urduMeaning: ریاضی میں ساخت محفوظ رکھتے ہوئے ایک شے سے دوسری کی طرف نقشہ، فنی استعمال میں تبدیل شدہ صورت، ایسا تعلق جو عمل یا نمونہ برقرار رکھ کر چیزوں کو جوڑے
englishMeaning: A structure-preserving map between mathematical objects. A transformation or form in technical usage. A relation that connects objects while preserving operations or patterns.
antonyms: Nonmapping, Disconnection, Break, Random change, Structure loss
sindhiMeaning: رياضي ۾ بناوت محفوظ رکندي هڪ شيءِ کان ٻي ڏانهن نقشو، فني استعمال ۾ تبديل صورت، اهڙو تعلق جيڪو عمل يا نمونو برقرار رکي شين کي ڳنڍي
synonyms: Map, Function, Transformation, Homomorphism, Mapping, Relation, Arrow, Correspondence
examples: The professor explained a morphism between two groups. A morphism preserves important structure. Category theory studies objects and morphisms. The diagram shows how each morphism connects the spaces.

urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو عام لوگوں کے لیے قابل رسائی بنانا، تنظیم یا نظام کو زیادہ جمہوری بنانا، طاقت موقعہ یا علم کو وسیع پیمانے پر پھیلانا
antonyms: Restrict, Centralize, Monopolize, Exclude, Privatize, Limit, Elitize
synonyms: Open up, Liberalize, Popularize, Equalize, Make accessible, Decentralize, Share power
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي عام ماڻهن لاءِ دستياب بڻائڻ، تنظيم يا نظام کي وڌيڪ جمهوري بڻائڻ، طاقت موقعو يا علم کي وڏي پيماني تي ورهائڻ
englishMeaning: To make something accessible to ordinary people. To make an organization or system more democratic. To spread power, opportunity, or knowledge more widely.
examples: The internet helped democratize information. Reforms aimed to democratize local government. Low-cost tools can democratize education. The movement tried to democratize access to art.

synonyms: Popular rule, Self-government, Republic, Representative government, Political equality, Freedom
urduMeaning: ایسا حکومتی نظام جس میں لوگ ووٹ سے رہنما چنیں، عوام کی حکمرانی، سیاسی برابری حقوق اور شرکت پر مبنی معاشرہ
examples: Democracy depends on free elections. Citizens have responsibilities in a democracy. The movement demanded democracy and basic rights. A healthy democracy protects minority voices.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙو حڪومتي نظام جنهن ۾ ماڻهو ووٽ سان اڳواڻ چونڊين، عوام جي حڪمراني، سياسي برابري حقن ۽ شرڪت تي ٻڌل سماج
antonyms: Dictatorship, Autocracy, Tyranny, Monarchy, Authoritarianism, Oligarchy
englishMeaning: A system of government in which people choose leaders by voting. Rule by the people. A society based on political equality, rights, and participation.

urduMeaning: فلم اینیمیشن اشتہار یا پریزنٹیشن کے مناظر کا منصوبہ بند خاکہ یا پینلوں کا سلسلہ، کہانی یا منصوبے کو تصویری پینلوں میں ترتیب دینا
antonyms: Impromptu filming, Final film, Random sequence, Unplanned scene, Text only
synonyms: Visual plan, Scene plan, Panels, Sketch sequence, Layout, Shot plan, Outline
sindhiMeaning: فلم اينيميشن اشتهار يا پريزنٽيشن جي منظرن جو رٿيل خاڪو يا پينلن جو سلسلو، ڪهاڻي يا منصوبي کي تصويري پينلن ۾ رٿڻ
examples: The director reviewed the storyboard before filming. Students created a storyboard for their video. We need to storyboard the opening scene. The storyboard helped everyone understand the sequence.
englishMeaning: A sequence of drawings or panels showing the planned scenes of a film, animation, advertisement, or presentation. To plan a story or project visually in panels.

antonyms: Calm, Peaceful, Clear, Quiet, Sunny, Settled, Mild, Tranquil
sindhiMeaning: طوفان سان متاثر، تيز هوا مينهن گجگوڙ يا خراب موسم سان ڀريل، تڪرار جذبي يا بي چيني سان ڀريل
synonyms: Turbulent, Tempestuous, Rough, Windy, Rainy, Unsettled, Violent, Emotional
englishMeaning: Affected by storms. Full of strong wind, rain, thunder, or rough weather. Marked by conflict, emotion, or disturbance.
examples: We stayed indoors during the stormy night. Their marriage had a stormy period. The sea looked dark and stormy. A stormy debate followed the announcement.
urduMeaning: طوفان سے متاثر، تیز ہوا بارش گرج یا خراب موسم سے بھرا، تنازع جذبات یا بے چینی سے بھرا

sindhiMeaning: تيز هوا مينهن گجگوڙ برف يا مٽي سان سخت موسمي واقعو، احساس احتجاج يا حملي جو اوچتو ڦاٽ، زور سان هلڻ يا حملو ڪرڻ
antonyms: Calm, Peace, Stillness, Quiet, Clear weather, Tranquility, Retreat
englishMeaning: A violent weather event with strong wind, rain, thunder, snow, or dust. A sudden outburst of emotion, protest, or attack. To move or attack forcefully.
examples: A storm damaged the roof. The decision caused a storm of criticism. Soldiers tried to storm the gate. She stormed out of the room angrily.
urduMeaning: تیز ہوا بارش گرج برف یا گرد کے ساتھ سخت موسمی واقعہ، احساس احتجاج یا حملے کا اچانک پھٹ پڑنا، زور سے چلنا یا حملہ کرنا
synonyms: Tempest, Gale, Squall, Outburst, Uproar, Attack, Rage, Thunderstorm

examples: She caught a fleeting glimpse of the bird. Happiness can feel fleeting. A fleeting smile crossed his face. The chance was fleeting, so we acted quickly.
synonyms: Brief, Momentary, Short-lived, Passing, Temporary, Transient, Ephemeral, Quick
antonyms: Lasting, Permanent, Enduring, Long-term, Constant, Durable, Persistent
sindhiMeaning: تمام ٿوري وقت لاءِ رهندڙ، جلدي گذرندڙ، عارضي ۽ مختصر
urduMeaning: بہت کم وقت تک رہنے والا، جلد گزر جانے والا، عارضی اور مختصر
englishMeaning: Lasting for a very short time. Passing quickly. Temporary and brief.

synonyms: Briefly, Momentarily, Quickly, Temporarily, Transiently, Shortly, For an instant
englishMeaning: For a very short time. Briefly or momentarily. In a way that passes quickly.
urduMeaning: بہت کم وقت کے لیے، مختصر یا لمحاتی طور پر، جلد گزر جانے والے انداز میں
examples: She looked at him fleetingly. The idea crossed my mind fleetingly. Sunlight appeared fleetingly between the clouds. He smiled fleetingly and walked away.
sindhiMeaning: تمام ٿوري وقت لاءِ، مختصر يا لمحي طور، جلدي گذرندڙ انداز ۾
antonyms: Permanently, Lastingly, Constantly, Enduringly, Continuously, Long-term

synonyms: Manager, Executive, Supervisor, Director, Controller, Coordinator, Officer, Organizer
examples: The school administrator answered parents' questions. A system administrator fixed the server. The court appointed an administrator for the estate. Good administrators keep records clear.
sindhiMeaning: ادارو آفيس نظام يا پروگرام هلائيندڙ شخص، قاعدن رڪارڊن ۽ ڪاررواين جو ذميوار، ملڪيت يا رسمي عمل سنڀاليندڙ ماڻهو
englishMeaning: A person who manages an organization, office, system, or program. Someone responsible for rules, records, and operations. A person who administers an estate or official process.
antonyms: Worker, Subordinate, Trainee, Follower, Client, User, Employee
urduMeaning: ادارہ دفتر نظام یا پروگرام چلانے والا شخص، قواعد ریکارڈ اور کارروائیوں کا ذمہ دار، جائیداد یا رسمی عمل سنبھالنے والا شخص

examples: She handles administrative tasks. The administrative office is on the second floor. New administrative rules were announced. The project needs administrative approval.

synonyms: Managerial, Executive, Organizational, Official, Office, Procedural, Bureaucratic
antonyms: Operational only, Nonofficial, Informal, Personal, Unmanaged, Nonadministrative
urduMeaning: تنظیم کے انتظام یا چلانے سے متعلق، دفتری کام قواعد ریکارڈ یا رسمی طریقہ کار سے وابستہ
englishMeaning: Relating to the management or operation of an organization. Connected with office duties, rules, records, or official procedures.

antonyms: Unofficially, Informally, Personally, Casually, Privately, Nonprocedurally
englishMeaning: In a way related to management, official procedures, or organizational control. From an administrative point of view. By official office action.
examples: The departments were administratively combined. Administratively, the change is simple. The case was closed administratively. The school is administratively responsible for the program.
urduMeaning: انتظامی یا رسمی طریقہ کار سے، انتظامی نقطہ نظر سے، دفتری کارروائی کے ذریعے
synonyms: Officially, Managerially, Organizationally, Procedurally, Bureaucratically, Operationally
sindhiMeaning: انتظامي يا رسمي طريقيڪار سان، انتظامي نقطه نظر کان، آفيسي عمل ذريعي
ڪنهن شيءِ چونڊڻ استعمال ڪرڻ يا ڪرڻ جي صلاح ڏيڻ، ڪنهن شخص يا شيءِ بابت سٺي راءِ ڏيڻ، مناسب يا فائديمند سمجهي سفارش ڪرڻ
antonyms: Discourage, Oppose, Reject, Warn against, Disapprove, Criticize, Dissuade
englishMeaning: To suggest that someone should choose, use, or do something. To speak favorably about a person or thing. To advise as suitable or beneficial.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو چننے استعمال کرنے یا کرنے کا مشورہ دینا، کسی شخص یا چیز کے بارے میں اچھی رائے دینا، مناسب یا مفید سمجھ کر سفارش کرنا
synonyms: Suggest, Advise, Endorse, Propose, Commend, Urge, Counsel, Approve
examples: I recommend this book to beginners. The doctor recommended more rest. She recommended him for the job. Experts recommend saving a little money every month.

sindhiMeaning: رڪجڻ کان پوءِ ٻيهر شروع ٿيڻ، سرگرمي ٻيهر شروع يا جاري ڪرڻ، هڪ ڀيرو وري آغاز ڪرڻ
englishMeaning: To begin again after stopping. To restart or resume an activity. To start once more.
examples: Classes will recommence on Monday. Work recommenced after the storm. The meeting recommenced after lunch. They waited for the music to recommence.
synonyms: Restart, Resume, Begin again, Continue, Reopen, Renew, Start over
antonyms: Stop, Cease, End, Finish, Suspend, Halt, Discontinue
urduMeaning: رکنے کے بعد دوبارہ شروع ہونا، سرگرمی دوبارہ شروع یا جاری کرنا، ایک بار پھر آغاز کرنا

antonyms: Warning, Discouragement, Rejection, Opposition, Disapproval, Criticism
urduMeaning: مشورہ یا تجویز، کسی شخص یا چیز کی حمایت میں رسمی بیان، سفارش کرنے کا عمل
synonyms: Suggestion, Advice, Proposal, Endorsement, Reference, Counsel, Tip, Commendation
examples: The committee made a recommendation. She wrote a recommendation for her student. I followed the doctor's recommendation. The report includes several recommendations.
englishMeaning: A suggestion or piece of advice. A formal statement supporting someone or something. The act of recommending.
sindhiMeaning: صلاح يا مشورو، ڪنهن شخص يا شيءِ جي حمايت ۾ رسمي بيان، سفارش ڪرڻ جو عمل

synonyms: Compensation, Payment, Reward, Repayment, Restitution, Reimbursement, Amends
sindhiMeaning: محنت نقصان يا زخمي ٿيڻ جو معاوضو يا انعام، نقصان يا خدمت جي تلافي، واپس ادا ڪرڻ يا ازالو ڪرڻ
examples: The workers received recompense for overtime. No money could recompense her for the loss. The court ordered recompense for damages. He hoped kindness would be recompensed.
englishMeaning: Payment or reward for effort, loss, or injury. Compensation for damage or service. To repay or make amends.
antonyms: Penalty, Loss, Debt, Nonpayment, Punishment, Damage, Fine
urduMeaning: محنت نقصان یا زخم کا معاوضہ یا انعام، نقصان یا خدمت کی تلافی، واپس ادا کرنا یا ازالہ کرنا
نقصان چوٹ یا کام کا معاوضہ دینا، کسی کمی یا نقصان کا ازالہ کرنا، اثر کو برابر یا متوازن کرنا
englishMeaning: To pay someone for loss, injury, or work. To make up for something lacking or harmful. To balance or offset an effect.
examples: The company compensated customers for the delay. Extra training can compensate for lack of experience. The medicine helps compensate for a chemical imbalance. He was compensated for his overtime.
synonyms: Pay, Reimburse, Repay, Offset, Make up for, Balance, Reward, Indemnify
antonyms: Cheat, Underpay, Penalize, Deprive, Charge, Harm, Worsen
sindhiMeaning: نقصان زخمي ٿيڻ يا ڪم جو معاوضو ڏيڻ، ڪنهن گهٽتائي يا نقصان جو ازالو ڪرڻ، اثر کي برابر يا متوازن ڪرڻ

englishMeaning: Payment given for loss, injury, work, or inconvenience. Something that makes up for a disadvantage. The act of compensating. Salary and benefits in employment.
examples: The injured worker received compensation. The job offers fair compensation. Extra vacation was small compensation for the stress. The law provides compensation for victims.
synonyms: Payment, Reimbursement, Damages, Salary, Reward, Restitution, Indemnity, Repayment
urduMeaning: نقصان چوٹ کام یا تکلیف کا معاوضہ، نقصان کے بدلے ملنے والی چیز، ازالے کا عمل، ملازمت میں تنخواہ اور فوائد
antonyms: Loss, Penalty, Fine, Nonpayment, Debt, Damage, Cost
sindhiMeaning: نقصان زخمي ٿيڻ ڪم يا تڪليف جو معاوضو، نقصان جي بدلي ملندڙ شيءِ، ازالي جو عمل، نوڪري ۾ پگهار ۽ فائدا

examples: The court awarded compensatory damages. She took compensatory time off after working late. The program offers compensatory education. His smile was a compensatory gesture after the argument.
synonyms: Restorative, Reimbursing, Corrective, Remedial, Repaying, Offseting, Balancing
englishMeaning: Intended to compensate for loss, damage, weakness, or disadvantage. Providing repayment or correction. Making up for something lacking.
urduMeaning: نقصان کمزوری یا محرومی کا ازالہ کرنے کے لیے، تلافی یا درستگی فراہم کرنے والا، کسی کمی کو پورا کرنے والا
antonyms: Punitive, Harmful, Noncompensating, Damaging, Penal, Unpaid
sindhiMeaning: نقصان ڪمزوري يا محرومي جو ازالو ڪرڻ لاءِ، تلافي يا درستگي فراهم ڪندڙ، ڪنهن گهٽتائي جي پورائي ڪندڙ

antonyms: Empty, Depopulate, Vacate, Clear, Remove, Evacuate, Delete
examples: Immigrants helped populate the region. Please populate the spreadsheet with names. Birds populate the wetlands in spring. The software can populate the fields automatically.
urduMeaning: جگہ کو لوگوں یا جانداروں سے بھرنا، فارم جدول یا نظام میں ڈیٹا یا مواد شامل کرنا، کسی علاقے میں رہنا
englishMeaning: To fill a place with people or living things. To add data or content to a form, table, or system. To live in an area.
sindhiMeaning: جڳهه کي ماڻهن يا جاندارن سان ڀرڻ، فارم ٽيبل يا نظام ۾ ڊيٽا يا مواد شامل ڪرڻ، ڪنهن علائقي ۾ رهڻ
synonyms: Fill, Inhabit, Occupy, Settle, Enter data, Load, Complete, Fill in

examples: He is popularly known as the village doctor. The song became popularly loved. The term is popularly used online. She was popularly elected by the members.
englishMeaning: By many people or among the general public. Commonly or widely. In a way that is generally known or accepted.
synonyms: Widely, Commonly, Generally, Publicly, Famously, Broadly, Universally
sindhiMeaning: گهڻن ماڻهن يا عوام ۾، عام يا وسيع نموني، عام طور ڄاتل يا قبول ڪيل انداز ۾
antonyms: Rarely, Privately, Uncommonly, Obscurely, Narrowly, Secretly
urduMeaning: بہت سے لوگوں یا عام عوام میں، عام یا وسیع طور پر، عمومی طور پر معلوم یا قبول شدہ انداز میں

synonyms: Promote, Spread, Publicize, Make known, Simplify, Introduce, Advertise, Disseminate
examples: The scientist helped popularize astronomy. Social media can popularize new slang quickly. The chef popularized regional dishes. The book popularized complex economic ideas.
englishMeaning: To make something known, liked, or used by many people. To explain an idea in a way the general public can understand. To spread wider interest in something.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي گهڻن ماڻهن ۾ مشهور يا استعمال لائق بڻائڻ، خيال کي عوام لاءِ سمجهه جوڳو بيان ڪرڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ ۾ وسيع دلچسپي پکيڙڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو بہت سے لوگوں میں مشہور یا قابل استعمال بنانا، خیال کو عوام کے لیے قابل فہم انداز میں بیان کرنا، کسی چیز میں وسیع دلچسپی پھیلانا
antonyms: Obscure, Suppress, Hide, Restrict, Complicate, Limit, Conceal

englishMeaning: The state of being liked, admired, or supported by many people. General public favor. Widespread acceptance or use.
examples: The singer's popularity grew quickly. Popularity does not always mean quality. The app gained popularity among students. Her kindness increased her popularity at school.
urduMeaning: بہت سے لوگوں کی پسند تعریف یا حمایت ملنے کی حالت، عام عوامی مقبولیت، وسیع قبولیت یا استعمال
synonyms: Fame, Favor, Acceptance, Approval, Admiration, Renown, Public support, Liking
antonyms: Unpopularity, Dislike, Obscurity, Rejection, Disapproval, Infamy, Neglect
sindhiMeaning: گهڻن ماڻهن طرفان پسند ساراهه يا حمايت ملڻ جي حالت، عام عوامي مقبوليت، وسيع قبوليت يا استعمال
گهڻن ماڻهن ۾ پسند يا مشهور، عام استعمال يا وسيع ڄاتل، ماهرن بدران عام ماڻهن لاءِ ٺاهيل
synonyms: Well-liked, Famous, Common, Widespread, Favored, Admired, Public, Mainstream
englishMeaning: Liked, admired, or supported by many people. Commonly used or widely known. Intended for ordinary people rather than specialists.
examples: The restaurant is popular with families. This is a popular song in many countries. Popular science books explain difficult ideas simply. She became popular because she treated everyone kindly.
antonyms: Unpopular, Unknown, Rare, Disliked, Obscure, Elite, Uncommon
urduMeaning: بہت سے لوگوں میں پسندیدہ یا مشہور، عام استعمال یا وسیع طور پر معروف، ماہرین کے بجائے عام لوگوں کے لیے بنایا گیا

examples: You know your goals best, so sail your boat the way you want. He decided to leave the family business and sail his boat alone. Stop worrying about their opinions and simply sail your boat. She sailed her boat quietly and built a successful career.
sindhiMeaning: پنهنجا معاملا پاڻ سنڀالڻ، پنهنجي راهه تي هلڻ، پنهنجي مرضيءَ سان اڳتي وڌڻ، پنهنجي محنت ۽ سمجهه سان زندگي گذارڻ، جيڪو توهان کي مناسب لڳي سو ڪرڻ
englishMeaning: To manage your own affairs or move forward in life in your own way. An informal expression meaning to do what suits you or to follow your own path. To make progress steadily by using your own effort and judgement. Used to encourage someone to continue with their chosen course of action. Whatever makes you happy, matches your personal taste, or work best for your specific choices.
synonyms: Go your own way, Chart your course, Steer your ship, Manage your affairs, Carry on, Proceed, Move forward, Take charge
urduMeaning: اپنے معاملات خود سنبھالنا، اپنی راہ پر چلنا، اپنی مرضی سے آگے بڑھنا، اپنی محنت اور سوجھ بوجھ سے زندگی گزارنا، جو مناسب لگے وہی کرنا
antonyms: Follow blindly, Depend on others, Give up, Stay stuck, Hesitate, Surrender, Drift aimlessly

examples: They spent the weekend in a luxurious hotel by the sea. The car has a luxurious leather interior. She wrapped herself in a luxurious woollen shawl. The resort offers luxurious rooms at surprisingly fair prices.
urduMeaning: نہایت آرام دہ اور مہنگا، عالیشان اور پرتعیش، آسائشوں سے بھرپور، اعلیٰ معیار کا، حواس کو راحت پہنچانے والا
englishMeaning: Very comfortable, elegant, and expensive. Providing great comfort and pleasure to the senses. Showing or involving costly and high-quality materials. Rich, generous, and indulgent in style or quality.
synonyms: Lavish, Opulent, Sumptuous, Plush, Deluxe, Rich, Elegant, Grand, Extravagant, Comfortable
antonyms: Simple, Plain, Modest, Basic, Shabby, Austere, Cheap, Spartan, Humble
sindhiMeaning: تمام آرامده ۽ قيمتي، عاليشان ۽ شاندار، آسائشن سان ڀرپور، اعليٰ معيار جو ۽ مهانگو، حواسن کي راحت ڏيندڙ
عيش ۽ آرام، آسائش، اهڙي شيءِ جيڪا ضروري ناهي پر آرام ۽ خوشي ڏي، شاهاڻي زندگي، اعليٰ ۽ قيمتي شين جو مزو
antonyms: Poverty, Necessity, Simplicity, Hardship, Austerity, Deprivation, Want
englishMeaning: Great comfort and pleasure obtained from expensive and beautiful things. Something expensive and pleasant that is not necessary for ordinary life. A state of living surrounded by rich and costly surroundings. Relating to goods or services of the highest quality and price.
examples: They lived in luxury after the business succeeded. A quiet morning with a good book is my favourite luxury. The hotel is known for its luxury and excellent service. He bought a luxury watch to celebrate his promotion.
synonyms: Opulence, Comfort, Extravagance, Splendour, Indulgence, Richness, Affluence, Treat
urduMeaning: عیش و آرام، آسائش، ایسی چیز جو ضروری نہ ہو مگر لطف دے، پرتعیش زندگی، اعلیٰ اور مہنگی اشیاء کا لطف

englishMeaning: Having a modern design or quality that seems to belong to the future. Relating to ideas, technology, or styles that are far ahead of the present time. Imagining or describing what life may be like in years to come. Unusually advanced or innovative in appearance or function.
antonyms: Old-fashioned, Traditional, Outdated, Ancient, Retro, Conventional, Primitive
synonyms: Modern, Advanced, Innovative, Cutting-edge, Progressive, Visionary, Ultramodern, Forward-looking
urduMeaning: مستقبل جیسا، آنے والے زمانے سے متعلق، جدید اور بہت آگے کا ڈیزائن رکھنے والا، آئندہ وقت کا تصور پیش کرنے والا، غیر معمولی طور پر جدید
sindhiMeaning: مستقبل جهڙو، ايندڙ زماني سان لاڳاپيل، جديد ۽ اڳتي وڌيل ڊزائين وارو، ايندڙ وقت جو تصور ڏيندڙ، غير معمولي طور جديد
examples: The museum has a futuristic glass dome. He wrote a futuristic novel about life on Mars. Their new office looks bright and futuristic. The concept car has a futuristic shape and silent engine.

antonyms: Historian, Traditionalist, Archivist, Antiquarian
sindhiMeaning: مستقبل جو اڀياس ڪندڙ ماهر، ايندڙ وقت جي اڳڪٿي ڪندڙ، سماجي ۽ سائنسي رجحانن مان مستقبل جو اندازو لڳائيندڙ عالم
urduMeaning: مستقبل کا مطالعہ کرنے والا ماہر، آنے والے وقت کی پیش گوئی کرنے والا، سماجی و سائنسی رجحانات سے مستقبل کا اندازہ لگانے والا
englishMeaning: A person who studies and predicts future developments in society, science, and technology. An expert who analyses present trends in order to forecast what may happen later. A specialist in the field of futurology.
examples: The futurologist predicted that most cars would be electric within a decade. A well-known futurologist addressed the technology conference. Futurologists study data to understand coming social changes. She works as a futurologist for a research institute.
synonyms: Forecaster, Trend analyst, Visionary, Prognosticator, Futurist, Predictor

urduMeaning: مستقبل کا علم، آنے والے حالات کی پیش گوئی کا مطالعہ، سماجی و تکنیکی تبدیلیوں کی پیش بینی کا فن، رجحانات کی بنیاد پر مستقبل کا مطالعہ
antonyms: History, Archaeology, Retrospection, Hindsight
englishMeaning: The systematic study of possible future events and conditions. The practice of forecasting social, economic, and technological developments. A field of research that uses current data and trends to describe likely futures.
synonyms: Forecasting, Foresight studies, Trend analysis, Prediction, Prognostication
sindhiMeaning: مستقبل جو علم، ايندڙ حالتن جي اڳڪٿي جو مطالعو، سماجي ۽ ٽيڪنالاجي تبديلين جي اڳڪٿي ڪرڻ جو فن، رجحانن جي بنياد تي مستقبل جو اڀياس
examples: He teaches futurology at a European university. Futurology helps governments plan for long-term challenges. Her interest in futurology began with science fiction. The report applies futurology to the energy sector.

urduMeaning: مستقبل، آنے والا زمانہ، وہ وقت جو ابھی آنا ہے، آئندہ کے حالات و امکانات، آئندگی
antonyms: Past, History, Bygone days, Present, Antiquity
sindhiMeaning: مستقبل، ايندڙ زمانو، اهو وقت جيڪو اڃا اچڻو آهي، ايندڙ حالتون ۽ امڪان، آئنده جو زمانو
englishMeaning: The future considered as a whole or as a period yet to come. The quality or state of being in the future. Events, conditions, or possibilities that lie ahead. A literary or formal word for time still to come.
examples: The poem reflects on love and futurity. No one can be certain about futurity. He spoke of futurity with quiet hope. Their plans were built on an uncertain futurity.
synonyms: Future, Time to come, Hereafter, Tomorrow, Prospect, Afterlife

sindhiMeaning: مستقبل جي اڳڪٿي ڪندڙ ماڻهو، اهو شخص جنهن جا خيال ۽ ڪم مستقبل تي مرڪوز هجن، فن ۾ فيوچرزم جو پيروڪار، جديديت پسند
antonyms: Traditionalist, Conservative, Historian, Reactionary
synonyms: Visionary, Forecaster, Futurologist, Innovator, Modernist, Trend analyst
urduMeaning: مستقبل کی پیش گوئی کرنے والا شخص، وہ شخص جس کے خیالات و کام مستقبل پر مرکوز ہوں، فن میں فیوچرزم کا پیروکار، جدت پسند
examples: The futurist believes robots will assist in most homes. Her futurist ideas influenced modern architecture. He is a futurist who advises large companies. The gallery displays futurist paintings from the last century.
englishMeaning: A person who studies or predicts what will happen in the future. Someone whose ideas, work, or designs are focused on the future. Relating to art or design movements concerned with modern speed and technology. A follower of futurism in art or literature.

sindhiMeaning: ويهين صديءَ جي شروعات جي هڪ فني تحريڪ جيڪا رفتار ۽ مشينن جي تعريف ڪندي هئي، روايت کي رد ڪري جديديت کي ساراهيندڙ فن، مستقبل تي مرڪوز نظريو
synonyms: Modernism, Avant-garde, Progressivism, Innovation, Vanguardism
examples: Futurism began in Italy in the early 1900s. The exhibition explains the influence of futurism on design. Futurism admired machines, speed, and city life. Critics argue that futurism ignored the value of tradition.
englishMeaning: An early twentieth-century artistic movement that celebrated speed, machinery, and modern life. A style in art, music, or literature that rejects tradition and praises technology. The belief that society should be shaped by future possibilities rather than the past.
antonyms: Traditionalism, Classicism, Conservatism, Revivalism
urduMeaning: بیسویں صدی کے آغاز کی ایک فنی تحریک جو رفتار اور مشینوں کو سراہتی تھی، روایت کو رد کر کے جدت کو اپنانے والا فن، مستقبل پر مرکوز نظریہ

sindhiMeaning: نرم ۽ ننڍڙا وار يا ريشا، ڪنهن تصوير يا آواز جو ڌنڌلو هجڻ، گٽار جو ٿلهو ۽ بگڙيل آواز، ڌنڌلو ٿي وڃڻ، پوليس لاءِ عام ٻولي ۾ لفظ
synonyms: Fluff, Down, Lint, Haze, Blur, Distortion, Nap, Frizz
examples: There was a soft fuzz on the surface of the peach. The old photograph has lost detail and shows only fuzz. He added fuzz to the guitar for a rougher sound. The picture began to fuzz as the signal weakened.
antonyms: Clarity, Sharpness, Smoothness, Focus, Precision
englishMeaning: A mass of short, soft, light fibres or hairs. A blurred or unclear appearance in an image or sound. A distorted electric guitar effect. To become blurred or indistinct. An informal and slang term for the police.
urduMeaning: نرم اور چھوٹے بال یا ریشے، تصویر یا آواز کا دھندلا پن، گٹار کی بھاری اور بگڑی ہوئی آواز، دھندلا ہو جانا، پولیس کے لیے عامیانہ لفظ

antonyms: Clearly, Sharply, Distinctly, Precisely, Vividly
englishMeaning: In a blurred or unclear manner. Without sharp definition or precise detail. In a soft, fluffy way. In a confused or vague manner of thinking or speaking.
urduMeaning: دھندلے انداز میں، غیر واضح طور پر، بغیر صفائی کے، نرم و ملائم انداز میں، الجھے ہوئے انداز میں سوچتے یا بولتے ہوئے
sindhiMeaning: ڌنڌلي انداز ۾، صاف يا واضح نه، غير واضح طور تي، نرم ۽ ريشمي انداز سان، مونجهاري واري نموني سوچيندي يا ڳالهائيندي
examples: The distant hills appeared fuzzily through the mist. He remembered the evening only fuzzily. The text was printed fuzzily on cheap paper. She spoke fuzzily after waking from a deep sleep.
synonyms: Blurrily, Vaguely, Indistinctly, Hazily, Unclearly, Dimly
Blurriness, Haziness, Vagueness, Ambiguity, Indistinctness, Softness
urduMeaning: دھندلاپن، وضاحت کی کمی، نرم بالوں سے ڈھکے ہونے کی حالت، سوچ یا زبان میں ابہام اور غیر واضح پن
examples: The fuzziness of the image made the text unreadable. There is some fuzziness in the definition of the term. He complained about the fuzziness of the old television screen. The fuzziness of the fabric made it pleasant to touch.
englishMeaning: The state of being blurred, unclear, or lacking sharp detail. The quality of being covered with soft short hairs. Vagueness or lack of precision in thought, language, or definition.
sindhiMeaning: ڌنڌلائي، وضاحت جي کوٽ، نرم وارن سان ڍڪيل هجڻ جي حالت، سوچ يا ٻوليءَ ۾ مونجهارو ۽ غير واضح پڻو
antonyms: Clarity, Sharpness, Precision, Definition, Exactness
Clean channel, Acoustic sound, Unamplified tone
urduMeaning: ایک برقی آلہ جو گٹار کی آواز کو بگاڑتا ہے، گٹار کا ایفیکٹ پیڈل جو بھاری اور گونجتی آواز پیدا کرتا ہے، موسیقی میں فز ایفیکٹ کا آلہ
sindhiMeaning: هڪ اليڪٽرانڪ اوزار جيڪو گٽار جي آواز کي بگاڙي ٿو، گٽار جو اثر پيڊل جيڪو ٿلهو ۽ گونجندڙ آواز پيدا ڪري، ميوزڪ ۾ فز اثر ڏيندڙ ڊبي
examples: He switched on the fuzzbox for the guitar solo. The band's sound depends heavily on an old fuzzbox. She bought a vintage fuzzbox from a music shop. A fuzzbox can turn a clean tone into a growling one.
englishMeaning: An electronic device that distorts the sound of an electric guitar. A guitar effects pedal used to create a rough, buzzing tone. A common name for a fuzz effect unit in music.
synonyms: Fuzz pedal, Distortion pedal, Effects pedal, Overdrive unit, Stompbox

urduMeaning: بجلی کا حفاظتی آلہ جو زیادہ کرنٹ پر پگھل کر رابطہ توڑ دیتا ہے، دھماکے کو آگ دینے والی بتی، دو یا زیادہ چیزوں کو ملا کر ایک کرنا، حرارت سے پگھل کر جڑ جانا، فیوز اڑنے سے بند ہو جانا
antonyms: Separate, Divide, Split, Detach, Disconnect, Scatter
synonyms: Merge, Blend, Combine, Unite, Weld, Amalgamate, Melt, Integrate
englishMeaning: A safety device in an electrical circuit that melts and breaks the connection when the current is too strong. A length of material that is burned to set off an explosive. To join or blend two or more things into a single whole. To melt together under heat. To stop working because a fuse has melted.
sindhiMeaning: بجليءَ جو حفاظتي اوزار جيڪو گهڻي ڪرنٽ تي پگهري ڪري رستو ڪٽي ٿو، ڌماڪي کي باهه ڏيندڙ تند، ٻن يا وڌيڪ شين کي ملائي هڪ ڪرڻ، گرميءَ سان گڏجي پگهرجڻ، فيوز اڏامڻ ڪري بند ٿي وڃڻ
examples: The fuse blew when we switched on the heater. Engineers fuse copper wires with great care. The film fuses comedy and social criticism. He lit the fuse and stepped back quickly.

sindhiMeaning: بم يا گولي کي ڦاٽائڻ وارو اوزار، مقرر وقت تي ڌماڪو ڪرائڻ وارو نظام، فوجي اصطلاح ۾ فيوز جو ٻيو لکڻي انداز، ڌماڪيدار شيءِ ۾ اهڙو اوزار لڳائڻ
antonyms: Safety catch, Deactivator, Disarming device
urduMeaning: بم یا گولے کو پھاڑنے والا آلہ، مقررہ وقت پر دھماکہ کرانے والا نظام، فوجی اصطلاح میں فیوز کا متبادل ہجہ، دھماکہ خیز شے میں ایسا آلہ لگانا
examples: The shell was fitted with a delayed-action fuze. Engineers inspected the fuze before the test. A faulty fuze can make a weapon extremely dangerous. Technicians carefully fuze each device in the workshop.
synonyms: Detonator, Trigger, Igniter, Primer, Firing device
englishMeaning: A device that triggers the explosion of a bomb, shell, or missile. A mechanism designed to detonate an explosive at a chosen moment. An alternative spelling of fuse used mainly in military contexts. To fit an explosive device with such a mechanism.

synonyms: Slope, Incline, Slant, Grade, Pitch, Rise, Transition, Ramp
urduMeaning: ڈھلان یا چڑھائی کا درجہ، سڑک یا سطح کی ڈھال کی پیمائش، رنگ یا شدت میں بتدریج تبدیلی، کسی مقدار کے فاصلے کے ساتھ بدلنے کی شرح، ریاضی میں خط کی ڈھلان
examples: The road has a steep gradient near the top of the hill. The designer used a soft gradient from blue to green. Scientists measured the temperature gradient in the lake. Cyclists struggled with the sharp gradient of the mountain pass.
sindhiMeaning: لاهي يا چاڙهي جو درجو، رستي يا سطح جو ڍلائي وارو ماپ، رنگ يا شدت ۾ آهستي آهستي تبديلي، ڪنهن مقدار جي مفاصلي سان بدلجڻ جي رفتار، رياضيءَ ۾ لڪير جي ڍلائي
englishMeaning: The degree of slope or steepness of a road, hill, or surface. A gradual change in colour, tone, or intensity from one point to another. The rate at which a physical quantity such as temperature or pressure changes over distance. In mathematics, a measure of the steepness of a line or curve.
antonyms: Flat, Level, Plateau, Horizontal surface, Uniformity
Fixed position, Stability, Alignment, Constancy
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ جي جاءِ جو ظاهري بدلجڻ جڏهن ان کي ٻن مختلف نقطن مان ڏٺو وڃي، ويجهيون شيون پري وارين کان تيز چرندي محسوس ٿيڻ، فلڪيات ۾ تارن جو مفاصلو ماپڻ جو طريقو، ڊزائين ۾ گهرائي جو احساس ڏيندڙ اسڪرول اثر
synonyms: Apparent shift, Displacement, Optical shift, Angular difference, Perspective change
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کی ظاہری جگہ کا بدلنا جب اسے دو مختلف مقامات سے دیکھا جائے، قریب کی اشیاء کا دور کی نسبت تیز حرکت کرتے محسوس ہونا، فلکیات میں ستاروں کا فاصلہ ناپنے کا طریقہ، ڈیزائن میں گہرائی کا احساس دینے والا اسکرول اثر
englishMeaning: The apparent change in the position of an object when it is viewed from two different points. An effect in which nearer objects seem to move faster than distant ones as the viewer moves. In astronomy, a method of measuring the distance of stars using this shift. In web and game design, a scrolling effect that creates a sense of depth.
examples: Astronomers use parallax to calculate the distance of nearby stars. The parallax effect makes the background move slowly. Always read the scale straight on to avoid parallax error. The website uses parallax scrolling for a modern look.

antonyms: Macro, Large, Huge, Giant, Massive, Large-scale
urduMeaning: نہایت چھوٹا، خردبینی سطح کا، باریک تفصیل سے متعلق، کسی اکائی کے دس لاکھویں حصے کو ظاہر کرنے والا سابقہ، مائیکروفون یا چھوٹے کمپیوٹر کے لیے عام لفظ
englishMeaning: Extremely small in size, scale, or scope. Relating to something very small or examined in fine detail. A prefix meaning one millionth of a unit. An informal short form of microcomputer or microphone.
sindhiMeaning: تمام ننڍڙو، بلڪل خردبيني سطح جو، باريڪيءَ سان لاڳاپيل، ڪنهن يونٽ جو ڏهه لکَ وارو حصو ظاهر ڪندڙ اڳياڙي، مائيڪروفون يا ننڍي ڪمپيوٽر لاءِ عام لفظ
synonyms: Tiny, Miniature, Minute, Small-scale, Minuscule, Microscopic
examples: The company focuses on micro loans for small farmers. Designers added micro animations to the buttons. A micro crack in the glass slowly grew larger. He studies changes at the micro level of the economy.
The studio is famous for its hand-drawn animation. Children watched the animation with great excitement. She spoke with animation about her travels. The animation of the logo lasts only two seconds.
synonyms: Cartoon, Motion graphics, Liveliness, Vitality, Energy, Enthusiasm, Vigour
urduMeaning: تصاویر یا ماڈلز کو اسکرین پر متحرک دکھانے کا فن، اس طریقے سے بنی فلم یا ویڈیو، کسی شخص کے انداز میں جوش و توانائی، کسی چیز میں جان ڈالنے کا عمل
antonyms: Stillness, Dullness, Lethargy, Apathy, Inactivity, Lifelessness
englishMeaning: The technique of making drawings or models appear to move on screen. A film or video created by this technique. Liveliness, energy, and enthusiasm in a person's manner. The act of bringing something to life or making it active.
sindhiMeaning: تصويرن يا ماڊلن کي اسڪرين تي چرندو ڏيکارڻ جو فن، اهڙي طريقي سان ٺهيل فلم يا وڊيو، ڪنهن ماڻهوءَ جي انداز ۾ جوش ۽ چستي، ڪنهن شيءِ ۾ جان وجهڻ جو عمل

antonyms: Deaden, Depress, Discourage, Dull, Subdue, Weaken
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ ۾ جان وجهڻ، چست ۽ جاندار بڻائڻ، تصويرن کي چرندو ڏيکاريندڙ فلم ٺاهڻ، ڪنهن کي جوش ۽ حوصلو ڏيڻ، جاندار يا زندگيءَ وارو
urduMeaning: کسی چیز میں جان ڈالنا، متحرک اور بارونق بنانا، تصاویر کو حرکت دیتی فلم بنانا، کسی کو جوش اور ولولہ دینا، جاندار یا زندہ
examples: A warm smile animated her tired face. The team will animate the characters next month. His speech animated the whole audience. Biology studies both animate and inanimate matter.
synonyms: Enliven, Invigorate, Energise, Inspire, Stimulate, Vitalise, Arouse
englishMeaning: To bring something to life or make it lively and active. To produce a film or sequence in which drawings or objects appear to move. To encourage or inspire someone with energy and enthusiasm. Alive or having life, as opposed to inanimate.

antonyms: Plain, Undramatic, Ordinary, Flat, Literary, Unremarkable
englishMeaning: Relating to the cinema or the making of films. Having the visual quality, atmosphere, or scale typical of a good film. Beautifully composed and dramatic in appearance. Suitable for being filmed or shown on the big screen.
examples: The documentary has a strikingly cinematic style. Sunset over the valley created a cinematic view. He praised the film's cinematic camera work. The novel is written in a highly cinematic manner.
sindhiMeaning: سئنيما يا فلم سازيءَ سان لاڳاپيل، فلم جهڙي خوبصورت ۽ اثرائتي منظرڪشي رکندڙ، ڊرامائي ۽ شاندار نظر ايندڙ، فلم لاءِ موزون
urduMeaning: سنیما یا فلم سازی سے متعلق، فلم جیسی خوبصورت اور بھرپور منظرکشی رکھنے والا، ڈرامائی اور شاندار دکھائی دینے والا، فلم بندی کے لیے موزوں
synonyms: Filmic, Movie-like, Dramatic, Visual, Picturesque, Theatrical

englishMeaning: Kind, calm, and careful in behaviour or manner. Not harsh, severe, or forceful in effect. Moderate in degree, strength, or slope. To make something softer or less severe.
antonyms: Harsh, Rough, Violent, Severe, Fierce, Brutal, Steep
synonyms: Kind, Mild, Tender, Soft, Soothing, Moderate, Placid, Considerate
sindhiMeaning: نرم مزاج، مهربان ۽ سنجيده، سخت يا زوردار نه، هلڪو ۽ معتدل، ٿورڙي لاهي وارو، ڪنهن شيءِ کي نرم بڻائڻ
examples: She has a gentle voice that calms the children. A gentle breeze moved the curtains. The doctor advised gentle exercise after the surgery. The path rises with a gentle slope towards the temple.
urduMeaning: نرم مزاج، مہربان اور شائستہ، سخت یا زوردار نہیں، ہلکا اور معتدل، ہلکی ڈھلان والا، کسی چیز کو نرم بنانا

englishMeaning: A soft rushing sound made by something moving quickly through the air. To move rapidly with such a sound. An exclamation imitating fast movement.
antonyms: Silence, Stillness, Hush, Crawl, Halt
synonyms: Swish, Rush, Swoosh, Hiss, Zoom, Sweep
urduMeaning: ہوا میں تیزی سے گزرنے پر پیدا ہونے والی سرسراہٹ، ایسی آواز کے ساتھ تیزی سے حرکت کرنا، تیز رفتاری کی نقل کرنے والا آواز
sindhiMeaning: تيزيءَ سان هوا مان لنگهڻ وقت پيدا ٿيندڙ سُر يا سرسراهٽ، اهڙي آواز سان تيز حرڪت ڪرڻ، تيز رفتاريءَ جي نقل ڪندڙ آواز
examples: We heard the whoosh of the train as it passed. The car whooshed past us on the highway. With a soft whoosh, the door slid open. The rocket rose with a great whoosh of flame.

synonyms: Oops, Oh dear, Sorry, Yikes, Cheer, Shout
examples: Whoops, I dropped the glass! Whoops, I think I sent that message to the wrong person. She said whoops and quickly picked up the papers. Whoops of joy rose from the crowd after the goal.
englishMeaning: An exclamation used when a small mistake or accident happens. A word said to show mild surprise or apology. A cry of excitement or joy.
urduMeaning: چھوٹی سی غلطی یا حادثے پر کہا جانے والا لفظ، ہلکی حیرت یا معذرت ظاہر کرنے والا لفظ، خوشی یا جوش کا نعرہ
antonyms: Well done, Perfect, Silence, Groan, Complaint
sindhiMeaning: ننڍڙي غلطي يا حادثي وقت چيو ويندڙ لفظ، هلڪي حيرت يا معذرت ظاهر ڪندڙ لفظ، خوشيءَ يا جوش جو نعرو

synonyms: Cry, Shout, Outcry, Utterance, Yell, Interjection, Ejaculation
urduMeaning: حیرت، غصے، خوشی یا تکلیف کا اظہار کرنے والی اچانک آواز یا کلمہ، زور اور جذبے سے کہا گیا لفظ یا جملہ، گرامر میں جذبہ ظاہر کرنے والا جملہ
sindhiMeaning: حيرت، ڪاوڙ، خوشي يا درد ظاهر ڪندڙ اوچتو رڙ يا لفظ، زور ۽ جذبي سان چيل لفظ يا جملو، گرامر ۾ جذبو ظاهر ڪندڙ جملو
examples: He gave an exclamation of surprise when he saw the bill. Her exclamation startled everyone in the room. The teacher explained the use of the exclamation mark. A loud exclamation came from the back of the hall.
antonyms: Silence, Whisper, Murmur, Mutter, Quietness
englishMeaning: A sudden cry or remark expressing surprise, anger, joy, or pain. A word or phrase spoken loudly and with strong feeling. In grammar, a sentence that expresses emotion and often ends with an exclamation mark.

sindhiMeaning: جذبي جي زور تي اوچتو رڙ ڪري چوڻ، حيرت يا ڪاوڙ ۾ تيزيءَ سان ڪجهه چوڻ، زور ڏئي ڪا ڳالهه بيان ڪرڻ
synonyms: Shout, Cry out, Call out, Yell, Blurt, Proclaim, Declare
urduMeaning: جذبے کی شدت میں اچانک بلند آواز سے کہنا، حیرت یا غصے میں تیزی سے کچھ کہنا، زور دے کر کوئی بات کہنا
examples: What a beautiful garden! she exclaimed. He exclaimed in pain when the door hit his hand. The children exclaimed with delight at the snow. She exclaimed that the news could not be true.
englishMeaning: To cry out suddenly and loudly because of strong emotion. To say something quickly and with feeling, especially surprise or anger. To declare something forcefully in speech.
antonyms: Whisper, Murmur, Mumble, Keep quiet, Suppress

sindhiMeaning: جوش ۽ ولولو پيدا ڪندڙ انداز ۾، دلچسپ ۽ سنسني خيز نموني، اهڙي طرح جو خوشي ۽ اتساهه پيدا ٿئي
examples: The match ended excitingly in the final minute. The project developed excitingly fast. She spoke excitingly about her new business. The story begins slowly but ends excitingly.
synonyms: Thrillingly, Stirringly, Dramatically, Vividly, Impressively
antonyms: Boringly, Dully, Tediously, Flatly, Uninterestingly
englishMeaning: In a way that causes excitement, interest, or enthusiasm. So as to make something thrilling or full of energy. In a manner that stirs strong positive feelings.
urduMeaning: جوش و ولولہ پیدا کرنے والے انداز میں، دلچسپ اور سنسنی خیز طریقے سے، ایسے کہ خوشی اور جذبہ پیدا ہو

antonyms: Boredom, Calm, Apathy, Indifference, Dullness, Depression
sindhiMeaning: جوش ۽ اتساهه جو مضبوط احساس، جذباتي طور تي بيتاب يا خوش هجڻ جي حالت، اهڙو موقعو جيڪو جوش پيدا ڪري، ڪنهن جاءِ تي وڌيل چهل پهل يا هلچل
urduMeaning: جوش اور بے تابی کا شدید احساس، جذباتی طور پر پرجوش ہونے کی کیفیت، ایسا موقع جو جوش پیدا کرے، کسی جگہ بڑھی ہوئی ہلچل
englishMeaning: A strong feeling of enthusiasm and eagerness. A state of being emotionally stirred or lively. An event or situation that causes such feelings. Increased activity or agitation in a person or place.
synonyms: Thrill, Enthusiasm, Eagerness, Anticipation, Elation, Stimulation, Buzz
examples: There was great excitement before the final match. She could hardly hide her excitement about the trip. The news created excitement across the whole village. In his excitement, he forgot to lock the door.
It was the most exciting game of the season. She has an exciting new job in Karachi. The film has an exciting opening scene. Travelling alone can be both exciting and difficult.
englishMeaning: Causing strong feelings of interest, enthusiasm, or pleasure. Full of activity, energy, or thrilling events. Likely to make someone eager and emotionally stirred.
urduMeaning: دلچسپی اور جوش پیدا کرنے والا، سنسنی خیز اور پرجوش، خوشی اور ولولہ دینے والا، سرگرمی اور توانائی سے بھرپور
synonyms: Thrilling, Stirring, Stimulating, Gripping, Electrifying, Inspiring
antonyms: Boring, Dull, Tedious, Monotonous, Uninteresting, Bland
sindhiMeaning: دلچسپي ۽ جوش پيدا ڪندڙ، سنسني خيز ۽ ولولي وارو، خوشي ۽ اتساهه ڏيندڙ، سرگرميءَ ۽ توانائيءَ سان ڀرپور

antonyms: Bore, Calm, Soothe, Dull, Pacify, Discourage
englishMeaning: To make someone feel very enthusiastic, eager, or emotionally stirred. To cause a particular feeling or reaction to arise. To stimulate a physical or chemical activity. To arouse interest or curiosity in something.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي جوش ۽ اتساهه ۾ آڻڻ، ڪو خاص جذبو يا ردعمل پيدا ڪرڻ، ڪنهن جسماني يا ڪيميائي عمل کي تحريڪ ڏيڻ، دلچسپي يا تجسس پيدا ڪرڻ
examples: The idea of studying abroad excites her. His speech excited the crowd. The discovery excited great interest among scientists. Loud noises can excite young children before bedtime.
urduMeaning: کسی کو جوش و ولولہ دلانا، کوئی خاص جذبہ یا ردعمل پیدا کرنا، کسی جسمانی یا کیمیائی عمل کو تحریک دینا، دلچسپی یا تجسس پیدا کرنا
synonyms: Thrill, Stimulate, Arouse, Inspire, Stir, Provoke, Animate

urduMeaning: جلد جوش میں آ جانے والا، چھوٹی باتوں پر شدید ردعمل دینے والا، جذباتی طور پر جلد متاثر ہونے والا، تحریک پر جلد اثر لینے والا
antonyms: Calm, Composed, Placid, Steady, Unemotional, Relaxed
synonyms: Emotional, Nervous, Volatile, Temperamental, Jumpy, Responsive
sindhiMeaning: جلد جوش ۾ اچي ويندڙ، ننڍين ڳالهين تي سخت ردعمل ڏيندڙ، جذباتي طور تي تڪڙو متاثر ٿيندڙ، تحريڪ تي جلد اثر وٺندڙ
englishMeaning: Easily made enthusiastic, nervous, or emotionally stirred. Tending to react strongly to small events. Responsive to stimulation, as in nerves or cells.
examples: He is an excitable child who talks very fast. The excitable crowd cheered every shot. She becomes excitable when she drinks too much tea. Nerve cells are highly excitable tissues.

synonyms: Nervousness, Volatility, Sensitivity, Responsiveness, Restlessness
examples: His excitability makes him a lively companion. The doctor noted the excitability of the patient's nerves. Excitability increases when people are short of sleep. She controlled her excitability during the interview.

urduMeaning: دو یا زیادہ چیزوں کے درمیان فرق پہچاننا یا بتانا، ایسی خصوصیت ہونا جو کسی کو دوسروں سے ممتاز کرے، مشکل کے باوجود کوئی چیز صاف دیکھنا، سننا یا سمجھنا، اتنا عمدہ کام کرنا کہ عزت اور نام ملے
antonyms: Confuse, Mix up, Mistake, Blend, Combine, Overlook, Miss, Ignore, Assimilate
sindhiMeaning: ٻن يا وڌيڪ شين جي وچ ۾ فرق سڃاڻڻ يا ٻڌائڻ، اهڙي خصوصيت هجڻ جيڪا ڪنهن کي ٻين کان الڳ ڪري، ڏکيائي جي باوجود ڪا شيءِ صاف ڏسڻ، ٻڌڻ يا سمجهڻ، ايترو سٺو ڪم ڪرڻ جو عزت ۽ نالو ملي

englishMeaning: Able to be recognized as different from something else. Able to be clearly seen, heard, or understood. Having features that make separate identification possible.
synonyms: Recognizable, Identifiable, Discernible, Noticeable, Perceptible, Detectable, Clear, Evident
urduMeaning: ایسا جسے کسی دوسری چیز سے مختلف پہچانا جا سکے، ایسا جو صاف دیکھا، سنا یا سمجھا جا سکے، ایسی خصوصیات رکھنے والا جن سے الگ پہچان ممکن ہو
examples: The two brands are barely distinguishable in taste. Her handwriting is easily distinguishable from mine. The shape was hardly distinguishable in the dark. Real pearls are distinguishable from fake ones by weight.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙو جنهن کي ٻي شيءِ کان مختلف سڃاڻي سگهجي، اهڙو جيڪو صاف ڏسي، ٻڌي يا سمجهي سگهجي، اهڙيون خصوصيتون رکندڙ جن جي ڪري الڳ سڃاڻپ ٿي سگهي
antonyms: Indistinguishable, Identical, Unrecognizable, Imperceptible, Unclear, Alike, Uniform, Vague

urduMeaning: اپنی نمایاں کارکردگی یا خدمت کی وجہ سے بہت معزز اور قابلِ تعریف، باوقار اور متاثر کن شخصیت والا، اعلیٰ معیار یا بہترین خوبیوں والا، کسی خاص شعبے میں مشہور اور محترم
antonyms: Unknown, Obscure, Ordinary, Undistinguished, Insignificant, Common, Disreputable, Humble
englishMeaning: Highly respected and admired for great achievement or service. Having a dignified and impressive appearance. Marked by excellence or superior quality. Well known and honoured in a particular field.
examples: A distinguished professor delivered the opening lecture. He had a distinguished career in public service. The award honours distinguished work in medicine. She looked distinguished in her simple grey suit.
sindhiMeaning: پنهنجي شاندار ڪم يا خدمت جي ڪري تمام گهڻو عزت وارو ۽ ساراهيل، باوقار ۽ متاثر ڪندڙ شخصيت وارو، اعليٰ معيار يا بهترين خوبين وارو، ڪنهن خاص شعبي ۾ مشهور ۽ معزز
synonyms: Eminent, Renowned, Celebrated, Prominent, Notable, Esteemed, Respected, Illustrious, Dignified

antonyms: Confuse, Equate, Mix up, Combine, Unify, Group together, Standardize, Homogenize
sindhiMeaning: ٻن يا وڌيڪ شين جي وچ ۾ فرق سڃاڻڻ يا ڏيکارڻ، ڪنهن هڪ شيءِ کي ٻيءَ کان مختلف بڻائڻ، ماڻهن يا گروهن سان مختلف رويو رکڻ، وڌيڪ خاص يا الڳ صورت ۾ تبديل ٿيڻ
englishMeaning: To recognize or show the difference between two or more things. To make one thing different from another in some way. To treat people or groups in a different manner. To develop into a more specialized form.
examples: Students must differentiate between facts and opinions. Good service differentiates this shop from its rivals. The law should not differentiate between citizens. Teachers differentiate their lessons for different learners.
synonyms: Distinguish, Discriminate, Separate, Contrast, Tell apart, Discern, Mark off, Individualize
urduMeaning: دو یا زیادہ چیزوں کے درمیان فرق پہچاننا یا ظاہر کرنا، کسی ایک چیز کو دوسری سے مختلف بنانا، لوگوں یا گروہوں کے ساتھ مختلف سلوک کرنا، زیادہ مخصوص یا الگ شکل اختیار کرنا

englishMeaning: The act or process of recognizing differences between things. The process of making something different or special compared with others. A clear separation between categories, groups, or ideas. In business, the strategy of making a product stand out from competitors.
antonyms: Similarity, Sameness, Uniformity, Confusion, Standardization, Equality, Blending
urduMeaning: چیزوں کے درمیان فرق پہچاننے کا عمل، کسی چیز کو دوسروں کے مقابلے میں مختلف یا خاص بنانے کا عمل، اقسام، گروہوں یا خیالات کے درمیان واضح جدائی، کاروبار میں اپنی مصنوعات کو حریفوں سے ممتاز کرنے کی حکمتِ عملی
examples: Clear differentiation between the two plans helped the vote. Product differentiation is important in a crowded market. The report explains the differentiation of roles within the team. Differentiation in teaching helps every child learn.
sindhiMeaning: شين جي وچ ۾ فرق سڃاڻڻ جو عمل، ڪنهن شيءِ کي ٻين جي ڀيٽ ۾ مختلف يا خاص بڻائڻ جو عمل، درجن، گروهن يا خيالن جي وچ ۾ چٽي جدائي، واپار ۾ پنهنجي شيءِ کي مقابلي وارن کان الڳ ڏيکارڻ جو طريقو
synonyms: Distinction, Separation, Discrimination, Contrast, Categorization, Specialization, Variation

urduMeaning: اس طرح جو پہلے یا دوسروں جیسا نہ ہو، دوسرے انداز یا دوسرے طریقے سے، بدلے ہوئے رویے، اسلوب یا نتیجے کے ساتھ
antonyms: Similarly, Alike, Identically, Equally, Uniformly, In the same way, Likewise
englishMeaning: In a way that is not the same as before or as others. In another manner or by another method. With a changed attitude, style, or result.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي طرح جيڪو اڳ يا ٻين وانگر نه هجي، ٻئي انداز يا ٻئي طريقي سان، بدليل رويي، اسلوب يا نتيجي سان
synonyms: Otherwise, Distinctly, Variously, Unlike, Contrastingly, In another way, Diversely
examples: She sees the problem differently from her colleagues. If I could start again, I would do it differently. People react differently to the same news. The two words are spelled differently in British English.

urduMeaning: کسی دوسرے شخص، چیز یا خیال جیسا نہ ہونا، ذکر کی گئی چیز سے الگ یا جدا، غیر معمولی یا اکثر سے ہٹ کر، ایک ہی قسم کے کئی یا مختلف
examples: Life in the village is very different from city life. We tried three different methods before it worked. He wanted to do something different with his career. Different people gave completely different answers.
englishMeaning: Not the same as another person, thing, or idea. Separate or distinct from what has been mentioned. Unusual or not like most others. Various or several of the same kind.
synonyms: Dissimilar, Unlike, Distinct, Varied, Diverse, Separate, Contrasting, Unusual, Other
antonyms: Same, Similar, Alike, Identical, Equal, Matching, Uniform, Comparable
sindhiMeaning: ٻئي ماڻهوءَ  شيءِ يا خيال وانگر نه هجڻ، ذڪر ڪيل شيءِ کان الڳ يا جدا، غير معمولي يا ٻين کان هٽي ڪري، ساڳي قسم جا ڪيترائي يا مختلف

examples: The novel is set in a fictional town by the sea. He is a fictional character loved by many readers. The film mixes real history with fictional events. She writes fictional stories for young children.
sindhiMeaning: رڳو ڪهاڻيءَ ۾ موجود، حقيقي زندگيءَ ۾ نه، فرضي ڪردارن، هنڌن يا واقعن سان لاڳاپيل، حقيقت بجاءِ تصور مان جوڙيل
synonyms: Imaginary, Invented, Made-up, Fictitious, Unreal, Mythical, Fanciful, Untrue
antonyms: Real, Actual, Factual, True, Historical, Genuine, Non-fictional, Authentic
englishMeaning: Existing only in a story and not in real life. Relating to invented characters, places, or events. Created by imagination rather than based on fact.
urduMeaning: صرف کہانی میں موجود، حقیقی زندگی میں نہیں، فرضی کرداروں، مقامات یا واقعات سے متعلق، حقیقت کے بجائے تخیل سے تخلیق کیا گیا

englishMeaning: Literature that describes imaginary events and people. A story or account that is invented rather than true. Something that is believed or stated but is not a fact. The general category of novels and short stories.
synonyms: Story, Novel, Tale, Invention, Fantasy, Fable, Myth, Falsehood, Fabrication
urduMeaning: وہ ادب جو فرضی واقعات اور کرداروں کو بیان کرے، ایسی کہانی یا بیان جو سچا نہ بلکہ گھڑا ہوا ہو، ایسی بات جو مانی جائے مگر حقیقت نہ ہو، ناولوں اور مختصر کہانیوں کی عمومی صنف
examples: She reads fiction every night before sleeping. The library keeps fiction and non-fiction on separate shelves. His account of the accident was pure fiction. Science fiction has become very popular among students.
antonyms: Fact, Truth, Reality, Non-fiction, History, Certainty, Actuality
sindhiMeaning: اهو ادب جيڪو فرضي واقعن ۽ ڪردارن جو بيان ڪري، اهڙي ڪهاڻي يا بيان جيڪو سچو نه پر بڻايل هجي، اهڙي ڳالهه جيڪا مڃي وڃي پر حقيقت نه هجي، ناولن ۽ ننڍين ڪهاڻين جو مجموعي درجو

synonyms: Dramatize, Novelize, Invent, Embellish, Romanticize, Adapt, Imagine
sindhiMeaning: حقيقي واقعن يا ماڻهن کي فرضي تفصيل شامل ڪري ڪهاڻيءَ جي شڪل ڏيڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ بابت افساني جي انداز ۾ لکڻ، حقيقتن کي ڪجهه بڻاوٽي انداز ۾ پيش ڪرڻ
examples: The author fictionalized her grandmother's life in the novel. The film fictionalizes a real court case from the 1970s. He decided to fictionalize the story to protect real names. Writers often fictionalize history for dramatic effect.
englishMeaning: To turn real events or people into a story by adding imaginary details. To write about something in the form of fiction. To present facts in a way that is partly invented.
antonyms: Document, Report, Record, State factually, Verify, Chronicle
urduMeaning: حقیقی واقعات یا لوگوں کو فرضی تفصیلات شامل کر کے کہانی کی شکل دینا، کسی چیز کے بارے میں افسانوی انداز میں لکھنا، حقائق کو کچھ گھڑے ہوئے انداز میں پیش کرنا

synonyms: Imaginary, Fictional, Invented, Fanciful, Unreal, Notional, Assumed, Make-believe
englishMeaning: Created by the imagination; not real. Relating to the making of fiction. Assumed or accepted for a particular purpose although not actually true.
urduMeaning: تخیل سے تخلیق کیا گیا، حقیقی نہیں، افسانہ نگاری سے متعلق، کسی خاص مقصد کے لیے فرض یا تسلیم کیا گیا اگرچہ حقیقتاً سچ نہ ہو
sindhiMeaning: تصور مان جوڙيل، حقيقي نه، افساني جي تخليق سان لاڳاپيل، ڪنهن خاص مقصد لاءِ فرض ڪيل يا مڃيل جيتوڻيڪ حقيقت ۾ سچ نه هجي
examples: The essay explores the fictive world of the poet. Law sometimes relies on a fictive person for legal purposes. Her memoir has a strongly fictive quality. The painting creates a fictive space that feels real.
antonyms: Real, Actual, Factual, Genuine, True, Authentic, Concrete

urduMeaning: بے ایمانی یا غیر قانونی کام میں ملوث ہونا خاص طور پر پیسہ حاصل کرنے کے لیے، دھوکہ دینا، خاص طور پر ملازمت میں رقم کے معاملے میں بے ایمانی کرنا، چھپ کر غلط یا ناجائز طریقے سے پیسہ کمانا
examples: The manager suspected that one of the clerks was on the fiddle. He lost his job after it turned out he was on the fiddle. Nobody knew for years that she had been on the fiddle. If staff are on the fiddle, the accounts will show it.
englishMeaning: To be involved in dishonest or illegal activity, especially to get money. To cheat, especially by handling money dishonestly at work. To be secretly making money in a wrong or unfair way.
sindhiMeaning: بي ايماني يا غير قانوني ڪم ۾ ملوث هجڻ خاص ڪري پئسو حاصل ڪرڻ لاءِ، ڌوڪو ڏيڻ، خاص ڪري نوڪريءَ ۾ پئسي جي معاملي ۾ بي ايماني ڪرڻ، لڪ ڇپ ۾ غلط يا ناجائز طريقي سان پئسو ڪمائڻ
synonyms: Cheat, Swindle, Defraud, Embezzle, Con, Scam, Fleece, Be dishonest
antonyms: Be honest, Be truthful, Play fair, Act lawfully, Be trustworthy, Be upright
Concentrate, Focus, Work hard, Hurry, Get on with it, Apply oneself
englishMeaning: To waste time doing unimportant things instead of working. To touch or move something in a restless, aimless way. To make small adjustments to something without a clear plan.
urduMeaning: اہم کام کے بجائے بے کار کاموں میں وقت ضائع کرنا، بے مقصد اور بے چینی سے کسی چیز کو چھونا یا ہلانا، بغیر کسی واضح منصوبے کے چھوٹی چھوٹی تبدیلیاں کرتے رہنا
examples: Stop fiddling around and finish your homework. He spent the whole morning fiddling around in the garage. They fiddled around with the settings until the sound improved. We cannot fiddle around while the deadline gets closer.
sindhiMeaning: اهم ڪم بجاءِ بيڪار ڪمن ۾ وقت وڃائڻ، بي مقصد ۽ بي چينيءَ سان ڪنهن شيءِ کي هٿ لائڻ يا هلائڻ، بغير ڪنهن واضح منصوبي جي ننڍيون ننڍيون تبديليون ڪندو رهڻ
synonyms: Mess about, Waste time, Potter, Tinker, Dawdle, Loiter, Play around, Trifle

urduMeaning: چھوٹے اور غیر اہم کاموں میں وقت گزارنا، بے مقصد طور پر چیزوں کو چھونا یا ادھر ادھر کرنا، فضول کاموں میں مصروف رہ کر ضروری کام میں تاخیر کرنا
antonyms: Work, Concentrate, Focus, Hurry, Be productive, Get busy
sindhiMeaning: ننڍن ۽ غير اهم ڪمن ۾ وقت گذارڻ، بي مقصد طور تي شيون هٿ لائڻ يا هيڏي هوڏي ڪرڻ، فضول ڪمن ۾ مصروف رهي ڪري ضروري ڪم ۾ دير ڪرڻ
synonyms: Mess about, Potter about, Tinker, Idle, Dawdle, Waste time, Fool around
englishMeaning: To spend time doing small, unimportant things. To move or handle things aimlessly and without purpose. To delay useful work by busying oneself with trifles.
examples: He was fiddling about in the kitchen instead of helping. Don't fiddle about with the wires while the power is on. They fiddled about for an hour and finished nothing. She fiddles about in the garden every Sunday.

synonyms: Tinker with, Play with, Toy with, Adjust, Tamper with, Meddle with, Twiddle, Manipulate
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي بار بار هٿ لائڻ يا ان سان کيڏڻ  اڪثر بيچينيءَ ۾، ڪنهن شيءِ کي درست يا ٺيڪ ڪرڻ لاءِ ننڍيون تبديليون ڪرڻ، اهڙي دخل اندازي جيڪا نقصان پهچائي سگهي، انگن اکرن يا رڪارڊ ۾ بي ايمانيءَ سان ڦير ڦار ڪرڻ
examples: She kept fiddling with her ring during the interview. He fiddled with the radio until he found the station. Please don't fiddle with the camera settings. The clerk was accused of fiddling with the accounts.
englishMeaning: To touch or play with something repeatedly, often nervously. To make small changes to something to adjust or repair it. To interfere with something in a way that may cause damage. To alter figures or records dishonestly.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو بار بار چھونا یا اس سے کھیلنا  اکثر بے چینی میں، کسی چیز کو درست کرنے کے لیے چھوٹی تبدیلیاں کرنا، ایسی مداخلت کرنا جو نقصان پہنچا سکے، اعداد و شمار یا ریکارڈ میں بے ایمانی سے ردوبدل کرنا
antonyms: Leave alone, Ignore, Keep still, Preserve, Respect, Let be

synonyms: Tinker with, Mess about with, Potter with, Play with, Meddle with, Toy with, Adjust
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي سست ۽ بي مقصد انداز ۾ هٿ لائڻ يا ٺيڪ ڪرڻ جي ڪوشش ڪرڻ، بغير ڪنهن اصل مقصد جي بار بار ڇهڻ يا بدلائڻ، ننڍيون ۽ اڪثر بيڪار تبديليون ڪندي وقت گذارڻ
examples: He was fiddling about with the old clock all evening. Don't fiddle about with the engine unless you know what you are doing. She fiddled about with the layout but kept the same design. They fiddled about with the plan and lost valuable time.
englishMeaning: To handle or adjust something in a slow, aimless way. To keep touching or changing something without real purpose. To spend time making small, often useless, changes to something.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو سست اور بے مقصد انداز میں چھونا یا درست کرنے کی کوشش کرنا، بغیر کسی اصل مقصد کے بار بار چھونا یا بدلنا، چھوٹی اور اکثر بے کار تبدیلیاں کرتے ہوئے وقت گزارنا
antonyms: Leave alone, Finish, Complete, Focus on, Let be, Work seriously

urduMeaning: کسی چیز میں چھوٹی تبدیلیاں کرنا، اکثر بغیر کسی واضح مقصد کے، کسی چیز کو بار بار چھونا، ہلانا یا اس سے کھیلنا، لاپرواہی سے کسی چیز پر تجربے کرنا
synonyms: Tinker with, Play around with, Experiment with, Mess with, Adjust, Toy with, Tamper with
examples: He likes to fiddle around with old computers at weekends. Stop fiddling around with the volume and listen. She fiddled around with the recipe until it tasted right. I fiddled around with the settings and fixed the problem.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ ۾ ننڍيون تبديليون ڪرڻ، اڪثر بغير ڪنهن واضح مقصد جي، ڪنهن شيءِ کي بار بار ڇهڻ، هلائڻ يا ان سان کيڏڻ، بي پرواهيءَ سان ڪنهن شيءِ تي تجربا ڪرڻ
englishMeaning: To make small adjustments to something, often without a clear purpose. To touch, move, or play with something repeatedly. To experiment with something in a casual way.
antonyms: Leave alone, Ignore, Keep untouched, Finalize, Settle, Let be
Centred, Straight, Balanced, Symmetrical, Even, Aligned, Conventional, Ordinary
sindhiMeaning: بلڪل وچ ۾ نه، ٿورو هڪ پاسي، مرڪز کان هٽيل جاءِ تي رکيل يا بيٺل، انداز يا رويي ۾ ٿورو غير معمولي، عجيب يا روايت کان هٽيل
examples: The picture is hanging slightly off-centre on the wall. The hole was drilled a little off-centre. His humour is off-centre but very clever. The table looks off-centre in this small room.
englishMeaning: Not exactly in the middle; slightly to one side. Placed or positioned away from the centre. Slightly unusual, strange, or unconventional in style or behaviour.
urduMeaning: بالکل درمیان میں نہیں، تھوڑا ایک طرف، مرکز سے ہٹ کر رکھا یا واقع، انداز یا رویے میں کچھ غیر معمولی، عجیب یا روایت سے ہٹ کر
synonyms: Askew, Crooked, Lopsided, Uncentred, Unbalanced, Eccentric, Quirky, Unconventional

antonyms: Healthy, Well, Fit, Fine, Decent, Polite, Bright, Fresh
englishMeaning: Slightly unwell or not feeling one's usual self. Rather rude, indecent, or in poor taste. Having lost the normal or expected colour.
urduMeaning: کچھ بیمار یا طبیعت ناساز محسوس کرنا، کچھ بے ہودہ، غیر مہذب یا بدذوق، اپنا معمول یا اصل رنگ کھو دینا
sindhiMeaning: ٿورو بيمار يا طبيعت ۾ سستي محسوس ڪرڻ، ڪجهه بي ادب، فحش يا بدذوق، پنهنجو معمولي يا اصلي رنگ وڃائي ويٺل
examples: She stayed home because she was feeling a bit off colour. He looked off colour after the long journey. The comedian told a few off colour jokes. The old curtains have gone off colour in the sunlight.
synonyms: Unwell, Poorly, Sick, Under the weather, Indecent, Vulgar, Faded, Discoloured
Scrap, Remnant, Leftover, Cutting, Piece, Fragment, Trimming, Residue
examples: The carpenter used an offcut to repair the small shelf. You can buy cheap offcuts of carpet at the shop. She made a photo frame from a wooden offcut. Offcuts of fabric were collected for a quilt.
englishMeaning: A piece of material left over after the main part has been cut. A remaining scrap of wood, cloth, paper, or metal. A small leftover piece that is often sold cheaply or thrown away.
