synonyms: Soon, Before long, Shortly, In due course, Presently, In the near future

englishMeaning: Not able to do something or lacking the necessary ability. Unable to behave in a particular way because of one's nature or character. Not competent or fit for a task or responsibility.
examples: He is incapable of telling a lie. The old machine is incapable of handling such a load. She felt incapable of facing the crowd that evening. The manager was found incapable of leading the team.
urduMeaning: کچھ کرنے کے قابل نہ ہونا, صلاحیت سے محروم, ناکارہ یا نااہل, ایسا شخص جو کوئی کام نہ کر سکے
synonyms: Unable, Powerless, Unfit, Incompetent, Helpless, Inept, Unqualified
antonyms: Capable, Able, Competent, Skilled, Qualified, Efficient
sindhiMeaning: ڪجهه ڪرڻ جي قابل نه هجڻ, صلاحيت کان محروم, ناڪاره يا نااهل, اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو ڪو ڪم ڪري نه سگهي

examples: He sat in an inconspicuous corner of the café. The door was small and quite inconspicuous. She wore plain clothes to remain inconspicuous in the crowd. The camera was hidden in an inconspicuous position.
sindhiMeaning: جيڪو آسانيءَ سان نظر نه اچي، ڌيان نه ڇڪيندڙ، لڪل يا معمولي ڏيک وارو، سادو ۽ غير نمايان
urduMeaning: جو آسانی سے نظر نہ آئے، توجہ نہ کھینچنے والا، غیر نمایاں یا معمولی سا، سادہ اور غیر واضح
englishMeaning: Not easily noticed or seen. Attracting little or no attention. Modest and unobtrusive in appearance or behaviour.
synonyms: Unnoticeable, Unobtrusive, Discreet, Hidden, Subtle, Modest, Low-key, Unremarkable, Camouflaged
antonyms: Conspicuous, Obvious, Noticeable, Prominent, Striking, Visible, Flashy, Evident, Eye-catching

examples: The company incurred heavy losses last year. You will incur a penalty if the payment is late. He incurred his father's anger by lying. They incurred large debts while building the house.
antonyms: Avoid, Escape, Evade, Prevent, Forestall, Shun, Sidestep, Dodge
urduMeaning: اپنے اعمال کے نتیجے میں کوئی ناخوشگوار چیز اپنے سر لینا، خرچ  قرض یا نقصان اپنے اوپر لینا، سزا یا ذمہ داری کا مستوجب ہونا، کسی نتیجے کا سامنا کرنا، کسی واجب الادا ذمہ داری میں پھنس جانا
englishMeaning: To become subject to something unpleasant as a result of one's own actions. To bring upon oneself a cost, loss, debt, or penalty. To experience or suffer a consequence, especially an unwanted one. To become liable for an expense or obligation.
synonyms: Sustain, Suffer, Bring upon oneself, Attract, Provoke, Contract, Acquire, Meet with, Undergo
sindhiMeaning: پنهنجي عملن جي نتيجي ۾ ڪا اڻ وڻندڙ شيءِ مٿان کڻڻ، خرچ  قرض يا نقصان پاڻ تي وجهڻ، سزا يا ڏوهه جو ذميوار ٿيڻ، ڪنهن نتيجي کي منهن ڏيڻ، ڪنهن ذميواريءَ ۾ ڦاسڻ

synonyms: Compensation, Reimbursement, Reparation, Restitution, Indemnity, Security, Protection, Recompense
urduMeaning: نقصان یا زیاں کی تلافی، قانونی معاہدے کے ذریعے مالی نقصان سے تحفظ، کسی کو ذمہ داری یا نقصان سے محفوظ کرنے کا عمل، سزاؤں یا ذمہ داریوں سے معافی یا تحفظ
englishMeaning: Compensation for damage, loss, or injury suffered. Protection against financial loss by legal agreement. The act of making someone secure against responsibility or loss. Security or exemption from penalties or liabilities.
sindhiMeaning: نقصان يا زيان جي تلافي، قانوني معاهدي ذريعي مالي نقصان کان تحفظ، ڪنهن کي ذميواري يا نقصان کان محفوظ ڪرڻ جو عمل، سزائن يا ذميوارين کان معافي يا تحفظ
antonyms: Penalty, Fine, Loss, Damage, Liability, Punishment, Forfeiture
examples: The contract included an indemnification clause to protect the supplier. The insurance company promised full indemnification for the damages. Indemnification agreements are common in construction projects. The victim received indemnification for his losses.

The farmer was indemnified for the crops destroyed by the flood. The company indemnified its employees against legal claims. The insured party was indemnified within thirty days. He felt indemnified knowing the policy covered all losses.
urduMeaning: نقصان یا زیاں کی تلافی کی گئی، قانونی ذمہ داری یا مالی نقصان سے محفوظ، معاہدے کے ذریعے سزاؤں یا ذمہ داریوں سے بچایا گیا
sindhiMeaning: نقصان يا زيان جي تلافي ڪئي وئي، قانوني ذميواري يا مالي نقصان کان محفوظ، معاهدي ذريعي سزائن يا ذميوارين کان بچايو ويو
synonyms: Compensated, Reimbursed, Protected, Secured, Repaid, Covered, Recompensed, Restituted
englishMeaning: Compensated for loss, damage, or injury. Protected or secured against legal responsibility or financial loss. Made safe from penalties or liabilities by agreement.
antonyms: Penalized, Fined, Charged, Punished, Liable, Exposed, Unprotected

synonyms: Beneficiary, Claimant, Insured, Compensated party, Protected party, Payee
englishMeaning: A person or party who receives compensation or protection against loss or damage. The one who is indemnified under a contract or agreement. A party legally entitled to be compensated for losses.
antonyms: Indemnitor, Guarantor, Insurer, Payer, Debtor
urduMeaning: وہ شخص یا فریق جو نقصان کی تلافی یا تحفظ حاصل کرے، وہ جس کی معاہدے کے تحت تلافی کی جائے، قانونی طور پر نقصانات کی تلافی کا حق رکھنے والا فریق
examples: The indemnitee submitted a claim for the property damage. Under the agreement, the tenant was the indemnitee. The indemnitee was fully compensated for the fire losses. Both parties reviewed the rights of the indemnitee.
sindhiMeaning: اهو شخص يا فريڪ جيڪو نقصان جي تلافي يا تحفظ حاصل ڪري، هو جنهنجي معاهدي تحت تلافي ڪئي وڃي، قانوني طور تي نقصان جي تلافي جو حق رکندڙ فريڪ

examples: The indemnitor agreed to cover all legal costs arising from the dispute. As the indemnitor, the company paid for the damages. The contract clearly defined the duties of the indemnitor. The insurance firm acted as the indemnitor in the agreement.
sindhiMeaning: اهو شخص يا فريڪ جيڪو ٻئي کي نقصان جي تلافي ڏيڻ جو واعدو ڪري، هو جيڪو نقصان کان تحفظ جي ضمانت ڏئي، قانوني طور تي پابند فريڪ جيڪو ٻئي جو نقصان پورو ڪري
synonyms: Guarantor, Insurer, Surety, Warrantor, Protector, Backer, Underwriter
antonyms: Indemnitee, Claimant, Beneficiary, Debtor, Obligee
urduMeaning: وہ شخص یا فریق جو دوسرے کو نقصان کی تلافی دینے کا وعدہ کرے، وہ جو نقصان سے تحفظ کی ضمانت دے، قانونی طور پر پابند فریق جو دوسرے کا نقصان پورا کرے
englishMeaning: A person or party who agrees to compensate another for loss or damage. The one who provides indemnity or guarantees protection against loss. A party legally bound to make good any loss suffered by another.

examples: I would never lie! she replied indignantly. He indignantly denied the accusation of cheating. The workers protested indignantly against the unfair decision. She indignantly refused to apologize for something she had not done.
antonyms: Calmly, Humbly, Meekly, Quietly, Agreeably, Submissively
urduMeaning: ناانصافی یا توہین پر غصے کے ساتھ، عزت نفس مجروح ہونے کے احساس کے ساتھ، غصے میں اعتراض کرتے ہوئے
sindhiMeaning: ناانصافي يا توهين تي ڪاوڙ سان، عزت نفس مجروح ٿيڻ جي احساس سان، غصي ۾ اعتراض ڪندي

sindhiMeaning: اهڙو رويو يا حالت جيڪو ماڻهو کي شرمندو يا بي عزت ڪري، توهين يا رسوا ڪرڻ وارو ڪم، عزت کان محرومي

synonyms: Humiliation, Shame, Disgrace, Insult, Embarrassment, Degradation, Dishonor, Affront

synonyms: Deep blue, Purplish blue, Navy, Blue dye, Anil, Indigo dye

synonyms: Secondhand, By implication, Obliquely, In a roundabout way, Circuitously, Through an intermediary

examples: The new tax will indirectly affect small businesses. He indirectly suggested that I should resign. The news reached her indirectly through a mutual friend. Smoking indirectly harms the health of the people around you.
urduMeaning: غیر سیدھے طریقے سے، کسی واسطے یا ذریعے سے، گھما پھرا کر یا اشارتاً، کھلے طور پر نہیں

antonyms: Limited, Finite, Scarce, Exhaustible, Depletable, Restricted

antonyms: Avoidable, Preventable, Yielding, Flexible, Merciful, Stoppable
sindhiMeaning: جنهن کي روڪڻ يا بدلائڻ ناممڪن هجي, نتيجي ڏانهن مسلسل وڌندڙ, ٻاڏائڻ يا سمجهائڻ سان نه مڙندڙ
synonyms: Relentless, Unstoppable, Inevitable, Unyielding, Implacable, Remorseless, Inescapable
Relentlessly, Inevitably, Unstoppably, Steadily, Implacably, Remorselessly
antonyms: Avoidably, Hesitantly, Reversibly, Sporadically, Mercifully
englishMeaning: In a way that cannot be stopped or changed. Relentlessly and inevitably. Without yielding to persuasion.

urduMeaning: ایسے انداز میں جسے روکا نہ جا سکے, مسلسل اور ناگزیر طور پر, التجا سے متاثر نہ ہوتے ہوئے

synonyms: Unwise, Imprudent, Impractical, Ill-advised, Disadvantageous, Unsuitable
englishMeaning: Not advisable or suitable in the circumstances. Likely to cause difficulty or disadvantage if done. Unwise from a practical point of view.

synonyms: Contagious, Transmissible, Communicable, Catching, Spreading, Viral, Epidemic
sindhiMeaning: هڪ شخص کان ٻئي کي انفيڪشن ذريعي منتقل ٿيڻ جي قابل، بيمارين سان لاڳاپيل جيڪي مائڪروآرگنزمز جهڙوڪ بيڪٽيريا يا وائرس سبب پيدا ٿين، ٻين ڏانهن جلدي پکڙڻ جو امڪان، جوش يا جذبو آسانيءَ سان ٻين تائين پکيڙڻ

examples: COVID-19 is a highly infectious disease. The infectious laughter spread through the room. Wash your hands to prevent infectious illnesses. Her enthusiasm is infectious and motivates everyone.
englishMeaning: Capable of being transmitted from one person to another through infection. Relating to diseases caused by microorganisms like bacteria or viruses. Likely to spread quickly to others. Spreading enthusiasm or emotion easily to others.

antonyms: Gerund, Participle, Finite verb, Conjugated verb, Inflected form
synonyms: Verb form, Base form, Root form, Dictionary form, Unconjugated verb
englishMeaning: The basic form of a verb, usually preceded by the word 'to'. A verb form that does not show tense, person, or number. The dictionary form of a verb used after certain other verbs or adjectives. Relating to or being this basic verb form.
sindhiMeaning: فعل جي بنيادي صورت جيڪا عام طور تي 'to' سان استعمال ٿيندي آهي، فعل جو اهو روپ جنهن ۾ زمانو يا شخص ظاهر نه ٿيندو آهي، لغت ۾ ڏنل فعل جي اصل شڪل، مصدر
examples: In the sentence 'She wants to sing', the words 'to sing' form an infinitive. Some verbs are always followed by an infinitive. The teacher explained how to use the infinitive correctly. English learners often confuse the infinitive with the gerund.
urduMeaning: فعل کی بنیادی شکل جو عموماً 'to' کے ساتھ آتی ہے، فعل کی وہ صورت جس میں زمانہ یا شخص ظاہر نہیں ہوتا، لغت میں دی گئی فعل کی اصل شکل، مصدر

examples: The inflexible metal rod would not bend under pressure. The manager was inflexible about the deadline. His inflexible attitude made negotiations difficult. The school's inflexible rules frustrated many parents.
sindhiMeaning: جيڪو آساني سان نه وڪڙجي سگهي، سخت، پنهنجي راءِ يا فيصلي کي بدلائڻ لاءِ تيار نه هجڻ، ضدي، نئين حالتن مطابق ڌڻي نه سگهندڙ، ضابطن ۾ سخت ۽ مضبوط
synonyms: Rigid, Stiff, Stubborn, Adamant, Unyielding, Strict, Obstinate, Firm, Unbending, Harsh
urduMeaning: جو آسانی سے جھکایا نہ جا سکے، سخت، اپنی رائے یا فیصلہ بدلنے کے لیے تیار نہ ہونے والا، ضدی، نئے حالات کے مطابق ڈھل نہ سکنے والا، اصولوں میں سخت اور مضبوط
englishMeaning: Not able to bend or be bent easily; stiff. Unwilling to change opinions, decisions, or plans; stubborn. Not able to be changed or adapted to new circumstances. Strict and firm in rules or demands.
antonyms: Flexible, Adaptable, Pliant, Supple, Yielding, Lenient, Accommodating, Soft, Elastic

synonyms: Flu, Grippe, Viral infection, Respiratory infection, Seasonal flu
antonyms: Health, Wellness, Flu-free, Non-infectious state, Immunity
sindhiMeaning: هڪ وبائي وائرل انفيڪشن جيڪو تنفس جي نظام کي متاثر ڪري، هڪ فلو بيماري جنهن ۾ بخار  کنگهه  جسم ۾ درد ۽ ٿڪاوٽ شامل آهي، هڪ وبائي بيماري جيڪا آساني سان هڪ شخص کان ٻئي کي پکڙجي، هڪ موسمي بيماري جنهن کي سالياني ويڪسينيشن ذريعي روڪي سگهجي ٿو
englishMeaning: A contagious viral infection affecting the respiratory system. A flu illness characterized by fever, cough, body aches, and fatigue. An infectious disease that spreads easily from person to person. A seasonal illness that can be prevented by annual vaccination.
examples: Influenza spreads rapidly during winter months. The influenza vaccine is recommended annually. She was sick with influenza for a week. Influenza can be serious for elderly people.
urduMeaning: ایک وبائی وائرل انفیکشن جو تنفسی نظام کو متاثر کرے، ایک فلو بیماری جس میں بخار  کھانسی  جسم میں درد اور تھکاوٹ شامل ہے، ایک وبائی بیماری جو آسانی سے ایک شخص سے دوسرے کو پھیلے، ایک موسمی بیماری جس کو سالانہ ویکسینیشن سے روکا جا سکتا ہے

synonyms: Hereditary, Transferable, Bequeathable, Genetic, Descendible, Passable
urduMeaning: وراثت میں ملنے کے قابل، وارث کو منتقل ہونے والا، کسی کی وفات کے بعد حاصل ہونے والی جائیداد یا خطاب، والدین سے اولاد کو منتقل ہونے والی خصوصیت یا بیماری، قانونی طور پر منتقل ہونے والا
antonyms: Non-transferable, Non-hereditary, Acquired, Personal, Forfeited
englishMeaning: Able to be inherited or passed on to an heir. Capable of being received as property or a title after someone's death. Of a quality or disease, able to be passed from parents to children through genes. In law, describing property that can legally be handed down.
examples: The land is inheritable under local law. Some forms of blindness are inheritable. The title is inheritable only by the eldest child. They discussed which assets are inheritable by the grandchildren.
sindhiMeaning: ورثي ۾ ملڻ جوڳو، وارث ڏانهن منتقل ٿيڻ جي قابل، ڪنهن جي وفات کان پوءِ حاصل ٿيڻ لائق ملڪيت يا لقب، والدين کان اولاد ڏانهن منتقل ٿيندڙ خاصيت يا بيماري، قانوني طور منتقل ٿيندڙ

synonyms: Legacy, Bequest, Heritage, Birthright, Endowment, Patrimony, Estate, Succession
urduMeaning: وراثت، کسی کی وفات کے بعد ملنے والی جائیداد یا رقم، ورثے میں ملنے کا حق، والدین سے اولاد کو منتقل ہونے والی جسمانی یا ذہنی خصوصیات، گزشتہ نسلوں سے ملنے والی روایت یا ثقافت
antonyms: Loss, Forfeiture, Disinheritance, Debt, Deprivation, Confiscation
examples: He used his inheritance to start a small business. The brothers divided the inheritance peacefully. Eye color is determined by genetic inheritance. Our language is a precious inheritance from our ancestors.
sindhiMeaning: وراثت، ڪنهن جي وفات کان پوءِ ملندڙ ملڪيت يا رقم، ورثي ۾ ملڻ جو حق، والدين کان اولاد ڏانهن منتقل ٿيندڙ جسماني يا ذهني خاصيتون، اڳين نسلن کان مليل روايت يا ثقافت
englishMeaning: Money, property, or possessions received from someone after their death. The act or right of receiving such property. Physical or mental qualities passed from parents to children through genes. Something valuable, such as tradition or culture, handed down from earlier generations.

synonyms: Heir, Successor, Beneficiary, Legatee, Recipient, Descendant, Heiress
antonyms: Testator, Donor, Benefactor, Ancestor, Giver, Disinherited person
englishMeaning: A person who receives money, property, or a title from someone who has died. An heir who takes over what has been left behind. Someone who receives and continues a tradition, culture, or set of ideas. A person who gains something passed down from earlier generations.
examples: She was the sole inheritor of the family estate. The inheritors sold the old house last spring. Young writers are the inheritors of a rich literary tradition. He became the inheritor of his father's business.
urduMeaning: وارث، وہ شخص جسے کسی کی وفات کے بعد جائیداد یا خطاب ملے، ورثہ حاصل کرنے والا، کسی روایت یا ثقافت کو آگے بڑھانے والا، گزشتہ نسلوں سے کچھ حاصل کرنے والا
sindhiMeaning: وارث، اهو شخص جنهن کي ڪنهن جي وفات کان پوءِ ملڪيت يا لقب ملي، ورثو حاصل ڪندڙ، ڪنهن روايت يا ثقافت کي اڳتي وڌائيندڙ، اڳين نسلن کان ڪا شيءِ حاصل ڪندڙ

examples: His apology sounded insincere and did not convince anyone. She gave an insincere smile before leaving the room. Customers can easily sense insincere praise from a salesperson. He was criticised for making insincere promises during the campaign.
urduMeaning: غیر مخلص، دل سے نہ کہنے والا، محض دکھاوے والا، جھوٹا اور بناوٹی رویہ رکھنے والا، ایسا شخص جو سچے جذبات نہ رکھتے ہوئے بھی ظاہر کرے، منافقانہ
englishMeaning: Not honest or genuine in what one says or feels. Pretending to have feelings, opinions, or intentions that one does not really have. Saying things only for show or personal advantage rather than out of truth. Lackinghonesty in behaviour, praise, or emotion.
synonyms: Dishonest, False, Fake, Hypocritical, Deceitful, Two-faced, Pretended, Hollow, Disingenuous, Untruthful
antonyms: Sincere, Honest, Genuine, Truthful, Heartfelt, Candid, Frank, Earnest, Authentic
sindhiMeaning: غير مخلص، دل کان نه چوندڙ، ٺلهي ڏيکاءَ وارو، ڪوڙو ۽ بناوٽي رويو رکندڙ، اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو سچا جذبا نه رکندي به ظاهر ڪري، منافقاڻو
دانشور طبقو، پڙهيل لکيل فڪري ماڻهو، اديب عالم نقاد ۽ سوچيندڙ، سماج جا علمي ۽ ثقافتي اڳواڻ
antonyms: Masses, Anti-intellectuals, Uneducated class, Ignorant people, Common crowd
synonyms: Intellectuals, Thinkers, Scholars, Literati, Educated class, Cultural elite, Academics
urduMeaning: دانشور طبقہ، پڑھے لکھے فکری لوگ، ادیب عالم نقاد اور مفکر، معاشرے کے علمی اور ثقافتی رہنما
examples: The city's intelligentsia debated the new policy. Writers and professors formed part of the local intelligentsia. The novel criticizes the silence of the intelligentsia. Political movements often seek support from the intelligentsia. Members of the intelligentsia helped shape public opinion.
englishMeaning: Educated people in a society who are involved in intellectual, cultural, political, or artistic life. The class of writers, scholars, thinkers, critics, and professionals who shape public ideas.

examples: The teacher improved the intelligibility of the lesson with examples. Background noise reduced the intelligibility of the recording. Clear pronunciation increases speech intelligibility. The report needs better structure for intelligibility. Font size affects the intelligibility of text on a screen.
englishMeaning: The quality of being understandable or clear. The degree to which speech, writing, sound, or meaning can be understood. Clarity of expression or communication.
synonyms: Clarity, Comprehensibility, Understandability, Coherence, Lucidity, Readability
sindhiMeaning: سمجهه ۾ اچڻ جي خاصيت، وضاحت، ڳالهه يا لکڻي جي سمجھڻ لائق هجڻ، آواز يا معنيٰ جي صاف هجڻ، ابلاغ جي وضاحت
antonyms: Unintelligibility, Confusion, Obscurity, Incoherence, Vagueness, Ambiguity
urduMeaning: قابل فہم ہونے کی خوبی، وضاحت، بات یا تحریر کا سمجھ میں آنے کے قابل ہونا، آواز یا معنی کا صاف ہونا، ابلاغ کی صفائی

englishMeaning: Able to be understood. Clear in meaning, speech, writing, sound, or explanation. Comprehensible to the mind or senses.
sindhiMeaning: سمجهه ۾ ايندڙ، واضح، سمجھڻ لائق، معنيٰ صاف رکندڙ، ٻڌڻ يا پڙهڻ ۾ سمجھه ايندڙ
urduMeaning: سمجھ میں آنے والا، واضح، قابل فہم، معنی صاف رکھنے والا، سننے یا پڑھنے میں سمجھ آنے والا
examples: His explanation was simple and intelligible. The recording was barely intelligible because of the noise. Scientific ideas should be made intelligible to ordinary readers. Her pronunciation is clear and intelligible. The map became intelligible after he explained the symbols.
antonyms: Unintelligible, Confusing, Incomprehensible, Obscure, Garbled, Unclear
synonyms: Understandable, Comprehensible, Clear, Coherent, Plain, Graspable, Lucid

englishMeaning: In a clear and understandable way. So that words, ideas, speech, or writing can be understood easily.
urduMeaning: واضح انداز میں، سمجھ میں آنے والے طریقے سے، صاف الفاظ میں، اس طرح کہ مطلب آسانی سے سمجھا جا سکے
antonyms: Unintelligibly, Confusingly, Unclearly, Incoherently, Obscurely, Mumbledly
synonyms: Clearly, Understandably, Coherently, Plainly, Lucidly, Readably
sindhiMeaning: واضح نموني، سمجهه ۾ ايندڙ طريقي سان، صاف لفظن ۾، اهڙي طرح جو مطلب آساني سان سمجھي سگهجي
examples: Please speak slowly and intelligibly. She explained the rule intelligibly to the class. The witness answered clearly and intelligibly. Technical information should be presented intelligibly. He writes intelligibly even about difficult subjects.

antonyms: Ground-only network, Local cable service, Terrestrial communication, Non-satellite system
synonyms: Satellite operator, Telecommunications company, Satellite network, Communications provider, Space communications
englishMeaning: A proper name associated with international satellite telecommunications. The name of a satellite communications organization and company. A term used for satellites, services, or systems connected with global communication by satellite.
sindhiMeaning: بين الاقوامي سيٽلائيٽ مواصلات سان لاڳاپيل نالو، سيٽلائيٽ ڪميونيڪيشن اداري يا ڪمپني جو نالو، عالمي سيٽلائيٽ رابطن سان واسطو رکندڙ نالو
urduMeaning: بین الاقوامی سیٹلائٹ مواصلات سے متعلق نام، سیٹلائٹ کمیونیکیشن ادارے یا کمپنی کا نام، عالمی سیٹلائٹ رابطوں سے وابستہ نام
examples: Intelsat provides satellite communication services. The broadcaster used an Intelsat link for the live event. Engineers monitored the Intelsat satellite during the operation. Intelsat is often mentioned in discussions of global telecommunications. The remote station received data through an Intelsat system.

sindhiMeaning: وڌيڪ دلچسپ لاءِ استعمال ٿيندڙ غير معياري لفظ، غير رسمي يا مذاق واري انداز ۾ چيو ويندڙ، رسمي انگريزيءَ ۾ غلط سمجهيو ويندڙ، جنهن جي جاءِ تي مور انٽرسٽنگ درست آهي
urduMeaning: زیادہ دلچسپ کے لیے استعمال ہونے والا غیر معیاری لفظ، غیر رسمی یا مزاحیہ انداز میں کہا جانے والا، رسمی انگریزی میں غلط سمجھا جانے والا، جس کی جگہ مور انٹرسٹنگ درست ہے
synonyms: More interesting, More engaging, More appealing, More absorbing
antonyms: Less interesting, Duller, More boring, More tedious
examples: Children sometimes say interestinger instead of more interesting. The teacher explained why interestinger is not correct English. He used interestinger in a joke and everyone laughed. In writing, always prefer more interesting to interestinger.
englishMeaning: A non standard comparative form sometimes used in place of more interesting. An informal or humorous way of saying that something is more engaging than another thing. Considered incorrect in formal English, where more interesting is the accepted form. Occasionally used in playful speech or writing for effect.

urduMeaning: دلچسپ انداز میں، توجہ کھینچنے والے طور پر، حیرت انگیز بات بتانے کے لیے استعمال ہونے والا لفظ، اس طرح کہ سننے والے کی دلچسپی برقرار رہے، قابل ذکر طور پر
sindhiMeaning: دلچسپ نموني، ڌيان ڇڪيندڙ انداز ۾، حيرت جوڳي ڳالهه ٻڌائڻ لاءِ استعمال ٿيندڙ لفظ، اهڙي طرح جو ٻڌندڙ جي دلچسپي برقرار رهي، قابل ذڪر طور
examples: Interestingly, the oldest building in town is also the smallest. She writes interestingly about ordinary daily life. Interestingly enough, both experiments produced the same result. The guide spoke interestingly about the region's history.
synonyms: Notably, Remarkably, Curiously, Engagingly, Surprisingly, Intriguingly
englishMeaning: In a way that attracts attention or curiosity. Used to introduce a fact that the speaker finds notable or surprising. Engagingly, so as to hold the listener's or reader's attention. Remarkably, in a manner worth mentioning.
antonyms: Boringly, Tediously, Dully, Unremarkably, Predictably

sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن نقطي يا لڪير تي ملڻ يا ڪٽڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي وچ مان گذرڻ يا پار ڪري ورهائڻ، گڏيل علاقو يا عنصر ونڊڻ، اهو نقطو يا لڪير جتي ٻه شيون ڪٽين
examples: The two roads intersect at the town center. These lines intersect at a right angle. The Venn diagrams show where the sets intersect. Their interests intersect in several areas.
urduMeaning: کسی نقطے یا لکیر پر ملنا یا کاٹنا، کسی چیز کو بیچ سے گزر کر یا پار کر کے تقسیم کرنا، مشترکہ علاقہ یا عنصر بانٹنا، وہ نقطہ یا لکیر جہاں دو چیزیں کٹیں
antonyms: Parallel, Diverge, Separate, Miss, Avoid, Bypass
synonyms: Cross, Meet, Overlap, Converge, Cut across, Join, Bisect, Divide
englishMeaning: To cross or meet at a point or along a line. To divide something by passing through or across it. To share a common area or element. The point or line where two things cross.

sindhiMeaning: ٻه يا وڌيڪ دائرا جيڪي هڪ يا وڌيڪ نقطن تي هڪ ٻئي کي ڪٽين، دائرا جيڪي گڏيل نقطا ونڊين جتي انهن جا محيط ملن، دائرا جيڪي اوورليپ ڪن ۽ تقاطع نقطا ٺاهين
examples: The Venn diagram shows two intersecting circles. Intersecting circles share common points. The Olympic logo consists of five intersecting circles. Calculate the area where the circles intersect.
englishMeaning: Two or more circles that cross each other at one or more points. Circles that share common points where their circumferences meet. Circles that overlap and create intersection points.
antonyms: Separate circles, Non-intersecting circles, Tangent circles, Disjoint circles
urduMeaning: دو یا زیادہ دائرے جو ایک یا زیادہ نقاط پر ایک دوسرے کو کاٹیں، دائرے جو مشترکہ نقاط بانٹیں جہاں ان کے محیط ملیں، دائرے جو اوورلیپ کریں اور تقاطع نقاط بنائیں
synonyms: Overlapping circles, Crossing circles, Circles with common points, Cutting circles
Present, Acquaint, Bring in, Launch, Establish, Initiate, Institute, Insert, Announce, Propose, Unveil
englishMeaning: To make a person known to another by name for the first time. To bring something into use, practice, or existence for the first time. To present a topic, speaker, or programme to an audience. To insert or put something into a place or substance. To formally propose a new law or bill for consideration.
antonyms: Withdraw, Remove, Abolish, Conclude, End, Take away, Suppress, Discontinue
urduMeaning: کسی کا تعارف کرانا، دو افراد کی پہلی بار شناسائی کرانا، کوئی نئی چیز یا رواج شروع کرنا، کسی موضوع یا پروگرام کو پیش کرنا، کوئی چیز اندر داخل کرنا، نیا قانون یا بل پیش کرنا
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن جو تعارف ڪرائڻ، ٻن ماڻهن جي پهرين ڀيرو واقفيت ڪرائڻ، ڪا نئين شيءِ يا رواج شروع ڪرڻ، ڪنهن موضوع يا پروگرام کي پيش ڪرڻ، ڪا شيءِ اندر داخل ڪرڻ، نئون قانون يا بل پيش ڪرڻ
examples: Allow me to introduce you to my colleague. The school introduced a new reading programme this year. She was invited to introduce the keynote speaker. The government plans to introduce stricter safety rules.

His invariable morning routine included a walk and coffee. The invariable laws of physics apply everywhere. She greeted everyone with her invariable smile. Rain is the invariable result of those dark clouds.
sindhiMeaning: ڪڏهن به نه بدلائيندڙ، هميشه هڪجهڙو، نوعيت يا مقدار ۾ مستقل ۽ بي تبديلي، اها شيءِ جيڪا مقرر رهي ۽ نه بدلجي، هميشه ساڳئي طريقي سان واقع ٿيندڙ
englishMeaning: Never changing; always the same. Constant and unvarying in nature or amount. Something that remains fixed and does not alter. Always occurring in the same way.
synonyms: Constant, Unchanging, Fixed, Uniform, Unvarying, Steady, Immutable, Consistent, Regular
antonyms: Variable, Changing, Unstable, Irregular, Fluctuating, Inconstant, Mutable, Erratic
urduMeaning: کبھی نہ بدلنے والا، ہمیشہ ایک جیسا، نوعیت یا مقدار میں مستقل اور غیر متغیر، وہ چیز جو مقرر رہے اور نہ بدلے، ہمیشہ اسی طریقے سے واقع ہونے والا

synonyms: Energize, Refresh, Revitalize, Stimulate, Enliven, Rejuvenate, Strengthen, Animate, Fortify, Renew
englishMeaning: To give strength, energy, or fresh life to someone or something. To make a person feel healthier, livelier, and more active. To stimulate or revive an activity, business, or economy. To refresh the mind and restore enthusiasm.
sindhiMeaning: طاقت  توانائي ۽ تازگي بخشڻ، ڪنهن کي چست ۽ تندرست ڪرڻ، ڪنهن ڪم يا معيشت ۾ نئين جان وجهڻ، ذهن کي تازو ۽ چاق ڪرڻ، همت ۽ جوش وڌائڻ
antonyms: Weaken, Exhaust, Tire, Drain, Enervate, Dull, Discourage, Sap, Debilitate
urduMeaning: طاقت  توانائی اور تازگی بخشنا، کسی کو چست اور تندرست بنانا، کسی کام یا معیشت میں نئی جان ڈالنا، ذہن کو تازہ دم کرنا، جوش اور حوصلہ بڑھانا
examples: A brisk morning walk always invigorates me. The new manager was hired to invigorate the struggling company. Cold mountain air invigorated the tired hikers. Fresh investment helped invigorate the local economy.

synonyms: Element I, Mineral iodine, Dietary iodine, Iodide
antonyms: Iodine-free, Non-iodized, Iodine deficiency
englishMeaning: A chemical element essential for thyroid hormone production. A trace mineral needed for proper metabolism and growth. A dark purple-black solid used as a disinfectant. A nutrient found in seafood, dairy, and iodized salt.
urduMeaning: ایک کیمیائی عنصر جو تھائیرائڈ ہارمون کی پیداوار کے لیے ضروری ہے، ایک معدنی جو صحیح میٹابولزم اور نشوونما کے لیے ضروری ہے، ایک گہرا جامنی سیاہ ٹھوس جو جراثیم کش کے طور پر استعمال ہو، ایک غذائی جزو جو سمندری غذا، دودھ کی مصنوعات اور آئوڈین والے نمک میں ملے
examples: Iodine is essential for thyroid function. The wound was cleaned with iodine solution. Seafood is a good source of dietary iodine. Iodine deficiency causes goiter.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ڪيميائي عنصر جيڪو تايرائڊ هارمون جي پيداوار لاءِ ضروري آهي، هڪ معدني جيڪو صحيح ميٽابولزم ۽ واڌ ويجهه لاءِ ضروري آهي، هڪ ڳاڙهو واڱڻائي ڪارو ٺوس جيڪو جراثيم ڪش طور استعمال ٿئي، هڪ غذائي جزو جيڪو سامونڊي کاڌي، کير جي شين ۽ آئوڊين ٿيل لوڻ ۾ ملي

englishMeaning: To put something in a place and then forget where it is. To lose an object temporarily through carelessness. To misplace something so that it cannot be found immediately. To leave an item somewhere and be unable to recall its location.
urduMeaning: کوئی چیز رکھ کر اس کی جگہ بھول جانا، غلط جگہ رکھ کر گم کر دینا، عارضی طور پر کھو دینا، لاپرواہی کے باعث کسی چیز کا نہ ملنا
sindhiMeaning: ڪا شيءِ رکي ان جي جاءِ وسارڻ، غلط جاءِ تي رکي وڃائڻ، عارضي طور تي گم ڪرڻ، لاپرواهيءَ سبب ڪا شيءِ نه ملڻ
examples: I seem to have mislaid my reading glasses again. He mislaid the file just before the meeting started. Please do not mislay the receipt, as we may need it. She mislaid her keys somewhere in the kitchen.

sindhiMeaning: گمراهه ڪندڙ، غلط تاثر ڏيندڙ، دوکو ڏيندڙ، اهڙي ڳالهه جيڪا سچائيءَ کان پري وٺي وڃي، مونجهارو پيدا ڪندڙ
examples: The headline was misleading and did not reflect the actual story. He was fined for making misleading claims about the product. The map turned out to be misleading in several places. Such misleading statistics can damage public trust.
synonyms: Deceptive, Confusing, Ambiguous, False, Delusive, Specious, Inaccurate, Distorted
antonyms: Truthful, Honest, Clear, Accurate, Straightforward, Reliable, Informative
englishMeaning: Giving a wrong idea or impression. Likely to make someone believe something that is not true. Deceptive in appearance, wording, or meaning. Causing confusion by presenting facts inaccurately.
urduMeaning: گمراہ کن، غلط تاثر دینے والا، دھوکہ دینے والا، ایسی بات جو سچائی سے دور لے جائے، الجھن پیدا کرنے والا

examples: The advertisement was misleadingly worded to attract more buyers. The report misleadingly suggested that sales had doubled. Prices were misleadingly displayed without mentioning extra charges. He misleadingly implied that he had written the entire book.
urduMeaning: گمراہ کن انداز میں، غلط تاثر دیتے ہوئے، اس طرح کہ سننے والا غلط بات کو سچ سمجھے، دھوکہ دینے والے انداز میں، غلط نتیجے کی طرف لے جانے والے طریقے سے
synonyms: Deceptively, Falsely, Confusingly, Ambiguously, Erroneously, Inaccurately, Delusively
sindhiMeaning: گمراهه ڪندڙ نموني، غلط تاثر ڏيندي، اهڙي طرح جو ٻڌندڙ کي غلط ڳالهه سچي لڳي، دوکي واري انداز ۾، غلط رخ ڏانهن وٺي ويندڙ نموني
antonyms: Truthfully, Honestly, Clearly, Accurately, Plainly, Correctly, Straightforwardly
englishMeaning: In a way that gives a wrong idea or false impression. So as to cause someone to believe something that is not true. In a manner that deceives or confuses, whether intentionally or not. In a way that points a person towards an incorrect conclusion.

antonyms: Philopedia, Love of children, Affection, Fondness, Tenderness, Nurturing
sindhiMeaning: ٻارن کان نفرت يا سخت ناپسنديدگي، خاص ڪري پنهنجي ٻارن کان بيزاري، ننڍڙن جي صحبت کان پري ڀڄڻ، ٻارن جي خلاف دشمني وارو ذهني رجحان
synonyms: Hatred of children, Child aversion, Antipathy, Hostility, Dislike, Loathing
englishMeaning: A hatred or strong dislike of children, especially of one's own children. An aversion to the company of the young. A psychological condition marked by hostility towards children.
urduMeaning: بچوں سے نفرت یا شدید ناپسندیدگی، خاص طور پر اپنی اولاد سے بیزاری، بچوں کی صحبت سے گریز، بچوں کے خلاف عداوت پر مبنی ذہنی کیفیت
examples: The therapist suspected a deep misopedia behind his behaviour. Misopedia is rarely discussed in ordinary conversation. Her coldness towards the children bordered on misopedia. The character in the novel suffers from misopedia.
You are mistaken about the time of the meeting. His mistaken identity led to confusion. She realized her mistaken assumption was wrong. They were arrested in a case of mistaken identity.

antonyms: Correct, Right, Accurate, True, Proper, Valid, Certain

sindhiMeaning: راءِ يا فيصلي ۾ غلط، غلطي تي ٻڌل يا غلطي تي مشتمل، غلط طور تي سڃاڻپ يا سمجهيو ويو، غلط فيصلو يا عقيدو ڪيو
synonyms: Wrong, Incorrect, Erroneous, False, Inaccurate, Misguided, Misinformed

sindhiMeaning: اهڙي طريقي سان جيڪا غلطي تي ٻڌل هجي يا غلطي تي مشتمل هجي، غلطي سان يا غلط طور تي، اهڙي انداز ۾ جيڪو غلط فيصلي يا سمجهه کي ڏيکاري، ڪنهن شيءِ بابت غلط هجڻ جي نتيجي ۾ ڪيل يا چيل

englishMeaning: In a way that is based on or contains a mistake. By error or incorrectly. In a manner showing wrong judgment or understanding. Done or said as a result of being wrong about something.
urduMeaning: ایسے طریقے سے جو غلطی پر مبنی ہو یا غلطی پر مشتمل ہو، غلطی سے یا غلط طور پر، ایسے انداز میں جو غلط فیصلے یا سمجھ کو ظاہر کرے، کسی چیز کے بارے میں غلط ہونے کے نتیجے میں کیا یا کہا گیا
examples: He mistakenly believed the meeting was today. I mistakenly sent the email to the wrong person. The package was mistakenly delivered to the wrong address. She mistakenly thought the store was closed.

synonyms: Ditch, Trench, Channel, Fosse, Canal, Waterway, Barrier, Excavation
antonyms: Bridge, Wall, Mound, Embankment, Dry land, Causeway, Open ground
sindhiMeaning: قلعي جي چوڌاري کوٽيل ڊگهي ۽ اونهي کاهي جيڪا پاڻيءَ سان ڀريل هجي، حفاظتي کاهي، شهر پناهه جي چوڌاري پاڻيءَ جو گهيرو، ڪنهن جاءِ کي کاهيءَ سان گهيرڻ
examples: The old castle is surrounded by a deep moat. Ducks now swim peacefully in the moat. Attackers found it impossible to cross the moat. The palace was moated for extra protection.
urduMeaning: قلعے کے گرد کھودی گئی گہری اور چوڑی خندق جو پانی سے بھری ہو، حفاظتی خندق، فصیل کے گرد پانی کا گھیرا، کسی جگہ کو خندق سے گھیرنا
englishMeaning: A deep, wide ditch dug around a castle or town and usually filled with water. A defensive water channel surrounding a fortified building. To surround a place with such a ditch for protection.

urduMeaning: کسی چیز میں کی گئی تبدیلی یا ترمیم، بہتری کے لیے لائی گئی تبدیلی، کسی منصوبے، قانون یا مشین میں کی گئی درستگی، ترمیم کرنے کا عمل
examples: The car requires a few modifications before the race. Minor modifications to the contract were accepted by both sides. Genetic modification of crops remains a debated topic. They approved the modification of the original design.

englishMeaning: A change made to something in order to improve it or make it more suitable. The act or process of modifying something. A small alteration in the structure, form, or quality of a thing. An adjustment made to a plan, rule, or machine.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ ۾ ڪيل تبديلي يا ترميم، بهتري لاءِ آندل ڦيرڦار، ڪنهن منصوبي، قانون يا مشين ۾ ڪيل سڌارو، ترميم ڪرڻ جو عمل
synonyms: Change, Alteration, Adjustment, Amendment, Revision, Adaptation, Variation, Refinement

antonyms: Head word, Noun, Subject, Core term, Main element

sindhiMeaning: اهو لفظ يا جملو جيڪو ٻئي لفظ جي معنيٰ کي واضح يا محدود ڪري، ترميم ڪندڙ، تبديلي آڻيندڙ شيءِ يا شخص، صفت يا حال جيڪو ڪنهن لفظ جي وضاحت ڪري
urduMeaning: وہ لفظ یا فقرہ جو کسی دوسرے لفظ کے معنی کو واضح یا محدود کرے، ترمیم کرنے والا، تبدیلی لانے والی چیز یا شخص، صفت یا متعلق فعل جو کسی لفظ کی وضاحت کرے
کسی چیز میں معمولی تبدیلی کرنا، بہتر بنانے کے لیے ترمیم کرنا، کسی منصوبے یا ڈیزائن میں رد و بدل کرنا، گرامر میں کسی لفظ کے معنی کو محدود کرنا
examples: The company had to modify its plan after the survey results. He modified the engine to make it run more efficiently. We can modify the design if the client is not satisfied. Adverbs modify verbs, adjectives, and other adverbs.
englishMeaning: To change something slightly in order to improve it or make it more suitable. To make partial changes to the form, character, or quality of something. To limit or qualify the meaning of a word in grammar. To adjust a design, plan, or behaviour.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ ۾ ٿوري تبديلي آڻڻ، بهتر بڻائڻ لاءِ ترميم ڪرڻ، ڪنهن منصوبي يا ڊيزائين ۾ ڦيرڦار ڪرڻ، گرامر ۾ ڪنهن لفظ جي معنيٰ کي محدود ڪرڻ
synonyms: Change, Alter, Adjust, Amend, Revise, Adapt, Refine, Reshape, Tweak, Vary
antonyms: Keep, Retain, Preserve, Maintain, Leave unchanged, Fix, Standardise

examples: She wore a modish jacket that caught everyone's attention. The café has a modish interior full of bright colours. His modish taste in music changes every season. The magazine featured several modish designs for spring.

synonyms: Fashionable, Stylish, Trendy, Chic, Smart, Contemporary, Voguish, Up-to-date

antonyms: Integrated, Fixed, Monolithic, Unified, Inseparable, One-piece

urduMeaning: صرف ایک زبان بولنے یا استعمال کرنے والا، صرف ایک ہی زبان میں لکھا یا بیان کیا گیا، ایسا شخص جو صرف ایک زبان جانتا ہو

examples: The charity supplies necessaries to displaced families. He earned barely enough to buy the necessaries of life. The law protects a minor who contracts for necessaries. Blankets and food were the first necessaries sent to the camp.

examples: Expensive things are not necessarily better. A long book is not necessarily a good one. The change will necessarily affect our budget. Rain does not necessarily mean the match will be cancelled.
sindhiMeaning: لازمي طور تي، ضروري نتيجي طور، هر حالت ۾، منفي جملي ۾ اهو ظاهر ڪرڻ لاءِ ته هميشه ائين نه ٿيندو آهي، اڻٽر طور

urduMeaning: ضروری، لازمی، کسی مقصد کے لیے درکار، قانون یا حالات کے مطابق واجب، ناگزیر اور یقینی، اختیاری نہیں بلکہ بنیادی
examples: It is necessary to book your seat in advance. The doctor did everything necessary to save the patient. Bring the necessary documents to the interview. Change was necessary if the company was to survive.

sindhiMeaning: ضروري، لازمي، ڪنهن مقصد لاءِ گهربل، قانون يا حالتن مطابق واجب، اڻٽر ۽ يقيني، اختياري نه پر بنيادي
synonyms: Essential, Required, Vital, Indispensable, Compulsory, Needed, Imperative, Obligatory
englishMeaning: Needed in order to achieve a particular result. Required by circumstances, rules, or law. Unavoidable and certain to happen. Essential rather than optional.

antonyms: Luxury, Extra, Option, Choice, Nonessential, Superfluity
urduMeaning: ضرورت، ایسی چیز جس کے بغیر گزارہ نہ ہو، لازمی ہونے کی حالت، مجبوری یا شدید حاجت، زندگی کی بنیادی ضرورت
synonyms: Need, Requirement, Essential, Prerequisite, Must, Obligation, Demand
sindhiMeaning: ضرورت، اهڙي شيءِ جنهن کان سواءِ گذارو نه ٿئي، لازمي هجڻ جي حالت، مجبوري يا سخت گهرج، زندگيءَ جي بنيادي گهرج
examples: Clean drinking water is an absolute necessity. Necessity forced them to sell the family land. There is no necessity to arrive before eight. For many households, a mobile phone is now a necessity.
englishMeaning: Something that is essential and cannot be done without. The state of being required or unavoidable. A situation of urgent need or hardship that forces action. A basic requirement for living or working.

examples: Our neighbour looks after the house when we travel. India and Nepal are close neighbours. We are taught to love our neighbour as ourselves. Their farm neighbours the river on the eastern side.
sindhiMeaning: ڀرسان رهندڙ ماڻهو، پاڙيسري، ڀرپاسي وارو ملڪ  شهر يا شيءِ، اخلاقي يا مذهبي لحاظ کان ٻيو انسان، ڪنهن شيءِ جي ڀرسان واقع هجڻ
synonyms: Resident nearby, Next-door, Fellow citizen, Adjacent party, Neighbor, Border on, Adjoin
antonyms: Stranger, Foreigner, Outsider, Alien, Distant party, Enemy
englishMeaning: A person living next door to or very near another person. A country, town, or thing situated next to another. A fellow human being, especially in a moral or religious sense. To be situated next to or adjoin something.
urduMeaning: ساتھ یا قریب رہنے والا شخص، ہمسایہ، ساتھ واقع ملک  شہر یا چیز، اخلاقی یا مذہبی لحاظ سے دوسرا انسان، کسی چیز کے ساتھ متصل ہونا

examples: They moved to a quiet neighbourhood near the park. The whole neighbourhood came out to help. There are three schools in the neighbourhood of the station. The repairs will cost in the neighbourhood of fifty thousand rupees.
synonyms: District, Locality, Area, Vicinity, Quarter, Community, Surroundings, Precinct
sindhiMeaning: شهر جو ڪو علائقو يا محلو خاص ڪري جنهن جي پنهنجي سڃاڻپ هجي، ڀرپاسي ۾ رهندڙ ماڻهو، ڪنهن جاءِ جي آسپاس وارو علائقو، لڳ ڀڳ مقدار يا اندازو، پاڙو
urduMeaning: شہر کا کوئی علاقہ یا محلہ خاص طور پر جس کی اپنی پہچان ہو، آس پاس رہنے والے لوگ، کسی جگہ کے گرد و نواح کا علاقہ، تقریباً مقدار یا اندازہ، پڑوس
englishMeaning: A district or area within a town or city, especially one with distinctive characteristics. The people who live near one another in a particular area. The surrounding region or vicinity of a place. An approximate amount or range, as in “in the neighbourhood of”.
antonyms: Distance, Remoteness, Wilderness, Faraway place, Outskirts, Isolation
Both, Either, Each, All
sindhiMeaning: ٻنهي مان ڪوبه نه، نه هي نه هو، ٻي ڳالهه لاءِ به نفي ظاهر ڪرڻ لاءِ استعمال ٿيندڙ لفظ، نار سان گڏجي ٻن منفي ڳالهين کي ڳنڍيندڙ
synonyms: Not either, Nor, None of the two, Not one
urduMeaning: دونوں میں سے کوئی بھی نہیں، نہ یہ نہ وہ، دوسری بات کے لیے بھی نفی ظاہر کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہونے والا لفظ، نار کے ساتھ مل کر دو منفی باتوں کو جوڑنے والا
englishMeaning: Not one nor the other of two people or things. Used to show that a negative statement applies equally to a second person or thing. Used with nor to link two negative alternatives. Not either of the two options mentioned.
examples: Neither answer was completely correct. He speaks neither French nor German. She did not agree, and neither did her brother. Neither of the two applicants had the required experience.

antonyms: Non-surgical treatment, Conservative therapy, Medication, Physiotherapy
englishMeaning: The branch of medicine and surgery concerned with the brain, spinal cord, and nervous system. A surgical operation performed on the nervous system, especially the brain. The medical specialty that diagnoses and surgically treats disorders of the nerves, brain, and spine.
sindhiMeaning: دماغ، ريڙهه جي هڏي ۽ اعصابي نظام جي جراحي، دماغي آپريشن جو شعبو، نسن ۽ دماغ جي بيمارين جو جراحي علاج، طب جي اها شاخ جيڪا اعصابي نظام جي آپريشن سان تعلق رکي
synonyms: Brain surgery, Neurological surgery, Cranial surgery, Spinal surgery
urduMeaning: دماغ، ریڑھ کی ہڈی اور اعصابی نظام کی جراحی، دماغی آپریشن کا شعبہ، اعصاب اور دماغ کی بیماریوں کا جراحی علاج، طب کی وہ شاخ جو اعصابی نظام کے آپریشن سے متعلق ہے
examples: He underwent neurosurgery to remove a small tumour. The hospital is well known for its advances in neurosurgery. She spent ten years training in neurosurgery. Modern neurosurgery relies heavily on precise imaging technology.

antonyms: Calm, Stable, Relaxed, Composed, Balanced, Rational, Easy-going, Untroubled
sindhiMeaning: حد کان وڌيڪ پريشان يا وهمي، ذهني بي چينيءَ ۾ ورتل، بي جا خوف ۽ وسوسن جو شڪار، اهڙو شخص جيڪو هر وقت فڪرمند رهي، نفسياتي بي آراميءَ سان لاڳاپيل
synonyms: Anxious, Obsessive, Nervous, Unstable, Compulsive, Overwrought, Paranoid, Highly strung
englishMeaning: Suffering from or affected by excessive anxiety, worry, or emotional instability. Behaving in an obsessive, overly sensitive, or irrationally fearful way. Relating to neurosis, a mild mental disorder involving distress but not loss of contact with reality. A person who is habitually anxious or obsessive.
urduMeaning: حد سے زیادہ پریشان یا وہمی، ذہنی بے چینی میں مبتلا، بلاوجہ خوف اور وسوسوں کا شکار، ایسا شخص جو ہر وقت فکرمند رہے، نفسیاتی بے چینی سے متعلق
examples: He becomes neurotic about cleanliness whenever guests are expected. Her neurotic fear of flying kept her from travelling. The film portrays a neurotic writer struggling with deadlines. Being a neurotic, he double-checked every detail of the plan.

He neurotically checked the locks three times before leaving. She worried neurotically about every small mistake at work. The character behaves neurotically whenever he is under pressure. They neurotically rearranged the files again and again.
sindhiMeaning: انتهائي پريشاني ۽ وسوسن واري انداز ۾، بي جا خوف يا ذهني بي چينيءَ سان، وهم ۽ جنون واري نموني، حد کان وڌيڪ حساسيت سان
englishMeaning: In a way that shows excessive anxiety, worry, or obsessive behaviour. In a manner marked by unreasonable fear or emotional instability. Behaving with nervous, compulsive, or over-sensitive tendencies.
antonyms: Calmly, Serenely, Coolly, Rationally, Confidently, Placidly, Steadily
synonyms: Anxiously, Obsessively, Compulsively, Nervously, Fretfully, Hysterically, Restlessly
urduMeaning: انتہائی پریشانی اور وہم کے انداز میں، بلاوجہ خوف یا ذہنی بے چینی کے ساتھ، جنونی اور وسوسوں بھرے طریقے سے، حد سے زیادہ حساسیت کے ساتھ

sindhiMeaning: اهو زهر جيڪو اعصابي نظام کي نقصان پهچائي، دماغ ۽ نسن جي ڪم کي متاثر ڪندڙ زهريلو مادو، سانپ، وڇون يا جراثيمن مان پيدا ٿيندڙ زهر، اعصابن کي تباهه ڪندڙ ڪيميائي مادو
examples: Snake venom contains a powerful neurotoxin that paralyses the muscles. Long exposure to this metal acts as a neurotoxin in young children. Scientists isolated the neurotoxin to develop an antidote. The bacteria release a neurotoxin that affects breathing.
synonyms: Nerve poison, Toxin, Venom, Poison, Toxic agent, Nerve agent
englishMeaning: A poison or substance that damages, destroys, or impairs the function of nerve tissue. A toxic chemical that acts on the nervous system, often produced by animals, plants, or bacteria. Any agent that interferes with the normal activity of nerves and the brain.
urduMeaning: وہ زہر جو اعصابی نظام کو نقصان پہنچائے، دماغ اور اعصاب کے افعال کو متاثر کرنے والا زہریلا مادہ، سانپ، بچھو یا جراثیم سے پیدا ہونے والا زہر، اعصاب کو تباہ کرنے والا کیمیائی مادہ
antonyms: Antidote, Antitoxin, Remedy, Cure, Nutrient, Tonic
Neurotoxin, Blocker, Inhibitor, Antagonist
urduMeaning: وہ کیمیائی مادہ جو ایک عصبی خلیے سے دوسرے تک پیغام پہنچاتا ہے، دماغی پیغام رساں مادہ، ڈوپامین یا سیروٹونن جیسا مادہ جو مزاج اور سوچ پر اثر ڈالتا ہے، اعصاب اور عضلات کے درمیان رابطے کا ذریعہ
sindhiMeaning: اهو ڪيميائي مادو جيڪو هڪ عصبي خليي کان ٻئي تائين پيغام پهچائي، دماغي پيغام رسان مادو، ڊوپامين يا سيروٽونين جهڙو ڪيميائي مواد جيڪو مزاج ۽ سوچ تي اثر انداز ٿئي، نسن ۽ عضون جي وچ ۾ رابطي جو ذريعو
synonyms: Chemical messenger, Signalling molecule, Brain chemical, Transmitter substance
englishMeaning: A chemical substance that carries signals from one nerve cell to another across a synapse. A messenger molecule released by neurons to communicate with muscles, glands, or other nerve cells. A brain chemical such as dopamine, serotonin, or acetylcholine that influences mood, movement, and thinking.
examples: Dopamine is a neurotransmitter linked to pleasure and motivation. Low levels of this neurotransmitter can affect a person's mood. The drug works by blocking a particular neurotransmitter in the brain. Researchers studied how the neurotransmitter travels across the synapse.

synonyms: Typical, Standard, Ordinary, Non-autistic, Conventional, Normative
sindhiMeaning: اهو شخص جنهن جي دماغي نشوونما ۽ رويو عام معيار مطابق هجي، آٽزم يا ڪنهن ٻي دماغي ترقياتي ڪيفيت کان سواءِ، عام ذهني ساخت رکندڙ، معمول مطابق سوچ ۽ ورتاءُ رکندڙ
antonyms: Neurodivergent, Autistic, Atypical, Neurodiverse, Unconventional
englishMeaning: Having patterns of thought, behaviour, and brain development that are considered typical or standard. Not having autism or another neurodevelopmental condition. A person whose neurological development follows the common pattern of the general population.
examples: The school welcomes both autistic and neurotypical students. Neurotypical people often misunderstand these sensory difficulties. She explained the idea in a way that neurotypical listeners could relate to. The study compared neurotypical children with those on the spectrum.
urduMeaning: وہ شخص جس کی دماغی نشوونما اور رویہ عام معیار کے مطابق ہو، آٹزم یا کسی اور اعصابی نشوونما کی کیفیت سے پاک، عام ذہنی ساخت رکھنے والا، معمول کے مطابق سوچ اور برتاؤ رکھنے والا

examples: Switzerland remained neutral throughout the war. She kept her voice neutral so no one could guess her feelings. The room was painted in neutral shades of beige and grey. He put the car in neutral before starting the engine.
sindhiMeaning: غير جانبدار، ڪنهن به فريق جي حمايت نه ڪندڙ، ڪنهن راءِ يا تعصب کان آجو، بيرنگ يا هلڪو رنگ جيڪو نمايان نه هجي، ڪيميا ۾ نه تيزابي نه القلي، بجليءَ جي لحاظ کان بي چارج، گاڏيءَ جي گيئر جي اها حالت جنهن ۾ انجڻ ڦيٿن سان ڳنڍيل نه هجي
englishMeaning: Not supporting or helping either side in a conflict, disagreement, or competition. Having no strong opinion, feeling, or bias. Not distinctive or emotionally expressive in tone, colour, or style. In chemistry, neither acidic nor alkaline. In physics, carrying no positive or negative electric charge. The position of gears in which the engine is not connected to the driving wheels.
synonyms: Impartial, Unbiased, Objective, Detached, Indifferent, Non-aligned, Uninvolved, Fair, Colourless, Muted
antonyms: Biased, Partial, Prejudiced, Partisan, Committed, Involved, Opinionated, Vivid, Charged
urduMeaning: غیر جانبدار، کسی فریق کی حمایت نہ کرنے والا، رائے یا تعصب سے پاک، ہلکا یا غیر نمایاں رنگ یا لہجہ، کیمیا میں نہ تیزابی نہ اساسی، برقی اعتبار سے بے بار، گاڑی کے گیئر کی وہ حالت جس میں انجن پہیوں سے جڑا نہ ہو

synonyms: Non-interventionist, Non-aligned, Isolationist, Pacifist, Impartialist, Fence-sitter
urduMeaning: غیر جانبداری کی پالیسی کا حامی شخص، وہ فرد جو سمجھتا ہے کہ ملک کو جنگوں میں کسی فریق کا ساتھ نہیں دینا چاہیے، غیر وابستگی کے نظریے کا پیروکار، غیر جانبدار پالیسی سے متعلق
antonyms: Interventionist, Partisan, Ally, Belligerent, Advocate, Supporter, Militarist
examples: The neutralists argued that the country should stay out of the alliance. He was known as a lifelong neutralist in foreign affairs. Neutralist opinion grew stronger as the conflict widened. The party adopted a firmly neutralist position on the war.
sindhiMeaning: غير جانبداريءَ جي پاليسيءَ جو حامي شخص، اهو ماڻهو جيڪو سمجهي ٿو ته ملڪ کي جنگين ۾ ڪنهن به طرف نه ٿيڻ گهرجي، غير وابستگيءَ جي سوچ رکندڙ، غير جانبدار پاليسيءَ سان لاڳاپيل
englishMeaning: A person who supports or follows a policy of neutrality, especially in international politics. Someone who believes a country should not take sides in wars or alliances. Relating to or characteristic of a policy of political neutrality.

synonyms: Counteraction, Nullification, Cancellation, Offsetting, Deactivation, Negation, Balancing
antonyms: Activation, Intensification, Reinforcement, Aggravation, Strengthening, Escalation
examples: The students observed the neutralization of acid by an alkali. Neutralization of the poison took several hours. The treaty led to the neutralization of the disputed border region. Neutralization reactions always produce a salt and water.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي بي اثر يا بي ضرر بڻائڻ جو عمل، ڪيميا ۾ تيزاب ۽ القليءَ جي ملڻ سان لوڻ ۽ پاڻي ٺهڻ وارو عمل، ڪنهن اثر يا قوت کي ختم ڪرڻ، ڪنهن علائقي کي غير جانبدار قرار ڏيڻ جو عمل
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو بے اثر یا بے ضرر بنانے کا عمل، کیمیا میں تیزاب اور اساس کے ملنے سے نمک اور پانی بننے کا عمل، کسی اثر یا قوت کو زائل کرنے کا عمل، کسی علاقے کو غیر جانبدار قرار دینے کا عمل
englishMeaning: The act or process of making something ineffective or harmless. A chemical reaction in which an acid and a base combine to form a salt and water, producing a neutral solution. The act of counteracting or cancelling out an effect or force. The act of declaring a state or territory politically neutral.

urduMeaning: کسی چیز کا اثر ختم یا بے اثر کر دینا، کیمیائی طور پر تیزابیت یا اساسیت ختم کر کے متوازن بنانا، کسی دشمن یا خطرے کو بے ضرر بنا دینا، کسی اثر کو زائل یا برابر کر دینا، کسی علاقے کو غیر جانبدار قرار دینا
synonyms: Counteract, Nullify, Cancel out, Offset, Disable, Counterbalance, Negate, Subdue, Deactivate
antonyms: Intensify, Strengthen, Activate, Aggravate, Reinforce, Provoke, Enhance, Support
englishMeaning: To stop something from having an effect by applying an opposite force or influence. To make a substance chemically neutral, neither acidic nor alkaline. To make an enemy, threat, or opponent harmless, often by disabling or eliminating them. To counteract or cancel out the impact of something. To declare a country or area politically neutral.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ جو اثر ختم يا بي اثر ڪرڻ، ڪيميائي طور تيزابيت يا القلائيت ختم ڪري متوازن بڻائڻ، ڪنهن دشمن يا خطري کي بي ضرر بڻائڻ، ڪنهن اثر کي رد ڪرڻ يا برابر ڪرڻ، ڪنهن علائقي کي غير جانبدار قرار ڏيڻ
examples: Baking soda is often used to neutralize acid in the stomach. The security team moved quickly to neutralize the threat. Tax cuts were introduced to neutralize the effect of rising prices. Their strong defence neutralized the opposing team's best striker.

synonyms: Impartially, Objectively, Fairly, Dispassionately, Evenly, Indifferently, Blandly
urduMeaning: غیر جانبدارانہ انداز میں، کسی فریق کی حمایت کیے بغیر، جذبات یا رائے ظاہر کیے بغیر، سادہ اور غیر نمایاں طریقے سے، متوازن حالت میں
antonyms: Partially, Subjectively, Emotionally, Prejudicially, Passionately, Vividly
examples: The reporter described the incident neutrally and without comment. She answered neutrally to avoid offending anyone. The walls were painted neutrally to suit any furniture. He held his face neutrally as the verdict was read out.
sindhiMeaning: غير جانبدارانه انداز ۾، ڪنهن به طرف جي حمايت کان سواءِ، بنا ڪنهن جذبي يا راءِ ظاهر ڪرڻ جي، سادي ۽ غير نمايان نموني، متوازن حالت ۾
englishMeaning: In an impartial way that does not favour either side. Without showing emotion, opinion, or bias. In a plain, understated, or non-distinctive manner. In a balanced position that is neither one extreme nor the other.

antonyms: Compound, Molecule, Macroscopic body, Composite particle
synonyms: Subatomic particle, Elementary particle, Lepton, Fundamental particle
sindhiMeaning: هڪ انتهائي ننڍڙو ذيلي ايٽمي ذرو جنهن جو ڪوبه بار ناهي ۽ ماس نه هجڻ برابر آهي، سج ۽ ايٽمي ردعمل مان پيدا ٿيندڙ بنيادي ذرو، اهو ذرو جيڪو مادي مان بنا رڪاوٽ گذري وڃي، ڪائنات جو انتهائي عام پر مشڪل سان پڪڙجندڙ ذرو
englishMeaning: An extremely small subatomic particle that has almost no mass and carries no electric charge. A fundamental particle produced in nuclear reactions such as those in the sun, which passes through matter almost undisturbed. One of the most abundant particles in the universe, very difficult to detect.
urduMeaning: ایک نہایت باریک ذیلی ایٹمی ذرہ جس پر کوئی برقی بار نہیں اور کمیت نہ ہونے کے برابر ہے، سورج اور جوہری تعاملات سے پیدا ہونے والا بنیادی ذرہ، وہ ذرہ جو مادے میں سے بغیر رکاوٹ گزر جاتا ہے، کائنات کا عام مگر مشکل سے قابلِ شناخت ذرہ
examples: Billions of neutrinos pass through your body every second. The detector was built deep underground to capture a neutrino. Scientists study the neutrino to understand the sun's core. A neutrino carries no electric charge at all.

englishMeaning: A subatomic particle found in the nucleus of an atom that carries no electric charge. A neutral particle with a mass slightly greater than that of a proton. One of the two main building blocks of the atomic nucleus, alongside the proton, whose number determines the isotope of an element.
examples: A neutron has no electric charge, unlike a proton. The nucleus of this atom contains six protons and eight neutrons. Firing a neutron at uranium can start a chain reaction. Neutron numbers differ between isotopes of the same element.
sindhiMeaning: ايٽم جي مرڪز ۾ موجود اهو ذرو جنهن تي ڪوبه برقي بار ناهي، پروٽان کان ٿورو وڌيڪ وزن رکندڙ غير جانبدار ذرو، ايٽمي مرڪز جو بنيادي جزو، اهو ذرو جنهن جو تعداد عنصر جي آئسوٽوپ کي طئي ڪري
synonyms: Nuclear particle, Subatomic particle, Nucleon, Neutral particle
antonyms: Proton, Electron, Ion, Charged particle
urduMeaning: ایٹم کے مرکزے میں موجود وہ ذرہ جس پر کوئی برقی بار نہیں ہوتا، پروٹون سے قدرے زیادہ کمیت رکھنے والا غیر جانبدار ذرہ، ایٹمی مرکزے کا بنیادی جزو، وہ ذرہ جس کی تعداد عنصر کے آئسوٹوپ کا تعین کرتی ہے

synonyms: Enhanced radiation weapon, Nuclear weapon, Radiation bomb, Atomic warhead
antonyms: Conventional weapon, Disarmament, Peace treaty, Non-nuclear arms
urduMeaning: وہ جوہری ہتھیار جو اپنی زیادہ تر توانائی نیوٹرون شعاعوں کی صورت میں خارج کرتا ہے، ایسا بم جو انسانوں کو شعاعوں سے ہلاک کرے مگر عمارتوں کو کم نقصان پہنچائے، بڑھی ہوئی تابکاری والا جوہری ہتھیار، سرد جنگ کے دور کا خطرناک ہتھیار
englishMeaning: A type of nuclear weapon designed to release most of its energy as deadly neutron radiation rather than blast and heat. A weapon intended to kill people through radiation while causing relatively little damage to buildings and infrastructure. An enhanced radiation warhead developed during the Cold War era.
examples: The neutron bomb was designed to kill people while leaving buildings standing. Many countries condemned the development of the neutron bomb. A neutron bomb releases intense radiation over a limited area. The treaty aimed to halt production of the neutron bomb.
sindhiMeaning: اهو ايٽمي هٿيار جيڪو گهڻي توانائي نيوٽران شعاعن جي صورت ۾ خارج ڪري، اهو بم جيڪو ماڻهن کي شعاعن سان ماري پر عمارتن کي گهٽ نقصان پهچائي، وڌايل تابڪاري وارو ايٽمي هٿيار، سرد جنگ واري دور جو خطرناڪ هٿيار

englishMeaning: In spite of that. Despite what has just been said. Used to introduce a statement that contrasts with the previous one without cancelling it.
examples: The task was difficult; nevertheless, she completed it on time. He was tired but nevertheless kept working. The plan has flaws; nevertheless, it is worth trying. She disagreed with him, nevertheless she respected his honesty.
synonyms: Nonetheless, However, Still, Yet, Even so, Notwithstanding, All the same, Regardless
sindhiMeaning: ان جي باوجود، تنهن هوندي به، پوءِ به، ايتري هوندي به، ان سڀ ڪجهه هوندي به
urduMeaning: اس کے باوجود، پھر بھی، تاہم، اس کے باوصف، اتنا ہونے کے باوجود
antonyms: Therefore, Thus, Consequently, Hence, Accordingly

englishMeaning: A person who gives nicknames to others. Someone known for creating or using nicknames. An informal term for a person fond of using alternative names. A person skilled at inventing descriptive or humorous names.
examples: He's the nickman of our group, always coming up with funny names. Every team needs a nickman to lighten the mood. The nickman gave everyone unique identifiers. As the office nickman, he knew everyone by their alternate names.
urduMeaning: ایسا شخص جو دوسروں کو عرفی نام دے، کوئی بھی جو عرفی نام بنانے یا استعمال کرنے کے لیے جانا جائے، متبادل ناموں کا استعمال کرنے کا شوقین شخص کے لیے غیر رسمی اصطلاح، تشریحی یا مزاحیہ نام ایجاد کرنے میں ماہر شخص
sindhiMeaning: اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو ٻين کي لقب ڏئي، ڪو به جيڪو لقب ٺاهڻ يا استعمال ڪرڻ لاءِ سڃاتو وڃي، متبادل نالا استعمال ڪرڻ جو شوقين شخص لاءِ غير رسمي اصطلاح، تشريحي يا مزاحيه نالا ايجاد ڪرڻ ۾ ماهر ماڻهو
synonyms: Nickname giver, Name creator, Moniker maker, Epithet inventor
antonyms: Formal person, Serious individual, Traditional name user

synonyms: Nineteen-sided polygon, Enneadecagon, Nonadecagonal shape, Nineteen-gon
sindhiMeaning: اڻويهه رخن ۽ اڻويهه ڪنڊن وارو هڪ شڪل، اڻويهه سڌي پاسن ۽ اڻويهه نقطن وارو جيوميٽري شڪل، اڻويهه ڪنڊن ۽ اڻويهه ڪنارن وارو ڪو به برابر شڪل
urduMeaning: انیس اضلاع اور انیس زاویوں والی شکل، انیس سیدھی اطراف اور انیس نقاط والی ہندسی شکل، انیس کونوں اور انیس کناروں والی کوئی بھی چپٹی شکل
englishMeaning: A nineteen-sided polygon with nineteen angles. A geometric shape with nineteen straight sides and nineteen vertices. Any flat shape with nineteen corners and nineteen edges.
antonyms: Circle, Triangle, Square, Hexagon, Irregular shape
examples: A regular nonadecagon has nineteen equal sides and angles. The complex geometric pattern included a nonadecagon. Students measured the interior angles of a nonadecagon. The ornamental design featured a nonadecagonal structure.

urduMeaning: نو اضلاع اور نو زاویوں والی شکل، نو سیدھی اطراف اور نو نقاط والی ہندسی شکل، نو کونوں اور نو کناروں والی کوئی بھی چپٹی شکل
synonyms: Nine-sided polygon, Nonagonal shape, Enneagon, Nine-gon
sindhiMeaning: نون رخن ۽ نون ڪنڊن وارو هڪ شڪل، نون سڌي پاسن ۽ نون نقطن وارو جيوميٽري شڪل، نون ڪنڊن ۽ نون ڪنارن وارو ڪو به برابر شڪل
antonyms: Circle, Triangle, Square, Octagon, Irregular shape
examples: A regular nonagon has nine equal sides and angles. The architectural design featured a nonagonal courtyard. Students calculated the interior angles of a nonagon. The decorative tile was shaped like a nonagon.
englishMeaning: A nine-sided polygon with nine angles. A geometric shape with nine straight sides and nine vertices. Any flat shape with nine corners and nine edges.

synonyms: Separate circles, Disjoint circles, Non-overlapping circles, Independent circles
sindhiMeaning: دائرا جيڪي هڪ ٻئي کي ڪنهن به نقطي تي نه ڪٽن ۽ نه ڇهن، دائرا جيڪي مڪمل طور الڳ هجن ۽ ڪو گڏيل نقطو نه هجي، دائرا جيڪي الڳ رهن ۽ اوورليپ يا ملڻ کان سواءِ
antonyms: Intersecting circles, Overlapping circles, Tangent circles, Connected circles
urduMeaning: دائرے جو ایک دوسرے کو کسی بھی نقطے پر نہ کاٹیں اور نہ چھوئیں، دائرے جو مکمل طور پر الگ ہوں اور کوئی مشترکہ نقطہ نہ ہو، دائرے جو الگ رہیں اور اوورلیپ یا ملنے کے بغیر
englishMeaning: Circles that do not cross or touch each other at any point. Circles that are completely separate with no common points. Circles that remain distinct without overlapping or meeting.
examples: The two planets' orbits are non-intersecting circles. Non-intersecting circles have no points in common. The diagram shows three non-intersecting circles. These circles are completely separate and non-intersecting.

sindhiMeaning: چوڻي جنهن جو مطلب آهي ته ڪاميابي وڌيڪ ڪاميابي آڻيندي آهي، هڪ ڀيرو ڪامياب ٿيڻ سان نوان موقعا ملندا آهن، ماڻهو ڪامياب ماڻهوءَ جو ساٿ ڏيندا آهن
examples: After his first hit song, offers poured in; nothing succeeds like success. The shop grew quickly because nothing succeeds like success. Investors joined the project late, proving that nothing succeeds like success. She often says nothing succeeds like success when advising young writers.
antonyms: Failure breeds failure, Vicious circle, Downward spiral
urduMeaning: ایک کہاوت جس کا مطلب ہے کہ کامیابی مزید کامیابی لاتی ہے، ایک بار کامیاب ہونے پر نئے مواقع ملتے ہیں، لوگ کامیاب شخص کا ساتھ دیتے ہیں
englishMeaning: A saying meaning that success creates the conditions for further success. Once a person or thing succeeds, more opportunities and support naturally follow. People are attracted to and encourage those who are already doing well.
synonyms: Success breeds success, Winning streak, Momentum, Snowball effect

antonyms: Pale, Fair, White, Blond, Light
sindhiMeaning: پچيل اخروٽ يا بادام جهڙو گرم ناسي رنگ، اهڙا وار، اکيون يا چمڙي جيڪي گهري ناسي رنگ جا هجن، سج ۾ سڙي ناسي ٿيل
synonyms: Chestnut, Hazel, Chocolate, Tawny, Russet, Brown
examples: She had nut-brown hair and bright eyes. The farmer's face was nut-brown from years in the sun. He polished the table to a warm nut-brown shine. The horse was a fine nut-brown mare.
urduMeaning: پکے میوے جیسا گرم بھورا رنگ، ایسے بال، آنکھیں یا جلد جو گہرے بھورے رنگ کے ہوں، دھوپ میں تپ کر بھورا ہو جانا
englishMeaning: A warm, medium to dark brown colour like that of a ripe nut. Describing hair, eyes, or skin of a rich brown shade. Tanned or darkened brown by the sun.

sindhiMeaning: پيهيل جَوَن جو اٽو جيڪو دليا ۽ بيڪريءَ جي شين ۾ ڪم اچي، جَوَن مان تيار ٿيل ناشتي جو دليو، جَوَن جهڙو هلڪو ڦڪو ڪريم رنگ، اهڙي نرم رنگ وارو ڪپڙو يا سامان
englishMeaning: Meal made from ground oats, used to make porridge and baked goods. A cooked breakfast dish made from oats and water or milk. A pale greyish-cream colour resembling uncooked oats. Describing fabric or furnishings of this soft neutral shade.
urduMeaning: پسے ہوئے جئی کا آٹا جو دلیہ اور بیکری کی اشیاء میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، جئی سے تیار ناشتے کا دلیہ، جئی جیسا ہلکا سرمئی کریم رنگ، ایسے نرم رنگ والا کپڑا یا سامان
examples: He eats oatmeal with honey every morning. The recipe calls for a cup of fine oatmeal. They chose an oatmeal carpet for the hallway. Her oatmeal sweater looked warm and simple.
antonyms: Bright, Vivid, Dark, Black, Bold
synonyms: Porridge, Oats, Rolled oats, Beige, Cream, Ecru

antonyms: Optional part, Silence, Solo, Ad libitum, Omission
englishMeaning: In music, an instrumental part that is essential and must not be left out of a performance. A prominent accompanying melody played alongside the main tune. Describing a musical part that is obligatory rather than optional. Figuratively, a persistent accompanying sound or background element.
synonyms: Accompaniment, Descant, Counterpoint, Melody line, Backing, Support, Ornament
urduMeaning: موسیقی میں وہ سازینہ جو لازمی ہو اور چھوڑا نہ جا سکے، مرکزی دھن کے ساتھ بجنے والی نمایاں سُر، لازمی سنگت، پس منظر میں مسلسل چلنے والی آواز
examples: The violin obbligato gave the song a haunting beauty. She composed a flute obbligato for the second movement. This part is marked obbligato in the score. The rain provided a soft obbligato to their conversation.
sindhiMeaning: موسيقيءَ ۾ اهو ساز وارو حصو جيڪو لازمي هجي ۽ ڇڏي نه سگهجي، مکيه ڌن سان گڏ وڄندڙ نمايان سُر، لازمي سنگت، پس منظر ۾ مسلسل هلندڙ آواز

examples: He obdurately refused to apologize for his remarks. She obdurately stuck to her original decision. The minister obdurately ignored every warning. They obdurately continued the strike for another week.
sindhiMeaning: هٺيلائيءَ سان، ضد ڪندي، پنهنجي راءِ يا رويي کي نه بدلائيندي، هر دٻاءَ جي باوجود اڙيل رهندي، سخت دلي سان، بي رحميءَ سان
antonyms: Flexibly, Yieldingly, Compliantly, Willingly, Submissively, Mercifully, Cooperatively
urduMeaning: ہٹ دھرمی سے، ضد کرتے ہوئے، اپنی رائے یا رویہ نہ بدلتے ہوئے، ہر دباؤ کے باوجود اڑے رہتے ہوئے، سخت دلی سے، بے رحمی کے ساتھ
englishMeaning: In a stubborn manner, refusing to change one's opinion or behavior. Persistently and unyieldingly, despite persuasion or pressure. In a hard-hearted way that shows no pity or regret. With firm and unbending determination.
synonyms: Stubbornly, Inflexibly, Unyieldingly, Doggedly, Firmly, Adamantly, Persistently, Callously
Compliance, Submission, Conformity, Deference, Docility, Allegiance, Adherence, Respect
englishMeaning: The act or practice of doing what one is told by a person in authority. Willingness to follow rules, laws, or commands. Compliance with the wishes or instructions of another. Submission to a religious rule, teacher, or superior. Training that makes an animal follow commands.
sindhiMeaning: فرمانبرداري، حڪم مڃڻ جو عمل، قاعدن ۽ قانونن تي عمل ڪرڻ، ڪنهن وڏي يا حاڪم جي چوڻ تي هلڻ، تابعداري، جانور کي حڪم مڃڻ جي تربيت
antonyms: Disobedience, Defiance, Rebellion, Resistance, Insubordination, Revolt, Nonconformity
urduMeaning: فرماں برداری، حکم ماننے کا عمل، قواعد و قوانین پر عمل کرنا، کسی بزرگ یا حاکم کے کہنے پر چلنا، اطاعت، جانور کو حکم ماننے کی تربیت
examples: The soldiers showed complete obedience to their commander. Blind obedience can be dangerous in any society. Children are taught obedience to school rules. The dog attends obedience classes every weekend.

englishMeaning: In a way that shows willingness to obey orders or instructions. Following commands promptly and without argument. In a submissive and respectful manner. Doing exactly what one is told to do.
sindhiMeaning: فرمانبرداريءَ سان، حڪم مڃيندي، بنا بحث جي چيل ڪم ڪندي، تابعداريءَ واري انداز ۾، ادب ۽ اطاعت سان
examples: The child obediently put away his toys. She obediently followed the doctor's advice. The dog sat down obediently beside its owner. The staff obediently carried out the new instructions.
urduMeaning: فرماں برداری کے ساتھ، حکم مانتے ہوئے، بغیر بحث کیے کہا ہوا کام کرتے ہوئے، اطاعت کے انداز میں، ادب اور تابعداری سے
antonyms: Defiantly, Rebelliously, Disobediently, Stubbornly, Unwillingly, Insolently
synonyms: Dutifully, Submissively, Compliantly, Meekly, Respectfully, Docilely, Faithfully

sindhiMeaning: قانون، رسم يا مذهبي فرض تي عمل ڪرڻ، رواج مطابق تقريب يا رسم ادا ڪرڻ، ضابطن جي پيروي، پابندي ڪرڻ
antonyms: Violation, Disobedience, Neglect, Breach, Disregard
synonyms: Compliance, Adherence, Obedience, Ritual, Ceremony, Practice, Keeping
urduMeaning: قانون، رسم یا مذہبی فریضے پر عمل کرنا، رواج کے مطابق تقریب یا رسم ادا کرنا، ضوابط کی پیروی، پابندی کرنا
englishMeaning: The practice of following a law, custom, rule, or religious duty. An act or ceremony performed as part of a custom or religion. Compliance with an established rule or tradition.
examples: Strict observance of safety rules is required in the factory. The observance of Ramadan begins with the sighting of the moon. Religious observances vary from region to region. The school insists on the observance of its dress code.

antonyms: Inattention, Neglect, Disregard, Oversight, Ignorance
synonyms: Watching, Monitoring, Scrutiny, Remark, Comment, Study, Examination, Notice
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي غور سان ڏسڻ، مشاهدو ڪرڻ، ڏٺل ڳالهه تي تبصرو، تفصيل نوٽ ڪرڻ جي صلاحيت، سائنسي مشاهدو يا نگراني
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو غور سے دیکھنا، مشاہدہ کرنا، دیکھی گئی بات پر تبصرہ یا رائے، تفصیلات نوٹ کرنے کی صلاحیت، سائنسی مشاہدہ یا نگرانی
examples: His careful observation of the birds lasted several weeks. She made an interesting observation about the data. The patient was kept under observation overnight. Scientific conclusions must be supported by accurate observation.
englishMeaning: The act of watching someone or something carefully. A remark or comment based on something noticed. The ability to notice important details. Information or data gathered by watching or measuring. Careful monitoring, especially in medicine or science.

synonyms: Pregnancy doctor, Childbirth specialist, OB doctor, Maternity specialist, Delivery doctor
urduMeaning: ایک طبی ڈاکٹر جو حمل  بچے کی پیدائش اور زچگی کے بعد کی دیکھ بھال میں ماہر ہو، ایک ڈاکٹر جو حاملہ خواتین کو طبی دیکھ بھال فراہم کرے اور بچے کی پیدائش کروائے، زچگی کی سائنس میں ماہر جو ماں اور جنین کی صحت کا انتظام کرے
antonyms: Pediatrician, General practitioner, Surgeon, Non-obstetric specialist
examples: The obstetrician delivered the baby safely. She is seeing an obstetrician for prenatal care. Obstetricians monitor the health of mother and baby. The obstetrician performed a cesarean section.
englishMeaning: A medical doctor who specializes in pregnancy, childbirth, and postpartum care. A physician who provides medical care to pregnant women and delivers babies. A specialist in obstetrics who manages maternal and fetal health.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ طبي ڊاڪٽر جيڪو حمل  ٻار جي پيدائش ۽ زچگي کانپوءِ سنڀال ۾ ماهر هجي، هڪ ڊاڪٽر جيڪو حامله عورتن کي طبي سنڀال فراهم ڪري ۽ ٻار جي پيدائش ڪرائي، زچگي جي سائنس ۾ ماهر جيڪو ماءُ ۽ جنين جي صحت جو انتظام ڪري

examples: The new sign is far too obtrusive for such a quiet street. He tried to help without being obtrusive. The camera was hidden so it would not be obtrusive. Obtrusive advertising can annoy customers.
synonyms: Intrusive, Conspicuous, Prominent, Interfering, Pushy, Meddlesome, Noticeable
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي طرح نمايان جيڪو ناپسنديده لڳي, حد کان وڌيڪ نمايان ۽ اڻ گهربل توجهه ڇڪيندڙ, پنهنجو پاڻ يا پنهنجي راءِ بنا گهُر جي مڙهيندڙ, اڻ وڻندڙ نموني اڳيان ۽ مداخلت ڪندڙ
urduMeaning: ایسا نمایاں جو ناگوار محسوس ہو, ضرورت سے زیادہ نمایاں اور غیر ضروری توجہ کھینچنے والا, بن بلائے اپنی رائے یا موجودگی مسلط کرنے والا, ناپسندیدہ طور پر نمایاں یا مداخلت کرنے والا
englishMeaning: Noticeable in an unpleasant or unwelcome way. Standing out too much and attracting unwanted attention. Tending to push oneself or one's opinions forward without invitation. Undesirably prominent or intrusive.
antonyms: Unobtrusive, Discreet, Subtle, Inconspicuous, Modest, Reserved

sindhiMeaning: اهڙي نموني جو ناپسنديده حد تائين نمايان لڳي, اڻ گهربل توجهه ڇڪڻ واري انداز ۾, مداخلت واري نموني, حد کان وڌيڪ نمايان انداز ۾
examples: The guard stood obtrusively near the entrance. She spoke obtrusively during the quiet ceremony. The new building rises obtrusively above the old town. He obtrusively checked his watch throughout the meeting.
englishMeaning: In a way that is unpleasantly noticeable. So as to attract unwanted attention. In an intrusive or interfering manner. In a manner that stands out too prominently.
antonyms: Unobtrusively, Discreetly, Subtly, Quietly, Inconspicuously
synonyms: Intrusively, Conspicuously, Prominently, Noticeably, Pushily
urduMeaning: اس طرح کہ ناگوار حد تک نمایاں ہو, غیر ضروری توجہ کھینچنے کے انداز میں, مداخلت کرنے والے انداز میں, حد سے زیادہ نمایاں انداز میں
وہ زاویہ جو 90 درجے سے بڑا مگر 180 درجے سے چھوٹا ہو, قائمہ زاویے سے بڑا کھلا زاویہ, قائمہ زاویے اور مستقیم زاویے کے درمیان کوئی بھی زاویہ, زاویوں کی جسامت کے مطابق ہندسی درجہ بندی
sindhiMeaning: اهو ڪنڊ جيڪو 90 درجن کان وڌيڪ پر 180 درجن کان گهٽ هجي, قائمه ڪنڊ کان وڏو ويڪرو ڪنڊ, قائمه ڪنڊ ۽ سڌي ڪنڊ جي وچ وارو ڪوبه ڪنڊ, ڪنڊن جي ماپ مطابق جاميٽري ورهاست
examples: The triangle contains one obtuse angle. An obtuse angle looks wider than a right angle. He measured an obtuse angle of one hundred and twenty degrees. The two walls meet at an obtuse angle.
antonyms: Acute angle, Right angle, Reflex angle, Zero angle
englishMeaning: An angle that measures more than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees. A wide, blunt angle larger than a right angle. Any angle between a right angle and a straight angle. A geometric classification of angles by size.
synonyms: Wide angle, Blunt angle, Open angle

examples: An obtuse-angled triangle can have only one obtuse angle. The diagram shows an obtuse-angled triangle with a wide top. She measured the largest angle of the obtuse-angled triangle. An obtuse-angled triangle never contains a right angle.
antonyms: Acute-angled triangle, Right-angled triangle, Right triangle

I owe you twenty dollars from last week. She owes her success to hard work and determination. We owe our parents gratitude for their sacrifices. He owes an apology for his rude behavior.

englishMeaning: Having legal possession of something. The act of possessing or having something as property. Acknowledging or admitting something, especially a mistake or fault. Taking responsibility for one's actions or words.

examples: Can you paraphrase this paragraph in simple English? Her paraphrase of the speech captured its spirit. The teacher asked us to paraphrase the article. He paraphrased the judgment for the newspaper readers.

urduMeaning: دوسرے الفاظ میں مطلب بیان کرنا، کسی بات کو آسان الفاظ میں دہرانا، اصل مفہوم برقرار رکھتے ہوئے الفاظ بدلنا، تشریح کرنے کا عمل

examples: The accident left him with permanent paraplegia. Physiotherapy can improve daily life for people with paraplegia. Paraplegia usually results from spinal cord injury. She wrote a book about living independently with paraplegia.

urduMeaning: جسم کے نچلے حصے کا فالج, دونوں ٹانگوں کا مفلوج ہو جانا, ریڑھ کی ہڈی کی چوٹ سے معذوری, نچلے جسم کا بے حس ہونا

examples: He became paraplegic after falling from the scaffolding. The centre trains paraplegic athletes for the Paralympics. A paraplegic patient may need a specially adapted vehicle. She learned to drive despite being paraplegic.
englishMeaning: A person who is paralysed in the lower half of the body. Relating to or affected by paraplegia. Describing paralysis that involves both legs. Suffering from loss of movement below the waist.

A slip of the tongue, pen, or memory believed to reveal an unconscious thought. A minor error in speech or action interpreted in psychoanalysis as meaningful. A Freudian slip that exposes hidden feelings or wishes.
synonyms: Freudian slip, Slip of the tongue, Verbal slip, Lapse, Blunder, Faux pas, Misstatement
antonyms: Accuracy, Correct statement, Precision, Deliberate speech, Care, Exactness
sindhiMeaning: زبان يا قلم جي اهڙي غلطي جيڪا لاشعوري سوچ ظاهر ڪري، نفسياتي لحاظ کان بامعنيٰ ننڍي غلطي، فرائيڊ جي چيل زباني ٿاٻي، لڪل خواهش ظاهر ڪندڙ چوڪ
examples: Calling his wife by his ex-partner's name was a classic parapraxis. Freud believed every parapraxis has a hidden cause. The lecture explained parapraxis with several amusing examples. Her parapraxis revealed more than she intended to say.

englishMeaning: An organism that lives on or in a host organism and benefits at the host's expense. A creature that depends on another for survival without giving benefit. An organism causing disease or harm to its host. A person who habitually relies on others without reciprocating.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ جاندار جيڪو ميزبان جاندار تي يا اندر رهي ۽ ميزبان جي خرچ تي فائدو وٺي، هڪ مخلوق جيڪا بقا لاءِ ٻئي تي منحصر آهي بغير فائدو ڏيڻ جي، هڪ جاندار جيڪو پنهنجي ميزبان کي بيماري يا نقصان پهچائي، هڪ شخص جيڪو عادتاً ٻين تي ڀروسو ڪري بغير بدلي ڏيڻ جي
examples: Malaria is caused by a parasite. Intestinal parasites can cause digestive problems. Fleas and ticks are external parasites. Some people act like parasites, taking without giving.

sindhiMeaning: سخت گرميءَ يا پاڻيءَ جي کوٽ سبب بلڪل سڪل، ڦاٽل ۽ سڪل زمين يا چپ، تمام گهڻي اڃ محسوس ڪندڙ، باهه يا گرميءَ تي ڀڳل يا سڪايل

examples: The parched fields cracked under the summer sun. After the long walk we were parched and exhausted. His lips were parched from the desert heat. They chewed parched grain during the journey.

urduMeaning: قیدی کی مشروط رہائی, وقت سے پہلے آزادی, وعدے پر رہا کرنا, قول و قرار, ضمانتی رہائی

examples: The protest ended peacefully after the leaders spoke to the crowd. The two countries settled their dispute peacefully. The baby slept peacefully in her mother's arms. They lived peacefully in the small village for many years.
