englishMeaning: The state or quality of being calm, quiet, and free from disturbance. The absence of violence, conflict, or noise. A feeling of inner calm and tranquility.
examples: She enjoyed the peacefulness of the countryside. The peacefulness of the early morning helped him think clearly. After years of war, the nation longed for peacefulness. The garden was designed to create a sense of peacefulness.
urduMeaning: سکون اور اطمینان کی حالت، تشدد جھگڑے یا شور سے آزادی، باطنی سکون کا احساس
synonyms: Calm, Tranquility, Serenity, Quiet, Stillness, Peace, Repose, Harmony
antonyms: Turmoil, Disturbance, Noise, Chaos, Unrest, Agitation

urduMeaning: وہ شخص یا سپاہی جو امن قائم رکھنے کے لیے بھیجا جائے، بین الاقوامی امن فوج کا رکن، جھگڑے ختم کر کے میل ملاپ رکھنے والا
examples: The United Nations sent peacekeepers to the troubled region. He served as a peacekeeper in three different countries. In our family, mother always acted as the peacekeeper. The peacekeepers helped distribute food and medicine to civilians.
englishMeaning: A person or soldier sent to an area to maintain peace and prevent fighting. A member of an international force that keeps peace in a conflict zone. Someone who helps settle disputes and keep harmony between people.
antonyms: Warmonger, Aggressor, Fighter, Instigator, Troublemaker, Combatant
synonyms: Peacemaker, Mediator, Negotiator, Conciliator, Intermediary, Peace force member
sindhiMeaning: اهو ماڻهو يا سپاهي جيڪو امن قائم رکڻ لاءِ موڪليو وڃي، بين الاقوامي امن فوج جو ميمبر، جهيڙا ختم ڪري ميل ملاپ رکڻ وارو

antonyms: Warfare, Warmongering, Aggression, Combat, Conflict
sindhiMeaning: امن قائم رکڻ جي سرگرمي، خاص ڪري بين الاقوامي فوج پاران جنگ جي علائقي ۾، جنگ روڪڻ ۽ شهرين جي حفاظت جون ڪوششون، امن مشن سان لاڳاپيل
synonyms: Peacemaking, Peace enforcement, Conflict prevention, Mediation, Truce-keeping
examples: The United Nations launched a peacekeeping mission in the region. Peacekeeping forces patrol the border between the two countries. He served on a peacekeeping mission for two years. The peacekeeping troops helped rebuild schools and hospitals.
urduMeaning: امن قائم رکھنے کی سرگرمی، خاص طور پر بین الاقوامی فوج کی طرف سے جنگ کے علاقے میں، لڑائی روکنے اور شہریوں کی حفاظت کی کوششیں، امن مشن سے متعلق
englishMeaning: The activity of maintaining peace, especially by an international military force in a conflict area. Efforts to prevent fighting and protect civilians in troubled regions. Relating to forces or missions that preserve peace.

sindhiMeaning: آڙوءَ جهڙي هلڪي گلابي نارنجي رنگ وارو، آڙوءَ جهڙي ذائقي، خوشبوءِ يا نرميءَ وارو، غير رسمي انداز ۾ تمام سٺو، وڻندڙ يا اطمينان بخش
synonyms: Rosy, Pinkish, Blush, Apricot, Fine, Excellent, Splendid
englishMeaning: Resembling a peach in colour, being a soft pinkish-orange shade. Resembling a peach in taste, smell, or softness. Very good, pleasant, or satisfactory, used informally.
antonyms: Pale, Grey, Dull, Awful, Terrible, Unpleasant
urduMeaning: آڑو جیسے ہلکے گلابی نارنجی رنگ والا، آڑو جیسے ذائقے، خوشبو یا نرمی والا، غیر رسمی انداز میں بہت اچھا، خوشگوار یا تسلی بخش
examples: She has a soft, peachy complexion. The dessert had a light peachy flavour. They painted the nursery in peachy tones. Everything is just peachy at the moment.

urduMeaning: ایک بڑا نر پرندہ جس کے لمبے اور رنگین پر پنکھے کی طرح پھیلتے ہیں، مور، مور کی نسل کا پرندہ، ایسا شخص جو خود نمائی پسند اور مغرور ہو، فخر سے خود کو دکھانا
synonyms: Peafowl, Show-off, Boaster, Dandy, Strut, Parade
antonyms: Peahen, Modest person, Humble, Hide, Withdraw
sindhiMeaning: هڪ وڏو نر پکي جنهن جا ڊگها ۽ رنگين کنڀ پکي وانگر ڦهلجن، مور، مور جي نسل جو پکي، اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو پاڻ پڏائيندڙ ۽ هٺيلو هجي، فخر سان پاڻ ڏيکارڻ
englishMeaning: A large male bird known for its long, brightly coloured tail feathers that can be spread like a fan. Any bird of the peafowl family, especially the Indian peafowl. A person who is vain and fond of showing off. To display oneself proudly in order to attract attention.
examples: A peacock spread its tail in the garden. The peacock's cry echoed across the fields. He is a peacock who loves to be photographed. He peacocked around the room in his new suit.

antonyms: Dull grey, Beige, Off-white, Pale, Brown
sindhiMeaning: مور جي کنڀن جهڙو گهرو ۽ چمڪدار سائو مائل نيرو رنگ، اهڙي رنگ وارو ڪپڙو، رنگ يا شيءِ، شان ۽ سجاوٽ سان لاڳاپيل رنگ
synonyms: Teal, Turquoise, Cyan, Blue-green, Cerulean
englishMeaning: A rich, vivid greenish-blue colour like that of a peacock's feathers. Describing fabric, paint, or objects of this bright blue-green shade. A colour associated with luxury and decoration.
urduMeaning: مور کے پروں جیسا گہرا اور چمکدار سبزی مائل نیلا رنگ، ایسے رنگ والا کپڑا، پینٹ یا چیز، شان اور سجاوٹ سے وابستہ رنگ
examples: She wore a peacock blue silk sari. The hall was decorated in peacock blue and gold. He chose peacock blue tiles for the bathroom. The lake shimmered a brilliant peacock blue.

antonyms: Dark green, Black, Grey, Pale, Muted
synonyms: Grass green, Lime-green, Olive, Fresh green, Verdant
englishMeaning: A medium yellowish-green colour like that of fresh garden peas. Describing something of this fresh green shade. Sometimes used to describe a sickly greenish appearance.
urduMeaning: تازے مٹروں جیسا درمیانہ زردی مائل سبز رنگ، ایسے تازہ سبز رنگ والی چیز، کبھی بیمار اور پھیکی سبز رنگت کے لیے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے
sindhiMeaning: تازين مٽرن جهڙو وچولو زردي مائل سائو رنگ، اهڙي تازي سائي رنگ واري شيءِ، ڪڏهن بيمار ۽ ڦڪي سائي شڪل لاءِ به استعمال ٿيندڙ
examples: They sailed away in a pea-green boat. The kitchen cupboards were painted pea-green. She bought a pea-green cushion for the sofa. He looked pea-green after the boat ride.
Sales peaked in December and then fell. He wore a peaked cap and a long coat. You look a little peaked this morning. The peaked roof sheds rain easily.
sindhiMeaning: چوٽي وارو يا نوڪدار مٿي وارو, پنهنجي بلند ترين حد تي پهچي پوءِ گهٽجڻ لڳڻ, ڦِڪو، ٿڪل يا بيمار نظر ايندڙ, اڳيان نڪتل ڪنارو رکندڙ، جيئن ٽوپي
synonyms: Pointed, Topped, Crested, Culminated, Pale, Sickly, Wan
englishMeaning: Having a pointed top or a peak. Reached the highest point before starting to decline. Looking pale, tired, or unwell. Fitted with a projecting brim, as in a peaked cap.
urduMeaning: نوکدار یا چوٹی والا, اپنی بلند ترین حد پر پہنچ کر کم ہونے لگنا, پیلا، تھکا ہوا یا بیمار دکھائی دینے والا, آگے نکلے ہوئے کنارے والا، جیسے ٹوپی
antonyms: Flat, Rounded, Blunt, Healthy, Rosy, Increasing
Silence, Hush, Quiet, Stillness, Murmur, Whisper
synonyms: Ring, Chime, Clang, Toll, Resound, Roar, Reverberate
sindhiMeaning: گهنڊ جو وڏو ۽ بار بار وڄڻ، کِل يا گجگوڙ جو وڏو آواز، زور سان وڄڻ يا گونجڻ، سُر ۾ ٺهيل گهنڊن جو سيٽ
urduMeaning: گھنٹی کا بلند اور مسلسل بجنا، ہنسی یا گرج کی زوردار آواز، زور سے بجنا یا گونجنا، ہم آہنگ گھنٹیوں کا مجموعہ
englishMeaning: A loud repeated ringing of a bell or set of bells. A loud burst of sound such as thunder or laughter. To ring loudly or resound. A set of bells tuned to one another.
examples: A peal of bells announced the beginning of the ceremony. A sudden peal of thunder frightened the sleeping children. The whole hall broke into peals of laughter at his joke. The church bells pealed across the quiet valley.

synonyms: Child doctor, Children's physician, Pediatric specialist, Child health expert
urduMeaning: ایک طبی ڈاکٹر جو بچوں  نوزائیدہ بچوں اور نوعمروں کی صحت اور طبی دیکھ بھال میں ماہر ہو، ایک ڈاکٹر جو بچوں کی طب میں تربیت یافتہ ہو اور نوجوان مریضوں کا علاج کرے، بچپن کی بیماریوں اور نشوونما میں ماہر
englishMeaning: A medical doctor who specializes in the health and medical care of infants, children, and adolescents. A physician trained in pediatrics who treats young patients. A specialist in childhood diseases and development.
antonyms: Geriatrician, Adult physician, General practitioner, Specialist for elderly
sindhiMeaning: هڪ طبي ڊاڪٽر جيڪو ٻارن  ٻچن ۽ نوجوانن جي صحت ۽ طبي سنڀال ۾ ماهر هجي، هڪ ڊاڪٽر جيڪو ٻارن جي طب ۾ تربيت يافته هجي ۽ نوجوان مريضن جو علاج ڪري، ننڍپڻ جي بيمارين ۽ ترقي ۾ ماهر
examples: The pediatrician examined the sick child. We took our baby to the pediatrician for vaccinations. She has been a pediatrician for fifteen years. The pediatrician specializes in infant care.

englishMeaning: A strong liking or tendency to do something. A natural fondness or taste for something. A habitual inclination toward a particular activity or thing.
examples: She has a penchant for collecting rare books. His penchant for adventure took him to remote mountains. The chef's penchant for spicy food is well known. He showed an early penchant for mathematics.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي ڪرڻ جي شديد پسند يا رجحان، ڪنهن شيءِ سان فطري لڳاءُ يا ذوق، ڪنهن خاص سرگرمي ڏانهن عادتي جھڪاءُ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو کرنے کی شدید پسند یا رجحان، کسی چیز کے ساتھ فطری لگاؤ یا ذوق، کسی خاص سرگرمی کی طرف عادتی میلان
synonyms: Liking, Fondness, Inclination, Tendency, Taste, Preference, Affinity, Propensity, Bent, Leaning
antonyms: Dislike, Aversion, Distaste, Antipathy, Hatred, Disinclination, Reluctance

synonyms: Short-sighted, False economy, Misguided thrift, Imprudent, Unwise saving
sindhiMeaning: ننڍين رقمن ۾ ڪفايت پر وڏين ۾ فضول خرچي، معمولي ڳالهين ۾ هوشيار پر اهم ڳالهين ۾ لاپرواهه، ٿورو بچائي گهڻو وڃائڻ
antonyms: Prudent, Far-sighted, Wise spending, Judicious, Sensible
examples: Buying cheap tyres to save money was penny wise and pound foolish. He is penny wise and pound foolish, saving on repairs but replacing the whole machine later. Skipping insurance to cut costs is penny wise and pound foolish. Their budget cuts proved penny wise and pound foolish in the long run.
englishMeaning: Careful about spending small amounts of money but wasteful with large amounts. Economical in trivial matters while being careless in important ones. Saving little while losing much through poor judgement.
urduMeaning: چھوٹی رقم میں کفایت شعاری مگر بڑی رقم میں فضول خرچی، معمولی باتوں میں ہوشیار اور اہم باتوں میں لاپرواہ، تھوڑا بچا کر بہت گنوا دینا

englishMeaning: A fifteen-sided polygon with fifteen angles. A geometric shape with fifteen straight sides and fifteen vertices. Any flat shape with fifteen corners and fifteen edges.
examples: A regular pentadecagon has fifteen equal sides and angles. The mosaic design included a pentadecagonal pattern. Geometry students calculated the area of a pentadecagon. The architectural element was shaped like a pentadecagon.
sindhiMeaning: پندرهن رخن ۽ پندرهن ڪنڊن وارو هڪ شڪل، پندرهه سڌي پاسن ۽ پندرهه نقطن وارو جيوميٽري شڪل، پندرهه ڪنڊن ۽ پندرهه ڪنارن وارو ڪو به برابر شڪل
antonyms: Circle, Triangle, Square, Pentagon, Irregular shape
synonyms: Fifteen-sided polygon, Pentakaidecagon, Pentadecagonal shape, Fifteen-gon
urduMeaning: پندرہ اضلاع اور پندرہ زاویوں والی شکل، پندرہ سیدھی اطراف اور پندرہ نقاط والی ہندسی شکل، پندرہ کونوں اور پندرہ کناروں والی کوئی بھی چپٹی شکل

antonyms: Circle, Triangle, Square, Hexagon, Irregular shape
sindhiMeaning: پنجن رخن ۽ پنجن ڪنڊن وارو هڪ شڪل، پنج سڌي پاسن ۽ پنج نقطن وارو جيوميٽري شڪل، پنج ڪنڊن ۽ پنج ڪنارن وارو ڪو به برابر شڪل
urduMeaning: پانچ اضلاع اور پانچ زاویوں والی شکل، پانچ سیدھی اطراف اور پانچ نقاط والی ہندسی شکل، پانچ کونوں اور پانچ کناروں والی کوئی بھی چپٹی شکل
synonyms: Five-sided polygon, Pentagonal shape, Five-gon
englishMeaning: A five-sided polygon with five angles. A geometric shape with five straight sides and five vertices. Any flat shape with five corners and five edges.
examples: The Pentagon building in Washington has a distinctive five-sided shape. A regular pentagon has all sides and angles equal. Students learned to draw a pentagon in geometry class. The traffic sign was shaped like a pentagon.

antonyms: Cube, Sphere, Triangular prism, Cylinder
urduMeaning: تین جہتی ٹھوس شکل جس میں دو متوازی پانچ کونوں والی بنیادیں ہوں جو پانچ مستطیل چہروں سے جڑی ہوں، ایک پرزم جس کا پانچ طرفہ کراس سیکشن پوری لمبائی میں ہو، ایک کثیر السطوح جس میں سات چہرے ہوں  دو پانچ کونے والے اور پانچ مستطیل
synonyms: Five-sided prism, Pentagon prism, Pentagonal solid
sindhiMeaning: ٽن طرفن وارو ٺوس شڪل جنهن ۾ ٻه متوازي پنج ڪنڊ وارا بنياد هجن جيڪي پنجن مستطيل منهن سان ڳنڍيل هجن، هڪ پرزم جنهن جو پنج طرفي ڪراس سيڪشن پوري ڊگهائي ۾ هجي، هڪ ڪثير السطوح جنهن ۾ ست منهن هجن  ٻه پنج ڪنڊ وارا ۽ پنج مستطيل
englishMeaning: A three-dimensional solid with two parallel pentagonal bases connected by five rectangular faces. A prism with a five-sided cross-section throughout its length. A polyhedron with seven faces, two pentagonal and five rectangular.
examples: The pencil has a pentagonal prism shape. A pentagonal prism has seven faces. Calculate the surface area of the pentagonal prism. The building's column is a pentagonal prism.

urduMeaning: پانچ نوکوں والا ستارہ جو پانچ سیدھی لکیروں سے بنتا ہے، پانچ گوشہ ستارہ جو علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے، ایسے ستارے پر مبنی سجاوٹی نقش
englishMeaning: A five-pointed star drawn with five straight strokes. A geometric figure or symbol in the shape of a five-pointed star, often used in mysticism and heraldry. A decorative motif based on such a star.
examples: The children learned to draw a pentagram in one stroke. A pentagram was carved above the old doorway. The flag features a single white pentagram. He explained the geometry of the pentagram.
sindhiMeaning: پنجن ڪنڊن وارو تارو جيڪو پنجن سڌين ليڪن سان ٺهي، پنج ڪنڊو تارو جيڪو علامت طور استعمال ٿئي، اهڙي تاري تي ٻڌل سجاوٽي نقش
antonyms: Hexagram, Circle, Square, Formless shape
synonyms: Five-pointed star, Pentacle, Star polygon, Pentangle

examples: A square pyramid is a common pentahedron. The students built a pentahedron out of paper. Each pentahedron in the model had five faces. He calculated the surface area of the pentahedron.
sindhiMeaning: پنجن سطحن واري ٺوس جاميٽري شڪل، اهڙي ٽه طرفي شڪل جيئن چورس بنياد وارو اهرام يا مثلثي منشور، اهڙو ڪثيرالسطح جسم جنهن جا پنج منهن هجن
englishMeaning: A solid geometric figure having five plane faces. A three-dimensional shape such as a square pyramid or triangular prism, made up of five flat surfaces. Any polyhedron with exactly five faces.
urduMeaning: پانچ سطحوں والی ٹھوس ہندسی شکل، ایسی تین جہتی شکل جیسے چوکور اہرام یا مثلثی منشور، ایسا کثیرالسطوح جسم جس کے پانچ چہرے ہوں
synonyms: Polyhedron, Pyramid, Prism, Solid figure
antonyms: Sphere, Cylinder, Cone, Plane figure

englishMeaning: Out of every hundred, used to express a proportion or rate. A fraction or ratio with one hundred as the denominator. The symbol or term representing parts per hundred. Another spelling of percent.
synonyms: Percent, Percentage, Per centum, Parts per hundred, %
antonyms: Whole, Total, Complete amount
examples: The interest rate is five per cent per annum. Ninety per cent of students passed the test. The discount is twenty per cent off the original price. Inflation increased by three per cent last year.
sindhiMeaning: هر سؤ مان، تناسب يا شرح جو اظهار ڪرڻ لاءِ استعمال ٿيندو آهي، هڪ جزو يا تناسب جنهن ۾ هڪ سؤ ڊينومينيٽر طور آهي، نشان يا اصطلاح جيڪو في سؤ حصن جي نمائندگي ڪري، سيڪڙو جي ٻي اسپيلنگ
urduMeaning: ہر سو میں سے، تناسب یا شرح کا اظہار کرنے کے لیے استعمال، ایک حصہ یا تناسب جس میں ایک سو فرقہ کے طور پر ہو، علامت یا اصطلاح جو فی سو حصوں کی نمائندگی کرے، فیصد کی دوسری ہجے

englishMeaning: Out of every hundred, used to express a proportion or rate. A fraction or ratio with one hundred as the denominator. For or in every hundred. The symbol % representing parts per hundred.
antonyms: Whole, Total, Complete amount
synonyms: Per cent, Percentage, Per centum, Parts per hundred, %
urduMeaning: ہر سو میں سے، تناسب یا شرح کا اظہار کرنے کے لیے استعمال، ایک حصہ یا تناسب جس میں ایک سو فرقہ کے طور پر ہو، فی یا ہر سو میں، علامت % جو فی سو حصوں کی نمائندگی کرے
examples: Fifty percent of the budget went to education. The battery is charged to one hundred percent. There is a ten percent chance of rain today. Housing costs increased by seven percent.
sindhiMeaning: هر سؤ مان، تناسب يا شرح جو اظهار ڪرڻ لاءِ استعمال ٿيندو آهي، هڪ جزو يا تناسب جنهن ۾ هڪ سؤ ڊينومينيٽر طور آهي، في يا هر سؤ ۾، نشان % جيڪو في سؤ حصن جي نمائندگي ڪري
هر سؤ ۾ شرح  تعداد  يا رقم، مجموعي جي سلسلي ۾ تناسب يا حصو، سيڪڙو طرفان مقدار کي ضرب ڪرڻ سان حاصل ڪيل نتيجو، هڪ سؤ جي جزو طور ظاهر ڪيل مجموعي جو حصو
synonyms: Proportion, Ratio, Fraction, Share, Part, Portion, Rate, Per cent
urduMeaning: ہر سو میں شرح   تعداد  یا رقم، مجموعی کے سلسلے میں تناسب یا حصہ، فیصد کے ذریعے مقدار کو ضرب کرنے سے حاصل شدہ نتیجہ، ایک سو کے حصے کے طور پر ظاہر کیا گیا مجموعی کا حصہ
antonyms: Whole, Total, Entirety, All
examples: A large percentage of the population lives in cities. What percentage of students passed the exam? The percentage increase was significant. Sales increased by fifteen percentage points.
englishMeaning: A rate, number, or amount in each hundred. A proportion or share in relation to a whole. The result obtained by multiplying a quantity by a percent. A part of a whole expressed as a fraction of one hundred.

synonyms: Percentage rank, Statistical measure, Quantile, Distribution value
antonyms: None (no direct antonyms)
englishMeaning: A value on a scale of one hundred that indicates the percentage of a distribution that is equal to or below it. A statistical measure showing the relative standing of a value in a dataset. One of the ninety-nine values that divide a set of data into one hundred equal parts.
examples: She scored in the ninetieth percentile on the exam. The child's height is in the seventy-fifth percentile for his age. Percentiles help compare individual performance to a larger group. Income percentiles show wealth distribution.
urduMeaning: ایک سو کے پیمانے پر ایک قدر جو تقسیم کا فیصد ظاہر کرتی ہے جو اس کے برابر یا نیچے ہو، شماریاتی پیمائش جو ڈیٹا سیٹ میں قدر کی نسبتی حیثیت کو دکھاتی ہے، ننانوے اقدار میں سے ایک جو ڈیٹا کے سیٹ کو ایک سو برابر حصوں میں تقسیم کرتی ہے
sindhiMeaning: هڪ سؤ جي پيماني تي هڪ قدر جيڪا ورهائڻ جو سيڪڙو ڏيکاري ٿي جيڪا ان جي برابر يا هيٺان آهي، شمارياتي ماپ جيڪا ڊيٽا سيٽ ۾ قدر جي لاڳاپي واري موقف کي ڏيکاري ٿي، نون ننانوي قدرن مان هڪ جيڪا ڊيٽا جي سيٽ کي هڪ سؤ برابر حصن ۾ ورهائي ٿي

examples: The temperature dropped perceptibly after sunset. She was perceptibly nervous during the interview. The quality of his work improved perceptibly. The room grew perceptibly darker as clouds covered the sun.
englishMeaning: In a way that is noticeable or able to be perceived. To a degree that can be detected by the senses. In a manner that is recognizable or observable. Noticeably or discernibly.
synonyms: Noticeably, Observably, Visibly, Discernibly, Detectably, Appreciably, Evidently
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي طريقي سان جيڪو قابل ذڪر يا محسوس ٿي سگهي، ان درجي تائين جيڪا حواس ذريعي ڳولي سگهجي، اهڙي طريقي سان جيڪو سڃاڻي سگهجي يا مشاهدو ڪري سگهجي، قابل ذڪر يا واضح طور تي
antonyms: Imperceptibly, Unnoticeably, Invisibly, Undetectably, Subtly
urduMeaning: ایسے طریقے سے جو قابل ذکر ہو یا محسوس کیا جا سکے، اس درجے تک جو حواس کے ذریعے پتہ لگایا جا سکے، ایسے طریقے سے جو پہچانا جا سکے یا مشاہدہ کیا جا سکے، نمایاں طور پر یا واضح طور پر

synonyms: Insightful, Astute, Observant, Sharp, Discerning, Aware, Sensitive, Intuitive, Shrewd
englishMeaning: Having or showing sensitive insight and understanding. Able to notice and understand things quickly and accurately. Showing keen awareness and good judgment. Having the ability to perceive or recognize things clearly.
antonyms: Unperceptive, Obtuse, Insensitive, Unobservant, Dull, Unaware, Ignorant
urduMeaning: حساس بصیرت اور سمجھ رکھنے یا دکھانے والا، چیزوں کو جلدی اور درست طریقے سے نوٹ کرنے اور سمجھنے کے قابل، شاندار آگاہی اور اچھا فیصلہ دکھانے والا، چیزوں کو واضح طور پر سمجھنے یا پہچاننے کی صلاحیت رکھنے والا
sindhiMeaning: حساس بصيرت ۽ سمجھ رکڻ يا ڏيکارڻ، شين کي جلدي ۽ صحيح طور تي نوٽ ڪرڻ ۽ سمجھڻ جي قابل، شاندار آگاهي ۽ سٺو فيصلو ڏيکاريندڙ، شين کي واضح طور تي سمجھڻ يا سڃاڻڻ جي صلاحيت رکندڙ
examples: She made several perceptive comments about the issue. He is a perceptive observer of human nature. The critic wrote a perceptive review of the film. Teachers need to be perceptive to students' needs.

urduMeaning: حساس بصیرت اور سمجھ دکھانے والے طریقے سے، تیز آگاہی اور اچھے فیصلے کے ساتھ، ایسے طریقے سے جو چیزوں کو جلدی نوٹ کرنے اور سمجھنے کی صلاحیت کو ظاہر کرے، ادراک یا تمیز کے ساتھ
synonyms: Insightfully, Astutely, Observantly, Shrewdly, Discerningly, Keenly, Intuitively
antonyms: Obtusely, Insensitively, Carelessly, Unobservantly, Dully, Ignorantly
sindhiMeaning: حساس بصيرت ۽ سمجھ ڏيکاريندڙ طريقي سان، تيز آگاهي ۽ سٺي فيصلي سان، اهڙي طريقي سان جيڪو شين کي جلدي نوٽ ڪرڻ ۽ سمجھڻ جي صلاحيت کي ظاهر ڪري، ادراڪ يا تميز سان
englishMeaning: In a manner showing sensitive insight and understanding. With keen awareness and good judgment. In a way that demonstrates the ability to notice and understand things quickly. With perceptiveness or discernment.
examples: She spoke perceptively about the challenges ahead. He analyzed the situation perceptively. The author writes perceptively about human relationships. They commented perceptively on the social issues.

sindhiMeaning: حساس بصيرت ۽ سمجھ رکڻ يا ڏيکارڻ جو معيار، شين کي جلدي ۽ صحيح طور تي نوٽ ڪرڻ ۽ سمجھڻ جي صلاحيت، تيز آگاهي ۽ سٺو فيصلو، شين کي واضح طور تي سمجھڻ يا سڃاڻڻ جي صلاحيت
synonyms: Insight, Discernment, Awareness, Astuteness, Acuity, Sensitivity, Intuition, Understanding
englishMeaning: The quality of having or showing sensitive insight and understanding. The ability to notice and understand things quickly and accurately. Keen awareness and good judgment. The capacity to perceive or recognize things clearly.
antonyms: Obtuseness, Insensitivity, Dullness, Unawareness, Ignorance, Incomprehension
examples: Her perceptiveness helped her understand complex situations. The therapist's perceptiveness made patients feel understood. His perceptiveness as a manager improved team morale. Perceptiveness is a valuable trait in leadership.
urduMeaning: حساس بصیرت اور سمجھ رکھنے یا دکھانے کا معیار، چیزوں کو جلدی اور درست طریقے سے نوٹ کرنے اور سمجھنے کی صلاحیت، تیز آگاہی اور اچھا فیصلہ، چیزوں کو واضح طور پر سمجھنے یا پہچاننے کی صلاحیت

englishMeaning: A sweet or pleasant-smelling liquid that people put on their skin or clothes. A fragrant substance made from oils and alcohol used to give a pleasant scent. A pleasant or sweet smell, especially of flowers. To give something a pleasant smell. To fill the air or a place with a sweet scent.
urduMeaning: خوشبودار مائع جو لوگ اپنے جسم یا کپڑوں پر لگاتے ہیں، عطر یا خوشبو والا تیل، پھولوں کی میٹھی خوشبو، کسی چیز کو خوشبودار بنانا، ہوا یا جگہ کو خوشبو سے بھرنا
examples: She wore a delicate perfume that reminded him of roses. The flowers perfumed the entire garden with their sweet scent. He bought an expensive French perfume for his mother's birthday. The evening air was perfumed with the fragrance of jasmine.
antonyms: Stench, Stink, Reek, Odor, Malodor
synonyms: Fragrance, Scent, Aroma, Cologne, Essence, Bouquet, Attar, Smell, Odor
sindhiMeaning: خوشبودار مائع جيڪو ماڻهو پنهنجي جسم يا ڪپڙن تي لڳائيندا آهن، عطر يا خوشبو وارو تيل، گلن جي مٺي خوشبو، ڪنهن شيءِ کي خوشبودار ڪرڻ، هوا يا جاءِ کي خوشبو سان ڀرڻ

urduMeaning: کسی بند شکل یا علاقے کی بیرونی حد بنانے والی لکیر، کسی شکل کے گرد کل لمبائی یا محیط، کسی جگہ کا بیرونی کنارہ یا حد، فوجی مورچے کے گرد دفاعی حد
englishMeaning: The continuous line forming the outer boundary of a closed figure or area. The total length of the boundary of a shape, measured in units. The outer edge or limit of a place, such as a camp or airfield. A defensive boundary around a military position.
antonyms: Centre, Interior, Middle, Core, Inside
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن بند شڪل يا علائقي جي ٻاهرين حد ٺاهيندڙ ليڪ، ڪنهن شڪل جي چوڌاري ڪل ڊيگهه، ڪنهن جاءِ جو ٻاهريون ڪنارو يا حد، فوجي مورچي جي چوڌاري حفاظتي حد
synonyms: Boundary, Circumference, Border, Edge, Outline, Margin
examples: Calculate the perimeter of the rectangle. Guards patrolled the perimeter of the camp all night. A high fence runs around the perimeter of the airport. The perimeter of the field is nearly two kilometres.

She was offered a permanent position at the company. The accident left him with permanent hearing loss. They built a permanent shelter for the flood victims. She had a permanent done at the salon last week.
synonyms: Lasting, Enduring, Perpetual, Everlasting, Fixed, Stable, Durable, Constant
antonyms: Temporary, Short-lived, Fleeting, Transient, Provisional, Passing, Impermanent
urduMeaning: مستقل، دائمی، ہمیشہ رہنے والا، غیر عارضی، پائیدار، بالوں کا مستقل کرل
englishMeaning: Lasting or intended to last for a very long time. Not temporary or changing. Continuing without interruption or end. A long-lasting hair treatment that creates curls, used as a noun.

englishMeaning: Having a pleasant and attractive appearance and manner. Friendly and easy to get along with. Charming in a way that makes a good impression on others.
examples: The new receptionist is bright and personable. Clients like him because he is so personable. A personable manner helps a great deal in sales. She was personable and confident during the interview.
antonyms: Unpleasant, Disagreeable, Surly, Repulsive, Unfriendly

examples: She wore a petrol blue velvet jacket. The living room walls are painted petrol blue. Petrol blue looks striking against pale wood. He chose a petrol blue tie for the interview.

urduMeaning: گہرا نیلا رنگ جس میں سبز جھلک ہو، پانی پر پٹرول کی چمک جیسا رنگ، ایسے گہرے نیلے سبز رنگ والا کپڑا یا چیز، فیشن اور سجاوٹ میں استعمال ہونے والا گہرا رنگ

antonyms: Aversion studies, Avoidance, Detachment
urduMeaning: بوسے کا سائنسی مطالعہ، بوسے کے حیاتیاتی اور نفسیاتی پہلوؤں کی تحقیق، بوسے کے جذباتی اور ثقافتی اثرات کا علم

sindhiMeaning: چمي يا پيار جي مطالعي جو علم، چمي جي حياتياتي ۽ نفسياتي پهلوئن جي تحقيق، چمي جو ثقافتي ۽ جذباتي مطالعو
synonyms: Study of kissing, Kissing science, Kiss research
examples: Philematology studies the chemistry behind a simple kiss. According to philematology, kissing releases hormones that reduce stress. Her lecture on philematology drew a curious crowd. Philematology examines how kissing customs differ across cultures.

synonyms: Gather, Collect, Assemble, Rustle up, Scrape together, Stir up, Rouse, Approach, Roll up, Muster

synonyms: Boisterous, Rowdy, Unruly, Raucous, Exuberant, Lively, Wild, Riotous, Noisy, Rambunctious

antonyms: Humbly, Modestly, Sincerely, Genuinely, Honestly, Unassumingly, Respectfully, Meekly, Candidly, Simply
sindhiMeaning: ڏيکاءُ واري نيڪي سان، پاڻ کي ٻين کان وڌيڪ نيڪ ظاهر ڪندي، ٺلهي پرهيزگاري جي انداز سان، خودپسند ۽ نصيحت ڪندڙ لهجي ۾، منافقانه اخلاقي برتري ڏيکاريندي
englishMeaning: In a way that shows a false or exaggerated display of moral superiority. In a manner that pretends to be more righteous or religious than one truly is. With a self-righteous tone that suggests looking down on others.

examples: He spoke sanctimoniously about honesty while hiding his own mistakes. She sanctimoniously reminded everyone of the rules she often broke. The columnist sanctimoniously lectured readers on generosity. They nodded sanctimoniously as the accused was led away.

examples: There is a rumour that the factory will close next month. He refused to comment on the rumours about his resignation. Rumour spread quickly through the small village. It is rumoured that she will lead the new project.
sindhiMeaning: اُڏامندڙ خبر يا اَفواهه، بنا ثبوت جي پکڙيل ڳالهه، ماڻهن ۾ هلندڙ چوٻول يا ڀِڻڀِڻ، غير مصدقه خبر جيڪا وات مان وات پکڙجي، ڪا ڳالهه افواهه طور پکيڙڻ
synonyms: Gossip, Hearsay, Talk, Whisper, Speculation, Report, Buzz, Story, Chatter, Grapevine

antonyms: Fact, Truth, Certainty, Proof, Evidence, Confirmation, Reality, Verification, Statement, Disclosure
englishMeaning: A story or piece of information that spreads from person to person without confirmed proof. Unverified talk or gossip circulating among people. General talk or hearsay about someone or something. To spread or report something as a rumour, usually in the passive form.

synonyms: Trundle, Roll, Lumber, Plod, Continue, Persist, Drag on, Amble, Chug, Proceed

examples: The old bus rumbled along the dusty country road. The investigation rumbled along for another two years. Their conversation rumbled along without reaching any conclusion. A heavy cart rumbled along beneath our window at dawn.

synonyms: Clinic, Hospital, Infirmary, Sanitarium, Rest home, Convalescent home, Health resort, Nursing home, Spa, Sickbay
examples: He spent six months in a mountain sanatorium recovering from tuberculosis. The old sanatorium has been converted into a hotel. She was sent to the school sanatorium with a high fever. Doctors recommended a stay at a sanatorium by the sea.
sindhiMeaning: آرام گاهه يا صحت گاهه، ڊگهي علاج ۽ صحتيابيءَ لاءِ اسپتال، خاص طور تي پراڻين بيمارين جي مريضن جو مرڪز، اسڪول يا اداري ۾ مريضن لاءِ مخصوص ڪمرو، آب و هوا واري آرام واري جاءِ
antonyms: Home, Workplace, Office, Gymnasium, Factory, Residence, School, Prison, Battlefield, Marketplace

antonyms: Desecrate, Defile, Profane, Pollute, Corrupt, Condemn, Curse, Dishonour, Contaminate, Degrade
synonyms: Consecrate, Bless, Hallow, Purify, Cleanse, Dedicate, Anoint, Exalt, Legitimize, Venerate
englishMeaning: To make something holy or set it apart for religious use. To free someone from sin and make them pure. To give official approval or moral authority to something. To treat something as sacred or beyond criticism.
sindhiMeaning: پاڪ ڪرڻ يا مقدس بڻائڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي عبادت لاءِ مخصوص ڪرڻ، گناهن کان پاڪ ڪرڻ، ڪنهن ڳالهه کي جائز يا مقدس قرار ڏيڻ، تقدس بخشڻ
examples: The priest sanctified the newly built chapel. They believed that suffering would sanctify the soul. Long tradition has sanctified this simple ceremony. No cause can sanctify the use of violence against civilians.

The dispute over land ownership rumbled on for a decade. Thunder rumbled on long after the rain had stopped. Debate about the new tax rumbled on in parliament. Their old rivalry rumbled on beneath the polite conversation.
sindhiMeaning: ڊگهي عرصي تائين بنا حل جي جاري رهڻ، پس منظر ۾ مسلسل هلندو رهڻ، ڪنهن تڪرار جو ختم نه ٿيڻ، گهڙڪو ڪندي اڳتي وڌندو رهڻ، معاملي جو ڊگهو ٿيندو وڃڻ
synonyms: Continue, Persist, Drag on, Linger, Endure, Carry on, Simmer, Prolong, Grind on, Last
englishMeaning: To continue for a long time without being resolved. To keep going noisily or persistently in the background. To carry on rolling forward with a deep, continuous sound.
urduMeaning: طویل عرصے تک بغیر حل کے جاری رہنا، پس منظر میں مسلسل چلتے رہنا، کسی تنازع کا ختم نہ ہونا، گڑگڑاتے ہوئے آگے بڑھتے رہنا، معاملے کا طول پکڑنا
antonyms: End, Stop, Cease, Resolve, Conclude, Settle, Finish, Halt, Terminate, Subside
Hindtail, Rear, Back, Tail end, Stern, Remainder, Residue, Hindpart, Terminal, Aft
sindhiMeaning: دم جو اڳيون حصو، اڳ ۾ مخصوص ڪيل ڀاڱو، اڳيان لڙڪندڙ حصو، پراڻي استعمال ۾ پيشگي رکيل حصو، اڳئين پاسي وارو پڇڙيءَ جهڙو حصو
examples: The carving showed a strange creature with a long foretail. He explained that the foretail of the estate had been reserved by an earlier deed. Sailors used the word foretail for the trailing rope at the bow. The term foretail appears only in a few old manuscripts.
urduMeaning: دم کا اگلا حصہ، پہلے سے مخصوص کیا گیا حصہ، آگے کی جانب لٹکنے والا حصہ، قدیم استعمال میں پیشگی مختص شدہ حصہ، اگلی طرف کا دم نما حصہ
englishMeaning: The forward or leading part of a tail-like structure. In older usage, a portion set aside or reserved in advance. A rarely used term referring to something that trails at the front rather than behind.
synonyms: Front part, Fore section, Leading end, Prow, Forepart, Reserved portion, Advance share, Head, Front end, Foresection

examples: The sanctification of the temple took place at sunrise. He described marriage as the sanctification of love. Many believers see suffering as a path to sanctification. The sanctification of ancient customs makes them hard to question.
sindhiMeaning: پاڪ ڪرڻ جو عمل، تقدس بخشڻ، گناهن کان پاڪائي حاصل ڪرڻ جي حالت، ڪنهن شيءِ کي مقدس قرار ڏيڻ، روحاني صفائي ۽ پاڪيزگي
synonyms: Consecration, Blessing, Purification, Hallowing, Dedication, Anointing, Beatification, Cleansing, Veneration, Glorification
englishMeaning: The act or process of making something holy or sacred. The state of being purified from sin and made spiritually clean. Formal approval that gives something moral or religious authority.
urduMeaning: پاک کرنے کا عمل، تقدیس بخشنا، گناہوں سے پاکیزگی حاصل کرنے کی حالت، کسی چیز کو مقدس قرار دینا، روحانی صفائی اور پاکیزگی
antonyms: Desecration, Defilement, Profanation, Corruption, Pollution, Condemnation, Dishonour, Degradation, Contamination, Curse

urduMeaning: چھری گھونپنے والا شخص، تیز ہتھیار سے وار کرنے والا، سوراخ کرنے والا نوکیلا اوزار، غیر رسمی طور پر دھوکہ دینے والا شخص، پیٹھ میں چھرا گھونپنے والا
antonyms: Victim, Defender, Protector, Rescuer, Healer, Guardian, Ally, Saviour, Peacemaker, Friend
synonyms: Assailant, Attacker, Knifer, Assaulter, Aggressor, Piercer, Awl, Bodkin, Betrayer, Culprit
sindhiMeaning: ڇُري هڻندڙ شخص، تيز هٿيار سان وار ڪندڙ، سوراخ ڪرڻ وارو تکو اوزار، غير رسمي طور تي دوکو ڏيندڙ ماڻهو، پٺيءَ ۾ ڇرو هڻندڙ
examples: The police arrested the stabber within an hour of the attack. A leather worker keeps a small stabber for punching holes. Witnesses described the stabber as a young man in a grey coat. He called his former partner a stabber after the betrayal.
englishMeaning: A person who stabs someone with a sharp weapon. A pointed tool or instrument used for piercing or making holes. Informally, someone who betrays another person treacherously.

antonyms: Silence, Quiet, Stillness, Hush, Calm, Peace, Contentment, Satisfaction, Serenity, Muteness
englishMeaning: A low, deep, continuous sound like distant thunder. Making such a heavy rolling noise. The first signs of discontent, complaint, or trouble among people. A growling noise made by an empty stomach.
synonyms: Growl, Roar, Boom, Grumble, Thunder, Murmur, Reverberation, Roll, Discontent, Unrest
urduMeaning: گڑگڑاہٹ یا بھاری مسلسل آواز، دور کی گرج جیسی آواز، پیٹ کی گڑگڑاہٹ، لوگوں میں ناراضی کے ابتدائی آثار، گونجتی ہوئی آواز پیدا کرنا
examples: We heard the rumbling of thunder in the distance. There are rumblings of discontent among the workers. His stomach was rumbling loudly during the lecture. The rumbling of heavy trucks kept us awake all night.
sindhiMeaning: گهڙڪو يا ڳؤرو مسلسل آواز، پري جي گجگوڙ جهڙو آواز، پيٽ جي گڙگڙاهٽ، ماڻهن ۾ ناراضگيءَ جا شروعاتي آثار، آواز ڪندڙ

examples: His sanctimonious attitude annoyed everyone at the meeting. She gave a sanctimonious speech about the value of hard work. I cannot stand his sanctimonious tone whenever money is discussed. The film mocks sanctimonious public figures.
synonyms: Self-righteous, Pious, Holier-than-thou, Smug, Hypocritical, Preachy, Priggish, Moralizing, Pretentious, Unctuous
englishMeaning: Making a show of being morally superior to other people. Pretending to be more religious or virtuous than one really is. Expressing righteousness in a smug and hypocritical manner.
antonyms: Humble, Modest, Sincere, Genuine, Honest, Unpretentious, Meek, Down-to-earth, Candid, Unassuming
sindhiMeaning: ڏيکاءُ وارو نيڪ، پاڻ کي ٻين کان وڌيڪ پارسا سمجهندڙ، ٺلهي پرهيزگاري ڏيکاريندڙ، منافقانه اخلاقي برتري رکندڙ، نصيحتون ڪندڙ خودپسند
urduMeaning: دکھاوے کا نیک، خود کو دوسروں سے زیادہ پارسا سمجھنے والا، جھوٹی پرہیزگاری ظاہر کرنے والا، منافقانہ اخلاقی برتری رکھنے والا، خود پسند نصیحت گو

antonyms: Team player, Socialite, Extrovert, Joiner, Conformist, Companion, Collaborator, Groupie, Partner, Follower
urduMeaning: تنہا رہنا پسند کرنے والا شخص، گروہ سے الگ کام کرنے والا، اپنی مرضی سے اکیلا چلنے والا آدمی، کسی تنظیم کے بغیر تنہا کارروائی کرنے والا، تنہائی پسند
englishMeaning: A person who prefers to act, live, or work alone rather than with others. Someone who avoids group membership and keeps to themselves. An individual who carries out an action independently, without support from any organisation.
sindhiMeaning: اڪيلو رهڻ پسند ڪندڙ شخص، ٽولي کان الڳ ڪم ڪندڙ، پنهنجي مرضيءَ سان اڪيلو هلندڙ ماڻهو، ڪنهن تنظيم کان سواءِ اڪيلي سر ڪم ڪندڙ، اڪيلائي پسند
synonyms: Loner, Individualist, Recluse, Solitary, Maverick, Introvert, Nonconformist, Hermit, Independent, Outsider
examples: He has always been a lone wolf who avoids office gatherings. As a lone wolf, she prefers projects she can finish by herself. The investigators believe the attacker was a lone wolf. Being a lone wolf made him effective but hard to manage.

antonyms: Accompanied, Together, Crowded, Multiple, Joint, Numerous, Grouped, Attended, Collective, Shared
englishMeaning: Being by oneself with no one else present. Single or solitary in number. Standing apart from others in an isolated position. Feeling or appearing alone and without company.
urduMeaning: تنہا، اکیلا، واحد، دوسروں سے الگ تھلگ، ویران جگہ پر کھڑا ہوا
synonyms: Solitary, Single, Sole, Alone, Isolated, Individual, Unaccompanied, Only, Separate, Detached
sindhiMeaning: اڪيلو، تنها، هڪڙو ئي، ٻين کان الڳ ٿيل، ويران يا سنسان جاءِ تي بيٺل
examples: A lone traveller walked along the empty road. Only a lone tree stood in the middle of the field. She was the lone survivor of the accident. A lone light burned in the upstairs window.

antonyms: Company, Companionship, Togetherness, Sociability, Crowd, Fellowship, Community, Association, Gathering, Society
synonyms: Solitude, Isolation, Seclusion, Aloneness, Loneliness, Privacy, Remoteness, Withdrawal, Detachment, Retirement
englishMeaning: The state or quality of being alone. The condition of living apart from other people. A sense of separateness or isolation from company. The quality of a place that is remote and rarely visited.
examples: He found peace in the solitariness of the mountains. The solitariness of her later years shaped her writing. There is a deep solitariness about that old farmhouse. Long voyages taught the sailor to accept solitariness.
urduMeaning: تنہائی کی حالت، یکسوئی، دوسروں سے الگ رہنے کی کیفیت، ویرانی یا سنسانی، اکیلے رہنے کی خصوصیت
sindhiMeaning: اڪيلائي جي حالت، تنهائي، ٻين کان الڳ رهڻ جي ڪيفيت، ويرانگي يا سنسانپڻو، اڪيلي رهڻ جي خاصيت
اڪيلائي جو ڏک، ڪنهن ساٿي نه هجڻ جو احساس، تنهائيءَ ۾ اداسي، ماڻهن کان ڪٽجي وڃڻ جي ڪيفيت، ويران جاءِ جو سنسانپڻو
antonyms: Companionship, Friendship, Togetherness, Company, Fellowship, Belonging, Sociability, Intimacy, Community, Contentment
urduMeaning: تنہائی کا دکھ، کسی ساتھی کے نہ ہونے کا احساس، تنہائی میں اداسی، لوگوں سے کٹ جانے کی کیفیت، ویران جگہ کی سنسانی
examples: Loneliness is a growing problem among the elderly. She felt a deep loneliness after moving to the new city. The loneliness of the long winter nights was hard to bear. He filled his loneliness with books and music.
englishMeaning: A sad feeling caused by having no friends or company. The unhappy state of being isolated from other people. The quality of a place that is deserted and far from others.
synonyms: Solitude, Isolation, Desolation, Seclusion, Aloneness, Forlornness, Emptiness, Alienation, Friendlessness, Melancholy
Solitary, Friendless, Isolated, Forlorn, Desolate, Alone, Abandoned, Secluded, Remote, Companionless
urduMeaning: تنہا اور اداس، ساتھی کے بغیر، اکیلا محسوس کرنے والا، ویران اور سنسان جگہ، تنہائی میں گزارا ہوا
englishMeaning: Feeling sad because one has no friends or company. Without companions and therefore unhappy. Describing a place that is remote, empty, and rarely visited. Spent or passed alone.
examples: He felt lonely during his first week at the new school. They live in a lonely cottage on the moor. She spent a lonely evening waiting for the phone to ring. Many lonely people find comfort in community groups.
antonyms: Popular, Sociable, Crowded, Accompanied, Befriended, Busy, Cheerful, Connected, Lively, Contented
sindhiMeaning: اڪيلو ۽ اداس، ساٿيءَ کان سواءِ، تنها محسوس ڪندڙ، ويران ۽ سنسان جاءِ، اڪيلائيءَ ۾ گذاريل

synonyms: Groove, Trench, Rut, Channel, Wrinkle, Crease, Line, Ditch, Score, Corrugation
urduMeaning: ہل سے بنی نالی یا لکیر، زمین میں لمبا تنگ گڑھا، ماتھے پر پڑی گہری شکنیں، کسی سطح پر بنی لمبی نالی، زمین میں نالیاں بنانا یا ماتھے پر بل ڈالنا
sindhiMeaning: هر جو ٺهيل ٿلهو يا سِير، زمين ۾ لڪير جهڙو کڏو، نراڙ تي پيل گهرا گهنج، ڪنهن مٿاڇري تي ٿيل ڊگهي نالي، زمين کيڙڻ يا نراڙ گهنجائڻ
examples: The farmer walked slowly along the freshly cut furrow. Deep furrows lined his forehead after years of worry. Rainwater collected in the furrows between the rows. She furrowed her brow as she read the letter again.
englishMeaning: A long narrow trench made in the ground by a plough. A deep wrinkle or line on a person's face, especially on the forehead. Any long narrow groove or channel in a surface. To make grooves in soil, or to wrinkle the brow in thought or worry.
antonyms: Ridge, Bump, Mound, Smoothness, Flatness, Level, Elevation, Plane, Crest, Hill

synonyms: Monologue, Solo speech, Self-talk, Oration, Aside, Discourse, Reflection, Address, Meditation, Utterance
sindhiMeaning: ڊرامي ۾ ڪردار جو پاڻ سان ڳالهائڻ، اڪيلي سر دل جي ڳالهه زبان تي آڻڻ، خودڪلامي، ڊگهي اڪيلي تقرير، پنهنجن خيالن کي بلند آواز ۾ ظاهر ڪرڻ
examples: Hamlet's soliloquy is one of the most famous speeches in English literature. The actor delivered the soliloquy with quiet intensity. She sat by the window in a soliloquy of regret. His long soliloquy at dinner left the guests silent.
englishMeaning: A speech in a play in which a character speaks their thoughts aloud while alone. The act of talking to oneself without addressing anyone else. A long monologue delivered in the presence of others but not directed at them.
antonyms: Dialogue, Conversation, Discussion, Exchange, Debate, Interview, Chat, Colloquy, Silence, Interaction
urduMeaning: ڈرامے میں کردار کا خود سے گفتگو کرنا، تنہائی میں دل کی بات زبان پر لانا، خود کلامی، طویل تنہا تقریر، اپنے خیالات کو بلند آواز میں ظاہر کرنا

synonyms: Monologize, Talk to oneself, Muse aloud, Declaim, Orate, Reflect, Ponder aloud, Speak alone, Recite, Ruminate
examples: He often soliloquizes while pacing around his study. The character soliloquizes about death in the final act. She soliloquized quietly as she tidied the empty house. Grandfather liked to soliloquize over his morning tea.
sindhiMeaning: پاڻ سان ڳالهائڻ، خودڪلامي ڪرڻ، اڪيلي سر بلند آواز ۾ سوچڻ، ڊرامي ۾ اڪيلي تقرير ڪرڻ، بنا جواب جي توقع جي ڊگهو ڳالهائڻ
englishMeaning: To speak one's thoughts aloud when alone. To deliver a soliloquy, especially in a play. To talk at length without expecting a reply from anyone.
antonyms: Converse, Dialogue, Discuss, Talk with, Debate, Chat, Confer, Listen, Answer, Interact
urduMeaning: خود سے باتیں کرنا، خود کلامی کرنا، تنہائی میں بلند آواز میں سوچنا، ڈرامے میں تنہا تقریر کرنا، جواب کی توقع کے بغیر طویل گفتگو کرنا

antonyms: Enable, Strengthen, Empower, Heal, Restore, Cure, Qualify, Fortify, Rehabilitate, Activate
englishMeaning: To make someone unable to function normally or to act effectively. To deprive a person of physical or mental ability through injury or illness. To render a machine, system, or organisation unable to work. To legally disqualify someone from acting or holding a right.
synonyms: Disable, Cripple, Paralyse, Immobilize, Weaken, Debilitate, Disqualify, Impair, Sideline, Neutralize
urduMeaning: کسی کو ناکارہ یا معذور کر دینا، جسمانی یا ذہنی طور پر بے بس کرنا، کام کے قابل نہ چھوڑنا، مشین یا نظام کو ناکارہ بنا دینا، قانونی طور پر نااہل قرار دینا
examples: The accident incapacitated him for several months. A severe migraine can incapacitate a person for an entire day. The cyber attack incapacitated the company's entire network. Illness incapacitated the chairman shortly before the vote.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي ناڪاره يا بيڪار ڪري ڇڏڻ، جسماني يا ذهني طور تي عاجز ڪرڻ، ڪم ڪرڻ جهڙو نه ڇڏڻ، مشين يا نظام کي ناڪام بڻائڻ، قانوني طور تي نااهل قرار ڏيڻ

synonyms: Inability, Disability, Incompetence, Powerlessness, Weakness, Impotence, Ineffectiveness, Infirmity, Unfitness, Helplessness
englishMeaning: Lack of the ability, strength, or skill needed to do something. A physical or mental condition that prevents someone from working or acting. Legal inability to perform a duty or exercise a right.
urduMeaning: ناتوانی یا نااہلی، کام کرنے کی صلاحیت کا فقدان، جسمانی یا ذہنی معذوری، قانونی نااہلی، بے بسی
examples: His incapacity to make decisions delayed the whole project. She retired early because of physical incapacity. The contract explains what happens in the event of the owner's incapacity. Financial incapacity forced the family to sell the land.
sindhiMeaning: ناتواني يا ناڪامي، ڪم ڪرڻ جي صلاحيت جي کوٽ، جسماني يا ذهني معذوري، قانوني نااهلي، بي وسي
antonyms: Ability, Capability, Competence, Strength, Capacity, Power, Fitness, Skill, Efficiency, Qualification

urduMeaning: یہ فلسفیانہ نظریہ کہ صرف اپنی ذات کا وجود یقینی ہے، صرف اپنے تجربے کو حقیقت ماننا، انتہا درجے کی خود پرستی، بیرونی دنیا کی حقیقت پر شک، صرف اپنے آپ میں مگن رہنا
sindhiMeaning: اهو فلسفياڻو نظريو ته صرف پنهنجي ذات ئي يقيني آهي، رڳو پنهنجي سوچ کي حقيقت مڃڻ، خودپرستي جي انتها، ٻاهرين دنيا جي حقيقت تي شڪ، رڳو پاڻ ۾ محو رهڻ
antonyms: Altruism, Objectivity, Realism, Empathy, Selflessness, Sociability, Awareness, Generosity, Otherness, Community
englishMeaning: The philosophical view that only one's own mind is certain to exist. The belief that nothing outside one's own experience can be truly known. Extreme self-absorption or preoccupation with one's own feelings and interests.
examples: The novel explores solipsism through a narrator who doubts everything around him. Critics accused the poet of a comfortable solipsism. Solipsism is difficult to refute but almost impossible to live by. His solipsism made genuine friendship impossible.
synonyms: Self-absorption, Egocentrism, Self-centredness, Subjectivism, Narcissism, Introversion, Egoism, Self-obsession, Isolationism, Individualism

englishMeaning: Relating to the belief that only one's own mind certainly exists. Excessively concerned with oneself and indifferent to others. Showing a narrow view of the world limited to personal experience.
examples: The diary has a solipsistic tone that ignores everyone else. His solipsistic worldview left no room for other opinions. Critics called the film beautiful but solipsistic. She writes in a solipsistic style that rarely looks outward.
synonyms: Self-centred, Egocentric, Self-absorbed, Narcissistic, Introspective, Subjective, Egoistic, Insular, Self-obsessed, Inward-looking
sindhiMeaning: خودپرستيءَ وارو، رڳو پنهنجي ذات کي حقيقت سمجهندڙ، ٻين کان بي پرواهه، پنهنجي تجربي تائين محدود سوچ رکندڙ، پاڻ ۾ محو
antonyms: Altruistic, Objective, Selfless, Empathetic, Outward-looking, Generous, Sociable, Considerate, Realistic, Other-centred
urduMeaning: خود پرستی پر مبنی، صرف اپنی ذات کو حقیقت سمجھنے والا، دوسروں سے بے پروا، اپنے تجربے تک محدود سوچ رکھنے والا، اپنے آپ میں مگن
اکیلے کھیلا جانے والا تاش کا کھیل، انگوٹھی میں جڑا واحد نگینہ خاص طور پر ہیرا، ایک شخص کے لیے تختے والا کھیل، تنہا رہنے والا فرد، تنہا کھیل
antonyms: Team game, Group activity, Cluster, Multi-stone, Companion, Socialite, Partnership, Doubles, Collective, Crowd
englishMeaning: A card game played alone by a single player. A single gemstone, especially a diamond, set on its own in a ring. A board game for one person played by moving pegs or marbles. A person who lives alone in isolation.
sindhiMeaning: اڪيلي سر کيڏيو ويندڙ تاش جو راند، هڪ ئي نگينو خاص طور تي منڊيءَ ۾ جڙيل هيرو، هڪ ماڻهوءَ لاءِ تختي واري راند، اڪيلو رهندڙ شخص، تنها راند
examples: He plays solitaire on his phone during the train ride. She wore a simple gold ring with a small solitaire. The old wooden solitaire board belonged to his grandmother. After his retirement he lived like a solitaire in the hills.
synonyms: Patience, Card game, Single stone, Gem, Diamond, Recluse, Hermit, Loner, Solo game, Isolate

englishMeaning: To enter a state of complete happiness and relaxation. To become blissfully unaware of one's surroundings. To make someone feel deeply calm and contented.
urduMeaning: مکمل خوشی اور سکون کی کیفیت میں آ جانا، خوشی میں گم ہو جانا، ماحول سے بے خبر ہو جانا، کسی کو گہرا سکون پہنچانا، لطف میں ڈوب جانا
examples: She likes to bliss out with music after a long shift. The warm bath completely blissed him out. They blissed out on the beach for the whole afternoon. A good massage will bliss you out in minutes.
sindhiMeaning: مڪمل سُک ۽ سڪون جي حالت ۾ اچڻ، خوشيءَ ۾ گم ٿي وڃڻ، ماحول کان بيخبر ٿي وڃڻ، ڪنهن کي گهرو سڪون ڏيڻ، مزي ۾ ٻڏي وڃڻ
synonyms: Relax, Unwind, Chill out, Mellow out, Zone out, Delight, Enrapture, Soothe, Luxuriate, Revel

Hold back, Fight back, Suppress, Restrain, Check, Swallow
