sindhiMeaning: بغير سبب ظلم، تشدد يا تباهي ڪرڻ جي خصلت، ضبط، نظم يا اخلاقي روڪ جي کوٽ، بي جا فضول خرچي يا لاپرواهي، بي حيائي يا بداخلاقي

englishMeaning: Lacking or absent; not present when needed. Not good enough; falling short of a required standard. Feeling or expressing a desire for something. Deficient in a particular quality.
antonyms: Sufficient, Adequate, Complete, Present, Satisfactory, Ample, Full, Content
sindhiMeaning: غير حاضر يا موجود نه هجڻ، ضرورت مطابق نه هجڻ يا معيار تي پورو نه لهڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ جي خواهش رکندڙ، ڪنهن خاصيت ۾ گهٽتائي وارو
urduMeaning: موجود نہ ہونا یا کمی ہونا، معیار پر پورا نہ اترنا یا ناکافی ہونا، کسی چیز کی خواہش رکھنے والا، کسی خوبی میں کمی رکھنے والا
synonyms: Lacking, Missing, Absent, Deficient, Inadequate, Insufficient, Desiring, Short
examples: The report was found wanting in several important details. Courage was the one quality he was never wanting in. She left the meeting wanting a clearer answer. Their hospitality left nothing wanting.

synonyms: Wish to enter, Seek entry, Desire to join, Want in, Apply for, Seek admission
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن جاءِ  ڪمري يا عمارت ۾ داخل ٿيڻ جي خواهش ڪرڻ، ڪنهن گروهه  اداري يا سرگرميءَ ۾ شامل ٿيڻ جي خواهش رکڻ، ڪنهن معاملي يا سوديبازيءَ ۾ حصو وٺڻ چاهڻ
examples: The cat is scratching at the door because it wants into the house. He wants into the family business next year. Several investors want into the project before it launches. She knocked loudly, clearly wanting into the office.
urduMeaning: کسی جگہ  کمرے یا عمارت میں داخل ہونے کی خواہش کرنا، کسی گروہ  ادارے یا سرگرمی میں شامل ہونے کی خواہش رکھنا، کسی معاملے یا سودے میں شریک ہونا چاہنا
englishMeaning: To wish to enter a place, room, or building. To wish to join or become part of a group, organization, or activity. To desire involvement in a particular situation or deal.
antonyms: Want out, Wish to leave, Withdraw, Refuse, Stay out, Exit

examples: The dog is barking at the door and wants out. After two difficult years, he simply wanted out of the marriage. Two partners want out of the deal before the deadline. She wanted out of the meeting as soon as it began.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن جاءِ يا بند هنڌ مان ٻاهر نڪرڻ جي خواهش ڪرڻ، ڪنهن رشتي  معاهدي  نوڪري يا معاملي مان نڪري وڃڻ چاهڻ، ڪنهن ناپسنديده صورتحال کان نجات گهرڻ
synonyms: Wish to leave, Quit, Withdraw, Back out, Pull out, Escape, Opt out, Resign
antonyms: Want in, Stay, Remain, Join, Commit, Continue, Persist
englishMeaning: To wish to leave a place, room, or enclosed space. To wish to end one's involvement in a relationship, agreement, job, or situation. To desire release or escape from something unpleasant.
urduMeaning: کسی جگہ یا بند مقام سے باہر نکلنے کی خواہش کرنا، کسی رشتے  معاہدے  نوکری یا معاملے سے الگ ہونا چاہنا، کسی ناپسندیدہ صورتِ حال سے چھٹکارا چاہنا

sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ضروري شيءِ جي کوٽ محسوس ڪرڻ يا ان کان محروم هجڻ، بنيادي ضرورت جي محتاجي هجڻ، عام طور نفي واري جملي ۾ چوڻ ته ڪنهن کي ڪنهن به شيءِ جي گهرج ناهي
englishMeaning: To lack or be without something that is needed. To be in need of a basic necessity. Used mainly in negative sentences to say that someone has everything they need.
synonyms: Lack, Need, Require, Be short of, Be deprived of, Miss, Go without
urduMeaning: کسی ضروری چیز کی کمی ہونا یا اس سے محروم ہونا، بنیادی ضرورت کا محتاج ہونا، عام طور پر نفی کے جملے میں یہ ظاہر کرنا کہ کسی کو کسی چیز کی کمی نہیں
examples: The children never wanted for anything while their grandfather was alive. He works hard so that his family will not want for food or shelter. Despite their simple life, they wanted for nothing. Many families in the region want for clean drinking water.
antonyms: Have, Possess, Enjoy, Be supplied with, Abound in, Own

englishMeaning: To wish to come inside a place. To wish to be included in a plan, deal, group, or activity. To express eagerness to participate.
antonyms: Want out, Opt out, Withdraw, Decline, Stay outside, Refuse
synonyms: Want into, Seek entry, Join, Participate, Be included, Sign up, Enter
examples: The children are at the gate and want in. If the plan is really that profitable, I want in. He heard about the startup and immediately wanted in. She knocked twice to show that she wanted in.
urduMeaning: اندر آنے کی خواہش کرنا، کسی منصوبے  سودے  گروہ یا سرگرمی میں شامل ہونا چاہنا، شرکت کے لیے بے تاب ہونا
sindhiMeaning: اندر اچڻ جي خواهش ڪرڻ، ڪنهن منصوبي  سودي  گروهه يا سرگرميءَ ۾ شامل ٿيڻ چاهڻ، حصو وٺڻ لاءِ آتو هجڻ

synonyms: Reclaim, Demand return, Retrieve, Recover, Repossess, Ask for, Restore
englishMeaning: To wish to have something returned that was lost, lent, or taken away. To wish to return to a former place, job, or relationship. To desire the restoration of a previous situation.
examples: I lent him my camera and now I want it back. She wants her old job back at the hospital. After the argument, he wanted her back in his life. The village wants back the land it lost years ago.
urduMeaning: کھوئی ہوئی  ادھار دی گئی یا لی گئی چیز واپس مانگنا، سابقہ جگہ  نوکری یا رشتے میں لوٹنے کی خواہش کرنا، پہلی صورتِ حال کی بحالی چاہنا
antonyms: Give away, Relinquish, Surrender, Abandon, Forfeit, Let go
sindhiMeaning: وڃايل  اڌاري ڏنل يا کسيل شيءِ واپس گهرڻ، اڳوڻي جاءِ  نوڪري يا رشتي ڏانهن موٽڻ جي خواهش ڪرڻ، اڳوڻي حالت جي بحاليءَ جي خواهش رکڻ

antonyms: Stay, Remain, Sign on, Commit, Renew, Settle
synonyms: Seek a transfer, Wish to leave, Move on, Depart, Quit, Exit
urduMeaning: اپنے موجودہ کلب  ٹیم یا ادارے کو چھوڑنے کی خواہش کرنا  خاص طور پر کھیل میں، کسی اور جگہ منتقلی یا ٹرانسفر چاہنا
englishMeaning: To wish to leave one's current club, team, or employer, especially in sport. To desire a transfer or move elsewhere.
sindhiMeaning: پنهنجي موجوده ڪلب  ٽيم يا اداري کي ڇڏڻ جي خواهش ڪرڻ  خاص ڪري راندين ۾، ٻي جاءِ تي تبديلي يا منتقلي چاهڻ
examples: The striker wants away before the transfer window closes. Two senior players are said to want away this season. He made it clear in the interview that he wanted away. The manager refused to sell the midfielder even though he wanted away.

You cannot want it both ways by demanding freedom and protection at once. The government wants it both ways on taxes and public spending. He wants it both ways, complaining about the rules while enjoying their benefits. Voters accused the party of wanting it both ways.
synonyms: Have it both ways, Play both sides, Blow hot and cold, Sit on the fence, Hedge
antonyms: Choose one side, Take a stand, Commit, Accept the consequences, Be consistent
urduMeaning: ایک ہی وقت میں دو متضاد صورتوں کے فائدے حاصل کرنے کی کوشش کرنا، اپنے اختیار کردہ مؤقف کے نقصانات قبول کرنے سے انکار کرنا، فائدے کے لیے دونوں طرف کا ساتھ رکھنا
englishMeaning: To try to enjoy the benefits of two opposing situations or attitudes at the same time. To refuse to accept the drawbacks that come with a chosen position. To behave inconsistently in order to gain advantage from both sides.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ئي وقت ٻن مخالف صورتحالن جا فائدا وٺڻ جي ڪوشش ڪرڻ، پنهنجي چونڊيل موقف سان لاڳاپيل نقصان قبول ڪرڻ کان انڪار ڪرڻ، فائدي لاءِ ٻئي پاسا سنڀالڻ جي ڪوشش ڪرڻ

antonyms: Take sides, Decide, Commit, Be consistent, Accept the trade-off
englishMeaning: To benefit from two conflicting choices, arguments, or situations at the same time. To avoid the disadvantages of a decision while keeping its advantages. To hold two inconsistent positions for personal gain.
examples: You can't have it both ways; either you join us or you stay home. He wants low prices and high wages, but nobody can have it both ways. The company tried to have it both ways with its environmental promises. Critics said the minister was attempting to have it both ways.
urduMeaning: ایک ہی وقت میں دو متضاد باتوں یا صورتوں سے فائدہ اٹھانا، فیصلے کے نقصانات سے بچنا اور فوائد رکھنا، ذاتی مفاد کے لیے دو متضاد مؤقف رکھنا
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ئي وقت ٻن مخالف ڳالهين يا صورتحالن مان فائدو وٺڻ، فيصلي جا نقصان ٽارڻ ۽ فائدا رکڻ، ذاتي مفاد لاءِ ٻه متضاد موقف رکڻ
synonyms: Want it both ways, Play both sides, Straddle the fence, Equivocate, Hedge one's bets

englishMeaning: To wish to have no dealings, contact, or association with a person. To refuse to be involved with someone or something considered undesirable.
synonyms: Have no truck with, Avoid, Shun, Boycott, Steer clear of, Keep away from, Reject
urduMeaning: کسی شخص سے کوئی واسطہ، رابطہ یا تعلق نہ رکھنا چاہنا، کسی ناپسندیدہ شخص یا چیز سے وابستگی سے انکار کرنا
examples: The old shopkeeper wants no truck with the new landlord. She wants no truck with people who spread rumours. Our team wants no truck with dishonest suppliers. He made it clear he wanted no truck with the scheme.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ماڻهوءَ سان ڪوبه واسطو، رابطو يا لاڳاپو نه رکڻ چاهڻ، ڪنهن ناپسنديده شخص يا شيءِ سان شامل ٿيڻ کان انڪار ڪرڻ
antonyms: Associate with, Deal with, Befriend, Cooperate with, Welcome, Engage
Engage with, Accept, Tolerate, Associate with, Support, Embrace
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن سان ڪوبه واسطو يا لاڳاپو نه رکڻ، ڪنهن شخص يا ڳالهه کي قبول ڪرڻ يا برداشت ڪرڻ کان انڪار ڪرڻ، ناپسنديده خيال يا رواج کان بلڪل پري رهڻ
englishMeaning: To have no dealings or relationship with a person. To refuse to accept, tolerate, or engage with someone or something. To keep completely apart from an idea or practice one disapproves of.
examples: He has no truck with gossip of any kind. The committee has no truck with members who break the rules. My grandmother had no truck with modern gadgets. They have no truck with anyone who cheats customers.
synonyms: Want no truck with, Shun, Avoid, Reject, Disown, Boycott, Have nothing to do with
urduMeaning: کسی سے کوئی واسطہ یا تعلق نہ رکھنا، کسی شخص یا بات کو قبول یا برداشت کرنے سے انکار کرنا، ناپسندیدہ خیال یا رواج سے بالکل الگ رہنا

examples: The manager clearly wants rid of the new supervisor. They wanted rid of him long before he finally resigned. She wants rid of the tenant who never pays on time. Some board members want rid of the chairman.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن تنگ ڪندڙ يا اڻ گهربل ماڻهوءَ کان جان ڇڏائڻ چاهڻ، اهو گهرڻ ته ڪو هليو وڃي يا هٽايو وڃي، ڪنهن سان لاڳاپو ختم ڪرڻ جي خواهش رکڻ
synonyms: Want shot of, Wish to remove, Get rid of, Dismiss, Expel, Oust, Be free of
englishMeaning: To wish to get free from a person one finds troublesome or unwanted. To desire that someone leave, be dismissed, or be removed. To wish to end a connection with someone.
antonyms: Keep, Retain, Welcome, Embrace, Hold on to, Reinstate
urduMeaning: کسی تنگ کرنے والے یا ناپسندیدہ شخص سے جان چھڑانا چاہنا، یہ چاہنا کہ کوئی چلا جائے یا ہٹا دیا جائے، کسی سے تعلق ختم کرنے کی خواہش رکھنا

sindhiMeaning: ڪجهه به ضايع نه ڪريو، چوڻي ’ضايع نه ڪريو ته محتاج نه ٿيندؤ‘ جو پهريون حصو، جنهن جو مطلب آهي ته وسيلن جو سنڀال سان استعمال اڳتي هلي کوٽ کان بچائي ٿو، فضول خرچيءَ کان بچڻ جي نصيحت
synonyms: Save, Conserve, Economize, Be frugal, Use sparingly, Preserve
englishMeaning: Do not waste anything. The opening part of the proverb 'Waste not, want not', meaning that careful use of resources prevents future shortage. Used as advice to avoid extravagance.
urduMeaning: کچھ ضائع نہ کرو، کہاوت ’ضائع نہ کرو تو محتاج نہ ہو گے‘ کا پہلا حصہ، یعنی وسائل کا سنبھال کر استعمال آئندہ کی تنگی سے بچاتا ہے، فضول خرچی سے بچنے کی نصیحت
examples: Waste not, and you will always have enough for tomorrow. My grandmother lived by the rule of waste not. Waste not the water you draw from the well. In hard times people learn to waste not.
antonyms: Waste, Squander, Splurge, Throw away, Misuse, Be extravagant
Want, Lack, Need, Go short, Be deprived, Suffer scarcity
englishMeaning: Do not suffer from shortage or need. The closing part of the proverb 'Waste not, want not', meaning that avoiding waste protects one from future need.
sindhiMeaning: محتاجي يا کوٽ ۾ نه پوڻ، چوڻي ’ضايع نه ڪريو ته محتاج نه ٿيندؤ‘ جو ٻيو حصو، جنهن جو مطلب آهي ته ضياع کان بچڻ ايندڙ ضرورت کان بچائي ٿو
examples: Waste not, want not, as my mother always reminded us. Those who save carefully will want not in old age. The saying ends with the promise that you will want not. Live simply and you will want not.
urduMeaning: محتاجی یا کمی کا شکار نہ ہونا، کہاوت ’ضائع نہ کرو تو محتاج نہ ہو گے‘ کا دوسرا حصہ، یعنی ضیاع سے بچنا آئندہ کی ضرورت سے محفوظ رکھتا ہے
synonyms: Lack nothing, Be provided for, Have enough, Be secure, Be self-sufficient

urduMeaning: کسی معاہدے  بندوبست  رشتے یا ذمہ داری سے نکلنے کی خواہش کرنا، کسی جگہ یا صورتِ حال سے نکلنا چاہنا، کسی پابندی سے رہائی چاہنا
examples: He wants out of the contract before the next payment is due. She wanted out of the argument as quickly as possible. Two members want out of the partnership. The player wants out of his current club.
synonyms: Withdraw from, Back out of, Pull out of, Quit, Escape from, Opt out of, Exit
antonyms: Want into, Stay in, Commit to, Honour, Continue with, Join
englishMeaning: To wish to withdraw from an agreement, arrangement, relationship, or commitment. To wish to leave a place or situation. To seek release from an obligation.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن معاهدي  بندوبست  رشتي يا ذميواريءَ مان نڪرڻ جي خواهش ڪرڻ، ڪنهن جاءِ يا صورتحال مان نڪرڻ چاهڻ، ڪنهن فرض کان نجات گهرڻ

antonyms: Supplied with, Provided with, Full of, Having, Satisfied, Well stocked
synonyms: In need of, Lacking, Requiring, Short of, Deficient in, Craving, Deprived of
englishMeaning: In need of something; lacking something that is required. Requiring attention, repair, or supply. Used in formal or literary style to express need.
examples: The old house is badly in want of repair. He is a man in want of good advice. The garden is in want of water after the long summer. Their argument is in want of solid evidence.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کی ضرورت ہونا یا اس کی کمی ہونا، مرمت  توجہ یا فراہمی کی حاجت ہونا، رسمی یا ادبی انداز میں ضرورت ظاہر کرنا
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ جي ضرورت هئڻ يا ان جي کوٽ هئڻ، مرمت  سنڀال يا فراهميءَ جي گهرج هئڻ، رسمي يا ادبي انداز ۾ ضرورت ظاهر ڪرڻ

englishMeaning: To refuse to accept or take part in something. To reject an offer, idea, or behaviour completely. To make clear that one will not tolerate something.
synonyms: Have none of, Refuse, Reject, Decline, Turn down, Spurn, Repudiate
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو قبول کرنے یا اس میں شریک ہونے سے انکار کرنا، کسی پیشکش، خیال یا رویے کو مکمل طور پر مسترد کرنا، واضح کرنا کہ کوئی بات برداشت نہیں کی جائے گی
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي قبول ڪرڻ يا ان ۾ حصو وٺڻ کان انڪار ڪرڻ، ڪنهن آڇ، خيال يا رويي کي مڪمل طور رد ڪرڻ، صاف چوڻ ته ڪا ڳالهه برداشت نه ٿيندي
examples: She wants none of their excuses this time. I want none of the money you made that way. The teacher wants none of that behaviour in her classroom. He wanted none of the credit for the success.
antonyms: Accept, Welcome, Embrace, Agree to, Take part in, Approve

englishMeaning: To refuse to accept, allow, or tolerate something. To reject a suggestion, excuse, or behaviour firmly. To receive no share of something.
antonyms: Accept, Allow, Tolerate, Agree to, Endorse, Share in
synonyms: Want none of, Refuse, Reject, Dismiss, Not tolerate, Turn down, Resist
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڳالهه کي قبول ڪرڻ، اجازت ڏيڻ يا برداشت ڪرڻ کان انڪار ڪرڻ، ڪنهن تجويز  بهاني يا رويي کي سختيءَ سان رد ڪرڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ مان ڪو حصو نه ملڻ
urduMeaning: کسی بات کو قبول کرنے، اجازت دینے یا برداشت کرنے سے انکار کرنا، کسی تجویز  بہانے یا رویے کو سختی سے مسترد کرنا، کسی چیز میں کوئی حصہ نہ ہونا
examples: I offered to pay, but he would have none of it. The committee will have none of this delay. She had none of the profits from the sale. Their father would have none of such rudeness at the table.

synonyms: Triteness, Dullness, Cliche, Platitude, Commonplace, Staleness, Ordinariness, Tedium
examples: The speech was full of banality and offered nothing new. She was tired of the banality of daily office conversation. Critics complained about the banality of the film's dialogue. His writing rises above the banality of ordinary travel books.
englishMeaning: The quality of being dull, ordinary, and lacking originality. A remark, idea, or thing that is boringly commonplace. The state of being predictable or unoriginal in thought or expression.
urduMeaning: بے کیف  عام اور غیر اختراعی ہونے کی کیفیت، ایسی بات یا خیال جو بالکل عام اور بور کن ہو، سوچ یا اظہار میں جدت کی کمی
antonyms: Originality, Freshness, Novelty, Creativity, Inventiveness, Brilliance, Profundity
sindhiMeaning: بي مزي  عام ۽ اڻ نئين هجڻ جي حالت، اهڙي ڳالهه يا خيال جيڪو بلڪل عام ۽ بيزار ڪندڙ هجي، سوچ يا اظهار ۾ نواڻ جي کوٽ

antonyms: Occidental, Western, European, American, Atlantic
synonyms: Eastern, Asian, Far Eastern, Asiatic, Eastward, Levantine
examples: The museum has a fine collection of oriental ceramics. She decorated the room with oriental rugs and lanterns. Oriental spices give the dish its distinctive aroma. Many writers now avoid the word oriental when describing people.
englishMeaning: Relating to the countries of the East, especially East and Southeast Asia, and their cultures. A style of art, design, or goods associated with the East. An old and now often offensive term for a person from East Asia.
urduMeaning: مشرقی ممالک خاص طور پر مشرقی اور جنوب مشرقی ایشیا اور ان کی ثقافت سے متعلق، مشرق سے منسوب فن  ڈیزائن یا سامان، مشرقی ایشیا کے فرد کے لیے پرانی اصطلاح جو اب اکثر نامناسب سمجھی جاتی ہے
sindhiMeaning: اوڀر جي ملڪن خاص ڪري اوڀر ۽ ڏکڻ اوڀر ايشيا ۽ انهن جي ثقافت سان لاڳاپيل، اوڀر سان منسوب فن  ڊيزائن يا سامان، اوڀر ايشيا جي ماڻهوءَ لاءِ پراڻو لفظ جيڪو هاڻي اڪثر ناپسنديده سمجهيو ويندو آهي
ڪنهن شيءِ جو رخ يا ترتيب، ڪنهن کي نئين جاءِ  نوڪري  ڪورس يا صورتحال کان واقف ڪرائڻ جو عمل، ڪنهن جو بنيادي لاڙو  عقيدو يا دلچسپي، پنهنجي پوزيشن جو ماحول جي نسبت سان تعين
antonyms: Disorientation, Confusion, Misalignment, Aimlessness, Detachment
examples: The orientation of the building allows sunlight into every room. New students must attend the orientation on Monday morning. The company welcomes staff of every political orientation. He lost all sense of orientation in the thick fog.
englishMeaning: The direction or position in which something faces or is arranged. The process of introducing someone to a new place, job, course, or situation. A person's basic attitudes, beliefs, or interests. The determination of one's position relative to the surroundings.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کا رخ یا ترتیب، کسی کو نئی جگہ   نوکری  کورس یا صورتِ حال سے متعارف کرانے کا عمل، کسی کا بنیادی رجحان  عقیدہ یا دلچسپی، اپنے مقام کا ماحول کی نسبت سے تعین
synonyms: Direction, Alignment, Position, Bearing, Introduction, Induction, Briefing, Inclination, Attitude

examples: The panels are orientated towards the south for maximum sunlight. It took him a while to orientate himself in the unfamiliar city. A senior nurse will orientate the new staff this week. The syllabus is orientated towards practical skills.
synonyms: Orient, Align, Position, Direct, Adjust, Familiarize, Acclimatize, Guide
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو خاص سمت میں رکھنا یا ترتیب دینا، اپنی سمت یا مقام معلوم کرنا، کسی کو نئے ماحول  کام یا خیالات سے واقف کرانا، کوششوں یا پالیسیوں کو کسی خاص مقصد کی طرف موڑنا
antonyms: Disorientate, Confuse, Mislead, Misdirect, Unsettle, Bewilder
englishMeaning: To position or align something in a particular direction. To find one's bearings or establish one's position. To familiarize someone with a new environment, role, or set of ideas. To aim efforts or policies towards a particular goal.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي خاص رخ ۾ رکڻ يا سڌو ڪرڻ، پنهنجو رخ يا جاءِ معلوم ڪرڻ، ڪنهن کي نئين ماحول  ڪم يا خيالن کان واقف ڪرائڻ، ڪوششون يا پاليسيون ڪنهن خاص مقصد ڏانهن موڙڻ

englishMeaning: A scholar who studies the languages, history, literature, or cultures of the East. Relating to Orientalism in art or scholarship. Someone whose portrayal of Eastern societies is shaped by Western stereotypes, often used critically.
antonyms: Occidentalist, Western scholar, Layman, Non-specialist
sindhiMeaning: اهو عالم جيڪو اوڀر جي ٻولين  تاريخ  ادب يا ثقافتن جو مطالعو ڪري، فن يا علم ۾ مستشرقيت سان لاڳاپيل، اهڙو شخص جنهن جو اوڀر بابت نظريو مغربي تعصبن تي ٻڌل هجي، جيڪو اڪثر تنقيدي معنيٰ ۾ چيو ويندو آهي
examples: The famous orientalist spent thirty years studying Persian manuscripts. Edward Said criticised the orientalist view of Eastern societies. The gallery displays orientalist paintings from the nineteenth century. She trained as an orientalist at a European university.
urduMeaning: وہ عالم جو مشرق کی زبانوں  تاریخ  ادب یا ثقافتوں کا مطالعہ کرے، فن یا علم میں استشراق سے متعلق، ایسا شخص جس کا مشرق کے بارے میں تصور مغربی تعصبات پر مبنی ہو، جو اکثر تنقیدی معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے
synonyms: Eastern scholar, Asianist, Arabist, Sinologist, Indologist, Philologist

antonyms: Getting lost, Wandering, Aimless roaming, Indoor games, Disorientation
urduMeaning: ایک مسابقتی بیرونی کھیل جس میں شرکاء نقشے اور قطب نما کی مدد سے انجان علاقے میں مقررہ نشانات تک راستہ تلاش کرتے ہیں، تفریح یا تربیت کے طور پر میدانوں اور پہاڑوں میں راستہ تلاش کرنے کی سرگرمی
sindhiMeaning: هڪ مقابلي واري ٻاهرين راند جنهن ۾ حصو وٺندڙ نقشي ۽ قطب نما جي مدد سان اڻ ڄاتل علائقي ۾ مقرر نشانن تائين رستو ڳوليندا آهن، تفريح يا تربيت طور ميدانن ۽ جبلن ۾ رستو ڳولڻ جي سرگرمي
synonyms: Cross-country navigation, Map reading, Wayfinding, Trekking, Rogaining, Land navigation
examples: The school arranged an orienteering trip in the nearby hills. Orienteering teaches children to read maps with confidence. She won a medal at the national orienteering championship. Army recruits practise orienteering as part of their training.
englishMeaning: A competitive outdoor sport in which participants use a map and compass to navigate between control points across unfamiliar terrain. The activity of cross-country navigation as a recreation or training exercise.

antonyms: Bridge, Walk, Stay, Remain, Unload, Abandon
englishMeaning: A boat or ship that carries passengers, vehicles, or goods across a river, lake, or short stretch of sea. A regular service operated by such a boat. To transport people or things from one place to another, usually over water or in repeated trips.
urduMeaning: وہ کشتی یا جہاز جو مسافروں  گاڑیوں یا سامان کو دریا  جھیل یا سمندر کے مختصر حصے کے پار پہنچائے، ایسی کشتی کی باقاعدہ سروس  لوگوں یا اشیاء کو ایک جگہ سے دوسری جگہ پہنچانا  خاص طور پر پانی کے راستے یا بار بار چکر لگا کر
sindhiMeaning: اها ٻيڙي يا جهاز جيڪا مسافرن  گاڏين يا سامان کي درياءَ  ڍنڍ يا سمنڊ جي ننڍي پٽيءَ پار پهچائي، اهڙي ٻيڙيءَ جي باقاعده سروس  ماڻهن يا شين کي هڪ هنڌان ٻئي هنڌ پهچائڻ خاص ڪري پاڻيءَ مٿان يا وري وري چڪر هڻي
examples: We took the early ferry across the river. The ferry service runs every thirty minutes in summer. He ferried the children to school in his old van. Supplies were ferried to the island by boat.
synonyms: Boat, Ferryboat, Barge, Shuttle, Transport, Convey, Carry, Transfer

urduMeaning: وحشیانہ، ظالمانہ یا سخت انداز میں، شدید طاقت  زور یا جارحیت کے ساتھ، سخت عزم یا جوش ظاہر کرنے والے انداز میں
examples: The dog barked ferociously at the stranger. The wind blew ferociously all through the night. She defended her position ferociously during the debate. The two teams competed ferociously for the title.
sindhiMeaning: وحشيانو، ظالماڻو يا سخت انداز ۾، وڏي شدت  زور يا جارحيت سان، سخت عزم يا جوش ڏيکاريندڙ انداز ۾
synonyms: Fiercely, Savagely, Violently, Brutally, Aggressively, Intensely, Wildly, Furiously
antonyms: Gently, Calmly, Mildly, Peacefully, Softly, Tenderly, Meekly
englishMeaning: In a savage, violent, or fierce manner. With great intensity, force, or aggression. In a way that shows strong determination or passion.

antonyms: Flowering plant, Cactus, Succulent, Tree, Shrub, Weed
englishMeaning: A flowerless green plant that reproduces by spores and usually has feathery or divided leaves called fronds. Any plant of the group Filicopsida, commonly grown in shady or damp places.
examples: A large fern grew in the shady corner of the garden. Ferns thrive in damp, cool conditions. She placed a small fern on the office windowsill. The forest floor was covered with ferns and moss.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ سائو ٻوٽو جنهن کي گل نه ٿيندا آهن ۽ جيڪو ٻج بدران بيضن ذريعي وڌندو آهي، ان جا پن اڪثر کنڀ جهڙا ۽ ورهايل هوندا آهن، اهڙو ٻوٽو جيڪو گهڻو ڪري ڇانو ۽ نم واري جاءِ تي ٿيندو آهي
urduMeaning: ایک سبز پودا جس پر پھول نہیں آتے اور جو بیجوں کے بجائے بیضوں سے بڑھتا ہے، اس کے پتے عموماً پروں جیسے اور کٹے ہوئے ہوتے ہیں، ایسا پودا جو زیادہ تر سایہ دار اور نم جگہوں پر اگتا ہے
synonyms: Bracken, Frond plant, Pteridophyte, Maidenhair, Greenery, Foliage plant

urduMeaning: سختی، وحشت یا تشدد کی حالت یا خصوصیت، شدید قوت یا زور، رویے  گفتگو یا قدرتی واقعات میں ظاہر ہونے والی جارحانہ توانائی
antonyms: Gentleness, Mildness, Calmness, Tenderness, Kindness, Serenity, Restraint
synonyms: Fierceness, Savagery, Brutality, Violence, Intensity, Fury, Aggression, Vehemence
sindhiMeaning: سختي، وحشت يا تشدد جي حالت يا خاصيت، انتهائي شدت يا زور، رويي  ڳالهائڻ يا قدرتي واقعن ۾ ظاهر ٿيندڙ جارحاڻي طاقت
englishMeaning: The state or quality of being fierce, savage, or violent. Extreme intensity or force. Aggressive energy shown in behaviour, speech, or natural events.
examples: The ferocity of the storm surprised everyone in the village. He argued with a ferocity that silenced the room. The ferocity of the attack shocked local residents. She played the final set with astonishing ferocity.

The revocation of his driving licence followed a serious offence. The company appealed against the revocation of its trading permit. Revocation of the old law took effect last month. The court ordered the revocation of the agreement.
synonyms: Cancellation, Annulment, Repeal, Withdrawal, Rescission, Abolition, Invalidation, Reversal
englishMeaning: The official cancellation of a decision, law, licence, or agreement. The act of withdrawing or annulling something previously granted. Formal repeal of a right or privilege.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن فيصلي  قانون  لائسنس يا معاهدي جي سرڪاري منسوخي، اڳ ۾ ڏنل ڪنهن شيءِ کي واپس وٺڻ يا رد ڪرڻ جو عمل، ڪنهن حق يا رعايت جي باضابطه منسوخي
urduMeaning: کسی فیصلے  قانون  لائسنس یا معاہدے کی سرکاری منسوخی، پہلے دی گئی کسی چیز کو واپس لینے یا کالعدم کرنے کا عمل، کسی حق یا رعایت کی باقاعدہ تنسیخ
antonyms: Grant, Approval, Ratification, Confirmation, Enactment, Validation, Renewal

examples: He had to impignorate the family jewels to pay the debt. The merchant impignorated his land during the famine. They chose to impignorate the shop rather than sell it. Old records show that the estate was impignorated in 1782.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن قرض جي ضمانت طور ڪا شيءِ گروي رکڻ يا رهن ڪرڻ، قرض جي واپسيءَ تائين ملڪيت قرض ڏيندڙ وٽ رکڻ
urduMeaning: کسی قرض کی ضمانت کے طور پر کوئی چیز گروی یا رہن رکھنا، قرض کی واپسی تک جائیداد قرض دینے والے کے پاس رکھنا
synonyms: Pawn, Pledge, Mortgage, Hypothecate, Put in hock, Give as security
antonyms: Redeem, Reclaim, Repay, Recover, Free from debt, Release
englishMeaning: To pledge, pawn, or mortgage something as security for a debt. To place property in the hands of a creditor until a loan is repaid.

antonyms: Fool, Ignoramus, Simpleton, Materialist, Non-thinker
englishMeaning: A person who studies or develops ideas about knowledge, truth, existence, and the nature of reality. A thinker who examines fundamental questions about life, morality, and human understanding. Someone who remains calm and thoughtful in difficult situations and views life with wisdom.
urduMeaning: فلسفے کا ماہر, وہ شخص جو علم  سچائی اور وجود کے بارے میں غور و فکر کرے, دانشور یا مفکر, زندگی کو دانائی سے دیکھنے والا اور بردبار شخص
examples: The philosopher spent years writing about human freedom. Socrates is often called the father of Western philosophy as a philosopher. She approached the loss like a true philosopher. Every great philosopher asks questions others avoid.
synonyms: Thinker, Scholar, Sage, Theorist, Intellectual, Wise person, Metaphysician
sindhiMeaning: فلسفي جو ماهر, اهو ماڻهو جيڪو علم  سچ ۽ وجود بابت سوچ ويچار ڪري, دانشور يا مفڪر, زندگيءَ کي دانائيءَ سان ڏسندڙ ۽ صبر وارو ماڻهو

antonyms: Emotional, Excitable, Passionate, Nervous, Anxious, Sensitive, Agitated, Restless
englishMeaning: Calm, unemotional, and not easily excited or upset. Having a slow, sluggish temperament. Showing little reaction to things that normally excite or disturb people. Composed and unflappable in character.
urduMeaning: پرسکون، بے جذباتی اور آسانی سے پرجوش یا پریشان نہ ہونے والا، سست مزاج والا، ایسی چیزوں پر کم ردعمل دکھانے والا جو عام طور پر لوگوں کو پرجوش یا پریشان کریں، بے پرواہ اور ثابت قدم
examples: His phlegmatic nature helped him stay calm during the crisis. The phlegmatic clerk never seemed rushed or worried. She remained phlegmatic even when everyone else panicked. A phlegmatic response is sometimes wiser than an angry one.
sindhiMeaning: پرسڪون بي جذباتي ۽ آساني سان پرجوش يا پريشان نه ٿيندڙ، سست مزاج وارو، اهڙن شين تي ٿورو ردعمل ڏيکاريندڙ جيڪي عام طور تي ماڻهن کي پرجوش يا پريشان ڪن، بي پرواهه ۽ ثابت قدم
synonyms: Calm, Unemotional, Stoic, Impassive, Apathetic, Composed, Placid, Indifferent, Stolid

englishMeaning: Relating to the body rather than the mind. Connected with material things that can be touched or seen. Concerning the laws and properties of nature and matter. A medical examination of the body; involving bodily force or contact.
urduMeaning: جسمانی, بدن سے متعلق, مادی, دیکھنے اور چھونے کے قابل, طبعی, جسم کا طبی معائنہ
antonyms: Mental, Spiritual, Abstract, Intangible, Emotional, Immaterial
sindhiMeaning: جسماني, بدن سان لاڳاپيل, مادي, ڏسڻ ۽ ڇهڻ جوڳو, طبعي, جسم جي طبي جانچ
examples: Regular physical activity keeps the heart healthy. There was no physical evidence at the scene. The job requires physical strength and stamina. All pilots must pass an annual physical.
synonyms: Bodily, Corporeal, Material, Tangible, Concrete, Somatic, Real

urduMeaning: عوامی چوک یا کھلا بازار  خاص طور پر اطالوی شہروں میں، عمارتوں کے درمیان کھلی جگہ، چوک کے گرد ڈھکا ہوا برآمدہ یا راہداری، مکان سے ملحق کشادہ برآمدہ
englishMeaning: A public square or open marketplace, especially in an Italian town. An open space in a city surrounded by buildings. A covered walkway or gallery around an open square. A large veranda or porch attached to a house.
sindhiMeaning: عوامي چوڪ يا کليل بازار خاص ڪري اطالوي شهرن ۾، عمارتن جي وچ ۾ کليل ميدان، چوڪ جي چوڌاري ڍڪيل رستو يا ورانڊو، گهر سان لڳل ويڪرو ورانڊو
antonyms: Alley, Backstreet, Building, Enclosure, Wilderness
synonyms: Square, Plaza, Marketplace, Courtyard, Forum, Public square, Concourse, Veranda
examples: We drank coffee in a sunny piazza near the cathedral. The piazza fills with musicians every evening. A fountain stands in the centre of the piazza. Children played football across the empty piazza.

urduMeaning: پتھر  لکڑی  یا دھات سے بنا لمبا عمودی ڈھانچہ جو عمارت کی سہارے کے طور پر استعمال ہو، ایسا شخص یا چیز جو کسی چیز کے لیے ضروری مدد قابل اعتماد طور پر فراہم کرے، بنیادی اصول یا بنیاد جو نظام  نظریے یا عقیدے کو سہارا دے، ایسی چیز جو ستون کی شکل کی ہو یا سیدھی کھڑی ہو
sindhiMeaning: پٿر  ڪاٺ  يا ڌاتو مان ٺهيل ڊگهو عمودي ڍانچو جيڪو عمارت جي سهاري طور استعمال ٿئي، اهڙو ماڻهو يا شيءِ جيڪو ڪنهن شيءِ لاءِ ضروري مدد قابل اعتماد طور تي فراهم ڪري، بنيادي اصول يا بنياد جيڪو نظام  نظريي  يا عقيدي کي سهارو ڏئي، اها شيءِ جيڪا ڪالم جي شڪل وانگر هجي يا سڌو بيٺل هجي
englishMeaning: A tall vertical structure made of stone, wood, or metal used as a support for a building. A person or thing regarded as reliably providing essential support for something. A fundamental principle or basis supporting a system, theory, or belief. Something shaped like a column or standing upright.
antonyms: Weakness, Liability, Burden, Obstacle, Hindrance
synonyms: Column, Support, Post, Prop, Mainstay, Foundation, Cornerstone, Backbone, Upright
examples: Marble pillars support the ancient temple. She is a pillar of strength in difficult times. Education is considered a pillar of democracy. The four pillars of Islam guide Muslim life.

urduMeaning: چمکدار اور شوخ سرخ رنگ، برطانیہ کے ڈاک ڈبوں والا مخصوص سرخ رنگ، ایسا گہرا سرخ جو فوراً توجہ کھینچے، ہلکا نارنجی مائل سرخ رنگ
sindhiMeaning: چمڪندڙ ۽ تيز ڳاڙهو رنگ، برطانيه جي ٽپال دٻن وارو خاص ڳاڙهو رنگ، اهو گهرو ڳاڙهو رنگ جيڪو ڌيان ڇڪائي، ٿورو نارنگي مائل ڳاڙهو رنگ
englishMeaning: A bright, vivid, slightly orange-toned shade of red. The strong red colour traditionally used to paint British post boxes. A bold red used to attract attention, especially in clothing, design, or vehicles.
examples: She wore a pillar-box red coat that stood out in the crowd. The car was painted a glossy pillar-box red. He chose pillar-box red for the front door of the cottage. Her lipstick was a bold pillar-box red.
synonyms: Bright red, Scarlet, Vermilion, Crimson, Fire-engine red, Cherry red, Ruby red
antonyms: Pale, Pastel, Muted, Faded, Colourless, Dull, Washed-out
Ornate, Fancy, Complicated, Obscure, Decorated, Mountainous
englishMeaning: Simple and without decoration. Easy to understand or clearly evident. Honest and straightforward in speech. A large flat area of land with few trees.
sindhiMeaning: سادو ۽ بغير سينگار جو، آسانيءَ سان سمجهه ۾ ايندڙ، صاف ۽ سچي ڳالهه ڪندڙ، وسيع هموار زمين
synonyms: Simple, Clear, Obvious, Unadorned, Frank, Modest, Flatland
urduMeaning: سادہ اور بغیر آرائش کے، آسانی سے سمجھ میں آنے والا، صاف گو اور کھری بات کرنے والا، وسیع ہموار میدان
examples: She wore a plain white dress to the ceremony. It is plain that he was not telling the truth. He gave me his plain opinion about the plan. Herds of cattle grazed on the open plain.

antonyms: Praise, Compliment, Commendation, Contentment, Rejoicing
sindhiMeaning: رسمي شڪايت يا الزام  خاص ڪري عدالت ۾ داخل ڪيل, ڏک يا ماتم جو اظهار  اڪثر شاعريءَ ۾
examples: The plaint was filed before the civil court. His plaint against the landlord was dismissed. The poem is a plaint for a lost homeland. Her quiet plaint moved everyone in the room.
englishMeaning: A formal complaint or accusation, especially one made in a court of law. An expression of sorrow or lamentation, often in poetic use.
synonyms: Complaint, Lament, Grievance, Petition, Accusation, Lamentation
urduMeaning: رسمی شکایت یا الزام  خاص طور پر عدالت میں دائر کیا گیا, دکھ یا نالہ کا اظہار  عموماً شعری استعمال میں

urduMeaning: پرائمروز پھول جیسا نرم ہلکا پیلا رنگ، پیلے کا ہلکا اور نازک درجہ، نرم پیلا رنگ جو کپڑوں اور سجاوٹ میں استعمال ہوتا ہے

sindhiMeaning: ٽن طرفن وارو ٺوس شڪل جنهن ۾ ٻه متوازي هڪجهڙا بنياد ۽ مستطيل پاسي وارا منهن هجن، هڪ شفاف شڪل جيڪو سفيد روشني کي رنگن ۾ ورهائي، هڪ ڪثير السطوح جنهن جو يونيفارم ڪراس سيڪشن پوري ڊگهائي ۾ هجي
antonyms: Sphere, Cylinder, Cone, Irregular solid
englishMeaning: A three-dimensional solid with two parallel identical bases and rectangular lateral faces. A transparent object that separates white light into colors. A polyhedron with uniform cross-section along its length.
synonyms: Polyhedron, Crystal, Optical element, Geometric solid
urduMeaning: تین جہتی ٹھوس شکل جس میں دو متوازی یکساں بنیادیں اور مستطیل پہلو والے چہرے ہوں، ایک شفاف چیز جو سفید روشنی کو رنگوں میں تقسیم کرے، ایک کثیر السطوح جس کا یکساں کراس سیکشن پوری لمبائی میں ہو
examples: Light passes through the prism and creates a rainbow. A triangular prism has five faces. The crystal prism separates white light into spectrum. Calculate the surface area of the prism.

urduMeaning: منشور سے متعلق یا منشور جیسا، دھنک جیسے چمکدار اور رنگا رنگ رنگ دکھانے والا، روشنی کے انعطاف سے پیدا ہونے والے رنگوں والا، منشور کی شکل کا
synonyms: Iridescent, Rainbow-like, Multicoloured, Opalescent, Kaleidoscopic, Refractive, Variegated
examples: The crystal scattered prismatic colours across the wall. Her dress shimmered with prismatic light as she moved. The soap bubble displayed a prismatic sheen. Geologists studied the prismatic structure of the mineral.
sindhiMeaning: منشور سان لاڳاپيل يا منشور جهڙو، ڌنڪ جهڙا چمڪندڙ ۽ رنگا رنگي رنگ ڏيکاريندڙ، روشني جي انعطاف سان پيدا ٿيندڙ رنگن وارو، منشور جي شڪل وارو
antonyms: Monochrome, Colourless, Dull, Plain, Drab, Uniform
englishMeaning: Relating to or resembling a prism. Showing bright, varied colours like those formed when light passes through a prism. Brilliantly coloured and rainbow-like. Having the shape or form of a prism.

antonyms: Thrifty, Frugal, Economical, Prudent, Careful, Virtuous, Moderate, Saver
englishMeaning: Recklessly wasteful with money or resources. Shamelessly immoral in behaviour, especially in matters of pleasure. A person who spends money extravagantly and carelessly. Someone who lives a dissipated and immoral life.
synonyms: Wasteful, Extravagant, Spendthrift, Prodigal, Reckless, Dissolute, Immoral, Squanderer
examples: The government was criticized for its profligate spending. He led a profligate life and lost his entire inheritance. Such profligate use of water cannot continue during a drought. Once a profligate, he later became known for his charity.
sindhiMeaning: فضول خرچ ۽ بي احتياط، پئسو يا وسيلا اجايو ضايع ڪندڙ، اخلاقي طور تي بگڙيل ۽ عياش، اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو بي حساب خرچ ڪري، بدچلن ۽ عيش پرست ماڻهو
urduMeaning: فضول خرچ اور بے احتیاط، پیسہ یا وسائل بے دریغ ضائع کرنے والا، اخلاقی طور پر بگڑا ہوا اور عیاش، ایسا شخص جو بے حساب خرچ کرے، بدچلن اور عیش پسند شخص

synonyms: Sequence, Series, Advancement, Development, Progress, Growth, Forward movement
sindhiMeaning: انگن جو هڪ سلسلو هڪ مخصوص نمونو يا قاعدو سان، بتدريج ترقي ڪرڻ يا اڳتي وڌڻ جو عمل، هڪ سلسلو جيڪو باقاعده طريقي سان اڳتي وڌي، هڪ مقصد يا وڌيڪ ترقي يافته حالت ڏانهن حرڪت
examples: The arithmetic progression increases by 2 each time. Disease progression was monitored closely. The chord progression sounds harmonious. His career showed steady progression.
englishMeaning: A sequence of numbers with a specific pattern or rule. The process of developing or moving forward gradually. A series advancing in a regular way. Movement toward a goal or more advanced state.
urduMeaning: اعداد کی ایک ترتیب ایک مخصوص نمونہ یا اصول کے ساتھ، بتدریج ترقی کرنے یا آگے بڑھنے کا عمل، ایک سلسلہ جو باقاعدہ طریقے سے آگے بڑھے، ایک مقصد یا زیادہ ترقی یافتہ حالت کی طرف حرکت
antonyms: Regression, Decline, Deterioration, Stagnation, Backward movement

synonyms: Working class, Labourers, Workers, Wage earners, Masses, Commoners, Rank and file, Blue-collar class
examples: Marx believed the proletariat would eventually rise against the ruling class. Factory conditions in the city were shaped by the demands of the proletariat. The party claimed to speak for the proletariat. Rapid industrialisation created a large urban proletariat.
sindhiMeaning: مزدور طبقو جيڪو محنت وڪڻي گذر سفر ڪري، ڪارخانن ۽ ڪم جي جاين تي ڪم ڪندڙ ماڻهن جو طبقو، اهو طبقو جنهن وٽ ملڪيت نه هجي، سماج جو غريب ۽ محنتي طبقو، مارڪسي نظريي موجب پورهيت طبقو
englishMeaning: The class of industrial wage earners who own little property and live by selling their labour. The working class of a society, especially in Marxist theory. Ordinary labourers regarded as a social and economic group. The lowest social or economic class of a community.
antonyms: Bourgeoisie, Aristocracy, Nobility, Elite, Upper class, Capitalists, Gentry, Ruling class
urduMeaning: محنت کش یا مزدور طبقہ جو اپنی محنت بیچ کر گزر بسر کرتا ہے، کارخانوں اور کام کی جگہوں پر کام کرنے والوں کا طبقہ، وہ طبقہ جس کے پاس جائیداد نہ ہو، معاشرے کا غریب اور محنتی طبقہ، مارکسی نظریے کے مطابق پرولتاری طبقہ

antonyms: Improper, Wrong, Unsuitable, Inappropriate, Indecent, Incorrect
urduMeaning: مناسب, درست, صحیح, قاعدے کے مطابق, اصل, پورا پورا, کسی چیز سے خاص
englishMeaning: Suitable, correct, or appropriate for a particular purpose. Following accepted rules, customs, or standards of behaviour. Genuine, real, or of the expected kind. Belonging strictly to a particular thing or place; used after a noun to mean the main part.
synonyms: Correct, Appropriate, Suitable, Fitting, Right, Decent, Genuine, Apt
sindhiMeaning: مناسب, درست, صحيح, قاعدي مطابق, اصل, پورو پورو, ڪنهن شيءِ سان خاص
examples: Please fill the form in the proper manner. He never had a proper meal all day. That is not the proper way to speak to elders. The suburbs are busy, but the city proper is quiet.

synonyms: Prediction, Forecast, Premonition, Divination, Oracle, Vision, Prognostication, Augury
examples: The ancient prophecy foretold of a great hero. Her prophecy about the election proved accurate. Biblical prophecies are studied by scholars. The prophecy warned of dark times ahead.
englishMeaning: A prediction of what will happen in the future. A divinely inspired revelation or message. The action or practice of prophesying. A declaration of something to come. An inspired utterance from a prophet.
urduMeaning: مستقبل میں کیا ہوگا اس کی پیشین گوئی، خدائی الہام پذیر انکشاف یا پیغام، پیشین گوئی کرنے کا عمل یا رواج، آنے والی کسی چیز کا اعلان، نبی سے الہام پذیر بیان
sindhiMeaning: مستقبل ۾ ڇا ٿيندو ان جي اڳڪٿي، خدائي الهام پذير انڪشاف يا پيغام، اڳڪٿي ڪرڻ جو عمل يا رواج، ايندڙ ڪنهن شيءِ جو اعلان، نبي کان الهام پذير بيان
antonyms: Reality, Present fact, Historical event, Past occurrence

examples: The oracle prophesied victory in battle. She prophesied that technology would change everything. Prophets prophesy according to divine revelation. He prophesied doom if they ignored the warnings.
synonyms: Predict, Foretell, Forecast, Foresee, Prognosticate, Divine, Augur, Presage
urduMeaning: مستقبل کے واقعات کی پیشین گوئی کرنا یا پیش گوئی کرنا، نبی کے طور پر یا خدائی الہام سے بولنا، پہلے سے اعلان کرنا یا ظاہر کرنا، کیا ہوگا اس کے بارے میں پیشین گوئی کرنا
antonyms: Report, Describe past, Record history, Document
englishMeaning: To predict or foretell future events. To speak as a prophet or by divine inspiration. To declare or indicate in advance. To make a prediction about what will happen.
sindhiMeaning: مستقبل جي واقعن جي اڳڪٿي ڪرڻ يا اڳڪٿي ڪرڻ، نبي جي طور تي يا خدائي الهام سان ڳالهائڻ، اڳ ۾ اعلان ڪرڻ يا ظاهر ڪرڻ، ڇا ٿيندو ان بابت اڳڪٿي ڪرڻ

antonyms: Optimist, Positive thinker, Hopeful person, Encourager
examples: He's such a prophet of doom, always predicting the worst. The prophet of doom warned that the economy would collapse. Don't be a prophet of doom; stay positive. Every crisis brings out prophets of doom.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو آفت  ناڪامي  يا بدقسمتي جي اڳڪٿي ڪري، ڪو به جيڪو مسلسل منفي نتيجن جي اڳڪٿي ڪري، مايوسي پسند جيڪو ايندڙ تباهي جي خبردار ڪري، اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو مستقبل بابت خوف يا نااميدي پکيڙي
urduMeaning: ایسا شخص جو آفت، ناکامی، یا بدقسمتی کی پیشین گوئی کرے، کوئی بھی جو مسلسل منفی نتائج کی پیشین گوئی کرے، مایوسی پسند جو آنے والی تباہی کی خبردار کرے، ایسا شخص جو مستقبل کے بارے میں خوف یا مایوسی پھیلائے
englishMeaning: A person who predicts disaster, failure, or misfortune. Someone who constantly forecasts negative outcomes. A pessimist who warns of impending catastrophe. A person who spreads fear or despair about the future.
synonyms: Pessimist, Doomsayer, Alarmist, Doom merchant, Harbinger of doom, Catastrophist

urduMeaning: خاتون نبی، عورت جو خدائی الہام سے بولتی ہو یا مستقبل کے واقعات کی پیشین گوئی کرتی ہو، نظریے یا وجہ کے لیے خاتون ترجمان، عورت جسے الہام پذیر استاد یا خدا کا قاصد سمجھا جائے
examples: Deborah was a prophetess in the Old Testament. The prophetess warned of coming dangers. Ancient societies revered prophetesses for their wisdom. She was known as a prophetess of social justice.
sindhiMeaning: عورت نبي، عورت جيڪا خدائي الهام سان ڳالهائي يا مستقبل جي واقعن جي اڳڪٿي ڪري، نظريي يا سبب لاءِ عورت ترجمان، عورت جنهن کي الهام پذير استاد يا خدا جو قاصد سمجهيو وڃي
synonyms: Female prophet, Seer, Oracle, Visionary woman, Divine messenger, Female soothsayer
antonyms: Male prophet, Follower, Disciple, Non-believer
englishMeaning: A female prophet. A woman who speaks by divine inspiration or foretells future events. A female spokesperson for a doctrine or cause. A woman regarded as an inspired teacher or messenger of God.

examples: Her warnings proved prophetic when the crisis occurred. The novel's prophetic vision anticipated modern technology. His prophetic words came true years later. The artist's work was prophetic of future trends.
sindhiMeaning: صحيح طور تي اڳڪٿي ڪرڻ يا بيان ڪرڻ جيڪو مستقبل ۾ ٿيندو، نبي جي فطرت يا خاصيتون رکندڙ، اڳڪٿي تي مشتمل يا ان کي ٺاهيندڙ، مستقبل جي واقعن کي اڳڪٿي ڪرڻ يا اڳڪٿي ڪرڻ
synonyms: Predictive, Prescient, Visionary, Oracular, Clairvoyant, Foreseeing, Divining
urduMeaning: صحیح طور پر پیشین گوئی کرنا یا بیان کرنا جو مستقبل میں کیا ہوگا، نبی کی فطرت یا خصوصیات رکھنے والا، پیشین گوئی پر مشتمل یا اسے بنانے والا، مستقبل کے واقعات کی پیش بینی کرنا یا پیشین گوئی کرنا
englishMeaning: Accurately predicting or describing what will happen in the future. Having the nature or characteristics of a prophet. Containing or constituting a prophecy. Foreseeing or foretelling future events.
antonyms: Unpredictive, Short-sighted, Hindsighted, Retrospective

examples: A proton has a positive charge equal in size to that of an electron. The number of protons defines the atomic number of an element. Hydrogen has a single proton in its nucleus. Protons and neutrons are held together by a powerful force.
urduMeaning: ایٹم کے مرکزے میں موجود مثبت بار والا مستحکم ذرہ، وہ ذرہ جس کی تعداد عنصر کی شناخت متعین کرتی ہے، الیکٹران سے تقریباً 1836 گنا زیادہ کمیت والا ذرہ، ایٹمی مرکزے کا بنیادی جزو
synonyms: Positive particle, Nucleon, Subatomic particle, Nuclear particle
sindhiMeaning: ايٽم جي مرڪز ۾ موجود مثبت بار وارو مستحڪم ذرو، اهو ذرو جنهن جو تعداد عنصر جي سڃاڻپ طئي ڪري، اليڪٽران کان تقريباً 1836 ڀيرا وڌيڪ وزن رکندڙ ذرو، ايٽمي مرڪز جو بنيادي جزو
antonyms: Electron, Antiproton, Neutron, Negative particle
englishMeaning: A stable subatomic particle with a positive electric charge, found in the nucleus of every atom. The particle whose number in the nucleus determines which chemical element an atom is. A nucleon with a mass about 1,836 times that of an electron.

antonyms: Pale, White, Cream, Pastel, Colourless, Bright

examples: She turned puce with embarrassment when her name was called. The old armchair was covered in faded puce velvet. He chose a puce tie to match his jacket. The walls were an unfortunate shade of puce.
sindhiMeaning: گهرو ڳاڙهو يا واڱڻائي مائل ناسي رنگ، ڀوري ۾ واڱڻائي جهلڪ وارو رنگ، اهڙو گهرو ناسي واڱڻائي رنگ
synonyms: Purplish brown, Maroon, Mulberry, Plum, Burgundy, Wine-coloured
urduMeaning: گہرا سرخی مائل یا جامنی مائل بھورا رنگ، بھورے میں جامنی جھلک والا رنگ، ایسا گہرا بھورا جامنی رنگ

sindhiMeaning: تمام گهڻو خيال رکندڙ ۽ باريڪ بينيءَ وارو، ننڍڙين ڳالهين ۽ آدابن جو سختيءَ سان خيال رکندڙ، فرضن جي ادائگي ۾ نهايت محتاط ۽ درست، رسمن ۽ ضابطن جي پابندي ڪندڙ
antonyms: Careless, Negligent, Sloppy, Casual, Slapdash, Indifferent, Lax, Untidy, Inattentive
englishMeaning: Showing great attention to detail and correct behaviour. Very careful about rules, formalities, and small points of conduct. Extremely precise and conscientious in carrying out duties. Strict in observing etiquette and proper procedure.
synonyms: Meticulous, Scrupulous, Precise, Conscientious, Careful, Exact, Fastidious, Painstaking, Particular, Formal
urduMeaning: نہایت باریک بین اور تفصیل پر توجہ دینے والا، اصولوں اور آداب کا سختی سے خیال رکھنے والا، فرائض کی انجام دہی میں انتہائی محتاط اور درست، رسوم و ضوابط کا پابند
examples: He is punctilious about answering every email on the same day. The clerk was punctilious in checking each document. She kept punctilious records of every payment. Their host was punctilious about seating arrangements at dinner.

He punctiliously followed every step of the procedure. The documents were punctiliously checked before signing. She punctiliously observed the customs of her hosts. The accounts were punctiliously maintained for years.
englishMeaning: In a way that shows great attention to small details. Very carefully and correctly, especially about rules or manners. With strict regard for formality and accuracy. In a scrupulously precise manner.
sindhiMeaning: تمام باريڪ بينيءَ سان، ننڍين ننڍين ڳالهين تي ڌيان ڏيندي، اصولن جي سختيءَ سان پيروي ڪندي، مڪمل درستيءَ سان
synonyms: Meticulously, Scrupulously, Precisely, Carefully, Conscientiously, Exactly, Fastidiously
antonyms: Carelessly, Sloppily, Casually, Negligently, Roughly, Haphazardly
urduMeaning: نہایت باریک بینی سے، چھوٹی چھوٹی باتوں کا خیال رکھتے ہوئے، اصولوں کی سختی سے پابندی کرتے ہوئے، مکمل درستگی کے ساتھ

sindhiMeaning: باريڪ بيني، ننڍين ڳالهين تي ڌيان ڏيڻ جي خوبي، اصولن ۽ آدابن جي سخت پابندي، مڪمل درستگي
antonyms: Carelessness, Negligence, Sloppiness, Laxity, Indifference
englishMeaning: Great attention to small details and correct behaviour. The quality of being extremely careful about rules and formalities. Strictness in observing accuracy and etiquette. Scrupulous exactness.
urduMeaning: باریک بینی، چھوٹی باتوں کا خیال رکھنے کی خوبی، اصولوں اور آداب کی سخت پابندی، مکمل درستگی
synonyms: Meticulousness, Scrupulousness, Precision, Exactness, Thoroughness, Care
examples: His punctiliousness made him an excellent auditor. The punctiliousness of the host impressed every guest. She is known for her punctiliousness in official matters. Such punctiliousness slows the work but ensures accuracy.

antonyms: Late, Unpunctual, Delayed, Tardy, Unreliable, Irregular
englishMeaning: Arriving or happening at the exact time arranged. Doing things at the correct or agreed time. Not late, and respectful of time. Reliable regarding timing.
sindhiMeaning: وقت جو پابند، مقرر وقت تي پهچندڙ، وقت سِر ڪم ڪندڙ، دير نه ڪندڙ
examples: She is always punctual for her morning classes. A punctual employee earns the trust of the management. The train was punctual despite the heavy rain. Please be punctual, as the meeting starts at nine sharp.
synonyms: Timely, Prompt, On time, Reliable, Precise, Regular, Exact
urduMeaning: وقت کا پابند، مقررہ وقت پر پہنچنے والا، وقت پر کام کرنے والا، تاخیر نہ کرنے والا

examples: Punctuality is one of the marks of a professional. The school stresses punctuality and discipline. His punctuality impressed the interview panel. Poor punctuality can damage a company's reputation.
synonyms: Timeliness, Promptness, Regularity, Reliability, Precision, Discipline
englishMeaning: The habit of doing things at the exact arranged time. The quality of being on time. Strict observance of appointed hours. Reliability in keeping to a schedule.
urduMeaning: وقت کی پابندی، مقررہ وقت پر پہنچنے کی عادت، بروقت کام کرنے کی خوبی، شیڈول کی پیروی
antonyms: Lateness, Tardiness, Delay, Unreliability, Irregularity
sindhiMeaning: وقت جي پابندي، مقرر وقت تي پهچڻ جي عادت، وقت سِر ڪم ڪرڻ جي خوبي، شيڊول جي پيروي

examples: The ceremony began punctually at six in the evening. He arrives punctually every morning without fail. The flight departed punctually despite the crowd. She punctually submitted all her assignments.
synonyms: Promptly, On time, Timely, Precisely, Exactly, Regularly
sindhiMeaning: وقت سِر، مقرر وقت تي، بغير دير جي، ٺيڪ وقت تي
antonyms: Late, Belatedly, Tardily, Irregularly, Behind schedule
urduMeaning: وقت پر، مقررہ وقت پر، بغیر تاخیر، بالکل ٹھیک وقت پر
englishMeaning: At the exact time arranged, without delay. Promptly and on schedule. In a manner that respects agreed timing. Neither early nor late.

synonyms: Interrupt, Break, Mark, Intersperse, Accentuate, Emphasise
sindhiMeaning: لکت ۾ رموز اوقاف لڳائڻ، وچ وچ ۾ ڪنهن آواز يا عمل سان مداخلت ڪرڻ، وقفن سان زور ڏيڻ، وقت جي عرصي کي مختلف واقعن سان ورهائڻ
examples: Remember to punctuate your sentences correctly. Loud cheers punctuated the entire speech. She punctuated her lecture with useful examples. Short breaks punctuate the long working day.
urduMeaning: تحریر میں رموز اوقاف لگانا، درمیان درمیان کسی آواز یا عمل سے مداخلت کرنا، وقفوں کے ذریعے زور دینا، وقت کے عرصے کو مختلف واقعات سے تقسیم کرنا
antonyms: Continue, Run on, Merge, Leave unmarked, Flow
englishMeaning: To insert punctuation marks into a piece of writing. To interrupt something at intervals with a repeated action or sound. To emphasise or give rhythm to something by adding occasional elements. To break up a period of time with separate events.

synonyms: Interrupted, Broken, Marked, Interspersed, Dotted, Accented
sindhiMeaning: رموز اوقاف سان لکيل، وقفن سان وچ وچ ۾ ٽٽل، بار بار ٿيندڙ ڪنهن آواز يا واقعي سان مداخلت ٿيل، وقفن سان زور ڏنل
examples: The essay was carefully punctuated and easy to read. The silence was punctuated by distant thunder. His speech was punctuated with long pauses. The journey was punctuated by frequent stops for tea.
urduMeaning: رموز اوقاف کے ساتھ لکھا ہوا، وقفوں سے بیچ بیچ میں منقطع، بار بار ہونے والی آواز یا واقعے سے متاثر، وقفوں کے ساتھ زور دیا گیا
englishMeaning: Marked with punctuation such as commas and full stops. Interrupted at intervals by something, especially a repeated event or sound. Emphasised or given rhythm by occasional occurrences. Broken up by pauses or breaks at regular points.
antonyms: Continuous, Uninterrupted, Unbroken, Smooth, Unpunctuated
Omission, Run-on text, Continuity, Absence of marks
sindhiMeaning: رموز اوقاف، لکڻ ۾ استعمال ٿيندڙ نشان جيڪي جملن کي الڳ ڪن ۽ مطلب واضح ڪن، انهن نشانن جو نظام، وچ وچ ۾ ايندڙ وقفو، لکت ۾ نشان لڳائڻ جو عمل
examples: Correct punctuation makes writing much clearer. The teacher explained the rules of punctuation in simple terms. Poor punctuation can completely change the meaning of a sentence. His frequent jokes served as punctuation to a serious talk.
urduMeaning: رموز اوقاف، لکھائی میں استعمال ہونے والے نشان جو جملوں کو الگ کریں اور مفہوم واضح کریں، ان نشانات کا نظام، درمیان میں آنے والا وقفہ، تحریر میں نشان لگانے کا عمل
englishMeaning: The marks used in writing to separate sentences and clarify meaning. The practice or system of using such marks. Something that interrupts or breaks up a continuous activity at intervals. The act of adding these marks to written text.
synonyms: Marks, Pointing, Notation, Stops, Symbols
Stealing, Thieving, Pilfering, Filching, Snatching, Lifting, Embezzling, Swiping, Nicking
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي چوري ڪرڻ اڪثر چٽي يا خفياء طريقي سان، ٻئي جي شيءِ بنا اجازت وٺڻ، چوري ڪرڻ خاص ڪري ننڍن شين جي
examples: The servant was caught purloining silver spoons from the kitchen. He was dismissed for purloining office supplies. The mischievous boy delighted in purloining apples from the orchard. Someone had been purloining documents from the archive.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کی چوری کرنا اکثر چالاکی یا خفیہ طریقے سے، دوسرے کی چیز بغیر اجازت لینا، چوری کرنا خاص طور پر چھوٹی اشیاء کی
antonyms: Returning, Restoring, Giving, Donating, Protecting, Guarding
englishMeaning: Stealing something, often in a sly or secretive way. Taking something that belongs to someone else without permission. Committing theft, especially of small items.

urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو نیچے دبانا یا زور سے نیچے کرنا, قیمتوں یا اعداد کو کم کرنا, کسی احساس یا خیال کو دبانا
antonyms: Push up, Raise, Lift, Increase, Boost, Release
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي هيٺ دٻائڻ يا زور سان هيٺ ڪرڻ, قيمتون يا انگ گهٽائڻ, ڪنهن احساس يا خيال کي دٻائڻ
englishMeaning: To press or force something downward. To reduce prices, levels or numbers. To suppress a feeling or thought.
synonyms: Press down, Lower, Depress, Reduce, Suppress, Cut, Force down
examples: Push down the lever to start the machine. A good harvest pushed down vegetable prices. He pushed down his anger and kept quiet. Competition has pushed down the cost of data.

synonyms: Force through, Ram through, Enact, Press ahead, Persevere, Persist, Squeeze through
examples: The government pushed the bill through parliament in a single day. He pushed through the crowd to reach the exit. She was exhausted but pushed through to finish the report. They pushed the reform through despite fierce criticism.
urduMeaning: مخالفت کے باوجود کسی منصوبے یا قانون کو منظور کروانا, بھیڑ یا رکاوٹ سے زور سے گزر جانا, مشکل کے باوجود کام مکمل کرنا
sindhiMeaning: مخالفت جي باوجود ڪنهن رٿا يا قانون کي منظور ڪرائڻ, ميڙ يا رنڊڪ مان زور سان لنگهي وڃڻ, مشڪل جي باوجود ڪم پورو ڪرڻ
englishMeaning: To force a plan, law or decision to be accepted despite opposition. To make one's way forcefully through a crowd or obstacle. To continue with difficulty until something is completed.
antonyms: Abandon, Withdraw, Block, Delay, Give up, Halt, Stall

englishMeaning: To force someone into a helpless or desperate position. To defeat or overpower a person completely. To leave someone with no room to escape or choose. To press a rival hard until he must give way.
urduMeaning: کسی کو بے بس اور لاچار حالت میں دھکیل دینا، کسی کو مکمل طور پر شکست دینا، کسی کے لیے فرار یا انتخاب کا راستہ نہ چھوڑنا، حریف کو اتنا دبانا کہ وہ ہار مان لے
antonyms: Support, Help, Relieve, Encourage, Assist, Free, Strengthen
synonyms: Corner, Overpower, Defeat, Subdue, Crush, Drive to desperation, Overwhelm, Beat
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي بيوس ۽ لاچار حالت ۾ آڻڻ، ڪنهن کي مڪمل طور تي مات ڏيڻ، ڪنهن لاءِ ڀڄڻ يا چونڊ جو ڪو رستو نه ڇڏڻ، مخالف کي ايترو دٻائڻ جو هو هار مڃي
examples: Heavy debts pushed the small traders to the walls. The champion pushed his opponent to the walls in the last round. Rising prices have pushed poor families to the walls. Do not push an honest worker to the walls.
Please push up the window to let some air in. Fuel shortages pushed up transport costs. The plant pushed up through the cracked pavement. New demand pushed up prices across the market.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي مٿي ڏانهن کڻڻ يا زور سان چاڙهڻ, قيمتون يا انگ اکر وڌائڻ, هيٺان مٿي ڏانهن دٻاءُ وجهڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو اوپر اٹھانا یا زور سے چڑھانا, قیمتوں یا اعداد کو بڑھانا, نیچے سے اوپر کی طرف دباؤ ڈالنا
synonyms: Raise, Lift, Increase, Boost, Elevate, Hike, Drive up
antonyms: Push down, Lower, Reduce, Decrease, Drop, Cut
englishMeaning: To move or force something upward. To cause prices, numbers or levels to increase. To exert upward pressure from below.
An exercise in which the body is raised and lowered with the arms while lying face down. Designed to give lift or support, as with certain garments.
synonyms: Press-up, Floor press, Exercise, Lift, Boost, Support
examples: He does fifty push-ups every morning before breakfast. The coach added push-ups to the warm-up routine. She could barely manage a single push-up at first. The store advertised a new push-up design in its swimwear range.
urduMeaning: ایک ورزش جس میں منہ نیچے لیٹ کر بازوؤں سے جسم کو اوپر نیچے کیا جاتا ہے, اوپر اٹھانے یا سہارا دینے والا (لباس کے بارے میں)
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ورزش جنهن ۾ منهن هيٺ ليٽي هٿن سان جسم کي مٿي کڻي هيٺ ڪيو ويندو آهي, مٿي کڻڻ يا سهارو ڏيڻ وارو (لباس بابت)
antonyms: Rest, Inactivity, Idleness, Slouch, Collapse

examples: The salesman was so pushy that we left the shop. I do not want to sound pushy, but the deadline is today. Her pushy parents enrolled her in five classes at once. Being pushy rarely wins people's trust.
sindhiMeaning: زور زبردستي ڪندڙ، حد کان وڌيڪ اڳرائي ڪندڙ, ضد ڪندڙ ۽ ٿڪائيندڙ, حد کان وڌيڪ خواهشمند ۽ مطالبا ڪندڙ
englishMeaning: Excessively forceful or assertive in seeking what one wants. Insistent in an annoying or aggressive way. Overly ambitious and demanding of others.
synonyms: Aggressive, Assertive, Forceful, Insistent, Overbearing, Bossy, Demanding
urduMeaning: حد سے زیادہ زور دینے والا، ضدی, بے جا اصرار کرنے والا، جارحانہ, بہت زیادہ خواہش مند اور مطالبہ کرنے والا
antonyms: Timid, Modest, Reserved, Shy, Meek, Unassuming, Gentle

sindhiMeaning: ٻلي لاءِ پيار وارو يا غير رسمي نالو, ڇوڪريءَ لاءِ راند وارو لفظ, غير رسمي طور تي منهن يا وات
urduMeaning: بلی کے لیے پیار بھرا یا غیر رسمی نام, لڑکی کے لیے مزاحیہ لفظ, غیر رسمی طور پر چہرہ یا منہ
antonyms: Dog, Canine, Stranger, Body
synonyms: Cat, Kitty, Pussycat, Feline, Kitten, Face, Mug
englishMeaning: An informal or affectionate name for a cat. A playful term for a girl or young woman. In informal use, the face or mouth.
examples: She called the cat with a soft here, puss!. The old puss slept all afternoon on the windowsill. He told the sly puss to stop teasing her brother. Wipe that grin off your puss and get to work.

englishMeaning: A clever cat in a classic European fairy tale who wins fortune and status for his poor master through trickery. Used figuratively for a cunning helper who advances someone's cause by wit.
sindhiMeaning: يورپي پريءَ ڪهاڻيءَ جو هڪ چالاڪ ٻلو جيڪو پنهنجي غريب مالڪ لاءِ دولت ۽ مانُ حاصل ڪري ٿو, اشاري طور تي هوشيار مددگار جيڪو عقل سان ڪم ڪڍي
examples: The children acted out Puss in Boots for the school play. Puss in Boots outwits an ogre to help his master. She has read Puss in Boots to her son a dozen times. Their lawyer was a real Puss in Boots, clever and quick.
synonyms: Fairy tale, Folk tale, Trickster, Story, Fable, Legend
antonyms: History, Fact, Reality, Non-fiction
urduMeaning: یورپی پری کہانی کا ایک چالاک بلا جو اپنے غریب مالک کے لیے دولت اور مرتبہ حاصل کرتا ہے, اشارتاً ایک ہوشیار مددگار جو عقل سے کام نکالتا ہے
عام طور پر سمجھا یا مانا جانے والا اگرچہ ثابت نہ ہوا ہو، فرضی یا قیاسی طور پر موجود یا سچ، عام طور پر تسلیم شدہ یا مشہور کبھی کبھی غلط
sindhiMeaning: عام طور تي سمجهيو يا مڃيو ويندڙ جيتوڻيڪ ثابت نه ٿيل، فرضي يا قياسي طور تي موجود يا سچو، عام طور تي قبول ڪيل يا مشهور ڪڏهن ڪڏهن غلط
antonyms: Proven, Confirmed, Actual, Genuine, Verified, Authentic, Real, Certain
englishMeaning: Generally considered or believed to be something, though not proven. Supposed or assumed to exist or be true. Commonly accepted or reputed, sometimes wrongly.
synonyms: Supposed, Assumed, Reputed, Presumed, Alleged, Reported, So-called, Believed
examples: The putative author of the manuscript was never confirmed. The police questioned the putative leader of the gang. The putative benefits of the new drug are still under study. He is the putative heir to the family fortune.
His sudden departure was puzzling to everyone. The test results were puzzling to the doctors. It's puzzling why she refused the offer. The ancient symbols remain puzzling to researchers.
englishMeaning: Confusing or difficult to understand or explain. Causing confusion or bewilderment. Perplexing or mysterious. Creating doubt or uncertainty about something.
urduMeaning: الجھن میں ڈالنے والا یا سمجھنا یا وضاحت کرنا مشکل، الجھن یا حیرانی کا سبب، پریشان کن یا پراسرار، کسی چیز کے بارے میں شک یا غیر یقینی پیدا کرنے والا
sindhiMeaning: مونجهارو يا سمجهڻ يا وضاحت ڪرڻ ڏکيو، مونجهارو يا حيراني جو سبب، حيران ڪندڙ يا پراسرار، ڪنهن شيءِ بابت شڪ يا غير يقيني پيدا ڪندڙ
synonyms: Confusing, Perplexing, Baffling, Bewildering, Mystifying, Enigmatic, Mysterious, Unclear
antonyms: Clear, Obvious, Straightforward, Simple, Understandable, Transparent, Plain

synonyms: Triangle structure, Cone shape, Hierarchical structure, Ziggurat
sindhiMeaning: ٽن طرفن وارو ٺوس شڪل جنهن ۾ ڪثير الاضلاع بنياد ۽ مثلثي منهن هجن جيڪي هڪ نقطي تي ملن، قديم مصري پٿر جي اڏاوت جنهن جو چورس بنياد هجي، درجه بندي وارو ڍانچو يا نظام، بتدريج وڌائڻ يا ٺاهڻ
examples: The pyramids of Egypt are ancient wonders. A pyramid has triangular faces. The company has a pyramid organizational structure. He pyramided his investments over time.
englishMeaning: A three-dimensional solid with a polygonal base and triangular faces meeting at a point. An ancient Egyptian stone structure with a square base. A hierarchical structure or system. To increase or build up gradually.
antonyms: Cube, Sphere, Flat structure, Equal distribution
urduMeaning: تین جہتی ٹھوس شکل جس میں کثیر الاضلاع بنیاد اور مثلثی چہرے ہوں جو ایک نقطے پر ملیں، قدیم مصری پتھر کی تعمیر جس کی مربع بنیاد ہو، درجہ بندی والا ڈھانچہ یا نظام، بتدریج بڑھانا یا بنانا
چار سیدھے اضلاع اور چار زاویوں والی ہموار شکل, وہ کثیرالاضلاع جس کے چار کنارے اور چار راس ہوں, چار فریقوں یا اطراف سے متعلق, وہ عمومی زمرہ جس میں مربع   مستطیل  معین اور شبہ منحرف شامل ہیں
antonyms: Triangle, Pentagon, Circle, Ellipse
sindhiMeaning: چئن سڌن پاسن ۽ چئن ڪنڊن وارو هموار شڪل, اهو گهڻ ڪنڊو جنهن ۾ چار ڪنارا ۽ چار چوٽيون هجن, چئن ڌرين يا پاسن سان لاڳاپيل, اهو عام گروهه جنهن ۾ چورس  مستطيل  رومبس ۽ ٽريپيزيم شامل آهن
synonyms: Tetragon, Four-sided figure, Quadrangle, Polygon
examples: The sum of the angles of a quadrilateral is 360 degrees. A square is a special type of quadrilateral. They signed a quadrilateral security agreement. Identify each quadrilateral in the diagram.
englishMeaning: A flat shape with four straight sides and four angles. A polygon having exactly four edges and four vertices. Involving or formed by four parties or sides. A general category that includes squares, rectangles, rhombuses, and trapeziums.

examples: Please buy a quart of milk on your way home. The jug holds exactly one quart. A quart is smaller than a gallon but larger than a pint. He drank almost a quart of juice after the match.
synonyms: Measure, Unit, Volume, Quantity, Pint pair, Container, Jug
urduMeaning: مائع ناپنے کی ایک اکائی جو گیلن کا چوتھائی حصہ ہے، دو پنٹ کے برابر مقدار، اتنی مقدار رکھنے والا برتن، تقریباً ایک لیٹر کے برابر پیمانہ
sindhiMeaning: مائع ماپڻ جو هڪ ايڪو جيڪو گيلن جو چوٿون حصو آهي، ٻن پنٽن جي برابر ماپ، ايتري مقدار رکندڙ ٿانءُ، لڳ ڀڳ هڪ ليٽر جي برابر ماپ
antonyms: Gallon, Drop, Ounce, Teaspoon, Sip, Barrel, Trace
englishMeaning: A unit of liquid measurement equal to a quarter of a gallon or two pints. A container that holds this amount of liquid. A quantity of liquid equal to about 1.14 litres in the UK or 0.95 litres in the US.

sindhiMeaning: چئن برابر حصن مان هڪ، خاص طور تي ٽن مهينن جو عرصو يا مالي سال جو چوٿون حصو، آمريڪا ۾ 25 سينٽ جو سڪو، شهر يا ڳوٺ جو علاقو يا حصو
examples: She cut the apple into quarters. The company's profits increased in the last quarter. I need a quarter to use the parking meter. They live in the historic quarter of the city.
synonyms: Fourth, One-fourth, 25 percent, Three months, District, Section, Area, Neighborhood
urduMeaning: چار برابر حصوں میں سے ایک، خاص طور پر تین مہینوں کی مدت یا مالی سال کا چوتھا حصہ، امریکہ میں 25 سینٹ کا سکہ، شہر یا قصبے کا علاقہ یا حصہ
antonyms: Whole, Entirety, Total, Complete, Full, All
englishMeaning: One of four equal parts into which something can be divided. A period of three months, especially as a division of a financial year. A coin worth 25 cents in US currency. A district or section of a town or city.

antonyms: Full circle, Semicircle, Three-quarter circle, Complete circle
englishMeaning: One-fourth of a circle, formed by two perpendicular radii and the arc between them. A 90-degree sector of a circle. A curved shape that represents 25% of a complete circle.
synonyms: Quadrant, Fourth of circle, 90-degree arc, Right-angle sector
examples: The corner design featured a quarter circle. A quarter circle has a 90-degree arc. The table's edge was rounded into a quarter circle. Pizza slices often approximate a quarter circle shape.
urduMeaning: دائرے کا چوتھا حصہ، جو دو عمودی شعاعوں اور ان کے درمیان محراب سے بنے، دائرے کا 90 ڈگری والا حصہ، ایسی مڑی ہوئی شکل جو مکمل دائرے کا 25 فیصد ظاہر کرے
sindhiMeaning: گولائي جو چوٿون حصو، جيڪو ٻن عمودي شعاعن ۽ انهن جي وچ واري محراب سان بڻي، دائري جو 90 درجن وارو حصو، اهڙو مڙيل شڪل جيڪو مڪمل گولائي جو 25 سيڪڙو نمائندگي ڪري

antonyms: Drops, Ounces, Trace amounts, Fractions, Sips, Teaspoons
englishMeaning: Plural of quart; units of liquid measurement equal to two pints. Containers holding one quart of liquid each. Several measured quantities of a liquid such as milk or oil.
urduMeaning: کوارٹ کی جمع، مائع ناپنے کی اکائیاں جو دو پنٹ کے برابر ہوتی ہیں، ایک کوارٹ گنجائش والے برتن، مائع کی کئی ناپی ہوئی مقداریں
examples: She bought two quarts of milk from the corner shop. The recipe requires three quarts of water. He poured several quarts of oil into the tank. Two quarts are roughly equal to two litres.
sindhiMeaning: ڪوارٽ جو جمع، مائع ماپڻ جا ايڪا جيڪي ٻن پنٽن جي برابر آهن، هڪ ڪوارٽ ماپ وارا ٿانءَ، مائع جي ڪيترن ماپن جو مجموعو
synonyms: Measures, Units, Quantities, Litres, Containers, Volumes, Portions

urduMeaning: ایک سخت اور چمکدار معدنی پتھر، سلیکان ڈائی آکسائیڈ سے بنا بلور، گھڑیوں اور برقی آلات میں استعمال ہونے والی معدنیات، زیورات میں استعمال ہونے والا شفاف پتھر
englishMeaning: A hard, crystalline mineral made of silicon dioxide, found in many rocks. A mineral widely used in watches, clocks, and electronic devices. A transparent or coloured crystal used in jewellery and industry.
examples: The hillside is rich in quartz and other minerals. He wears a quartz watch that keeps perfect time. A large piece of pink quartz sat on her desk. Quartz crystals are widely used in electronic devices.
synonyms: Crystal, Silica, Rock crystal, Mineral, Gemstone, Flint, Agate
antonyms: Glass, Metal, Organic matter, Clay, Soil, Wood, Plastic
sindhiMeaning: هڪ سخت ۽ چمڪندڙ معدني پٿر، سلڪان ڊاءِ آڪسائيڊ مان ٺهيل ڪرسٽل، گهڙين ۽ برقي سامان ۾ استعمال ٿيندڙ معدنيات، زيورن ۾ ڪم ايندڙ شفاف پٿر

synonyms: Seemingly, Apparently, Pseudo, Near, Semi, Virtually, Almost
urduMeaning: بظاہر, کچھ کچھ, نیم, ایسا لگنے والا مگر حقیقت میں نہیں, تقریباً ویسا
sindhiMeaning: ظاهري طور تي, ڪجهه ڪجهه, نيم, ائين لڳندڙ پر حقيقت ۾ نه, تقريباً جهڙو
examples: It is a quasi-official body with limited powers. The film has a quasi-documentary style. He offered a quasi-apology that satisfied nobody. The group enjoys quasi-legal status in the region.
englishMeaning: Seemingly; apparently but not really. Resembling something but not truly being it. Used to show a partial or almost complete likeness. Having some, but not all, features of the thing named.
antonyms: Genuine, Real, True, Actual, Fully, Authentic
