antonyms: Speculation, Guesswork, Opinion, Fiction, Assumption
englishMeaning: Facts and figures collected for reference, analysis, or decision making. Information stored or processed by a computer. The results of observation or measurement in research. The plural form of datum, though often used as a singular mass noun.
sindhiMeaning: حقيقتون ۽ انگ اکر جيڪي جاچ يا فيصلي لاءِ گڏ ڪيا وڃن، ڪمپيوٽر ۾ محفوظ يا پروسيس ٿيندڙ معلومات، تحقيق ۾ مشاهدي جا نتيجا، ڊيٽم جو جمع
synonyms: Information, Facts, Figures, Statistics, Records, Details, Input

examples: Each datum was recorded carefully in the notebook. A single datum is not enough to prove the theory. Heights are measured from a fixed datum above sea level. The engineer marked the datum before starting the survey.
englishMeaning: A single piece of information or fact. One item in a set of data used for analysis. A fixed starting point or reference level used in surveying and measurement. A known value from which other measurements are calculated.
synonyms: Fact, Detail, Figure, Item, Reference point, Value, Statistic
sindhiMeaning: معلومات جو هڪ ٽڪرو، ڊيٽا جو واحد جزو، ماپ لاءِ مقرر ڪيل بنيادي نقطو يا حوالو، اهو ڄاتل قدر جنهن مان ٻيا ماپا ڪڍيا وڃن
antonyms: Assumption, Guess, Opinion, Estimate
urduMeaning: معلومات کا ایک ٹکڑا، ڈیٹا کا واحد جزو، پیمائش کے لیے مقرر کردہ بنیادی نقطہ یا حوالہ، وہ معلوم قدر جس سے دیگر پیمائشیں نکالی جائیں

antonyms: Moment, Instant, Second, Century, Millennium
englishMeaning: A period of ten years. A set or group of ten items or units. A ten-year stage used to divide a century or a person's life. A long span of time measured in tens of years.
synonyms: Ten years, Period, Era, Span, Interval, Stretch, Age
urduMeaning: دس سال کا عرصہ، دہائی، دس چیزوں کا مجموعہ، صدی کا دس سالہ حصہ، دہائیوں میں ناپا جانے والا طویل عرصہ
sindhiMeaning: ڏهن سالن جو عرصو، ڏهاڪو، ڏهن شين يا ايڪن جو مجموعو، صديءَ جو ڏهن سالن وارو حصو، ڊگهو عرصو جيڪو ڏهاڪن ۾ ماپيو وڃي
examples: Technology has changed dramatically over the past decade. She spent a decade working as a teacher. The city grew rapidly during the last decade. It took nearly a decade to complete the project.

synonyms: Decline, Decay, Degeneration, Corruption, Indulgence, Debauchery, Deterioration
antonyms: Morality, Virtue, Rise, Growth, Progress, Purity, Restraint
englishMeaning: Moral or cultural decline, especially after a period of high achievement. Excessive indulgence in luxury and pleasure. A state of low moral standards and self-indulgence. The process of falling into decay or deterioration.
sindhiMeaning: اخلاقي يا ثقافتي زوال، عياشي ۽ لذت پرستيءَ ۾ حد کان وڌيڪ مشغوليت، اخلاقي پستي، زوال ۽ خرابيءَ جي حالت
examples: Historians describe the decadence of the late empire. He criticized the decadence of modern consumer culture. The novel portrays wealth, decadence, and decline. Decadence slowly weakened the ruling class.
urduMeaning: اخلاقی یا ثقافتی زوال، عیاشی اور لذت پرستی میں حد سے زیادہ مشغولیت، اخلاقی پستی، زوال اور خرابی کی حالت
اخلاقی زوال ظاہر کرنے والا، عیاشی اور لذت پرستی میں ڈوبا ہوا، انتہائی پرتعیش، خاص طور پر کھانے کے لیے مرغن اور بھرپور، عیاش شخص
antonyms: Moral, Virtuous, Austere, Simple, Upright, Restrained
sindhiMeaning: اخلاقي زوال ڏيکاريندڙ، عياشي ۽ لذت پرستيءَ ۾ ٻڏل، انتهائي پرتعيش، خاص ڪري کاڌي جي حوالي سان مزيدار ۽ ڀرپور، عياش ماڻهو
synonyms: Self-indulgent, Luxurious, Corrupt, Degenerate, Immoral, Lavish, Hedonistic
examples: They served a decadent chocolate cake after dinner. The film shows the decadent lifestyle of the elite. Critics called the era decadent and wasteful. He was seen as a decadent among serious reformers.
englishMeaning: Showing moral or cultural decline. Characterized by excessive luxury and self-indulgence. Rich and indulgent, especially of food. A person who lives a life of luxury and low moral standards.

synonyms: Ten-sided polygon, Decagonal shape, Ten-gon
antonyms: Circle, Triangle, Pentagon, Hexagon, Irregular shape
urduMeaning: دس اضلاع اور دس زاویوں والی شکل، دس سیدھی اطراف اور دس نقاط والی ہندسی شکل، دس کونوں اور دس کناروں والی کوئی بھی چپٹی شکل
sindhiMeaning: ڏهن رخن ۽ ڏهن ڪنڊن وارو هڪ شڪل، ڏهه سڌي پاسن ۽ ڏهه نقطن وارو جيوميٽري شڪل، ڏهه ڪنڊن ۽ ڏهه ڪنارن وارو ڪو به برابر شڪل
examples: A regular decagon has ten equal sides and angles. The fountain base was designed as a decagon. Students learned to construct a decagon using geometric tools. The medal was shaped like a beautiful decagon.
englishMeaning: A ten-sided polygon with ten angles. A geometric shape with ten straight sides and ten vertices. Any flat shape with ten corners and ten edges.

antonyms: Denial, Concealment, Silence, Retraction, Withdrawal
synonyms: Statement, Announcement, Proclamation, Assertion, Pronouncement, Affirmation, Disclosure
sindhiMeaning: رسمي يا واضح بيان يا اعلان، ارادن، شرطن، يا عقيدن جو سرڪاري يا عوامي بيان، ڪنهن شيءِ کي اعلان ڪرڻ يا اعلان ڪرڻ جو عمل، اختيارين کي جمع ڪرايل لکت بيان، حقيقتن يا دعوائن جو رسمي دعويٰ
urduMeaning: رسمی یا واضح بیان یا اعلان، ارادوں، شرائط، یا عقائد کا سرکاری یا عوامی بیان، کسی چیز کو اعلان کرنے یا اعلان کرنے کا عمل، حکام کو جمع کرایا گیا تحریری بیان، حقائق یا دعووں کا رسمی دعویٰ
englishMeaning: A formal or explicit statement or announcement. An official or public statement of intentions, terms, or beliefs. The act of declaring or proclaiming something. A written statement submitted to authorities. A formal assertion of facts or claims.
examples: The Declaration of Independence was signed in seventeen seventy-six. He made a declaration of his intentions to run for office. Customs requires a declaration of all goods. Her declaration of love surprised everyone.

urduMeaning: بیان کرنے والا، کسی بات کو واضح طور پر بتانے یا اعلان کرنے والا، گرامر میں وہ جملہ جو کوئی حقیقت یا رائے بیان کرے، سوال یا حکم کے بجائے خبر دینے والا، کمپیوٹر میں وہ اندازِ تحریر جس میں نتیجہ بتایا جائے نہ کہ طریقہ، اعلانیہ، توضیحی
antonyms: Interrogative, Imperative, Questioning, Inquiring, Implicit, Vague, Indirect, Uncertain
englishMeaning: Having the form or function of making a statement rather than asking a question or giving a command. Serving to declare, announce, or state something clearly and openly. In grammar, describing a sentence that states a fact or opinion and normally ends with a full stop. In computing, describing a style of programming in which the desired result is described rather than the steps to achieve it. A declarative sentence or statement itself.
synonyms: Assertive, Affirmative, Expository, Stating, Announcing, Explanatory, Positive, Definite, Explicit
sindhiMeaning: بيان ڪندڙ، ڪا ڳالهه چٽيءَ طرح ٻڌائيندڙ يا اعلان ڪندڙ، گرامر ۾ اهو جملو جيڪو ڪا حقيقت يا راءِ بيان ڪري، سوال يا حڪم بجاءِ خبر ڏيندڙ، ڪمپيوٽر ۾ اهو انداز جنهن ۾ نتيجو ٻڌايو وڃي نه ڪي طريقو، اعلانيه، وضاحتي
examples: A declarative sentence always ends with a full stop. The teacher explained the difference between declarative and interrogative forms. His declarative tone left no room for argument. Modern web developers often prefer a declarative style of coding.

synonyms: Announce, State, Proclaim, Assert, Pronounce, Affirm, Reveal, Disclose, Make known
englishMeaning: To announce or state something formally or officially. To make something known publicly or openly. To assert or proclaim with confidence. To state goods or income for tax or customs purposes. To reveal or make evident.
antonyms: Conceal, Hide, Deny, Withhold, Suppress, Keep secret
examples: The president declared a state of emergency. She declared her candidacy for mayor. You must declare all income on your tax return. He declared his love for her in front of everyone.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي رسمي يا سرڪاري طور تي اعلان ڪرڻ يا بيان ڪرڻ، ڪا شيءِ عوامي يا کليل طور تي معلوم ڪرڻ، اعتماد سان دعويٰ ڪرڻ يا اعلان ڪرڻ، ٽيڪس يا ڪسٽم جي مقصدن لاءِ سامان يا آمدني جو بيان ڏيڻ، ظاهر ڪرڻ يا ظاهر ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو رسمی یا سرکاری طور پر اعلان کرنا یا بیان کرنا، کوئی چیز عوامی یا کھلے طور پر معلوم کرنا، اعتماد کے ساتھ دعویٰ کرنا یا اعلان کرنا، ٹیکس یا کسٹم کے مقاصد کے لیے سامان یا آمدنی کا بیان دینا، ظاہر کرنا یا واضح کرنا

englishMeaning: To state publicly that one is opposed to something or someone. To announce one's opposition to a plan, policy, decision, or candidate. To take a clear public stand rejecting an idea or course of action. To speak out openly in criticism of something.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز یا شخص کے خلاف کھلے عام اعلان کرنا، مخالفت کا اظہار کرنا، کسی منصوبے یا پالیسی کو عوامی طور پر مسترد کرنا، علانیہ مخالفت میں کھڑا ہونا، خلاف آواز اٹھانا
examples: Several members declared against the new tax proposal. The union declared against the management's decision. She declared against the war in a powerful speech. Two senior leaders have already declared against the bill.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ يا ماڻهوءَ جي خلاف کليل طور تي اعلان ڪرڻ، مخالفت جو اظهار ڪرڻ، ڪنهن منصوبي يا پاليسيءَ کي عام طور تي رد ڪرڻ، ظاهر ظهور مخالفت ۾ بيهڻ، خلاف آواز اٿارڻ
synonyms: Oppose, Object to, Denounce, Reject, Protest against, Condemn, Resist, Speak out against
antonyms: Declare for, Support, Endorse, Approve, Back, Favor, Advocate, Champion

examples: The governor declared for the reform package yesterday. Most of the delegates declared for the younger candidate. He finally declared for his old political party. The court declared for the plaintiff after a long hearing.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن جي حمايت جو کليل اعلان ڪرڻ، ڪنهن اميدوار، پارٽي يا پاليسيءَ جي طرفداري ڪرڻ، ڪنهن هڪ طرف جو ساٿ ڏيڻ جو اعلان ڪرڻ، رسمي طور تي ڪنهن جي حق ۾ فيصلو ڪرڻ، حمايت ۾ بيهڻ
synonyms: Support, Endorse, Back, Favor, Champion, Advocate, Side with, Approve
englishMeaning: To state publicly that one supports someone or something. To announce one's backing for a candidate, party, policy, or cause. To formally choose a side or option in a contest or debate. In sport, to announce an intention to take part or to end an innings.
urduMeaning: کسی کی حمایت کا کھلا اعلان کرنا، کسی امیدوار، جماعت یا پالیسی کی طرفداری کرنا، کسی ایک فریق کا ساتھ دینے کا اعلان کرنا، باقاعدہ طور پر کسی کے حق میں فیصلہ کرنا، حمایت میں کھڑا ہونا
antonyms: Declare against, Oppose, Reject, Denounce, Resist, Disapprove, Abandon, Condemn

urduMeaning: رسمی یا سرکاری طور پر معلوم کیا گیا، کھلے اور عوامی طور پر اعلان یا بیان کیا گیا، کھلے طور پر تسلیم یا قبول کیا گیا، اعلان یا دعویٰ کیا گیا ہے، سرکاری طور پر تسلیم شدہ یا اعلان شدہ
sindhiMeaning: رسمي يا سرڪاري طور تي معلوم ڪيو ويو، کليل ۽ عوامي طور تي اعلان يا بيان ڪيو ويو، کليل طور تي تسليم يا قبول ڪيو ويو، اعلان يا دعوي ڪيو ويو آهي، سرڪاري طور تي تسليم ٿيل يا اعلان ٿيل
examples: The government declared a state of emergency. She was declared the winner of the competition. He declared his assets as required by law. War was declared after the attack.
antonyms: Undeclared, Secret, Hidden, Concealed, Unannounced, Private, Withheld
synonyms: Announced, Stated, Proclaimed, Asserted, Pronounced, Affirmed, Made known, Public
englishMeaning: Made known formally or officially. Announced or stated openly and publicly. Acknowledged or admitted openly. Having been proclaimed or asserted. Officially recognized or announced.

sindhiMeaning: بي وس, بچاءُ کان محروم, بي هٿيار, ڪمزور ۽ حملي لاءِ کليل, لاچار
examples: The village was left defenseless after the troops withdrew. A newborn animal is completely defenseless. He felt defenseless against so many accusations. Defenseless civilians suffered the most in the conflict.
antonyms: Protected, Defended, Armed, Secure, Guarded, Invulnerable, Strong
urduMeaning: بے بس, دفاع سے محرومً, بے ہتھیار, کمزور اور حملے کے لیے کھلا, لاچار
synonyms: Helpless, Vulnerable, Unprotected, Exposed, Powerless, Weak, Unarmed
englishMeaning: Without protection or the means of defending oneself. Weak and open to attack or harm. Unable to resist criticism, danger, or force. Helpless and vulnerable.

urduMeaning: جنگلات کاٹ کر صاف کرنا, درخت کاٹنا, زمین کو درختوں سے خالی کرنا, جنگل ختم کرنا
examples: Companies continue to deforest the hillsides for timber. Farmers deforest land to grow more crops. It is illegal to deforest protected reserves. Once you deforest a slope, erosion soon follows.
antonyms: Afforest, Reforest, Plant, Preserve, Conserve, Replant
synonyms: Clear, Log, Cut down, Strip, Denude, Fell trees, Clear-cut
englishMeaning: To clear an area of its trees and forest cover. To cut down forests, especially on a large scale. To strip land of woodland for farming, mining, or building. To remove natural vegetation from a region.
sindhiMeaning: ٻيلن کي ڪٽي صاف ڪرڻ, وڻ ڪٽڻ, زمين کي وڻن کان خالي ڪرڻ, جهنگ ختم ڪرڻ

englishMeaning: The large-scale cutting down or clearing of forests. The permanent removal of tree cover from an area. A major environmental problem contributing to climate change and soil erosion. The loss of woodland caused by human activity.
examples: Deforestation is destroying habitats across the region. Heavy deforestation has increased the risk of floods. The report links deforestation with rising temperatures. Laws were passed to slow deforestation in the north.
antonyms: Afforestation, Reforestation, Conservation, Planting, Preservation
sindhiMeaning: ٻيلن جو ڪٽجڻ, وڏي پيماني تي وڻن جي ڪٽ, جهنگلن جي تباهي, وڻن جي خاتمي جو عمل
synonyms: Forest clearance, Logging, Tree felling, Denudation, Land clearing
urduMeaning: جنگلات کی کٹائی, بڑے پیمانے پر درختوں کا کاٹنا, جنگلات کی تباہی, درختوں کے خاتمے کا عمل

englishMeaning: To spoil the natural shape or form of something. To become misshapen or distorted. To change the appearance of something for the worse. In physics, to alter the shape of a material under stress.
sindhiMeaning: شڪل بگاڙڻ, بي صورت ڪرڻ, ٽيڙهو ميڙهو ڪرڻ, دٻاءُ سبب صورت بدلجڻ, خراب ڪرڻ
examples: Heat can deform plastic pipes very quickly. The disease began to deform his fingers. Heavy loads deform the metal beams over time. Rough handling deformed the wheel of the bicycle.
urduMeaning: شکل بگاڑنا, بے صورت کرنا, ٹیڑھا کرنا, دباؤ سے صورت بدل جانا, خراب کرنا
synonyms: Distort, Disfigure, Misshape, Warp, Bend, Twist, Mar, Buckle
antonyms: Shape, Form, Restore, Straighten, Perfect, Repair, Preserve
Restoration, Perfection, Symmetry, Repair, Preservation
urduMeaning: شکل کا بگڑنا, بے صورتی, دباؤ سے شکل کی تبدیلی, ٹیڑھا پن, خرابی
sindhiMeaning: شڪل جو بگڙجڻ, بي صورتي, دٻاءُ سبب صورت جي تبديلي, ٽيڙهه, خرابي
synonyms: Distortion, Disfigurement, Warping, Malformation, Contortion, Buckling
englishMeaning: The action of changing or spoiling the shape of something. A change in shape or size caused by applied force. The condition of being distorted or misshapen. A harmful alteration of an original form or structure.
examples: Engineers measured the deformation of the steel beam. Deformation of the tyre showed it was overloaded. The illness caused a slight deformation of the bone. Heat treatment reduces deformation in the mould.
The tree grew deformed because of constant wind. He was born with a deformed left foot. Fire left the metal frame badly deformed. Deformed fruit is often sold at a lower price.
englishMeaning: Having an abnormal or distorted shape. Spoiled in form or appearance. Twisted or misshapen as a result of injury, disease, or pressure. Not conforming to the normal or expected structure.
urduMeaning: بگڑا ہوا, بے صورت, ٹیڑھا میڑھا, بیماری یا چوٹ سے شکل خراب, ناقص شکل والا
synonyms: Misshapen, Distorted, Disfigured, Malformed, Twisted, Warped, Crooked
sindhiMeaning: بگڙيل, بي صورت, ٽيڙهو ميڙهو, بيماري يا زخم سبب شڪل خراب, ناقص شڪل وارو
antonyms: Perfect, Shapely, Normal, Symmetrical, Well-formed, Straight

sindhiMeaning: دوکو ڏئي ڪنهن جو مال يا پئسو کسڻ، فريب سان ڪنهن کي نقصان پهچائڻ، ٺڳي ڪرڻ، ڪوڙ ۽ جعلسازيءَ ذريعي فائدو حاصل ڪرڻ، ڪنهن کي سندس حق کان محروم ڪرڻ
examples: He was jailed for trying to defraud the company of millions. They used fake invoices to defraud the government. She was accused of defrauding elderly customers. The scheme was designed to defraud investors.
urduMeaning: دھوکہ دے کر کسی کا مال یا رقم ہتھیا لینا، فریب سے کسی کو نقصان پہنچانا، ٹھگنا، جھوٹ اور جعل سازی کے ذریعے فائدہ حاصل کرنا، کسی کو اس کے حق سے محروم کر دینا
englishMeaning: To illegally take money or property from someone by deception. To cheat a person or organisation out of something that belongs to them. To obtain a benefit dishonestly by using tricks, lies, or false documents. To deprive someone of a right or possession through fraud.
synonyms: Cheat, Swindle, Deceive, Con, Dupe, Embezzle, Trick, Hoodwink, Fleece
antonyms: Reimburse, Compensate, Repay, Protect, Safeguard, Be honest, Restore

synonyms: Clean, Wash, Cleanse, Scour, Wipe, Purify, Defat
antonyms: Grease, Oil, Lubricate, Soil, Contaminate
examples: Degrease the pan before adding fresh oil. The mechanic degreased the engine parts thoroughly. You must degrease the metal before painting it. Skim the stock to degrease the soup.
sindhiMeaning: چڪنائي هٽائڻ, تيل يا گندگي صاف ڪرڻ, ڪنهن شيءِ تان گريس لاهڻ
englishMeaning: To remove grease, oil or fat from something. To clean a surface, machine or dish of oily residue.
urduMeaning: چکنائی دور کرنا, تیل یا گریس صاف کرنا, کسی چیز سے روغنی مادہ ہٹانا

sindhiMeaning: درجو, گرمي پد يا زاويي جي ماپ, يونيورسٽيءَ جي سند, مقدار يا حد, درجه بندي جو مرحلو
urduMeaning: درجہ, درجۂ حرارت یا زاویے کی اکائی, جامعہ کی سند یا ڈگری, مقدار یا حد, درجہ بندی کا مرحلہ
examples: Water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius. She has a degree in civil engineering. There is a high degree of risk in this plan. A triangle's angles add up to one hundred and eighty degrees.
englishMeaning: A unit for measuring temperature or angles. An academic qualification awarded by a university. The amount, level or extent of something. A stage in a scale or series, as in comparison of adjectives.
antonyms: Whole, Totality, Absence, Nil, Insignificance
synonyms: Level, Extent, Grade, Measure, Qualification, Stage, Rank, Amount

englishMeaning: A type of raw cane sugar with large golden-brown crystals and a light molasses flavor. Natural brown sugar originally from the Demerara region of Guyana. A minimally processed sugar that retains some natural molasses.
urduMeaning: خام گنے کی چینی کی ایک قسم جس میں بڑے سنہرے بھورے کرسٹل اور ہلکا گڑ کا ذائقہ ہو، قدرتی بھوری چینی جو اصل میں گیانا کے ڈیمرارا علاقے سے ہے، کم پروسیسڈ چینی جو کچھ قدرتی گڑ برقرار رکھتی ہے

synonyms: Gastrointestinal system, GI tract, Alimentary canal, Gut system, Digestive tract

sindhiMeaning: ڊائريڪٽر يا هدايتڪاري سان لاڳاپيل، اداري جي انتظام يا قيادت سان تعلق رکندڙ، فلم يا ٿييٽر ۾ ڊائريڪٽر جي ڪم يا انداز سان جڙيل

urduMeaning: اختلاف کرنا، مختلف رائے رکھنا، مطابقت نہ رکھنا، بحث یا جھگڑا کرنا، صحت پر ناسازگار اثر ڈالنا
examples: I completely disagree with your conclusion. The two reports disagree on the number of victims. They disagreed about the best route to take. Spicy food seems to disagree with him.
synonyms: Differ, Dissent, Object, Oppose, Contradict, Conflict, Quarrel, Dispute
englishMeaning: To have a different opinion from someone else. To fail to correspond or match with other facts or figures. To argue or quarrel about something. To have a bad effect on someone, especially food on the stomach.
antonyms: Agree, Concur, Accept, Approve, Consent, Correspond, Harmonize
sindhiMeaning: اختلاف ڪرڻ، مختلف راءِ رکڻ، ميل نه کائڻ، بحث يا جهڳڙو ڪرڻ، طبيعت تي ناسازگار اثر ڪرڻ

antonyms: Claim, Acknowledge, Accept, Admit, Affirm, Avow, Embrace, Recognize
synonyms: Deny, Disavow, Reject, Repudiate, Renounce, Disown, Refuse, Refute, Decline
englishMeaning: To deny or refuse to acknowledge any connection with, responsibility for, or knowledge of something. To renounce a claim or right to something. To state that one is not responsible for or associated with something. To reject or repudiate formally.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز سے کسی بھی تعلق، ذمہ داری، یا علم کو رد کرنا یا تسلیم کرنے سے انکار کرنا، کسی چیز پر دعوے یا حق سے دستبردار ہونا، بیان کرنا کہ کوئی کسی چیز کا ذمہ دار یا اس سے منسلک نہیں ہے، رسمی طور پر رد یا انکار کرنا
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ سان ڪنهن به تعلق، ذميواري، يا ڄاڻ کي رد ڪرڻ يا تسليم ڪرڻ کان انڪار ڪرڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ تي دعويٰ يا حق کان دستبردار ٿيڻ، بيان ڪرڻ ته ڪو ڪنهن شيءِ جو ذميوار يا ان سان لاڳاپيل نه آهي، رسمي طور تي رد يا انڪار ڪرڻ
examples: The company disclaimed any responsibility for the accident. He quickly disclaimed knowledge of the illegal activities. The website contains a disclaimer of liability. She disclaimed all interest in the inheritance.

synonyms: Reveal, Expose, Divulge, Unveil, Announce, Declare, Publish, Make known, Tell
antonyms: Conceal, Hide, Suppress, Withhold, Cover up, Keep secret, Obscure
englishMeaning: To make secret or new information known or public. To reveal or uncover something previously hidden or unknown. To allow something to be seen or known. To provide information that was previously kept confidential.
examples: The company refused to disclose its financial records. He disclosed the truth about what happened that night. The document discloses important information about the project. She was reluctant to disclose personal details.
urduMeaning: خفیہ یا نئی معلومات کو معلوم یا عوامی کرنا، پہلے چھپی ہوئی یا نامعلوم چیز کو ظاہر یا بے نقاب کرنا، کسی چیز کو دیکھنے یا معلوم ہونے کی اجازت دینا، وہ معلومات فراہم کرنا جو پہلے رازداری میں رکھی گئی تھی
sindhiMeaning: ڳجهي يا نئين معلومات کي معلوم يا عوامي ڪرڻ، اڳ ۾ لڪيل يا نامعلوم شيءِ کي ظاهر يا بي نقاب ڪرڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي ڏسڻ يا معلوم ٿيڻ جي اجازت ڏيڻ، اها معلومات فراهم ڪرڻ جيڪا اڳ ۾ رازداري ۾ رکيل هئي

examples: Full disclosure of financial information is required by law. The disclosure of confidential documents caused controversy. Companies must make proper disclosure to shareholders. The witness made important disclosures during the trial.
sindhiMeaning: نئين يا ڳجهي معلومات کي معلوم يا عوامي ڪرڻ جو عمل، اڳ ۾ لڪيل حقيقتن يا تفصيلن جو انڪشاف، اها معلومات جيڪا ظاهر يا ظاهر ڪئي وئي آهي، ڪجهه معلومات ظاهر ڪرڻ جي قانوني ذميواري، خاص ڪري ڪاروباري يا مالي حوالن ۾
englishMeaning: The action of making new or secret information known or public. The revelation of previously hidden facts or details. Information that is disclosed or revealed. A legal obligation to reveal certain information, especially in business or financial contexts.
antonyms: Concealment, Hiding, Secrecy, Suppression, Cover-up, Withholding, Non-disclosure
urduMeaning: نئی یا خفیہ معلومات کو معلوم یا عوامی کرنے کا عمل، پہلے چھپی ہوئی حقیقتوں یا تفصیلات کا انکشاف، وہ معلومات جو ظاہر یا افشاء کی گئی ہو، کچھ معلومات ظاہر کرنے کی قانونی ذمہ داری، خاص طور پر کاروباری یا مالیاتی حوالوں میں
synonyms: Revelation, Exposure, Announcement, Declaration, Divulgence, Confession, Publication, Admission

antonyms: Real find, Genuine discovery, Breakthrough, Valuable finding, Success
synonyms: False discovery, Wild goose chase, Illusion, Hoax, Delusion, Empty find, Fiasco
urduMeaning: ایسی دریافت کرنا جو آخرکار بے کار یا جھوٹی نکلے، ایسی چیز پانا جو اہم لگے مگر خیالی ثابت ہو، الجھا ہوا اور بے فائدہ معاملہ سامنے لانا
englishMeaning: To make a discovery that turns out to be worthless or false. To find something that seems important but proves imaginary. To uncover a confusing and useless muddle.
examples: The inspector thought he had a clue but discovered a mare's nest. Their long research only discovered a mare's nest. He boasted of a great find and discovered a mare's nest. The rumour led the police to discover a mare's nest.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي ڳولا ڪرڻ جيڪا آخر ۾ بيڪار يا ڪوڙي نڪري، اهڙي شيءِ لهڻ جيڪا اهم لڳي پر خيالي ثابت ٿئي، مونجهاري ۽ بي فائدي معاملي کي ظاهر ڪرڻ

urduMeaning: احتیاط ہی اصل بہادری ہے، سمجھ داری بے جا جوش سے بہتر ہے، غیر ضروری خطرے سے بچنا دانش مندی ہے، کبھی پیچھے ہٹ جانا ہی حقیقی حوصلہ ہے
antonyms: Recklessness, Rashness, Foolhardiness, Impulsiveness, Bravado
synonyms: Better safe than sorry, Prudence, Caution, Wisdom, Restraint
word: Discretion is the better part of valour
englishMeaning: It is wiser to be cautious than to take unnecessary risks. Caution and good judgment are more valuable than reckless bravery. Avoiding danger sensibly is a form of true courage. Knowing when not to fight shows real wisdom.
sindhiMeaning: بي احتياطي کان بچڻ ئي اصل بهادري آهي، سمجهه ۽ احتياط جوش کان بهتر آهي، غير ضروري خطري کان پاسو ڪرڻ داناڻو عمل آهي، ڪڏهن پوئتي هٽڻ ئي حقيقي همت آهي
examples: He walked away from the argument, believing discretion is the better part of valour. Rather than climb in the storm, they decided discretion is the better part of valour. The captain retreated, knowing discretion is the better part of valour. She kept quiet in the meeting because discretion is the better part of valour.

Heart disease is preventable through lifestyle changes. The disease spread rapidly through the community. Doctors are searching for a cure for this disease. Early detection of disease improves treatment outcomes.
englishMeaning: A disorder of structure or function in a living organism that produces specific symptoms. An illness or sickness affecting the body or mind. A harmful condition that affects normal functioning. A particular quality or disposition regarded as adversely affecting a person or group.
urduMeaning: جاندار میں ساخت یا کام کی خرابی جو مخصوص علامات پیدا کرے، بیماری یا علالت جو جسم یا دماغ کو متاثر کرے، ایک نقصان دہ حالت جو عام کام کو متاثر کرے، کوئی خاص خوبی یا رویہ جو کسی فرد یا گروپ کو منفی طور پر متاثر کرے
synonyms: Illness, Sickness, Ailment, Disorder, Condition, Malady, Affliction, Infection
sindhiMeaning: جاندار ۾ ساخت يا ڪم جي خرابي جيڪا مخصوص علامتون پيدا ڪري، بيماري يا علالت جيڪا جسم يا دماغ کي متاثر ڪري، هڪ نقصانڪار حالت جيڪا عام ڪم کي متاثر ڪري، ڪا خاص خوبي يا رويو جيڪو ڪنهن فرد يا گروپ کي منفي طور متاثر ڪري
antonyms: Health, Wellness, Fitness, Well-being, Vigor, Soundness

urduMeaning: دلچسپی کی کمی, بے پروائی, لاتعلقی, بے طرفی, ذاتی مفاد سے آزادی, غیر جانبداری
sindhiMeaning: دلچسپي جي کوٽ, بي پرواهي, لاتعلقي, بي طرفي, ذاتي فائدي کان آزاد هجڻ, غير جانبداري
examples: His disinterest in the project was obvious from the very first meeting. A judge must decide every case with complete disinterest. She spoke about the offer with polite disinterest. Public disinterest caused the campaign to fail quietly.
englishMeaning: A lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern about something. Impartiality; freedom from bias or personal advantage in a matter. The state of being unaffected by the possible gain or loss involved. To cause someone to lose interest in something.
antonyms: Interest, Enthusiasm, Concern, Eagerness, Bias, Partiality, Curiosity, Involvement
synonyms: Indifference, Apathy, Unconcern, Detachment, Impartiality, Neutrality, Objectivity, Aloofness

englishMeaning: The act of hiding one's true feelings, thoughts, or intentions. Deliberate concealment carried out by pretence. Deceit practised by pretending that something is not the case.
synonyms: Pretence, Deceit, Concealment, Hypocrisy, Duplicity, Feigning
antonyms: Honesty, Frankness, Candour, Openness, Sincerity, Transparency
urduMeaning: اپنے حقیقی جذبات یا ارادے چھپانا، دکھاوے کے ذریعے حقیقت پوشیدہ رکھنا، فریب کے لیے اصل بات چھپانا
sindhiMeaning: پنهنجا سچا جذبا يا ارادا لڪائڻ، ٺلهي ڏيک ذريعي حقيقت لڪائڻ، دوکو ڏيڻ لاءِ اصل ڳالهه ڍڪڻ
examples: His calm face was pure dissimulation; inside he was furious. Politics often rewards dissimulation more than honesty. She saw through his dissimulation at once. Years of dissimulation had left him unable to speak plainly.

He wasted his fortune on a dissolute lifestyle. The novel describes the dissolute habits of the young lord. Years of dissolute living ruined his health. She left the city to escape its dissolute society.
englishMeaning: Living an immoral life devoted to pleasure and self-indulgence. Lacking moral restraint or discipline in behaviour. Given to drinking, gambling, or other excesses.
sindhiMeaning: عياش ۽ بدچلن، عيش عشرت ۾ ٻڏل زندگي گذاريندڙ، اخلاقي ضابطي کان آجو، شراب ۽ جوا جهڙين براين ۾ ورتل
synonyms: Debauched, Immoral, Licentious, Profligate, Depraved, Decadent, Wanton, Corrupt
antonyms: Moral, Virtuous, Upright, Chaste, Disciplined, Abstemious, Pure, Restrained
urduMeaning: عیاش اور بدچلن، عیش و عشرت میں ڈوبی زندگی گزارنے والا، اخلاقی ضبط سے عاری، شراب اور جوے جیسی برائیوں میں مبتلا

antonyms: Proximal, Central, Near, Inner, Medial
sindhiMeaning: جسم جي مرڪز کان پري واقع، ڪنهن جوڙ يا شروعاتي نقطي کان ڏور، عضوي جي ٻاهرين ڇيڙي وارو، پرئين پاسي واقع
synonyms: Outer, Peripheral, Far, Terminal, Remote, Outlying
englishMeaning: Situated away from the centre of the body or from the point of attachment. Farther from the origin or main part of a structure. Used in anatomy to describe the outer end of a limb or bone. Located at the far end of something.
urduMeaning: جسم کے مرکز سے دور واقع، کسی جوڑ یا ابتدائی نقطے سے دور، عضو کے بیرونی سرے والا، پرلی جانب واقع
examples: The distal end of the bone was fractured in the accident. Doctors examined the distal joints of her fingers. Blood flow to the distal tissues was carefully monitored. The distal part of the tube must be kept sterile.

englishMeaning: The amount of space between two points, places, or objects. A long space between things. The state of being far apart in time, space, or relationship. To keep oneself apart or uninvolved.
synonyms: Space, Gap, Interval, Span, Range, Separation, Length, Remoteness
urduMeaning: دو مقامات کے درمیان فاصلہ، دوری، لمبا وقفہ، وقت یا تعلق کے لحاظ سے دور ہونے کی حالت، خود کو الگ رکھنا
antonyms: Closeness, Proximity, Nearness, Adjacency, Contact, Intimacy
sindhiMeaning: ٻن نقطن جي وچ ۾ فاصلو، مفاصلو، ڊگهو وٿي، وقت يا تعلق جي لحاظ کان پري هجڻ جي حالت، پاڻ کي پري رکڻ
examples: The distance between the two cities is about fifty kilometres. She kept her distance from the arguing group. He tried to distance himself from the controversy. From this distance, the writing is hard to read.

sindhiMeaning: پري وارو، دور دراز، وقت يا فاصلي جي لحاظ کان پري، پري جو مائٽ، سرد مهر يا بي رخ رويو، مبهم يا هلڪو
examples: They live in a distant village near the mountains. He is a distant cousin whom I rarely meet. Her manner was polite but distant throughout the meeting. A distant sound of music came from the garden.
urduMeaning: دور کا، دور دراز، وقت یا فاصلے کے لحاظ سے دور، دور کا رشتہ دار، سرد مہر یا بے رخ رویہ، مبہم یا ہلکا
antonyms: Near, Close, Nearby, Friendly, Warm, Adjacent, Intimate
synonyms: Faraway, Remote, Far-off, Aloof, Detached, Reserved, Faint, Outlying
englishMeaning: Far away in space or time. Not closely related in family or connection. Cold and unfriendly in manner. Faint or vague, as in a sound or memory.
In a way that is far away in space or time. In a manner that shows little warmth or friendliness. Vaguely or faintly, as in a memory or sound. In a way that indicates a remote family connection.
sindhiMeaning: پري کان، فاصلي سان، سرد مهريءَ سان، بي رخيءَ سان، مبهم يا هلڪي انداز ۾، پري جي مٽي مائٽيءَ جي لحاظ کان
examples: He smiled distantly and walked away without speaking. Thunder rumbled distantly across the valley. She is distantly related to the royal family. He distantly remembered visiting the town as a child.
urduMeaning: دور سے، فاصلے کے ساتھ، سرد مہری سے، بے رخی سے، مبہم یا ہلکے انداز میں، دور کی رشتہ داری کے لحاظ سے
antonyms: Closely, Warmly, Intimately, Nearby, Clearly, Directly
synonyms: Remotely, Faintly, Vaguely, Coldly, Aloofly, Slightly, Far off

antonyms: Converge, Meet, Merge, Unite, Agree, Join, Coincide, Conform
englishMeaning: To separate and go in different directions from a common point. To differ or become different from something else. To depart from an expected course, standard, or plan. In mathematics, to fail to approach a finite limit.
synonyms: Separate, Branch off, Differ, Deviate, Split, Part, Digress, Vary
urduMeaning: ایک نقطے سے الگ ہو کر مختلف سمتوں میں جانا، جدا ہونا، کسی دوسرے سے مختلف ہو جانا، مقررہ راستے یا معیار سے ہٹ جانا، ریاضی میں کسی حد تک نہ پہنچنا
sindhiMeaning: هڪ نقطي کان جدا ٿي مختلف طرفن ڏانهن وڃڻ، الڳ ٿيڻ، ڪنهن ٻئي کان مختلف ٿيڻ، مقرر رستي يا معيار کان هٽي وڃڻ، رياضيءَ ۾ ڪنهن حد ڏانهن نه پهچڻ
examples: The two roads diverge just beyond the bridge. Their opinions began to diverge after the first meeting. The film diverges from the original novel in several ways. The series diverges and has no finite sum.

antonyms: Similar, Uniform, Identical, Homogeneous, Alike, Same, Monotonous
sindhiMeaning: مختلف قسمن وارو، رنگا رنگ، هڪٻئي کان مختلف، ڀانت ڀانت جو، ڪيترن ثقافتن، پس منظرن يا رايُن تي مشتمل، متنوع
englishMeaning: Showing a great deal of variety and difference. Made up of people or things of many different kinds. Differing from one another in nature, form, or quality. Including many different cultures, backgrounds, or opinions.
synonyms: Varied, Assorted, Different, Mixed, Heterogeneous, Multiple, Manifold, Distinct
urduMeaning: مختلف اقسام والا، رنگا رنگ، ایک دوسرے سے مختلف، طرح طرح کا، کئی ثقافتوں، پس منظروں یا آراء پر مشتمل، متنوع
examples: The city has a diverse and welcoming population. She has diverse interests, from music to astronomy. The company hires people from diverse backgrounds. Pakistan is home to diverse languages and cultures.

synonyms: Variously, Differently, Multifariously, Distinctly, Separately, Heterogeneously
urduMeaning: مختلف طریقوں سے، طرح طرح کے انداز میں، گوناگوں انداز میں، کئی مختلف صورتوں میں، مختلف زاویوں سے
sindhiMeaning: مختلف طريقن سان، ڀانت ڀانت جي انداز ۾، گوناگون نموني، ڪيترن مختلف صورتن ۾، مختلف نقطن نظر کان
antonyms: Uniformly, Identically, Similarly, Equally, Homogeneously, Alike
examples: The poem has been diversely interpreted by critics. The species is diversely distributed across the continent. Their opinions were diversely expressed during the debate. Resources are diversely allocated among the departments.
englishMeaning: In a varied manner, showing many differences. In several different ways or forms. With variety in kind, quality, or character. From many different points of view or backgrounds.

sindhiMeaning: ٻارهن رخن ۽ ٻارهن ڪنڊن وارو هڪ شڪل، ٻارهه سڌي پاسن ۽ ٻارهه نقطن وارو جيوميٽري شڪل، ٻارهه ڪنڊن ۽ ٻارهه ڪنارن وارو ڪو به برابر شڪل
examples: A regular dodecagon has twelve equal sides and angles. The clock face was designed as a dodecagon. Some architectural domes feature dodecagonal patterns. The decorative window had a dodecagon shape.
urduMeaning: بارہ اضلاع اور بارہ زاویوں والی شکل، بارہ سیدھی اطراف اور بارہ نقاط والی ہندسی شکل، بارہ کونوں اور بارہ کناروں والی کوئی بھی چپٹی شکل
antonyms: Circle, Triangle, Square, Pentagon, Irregular shape
englishMeaning: A twelve-sided polygon with twelve angles. A geometric shape with twelve straight sides and twelve vertices. Any flat shape with twelve corners and twelve edges.
synonyms: Twelve-sided polygon, Dodecagonal shape, Twelve-gon

sindhiMeaning: اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو پاڻ به فائدو نه وٺي ۽ ٻين کي به نه ڏي، خودغرض ۽ حسد ڪندڙ ماڻهو، بيڪار شيءِ به ٻين کي نه ڏيندڙ، ڪينو رکندڙ رويو
antonyms: Generous person, Benefactor, Sharer, Altruist, Giver, Philanthropist
synonyms: Spoilsport, Begrudger, Miser, Selfish person, Killjoy, Obstructionist
urduMeaning: ایسا شخص جو خود بھی فائدہ نہ اٹھائے اور دوسروں کو بھی نہ لینے دے، خود غرض اور حاسد شخص، بے کار چیز بھی دوسروں کو نہ دینے والا، کینہ پرور رویہ
examples: He is a dog in the manger about the empty office upstairs. Don't be a dog in the manger; let the children use the field. Her dog in the manger attitude annoyed the whole team. The neighbour behaved like a dog in the manger over the shared driveway.
englishMeaning: A person who prevents others from having something they cannot use themselves. Someone who selfishly withholds what is of no benefit to them. A spiteful attitude of denying others out of pure meanness.

examples: A dolphin leapt gracefully beside our boat. Dolphins communicate with each other using clicks and whistles. The children were thrilled to watch the dolphins at the marine park. Scientists believe the dolphin is one of the most intelligent animals on earth.
antonyms: Land animal, Predator shark, Terrestrial creature, Reptile
sindhiMeaning: سمنڊ جو هڪ ذهين ٿڻ ڌاري جانور، ڊگهي چهنب ۽ چمڪندڙ جسم وارو مڇيءَ جهڙو جانور، ننڍي قسم جي ويل جيڪا ٽولن ۾ رهندي آهي، سکيا وٺندڙ ۽ ماڻهن سان مانوس سامونڊي جانور، ڊولفن جي شڪل وارو نشان يا علامت
urduMeaning: سمندر کا ایک ذہین دودھ پلانے والا جانور، لمبی چونچ اور چکنے جسم والا مچھلی نما جانور، چھوٹی قسم کی وہیل جو گروہوں میں رہتی ہے، تربیت پذیر اور انسانوں سے مانوس سمندری جانور، ڈولفن کی شکل کا نشان یا علامت
synonyms: Porpoise, Marine mammal, Sea mammal, Cetacean, Delphinid
englishMeaning: A highly intelligent marine mammal with a streamlined body, a beak-like snout, and a blowhole. urduMeaning: ایسا شخص جو عادتاً منفی نتائج اور آفتوں کی پیشین گوئی کرے یا زور دے، کوئی بھی جو مایوسی پھیلائے اور تباہی کی پیشین گوئی کرے، مایوسی پسند جو مسلسل تباہی کی خبردار کرے، تباہی کے نبی کی دوسری اصطلاح
englishMeaning: A person who habitually predicts or emphasizes negative outcomes and disasters. Someone who spreads pessimism and forecasts catastrophe. A pessimist who constantly warns of doom. Another term for prophet of doom.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو عادت طور منفي نتيجن ۽ آفتن جي اڳڪٿي ڪري يا زور ڏئي، ڪو به جيڪو مايوسي پکيڙي ۽ تباهي جي اڳڪٿي ڪري، مايوسي پسند جيڪو مسلسل تباهي جي خبردار ڪري، تباهي جي نبي جو ٻيو اصطلاح
examples: Stop being a doom merchant and look at the positives. The doom merchants predicted economic collapse. Media doom merchants exaggerate every crisis. His reputation as a doom merchant preceded him.

urduMeaning: بالکل ضائع ہو جانا، محنت  پیسہ یا وقت رائیگاں جانا، برباد ہو جانا یا بے نتیجہ رہنا

antonyms: Bright, Light, Fair, Radiant, Luminous, Pale

antonyms: Contents, Letter, Interior, Core, Inside, Nucleus

urduMeaning: فلسفے کی وہ شاخ جو علم  اس کی نوعیت  ذرائع اور حدود کا مطالعہ کرتی ہے، نظریۂ علم، یہ مطالعہ کہ ہم کیسے جانتے ہیں اور عقائد کیسے ثابت ہوتے ہیں، حقیقی علم اور محض گمان کے فرق کا علم، معرفت کا فلسفہ
examples: He wrote his thesis on the epistemology of modern science. Epistemology asks how we can be certain of anything. Their debate turned into a question of epistemology. Western and Eastern epistemology often differ in method.
antonyms: Ignorance, Nescience, Unawareness, Superstition, Guesswork
englishMeaning: The branch of philosophy that studies knowledge, its nature, sources, and limits. The theory of how we know what we know and how beliefs are justified. A particular way of understanding what counts as valid knowledge. The study of the difference between genuine knowledge and mere opinion.
sindhiMeaning: فلسفي جي اها شاخ جيڪا علم  ان جي حقيقت  سرچشمن ۽ حدن جو مطالعو ڪري، علم جو نظريو، ڄاڻ ڪيئن حاصل ٿئي ٿي ان جو مطالعو، سچي علم ۽ رڳي گمان جي وچ ۾ فرق جو علم، معرفت جو فلسفو
synonyms: Theory of knowledge, Philosophy of knowledge, Gnoseology, Cognitive theory
Cognitive, Philosophical, Theoretical, Knowledge-related, Conceptual
englishMeaning: Relating to the branch of philosophy that studies knowledge, belief, and justification. Concerning how we know what we know and the limits of human understanding. Belonging to theories about the nature and sources of knowledge.
antonyms: Practical, Empirical, Unphilosophical, Applied, Intuitive
examples: The debate raised difficult epistemological questions. Her thesis takes an epistemological approach to memory. Scientists rarely discuss the epistemological basis of their methods. The book examines the epistemological limits of observation.
sindhiMeaning: علم جي فلسفي سان لاڳاپيل, ڄاڻ ۽ يقين جي نوعيت بابت, علم حاصل ڪرڻ جي طريقن سان تعلق رکندڙ, نظريه علم سان واسطو رکندڙ
urduMeaning: علم کے فلسفے سے متعلق, معرفت اور یقین کی نوعیت کے بارے میں, علم حاصل کرنے کے طریقوں سے تعلق رکھنے والا, نظریہ علم سے وابستہ

antonyms: Practically, Empirically, Intuitively, Superficially
sindhiMeaning: علم جي نظريي جي لحاظ کان, ڄاڻ حاصل ڪرڻ جي نقطه نظر کان, معرفت جي فلسفي مطابق, علمياتي طور تي
synonyms: Philosophically, Theoretically, Cognitively, Conceptually, In terms of knowledge
urduMeaning: نظریہ علم کے اعتبار سے, معرفت حاصل کرنے کے نقطہ نظر سے, علم کے فلسفے کے مطابق, علمیاتی طور پر
englishMeaning: In a way that relates to the theory of knowledge. From the point of view of how knowledge is acquired and justified. In terms of epistemology or philosophical enquiry into knowing.
examples: Epistemologically, the claim rests on very weak evidence. The two theories differ epistemologically as well as practically. He argued that the method is epistemologically unsound. Epistemologically speaking, certainty is rarely possible.

englishMeaning: The branch of philosophy that studies the nature, origin, and limits of knowledge. The theory of how we come to know things and how beliefs can be justified. A particular set of ideas about what counts as valid knowledge.
antonyms: Ignorance, Superstition, Dogma, Blind belief
synonyms: Theory of knowledge, Philosophy of knowledge, Cognitive theory, Gnoseology
sindhiMeaning: علم جو فلسفو, ڄاڻ جي نوعيت ۽ حدن جو مطالعو, معرفت جو نظريو, ڄاڻ حاصل ڪرڻ جي طريقن جو علم
examples: Epistemology asks how we can be sure of what we believe. He teaches epistemology at the university. Modern epistemology draws heavily on cognitive science. The two thinkers differ sharply in their epistemology.
urduMeaning: علم کا فلسفہ, معرفت کی نوعیت اور حدود کا مطالعہ, نظریہ علم, علم حاصل کرنے کے طریقوں کا مطالعہ

synonyms: Letter, Missive, Message, Dispatch, Communication, Note
sindhiMeaning: هڪ رسمي يا ادبي خط, ڊگهو ۽ سنجيده خط, انجيل ۾ شامل حوارين جا خط, لکيل پيغام
englishMeaning: A formal or literary letter, especially a long one. Any of the letters written by the apostles and included in the New Testament. A written communication in an elegant or old-fashioned style.
urduMeaning: ایک رسمی یا ادبی خط, طویل اور سنجیدہ مکتوب, انجیل میں شامل حواریوں کے خطوط, تحریری پیغام
antonyms: Speech, Conversation, Silence, Reply, Verbal message
examples: He wrote a long epistle to his old teacher. The epistles of Paul are studied in theology classes. Her weekly epistle from abroad delighted the whole family. The novel is written as a series of epistles.

Dracula is a famous epistolary novel. Their epistolary friendship lasted for thirty years. The author chose an epistolary style for the memoir. Scholars study the epistolary habits of eighteenth-century writers.
urduMeaning: خطوط کی شکل میں لکھا گیا, خطوط سے متعلق, ایسا ناول جو خطوط کے ذریعے بیان ہو, مراسلت سے تعلق رکھنے والا
sindhiMeaning: خطن جي صورت ۾ لکيل, خطن سان لاڳاپيل, اهڙو ناول جيڪو خطن جي ذريعي بيان ٿيل هجي, مراسلت سان تعلق رکندڙ
antonyms: Oral, Spoken, Verbal, Conversational, Face-to-face
synonyms: Letter-based, Written, Correspondential, Literary, Textual
englishMeaning: Relating to or written in the form of letters. Describing a novel or work of literature told through the exchange of letters. Concerning correspondence between people.

synonyms: Inscription, Tombstone text, Memorial, Elegy, Tribute, Eulogy, Commemoration, Obituary
antonyms: Introduction, Prologue, Birth announcement, Beginning, Preface
sindhiMeaning: قبر جي پٿر تي لکيل يادگار عبارت، مري ويلن جي ياد ۾ لکيل ننڍڙو شعر يا جملو، ڪنهن ماڻهو يا دور جو مختصر خلاصو ڪندڙ جملو، آخري يادگار لفظ، ڪتبو
englishMeaning: An inscription written on a tombstone in memory of the person buried there. A short text or verse composed to honour someone who has died. Any brief statement that sums up a person, era, or event that has ended. A final commemorative remark.
urduMeaning: قبر کے کتبے پر لکھی گئی یادگاری عبارت، مرحوم کی یاد میں لکھا گیا مختصر شعر یا جملہ، کسی شخص یا دور کا خلاصہ بیان کرنے والا مختصر جملہ، آخری یادگار الفاظ، کتبہ
examples: His epitaph reads simply, “A kind and honest man.” The poet wrote his own epitaph before he died. The closing of the mill served as an epitaph for the town's industry. Visitors stopped to read the weathered epitaph.

synonyms: Title, Nickname, Label, Sobriquet, Appellation, Description, Slur
antonyms: Real name, Praise, Compliment, Formal name
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن جي خاصيت ظاهر ڪندڙ لقب, نالي سان گڏ استعمال ٿيندڙ صفت, تعريفي يا طنزيه خطاب, گاريءَ جهڙو لفظ
englishMeaning: A word or short phrase used to describe a person's most noticeable quality. A descriptive title added to or used instead of a name. An offensive or insulting word aimed at someone.
examples: Alexander earned the epithet the Great. The crowd shouted racial epithets at the players. Poets often use fixed epithets for their heroes. His courage won him the epithet of lionheart.
urduMeaning: کسی کی خاصیت ظاہر کرنے والا لقب, نام کے ساتھ استعمال ہونے والی صفت, تعریفی یا طنزیہ خطاب, گالی نما لفظ
تاریخ کا ایک خاص دور، اہم واقعات سے جڑا زمانہ، مخصوص خصوصیات رکھنے والا طویل عرصہ، کسی نئے دور کا آغاز، ارضیاتی وقت کا حصہ
englishMeaning: A particular period of time in history marked by notable events. A long span of time associated with distinctive characteristics. The beginning of a distinctive period in history. A division of geological time smaller than a period.
examples: The invention of the printing press marked a new epoch in human history. We are living in an epoch of rapid technological change. Geologists study each epoch through layers of rock. That victory opened a fresh epoch for the nation.
sindhiMeaning: تاريخ جو هڪ خاص دور، اهم واقعن سان جڙيل زمانو، ڊگهو عرصو جنهن جون خاص خصوصيتون هجن، ڪنهن نئين دور جي شروعات، ارضياتي وقت جو حصو
antonyms: Moment, Instant, Second, Flash, Present, Timelessness, Blink
synonyms: Era, Age, Period, Time, Aeon, Chapter, Phase, Span, Stage, Milestone
Identical, Same, Even, Uniform, Matching, Equivalent, Peer
sindhiMeaning: برابر، هڪجهڙو، مقدار، ماپ يا قدر ۾ ساڳيو، هڪجهڙا حق ۽ حيثيت رکندڙ، ڪنهن جي برابر هجڻ، ساڳي درجي وارو ماڻهو
antonyms: Unequal, Different, Uneven, Superior, Inferior, Disparate
examples: All citizens are equal before the law. Two plus three equals five. She had an equal share in the business. He has no equal in the field of mathematics.
urduMeaning: برابر، یکساں، مقدار، حجم یا قدر میں ایک جیسا، یکساں حقوق اور حیثیت رکھنے والا، کسی کے برابر ہونا، ہم پلہ شخص
englishMeaning: Being the same in quantity, size, value, or degree. Having the same rights, status, or opportunities. To be the same as something in amount or quality. A person or thing of the same rank or ability as another.

urduMeaning: برابری، مساوات، حقوق اور حیثیت میں یکسانیت، بغیر تعصب کے سب کے ساتھ یکساں سلوک، مقدار یا قدر میں مساوات، ریاضی میں دو قدروں کی برابری
synonyms: Parity, Fairness, Equity, Sameness, Uniformity, Justice, Balance
sindhiMeaning: برابري، مساوات، حقن ۽ حيثيت ۾ هڪجهڙائي، بنا تعصب جي سڀني سان هڪجهڙو سلوڪ، مقدار يا قدر ۾ هڪجهڙائي، رياضي ۾ ٻن قدرن جي برابري
antonyms: Inequality, Discrimination, Bias, Disparity, Injustice, Imbalance
englishMeaning: The state of being equal in rights, status, or opportunities. Fair treatment of all people without discrimination. The condition of being the same in quantity or value. In mathematics, the relation of two expressions having the same value.
examples: The movement fought for equality between men and women. Equality of opportunity is essential in education. The law guarantees equality for every citizen. They demanded equality in pay for the same work.

englishMeaning: To make things equal in size, amount, or status. To remove differences between people or groups. In sport, to score a goal or point that makes the score level. To balance pressure, sound, or force evenly.
examples: The new policy aims to equalize educational opportunities. He scored late to equalize the match. Divers must equalize the pressure in their ears. Taxes were adjusted to equalize incomes.
antonyms: Differentiate, Unbalance, Skew, Distort, Discriminate
urduMeaning: برابر کرنا، حجم، مقدار یا حیثیت میں یکساں بنانا، فرق ختم کرنا، کھیلوں میں برابری کا گول کرنا، دباؤ یا آواز کو متوازن کرنا
sindhiMeaning: برابر ڪرڻ، ماپ، مقدار يا حيثيت ۾ هڪجهڙو بڻائڻ، فرق ختم ڪرڻ، راندين ۾ برابري وارو گول ڪرڻ، دٻاءَ يا آواز کي متوازن ڪرڻ
synonyms: Balance, Level, Even out, Match, Standardize, Regularize

examples: He adjusted the equalizer to improve the bass. Their striker scored the equalizer in the last minute. Education is often called the great equalizer. The engineer installed a digital equalizer in the studio.
antonyms: Divider, Discriminator, Imbalance, Advantage, Handicap
urduMeaning: آواز کی فریکوئنسی کو متوازن کرنے والا آلہ، کھیل میں برابری کرنے والا گول، وہ چیز جو سب کے لیے حالات یکساں بنا دے، فرق ختم کرنے والا ذریعہ
synonyms: Leveller, Balancer, Adjuster, Stabilizer, Tying goal
sindhiMeaning: آواز جي فريڪوئنسي کي متوازن ڪندڙ اوزار، راندين ۾ برابري ڪندڙ گول، اهو شيءِ جيڪو سڀني لاءِ حالتون هڪجهڙيون بڻائي، فرق ختم ڪندڙ ذريعو
englishMeaning: A device that adjusts the balance of sound frequencies. A goal or point that makes the scores level in a game. Something that makes conditions equal for everyone. A person or thing that removes advantage or difference.

examples: The cake was divided equally among the children. Both options are equally attractive. She treats all her students equally. Equally, we must consider the long-term costs.
englishMeaning: To the same extent or degree. In equal parts or amounts. In a fair and even manner. Used to introduce a point of similar importance.
urduMeaning: یکساں حد تک، برابر حصوں میں، انصاف اور برابری کے ساتھ، اسی طرح، اس طرح کہ کوئی فرق نہ رہے
synonyms: Evenly, Uniformly, Alike, Fairly, Identically, Similarly
sindhiMeaning: هڪجهڙي حد تائين، برابر حصن ۾، انصاف ۽ برابريءَ سان، ساڳي طرح، اهڙي طرح جو ڪوبه فرق نه رهي
antonyms: Unequally, Unevenly, Differently, Unfairly, Disproportionately

synonyms: Horsemanship, Horse riding, Riding, Dressage, Show jumping, Equitation
englishMeaning: The art, sport, or practice of horse riding. The skill of riding, driving, or handling horses. A competitive sport that includes dressage, show jumping, and eventing. Activities and disciplines connected with horses and horsemanship.
antonyms: Non-equestrian activity, Walking, Pedestrianism, Motoring
examples: Equestrianism has been part of the Olympic Games for over a century. She developed a lifelong passion for equestrianism as a child. The club promotes equestrianism among young riders. Modern equestrianism demands both skill and patience.
urduMeaning: گھوڑے سواری کا فن یا کھیل, گھوڑوں کو چلانے اور سنبھالنے کی مہارت, گھوڑے سواری کے مقابلے جیسے ڈریسیج اور شو جمپنگ, گھوڑوں سے متعلق تمام سرگرمیاں
sindhiMeaning: گهوڙي سواري جو فن يا کيڏ، گهوڙن کي هلائڻ ۽ سنڀالڻ جي مهارت, گهوڙي سواري جا مقابلا جهڙوڪ ڊريسيج ۽ ڪُڏائڻ, گهوڙن سان لاڳاپيل سڀ سرگرميون

examples: The town is equidistant from both cities. Plant the trees equidistant from one another. Every point on a circle is equidistant from the centre. The offices are equidistant from the main station.
sindhiMeaning: ٻن يا وڌيڪ نقطن کان هڪجهڙي فاصلي تي، هڪجهڙي وٿي تي رکيل، ٻن جڳهين جي بلڪل وچ تي واقع، برابر وقفن سان ترتيب ڏنل

urduMeaning: دو یا زیادہ نقاط سے یکساں فاصلے پر، برابر فاصلے پر رکھا ہوا، دو مقامات کے عین درمیان واقع، مساوی وقفوں سے ترتیب دیا گیا
englishMeaning: Being at an equal distance from two or more points. Placed at the same distance apart from each other. Located centrally between two places. Evenly spaced in position or arrangement.
antonyms: Uneven, Nearer, Farther, Irregular, Unequally spaced

examples: Each angle of an equilateral triangle measures sixty degrees. He drew an equilateral triangle using a compass. The logo is based on an equilateral triangle. An equilateral triangle is also equiangular.
synonyms: Regular triangle, Equal-sided triangle, Symmetrical triangle
englishMeaning: A triangle in which all three sides are of equal length. A triangle whose three angles each measure sixty degrees. A perfectly symmetrical three-sided figure. A regular polygon with three equal sides.
urduMeaning: وہ مثلث جس کے تینوں اضلاع برابر ہوں، جس کے تینوں زاویے ساٹھ درجے ہوں، مکمل متوازن تین اطراف والی شکل، تین برابر اضلاع والا باقاعدہ شکل
sindhiMeaning: اهو ٽڪنڊو جنهن جا ٽيئي پاسا برابر هجن، جنهن جون ٽيئي ڪنڊون سٺ درجا هجن، مڪمل متوازن ٽن پاسن واري شڪل، ٽن برابر پاسن وارو باقاعده شڪل

synonyms: Balance, Stability, Steadiness, Poise, Symmetry, Harmony
antonyms: Imbalance, Instability, Disorder, Turmoil, Disequilibrium
urduMeaning: توازن کی حالت، مخالف قوتوں کی برابری، جسمانی استحکام کی حالت، ذہنی سکون اور اطمینان، کیمیا یا معاشیات میں مساوی حالت
examples: The scales settled into perfect equilibrium. She regained her emotional equilibrium after the news. Supply and demand reached equilibrium in the market. The chemical reaction finally reached equilibrium.
englishMeaning: A state of balance between opposing forces or influences. A condition of physical stability where forces cancel out. Calmness and balance of mind or emotions. In chemistry or economics, a state where opposing rates or forces are equal.
sindhiMeaning: توازن جي حالت، مخالف قوتن جي برابري، جسماني استحڪام جي حالت، ذهني سڪون ۽ اطمينان، ڪيميا يا معاشيات ۾ برابريءَ واري حالت

examples: The vet specialises in equine medicine. She has a slightly equine profile. Equine influenza spread quickly through the stables. The farm cares for more than fifty equines.
englishMeaning: Relating to or resembling horses. Belonging to the horse family. A horse or a member of the horse family. Typical of the features or behaviour of a horse.
urduMeaning: گھوڑے سے متعلق یا گھوڑے جیسا, گھوڑوں کے خاندان سے تعلق رکھنے والا, گھوڑا یا اس کی نسل کا جانور, گھوڑے کی خصوصیات رکھنے والا
synonyms: Horsey, Horselike, Horse, Caballine
antonyms: Bovine, Canine, Feline, Human
sindhiMeaning: گهوڙي سان لاڳاپيل يا گهوڙي جهڙو, گهوڙي جي نسل سان تعلق رکندڙ, گهوڙو يا گهوڙي جي خاندان جو ڪو جانور, گهوڙي جي خاصيتن وارو

englishMeaning: Relating to the equinox, when day and night are of equal length. Occurring at or near the time of an equinox. Relating to the celestial equator. Happening at regular equinox periods, such as equinoctial gales.
examples: Equinoctial storms often batter the coast in late September. The equinoctial line divides the celestial sphere into two halves. Farmers plan sowing around the equinoctial period. He recorded the equinoctial sunrise from the hilltop.
antonyms: Solstitial, Polar, Irregular, Non-seasonal
sindhiMeaning: ايڪوينڪس (سمرات) سان لاڳاپيل، جڏهن ڏينهن ۽ رات برابر هوندا آهن, سمرات جي وقت ٿيندڙ, آسماني خط استوا سان لاڳاپيل, سمرات وقت لڳندڙ طوفانن سان لاڳاپيل
synonyms: Equatorial, Seasonal, Solstitial (related), Astronomical
urduMeaning: اعتدالِ شب و روز سے متعلق، جب دن اور رات برابر ہوتے ہیں, اعتدالین کے وقت پیش آنے والا, آسمانی خطِ استوا سے متعلق, اعتدالین کے موسمی طوفانوں سے متعلق

synonyms: Balance, Equilibrium, Stability, Counterbalance, Symmetry, Poise
englishMeaning: A state of balance between opposing forces or interests. Equal distribution of weight or influence. A counterbalance that keeps something steady. To balance or hold something in equilibrium.
urduMeaning: مخالف قوتوں کے درمیان توازن کی حالت، وزن یا اثر کی برابر تقسیم، کسی چیز کو متوازن رکھنے والا سہارا، توازن میں رکھنا
antonyms: Imbalance, Instability, Disequilibrium, Unsteadiness, Bias
examples: The two arguments were held in perfect equipoise. She maintained an emotional equipoise during the crisis. Political power rested in a delicate equipoise. The weights equipoise each other on the scale.
sindhiMeaning: مخالف قوتن جي وچ ۾ توازن جي حالت، وزن يا اثر جي برابر ورهاست، ڪنهن شيءِ کي متوازن رکندڙ سهارو، توازن ۾ رکڻ

antonyms: Unfairly, Unjustly, Partially, Unequally, Arbitrarily
sindhiMeaning: انصاف ۽ برابريءَ سان، غيرجانبدارانه نموني، سڀني سان مناسب ۽ منصفانه سلوڪ ڪندي، بنا طرفداري جي ورهاست ڪندي
urduMeaning: انصاف اور برابری کے ساتھ، غیر جانبدارانہ طور پر، سب کے ساتھ مناسب اور منصفانہ سلوک کرتے ہوئے، بغیر طرفداری کے تقسیم کرتے ہوئے
synonyms: Fairly, Justly, Impartially, Evenly, Reasonably, Even-handedly
examples: The profits were divided equitably among the partners. Resources must be shared equitably between the provinces. The teacher treated all students equitably. Work was distributed equitably across the team.
