englishMeaning: Devilish, wicked, or fiendishly cunning. Resembling Mephistopheles, the demonic tempter in the Faust legend. Showing sinister charm, malicious intelligence, or a temptation toward evil.
urduMeaning: شیطانی بدکار یا نہایت مکار، فاؤسٹ کی داستان کے شیطانی بہکانے والے میفسٹوفیلس جیسا، خوفناک دلکشی شرارتی ذہانت یا برائی کی ترغیب ظاہر کرنے والا
antonyms: Angelic, Benevolent, Virtuous, Saintly, Innocent, Good

sindhiMeaning: اهڙو معاشي نظام جنهن ۾ حڪومت واپار تي ضابطو رکي برآمد وڌائي ۽ درآمد گهٽائي قومي دولت ۽ طاقت وڌائي، اهو معاشي نظريو ته قيمتي ڌاتن جي ذخيرن ۽ فائدي واري واپاري توازن سان خوشحالي اچي ٿي، واپار ۽ نفعي تي تمام گهڻو زور
antonyms: Free trade, Laissez-faire, Economic liberalism, Open markets
urduMeaning: ایسا معاشی نظام جس میں حکومت تجارت پر قابو رکھ کر برآمدات بڑھاتی اور درآمدات محدود کرتی ہے تاکہ قومی دولت اور طاقت بڑھے، یہ معاشی نظریہ کہ قیمتی دھاتوں کے ذخیرے اور موافق تجارتی توازن سے خوشحالی آتی ہے، تجارت اور منافع پر بہت زیادہ زور
examples: Mercantilism shaped European trade policy for several centuries. Under mercantilism, governments often imposed high tariffs on imports. The historian explained how colonies supported the goals of mercantilism. Critics argue that strict mercantilism can restrict open trade.
englishMeaning: An economic system in which a government seeks national wealth and power by controlling trade, promoting exports, and limiting imports. The economic doctrine that national prosperity depends on accumulating precious metals and maintaining a favorable balance of trade. A strong commercial spirit or emphasis on profit.
synonyms: Economic nationalism, Protectionism, Trade regulation, Commercialism, Bullionism
Protectionist, Economic nationalist, Trade regulator, Commercialist, Mercantilism advocate
sindhiMeaning: مرڪنٽيلزم جو حامي يا عمل ڪندڙ، قومي دولت وڌائڻ لاءِ واپار تي سرڪاري ضابطي برآمد وڌائڻ ۽ درآمد گهٽائڻ جو حامي، مرڪنٽيلزم سان لاڳاپيل، واپار يا نفعي تي گهڻو ڌيان ڏيندڙ
englishMeaning: A supporter or practitioner of mercantilism. A person who favors government control of trade, export promotion, and import restriction to increase national wealth. Relating to or characteristic of mercantilism. Strongly focused on commerce or profit.
examples: The minister adopted a mercantilist approach to foreign trade. Mercantilist writers favored a positive balance of trade. The historian described him as a committed mercantilist. New tariffs reflected the government’s mercantilist priorities.
antonyms: Free trader, Economic liberal, Laissez-faire advocate, Internationalist
urduMeaning: مرکنٹیلزم کا حامی یا اس پر عمل کرنے والا، قومی دولت بڑھانے کے لیے تجارت پر حکومتی کنٹرول برآمدات کے فروغ اور درآمدات کی پابندی کا حامی، مرکنٹیلزم سے متعلق، تجارت یا منافع پر زیادہ توجہ دینے والا

synonyms: With permission, By authorization, Officially approved, Licensed, Legally permitted
sindhiMeaning: اختيار رکندڙ اداري يا حق مالڪ جي سرڪاري اجازت سان، قانوني لائسنس جي شرطن هيٺ، بااختيار رضامندي سان تيار وڪرو استعمال يا هلائيندڙ
examples: The medicine is manufactured under license in several countries. This software may be used only under license. The café sells the branded products under license. Local firms operate the service under license from the government.

urduMeaning: کاروبار, تجارت, کمپنی یا ادارہ, پیشہ یا کام, معاملہ, ذمہ داری, گاہکوں یا فروخت کی سرگرمی, سنجیدہ کام, ذاتی معاملہ, صنعت

urduMeaning: قابل فروخت, خریداروں کے لیے پُرکشش, بازار میں مطلوب, تجارتی قدر رکھنے والا, خرید و فروخت یا منتقلی کے قابل, آسانی سے تشہیر کے قابل

englishMeaning: Belief in promoting human welfare and reducing suffering. The principle that every person deserves dignity, compassion, and assistance. sindhiMeaning: مدت وڌائڻ يا ڊگهو ڪرڻ جو عمل، وقت ۾ واڌ، ڊگهي ٿيل حالت، ڪنهن عمل زندگي آواز يا بناوت جو وڌاءُ، پڄاڻيءَ ۾ ڄاڻي واڻي يا غير ضروري دير
synonyms: Extension, Lengthening, Continuation, Protraction, Perpetuation, Delay, Elongation
urduMeaning: مدت بڑھانے یا طول دینے کا عمل، وقت میں اضافہ، طویل شدہ حالت، کسی عمل زندگی آواز یا ساخت کی توسیع، اختتام میں دانستہ یا غیر ضروری تاخیر
examples: The prolongation of the conflict caused further suffering. The new medicine may allow the prolongation of healthy life. A prolongation of the deadline was granted after the storm. The singer used the prolongation of the final note for dramatic effect.

synonyms: Cruelly, Insensitively, Heartlessly, Coldly, Ruthlessly, Unfeelingly, Indifferently
examples: He callously ignored the injured man’s request for help. The workers were callously dismissed without warning. She spoke callously about people who had lost their homes. The company callously placed profit above public safety.
urduMeaning: بے حسی سے، سنگ دلی سے، دوسروں کے درد یا جذبات کی پروا کیے بغیر، ظالمانہ یا بے رحمانہ انداز میں، ہمدردی اور رحم کے بغیر، نقصان کو نظر انداز کرتے ہوئے
englishMeaning: In an insensitive, cruel, or emotionally hardened manner. Without sympathy for the pain or feelings of others. With careless disregard for suffering or harm. In a way that shows a lack of compassion or concern.
antonyms: Compassionately, Kindly, Sympathetically, Humanely, Considerately, Tenderly
sindhiMeaning: بي حسيءَ سان، سنگدليءَ سان، ٻين جي درد يا احساسن جي پرواهه کان سواءِ، ظلم يا بي رحميءَ سان، همدردي ۽ رحم کان خالي نموني، نقصان کي نظرانداز ڪندي

synonyms: Lure, Bait, Dummy, Distraction, Trap, Enticement, Red herring, Mislead
sindhiMeaning: ڦاسائڻ لاءِ رکيل ڪوڙو ماڻهو جانور يا شيءِ، ڌيان اصل مقصد کان هٽائڻ وارو وسيلو، شڪار کي ويجهو آڻڻ لاءِ نقلي پکي يا جانور، ٺڳيءَ سان ڪنهن کي ڦاسائڻ يا ٻي طرف ڇڪڻ
urduMeaning: پھانسنے کے لیے استعمال ہونے والا جعلی شخص جانور یا چیز، توجہ اصل مقصد سے ہٹانے کا ذریعہ، شکار کو قریب لانے کے لیے نقلی پرندہ یا جانور، دھوکے سے کسی کو جال میں لانا یا دوسری طرف کھینچنا
examples: The police used an empty van as a decoy. Wooden ducks served as decoys on the lake. The first email was a decoy designed to distract the security team. The thieves decoyed the guard away from the entrance.
englishMeaning: A person, animal, object, or imitation used to lure someone or something into a trap. Something used to distract attention from the real target, purpose, or activity. A model bird or animal used to attract live game. To lure, mislead, or draw someone away by using a decoy.
antonyms: Warning, Deterrent, Repellent, Revelation, Truth, Disclosure

urduMeaning: جڑی ہوئی یا ایک دوسرے پر منحصر چیزوں کو الگ کرنا، ایک عمل یا نظام کو دوسرے سے آزاد چلانا، معاشی ترقی کو وسائل کے استعمال یا ماحولیاتی نقصان سے جدا کرنا، سرکٹس کے درمیان غیر مطلوب توانائی یا سگنل کی منتقلی روکنا
antonyms: Couple, Connect, Link, Join, Attach, Integrate, Associate
synonyms: Separate, Disconnect, Detach, Disengage, Dissociate, Unlink, Isolate, Uncouple
sindhiMeaning: ڳنڍيل يا هڪ ٻئي تي دارومدار رکندڙ شين کي جدا ڪرڻ، هڪ عمل يا نظام کي ٻئي کان آزاد هلائڻ، معاشي واڌ کي وسيلن جي استعمال يا ماحولياتي نقصان کان الڳ ڪرڻ، سرڪٽن وچ ۾ غير ضروري سگنل يا توانائيءَ جي منتقلي روڪڻ
englishMeaning: To separate two things that are connected, linked, or dependent on each other. To make one process or system operate independently of another. To reduce or remove the connection between economic growth and resource use or environmental harm. In electronics or engineering, to prevent unwanted transfer of energy or signals between circuits or components.
examples: The company plans to decouple salaries from short-term sales figures. Engineers used a capacitor to decouple the two circuits. We must decouple economic growth from rising carbon emissions. The new design decouples the screen from the main control unit.

sindhiMeaning: ڪاغذ جون تصويرون يا نقش ڪٽي ڪنهن شيءِ تي چنبڙائڻ جو سينگار وارو هنر، ڪاغذي ڪٽڻين سان سينگاريل شيءِ يا سطح، وارنش جي تهن سان مڪمل ڪيل اهڙو ڪم، هن طريقي سان تيار ڪيل آرائشي فن
antonyms: Plainness, Bareness, Undecorated surface, Simplicity
englishMeaning: The decorative art of cutting out paper pictures or designs and gluing them onto an object. An object or surface decorated with pasted paper cutouts, often finished with layers of varnish. The technique or finished work produced by this method.
urduMeaning: کاغذ کی تصویریں یا نقش کاٹ کر کسی چیز پر چپکانے کا آرائشی فن، کاغذی تراشوں سے سجائی گئی چیز یا سطح، وارنش کی تہوں سے مکمل کیا گیا ایسا کام، اس طریقے سے تیار کردہ آرائشی فن پارہ
examples: She decorated the wooden box with floral decoupage. The class learned how to make decoupage using old magazines. A layer of varnish protected the decoupage on the table. The museum displayed an eighteenth-century decoupage screen.
synonyms: Paper craft, Collage, Cutwork, Decoration, Ornamentation, Papier collé

englishMeaning: In a polite, proper, and socially acceptable manner. With dignity, good taste, and respect for convention. In a way appropriate to a formal occasion or setting. Modestly and without causing offense or embarrassment.
synonyms: Properly, Politely, Respectably, Dignifiedly, Tastefully, Modestly, Correctly
examples: The guests behaved decorously throughout the ceremony. She was decorously dressed for the formal reception. The disagreement was discussed quietly and decorously. He bowed decorously before leaving the room.
sindhiMeaning: ادب ۽ شائستگيءَ سان، مناسب ۽ سماجي طور قبوليل نموني، وقار ۽ سٺي ذوق سان، رسمي موقعي جي مطابق، حيا ۽ احترام سان، ڪنهن کي شرمندگي يا تڪليف ڏيڻ کان سواءِ
urduMeaning: ادب اور شائستگی سے، مناسب اور سماجی طور پر قابل قبول انداز میں، وقار اور اچھے ذوق کے ساتھ، رسمی موقع کے مطابق، حیا اور احترام سے، کسی کو شرمندہ یا ناراض کیے بغیر
antonyms: Improperly, Rudely, Indecorously, Vulgarily, Disrespectfully, Shamelessly

englishMeaning: Polite, proper, and in good taste. Behaving with dignity and respect for social conventions. Appropriate to a formal situation or occasion. Modest, restrained, and unlikely to cause offense or embarrassment.
urduMeaning: شائستہ اور باادب، مناسب اور اچھے ذوق والا، سماجی آداب کا احترام کرنے والا، وقار سے پیش آنے والا، رسمی موقع کے لیے موزوں، باحیا اور سنجیدہ، اعتراض یا شرمندگی پیدا نہ کرنے والا
antonyms: Indecorous, Improper, Rude, Vulgar, Unseemly, Disrespectful, Shameless
synonyms: Proper, Polite, Respectable, Dignified, Tasteful, Modest, Seemly, Civil
sindhiMeaning: شائسته ۽ باادب، مناسب ۽ سٺي ذوق وارو، سماجي آداب جو احترام ڪندڙ، وقار سان هلندڙ، رسمي موقعي لاءِ موزون، باحيا ۽ سنجيده، اعتراض يا شرمندگي پيدا نه ڪندڙ
examples: Everyone maintained a decorous silence during the memorial. Her decorous manner impressed the interview panel. The restaurant offers a quiet and decorous setting. They reached a decorous compromise without public argument.

We hired a decorator to redesign the living room. The cake decorator created delicate sugar flowers. A professional decorator painted every room in the hotel. In Python, the decorator adds logging to the function.
synonyms: Interior designer, Painter, Stylist, Ornamenter, Designer, Embellisher
antonyms: Stripper, Defacer, Vandal, Undecorator, Minimalist
sindhiMeaning: گهرن يا عمارتن جي اندروني حصي کي سينگاريندڙ ماهر، ڀتين تي رنگ يا وال پيپر ڪندڙ ڪاريگر، شين جڳهن کاڌي يا تقريبن کي آرائش ڏيندڙ ماڻهو، ڪمپيوٽنگ ۾ ڪنهن فنڪشن ڪلاس يا آبجيڪٽ ۾ بنيادي جوڙجڪ بدليل بغير خاصيتون وڌائيندڙ طريقو
englishMeaning: A person whose job is to decorate the interior of buildings. A person who paints and wallpapers rooms professionally. Someone who adds ornaments, colors, or visual details to objects, spaces, food, or events. In computing, a function or design pattern that adds behavior or features to another function, class, or object without changing its basic structure.
urduMeaning: گھروں یا عمارتوں کے اندرونی حصے کو سجانے والا ماہر، دیواروں پر رنگ یا وال پیپر کرنے والا کاریگر، اشیا جگہوں کھانے یا تقریبات کو آرائش دینے والا شخص، کمپیوٹنگ میں کسی فنکشن کلاس یا آبجیکٹ کی بنیادی ساخت بدلے بغیر خصوصیات بڑھانے والا طریقہ

antonyms: Decree nisi, Conditional order, Marriage, Reconciliation, Interim order
synonyms: Final divorce order, Final decree, Dissolution order, Conclusive judgment
urduMeaning: عدالت کا آخری حکم جو شادی کو قانونی طور پر ختم کر دے، طلاق کا آخری مرحلہ، ڈگری نائسی کے بعد جاری ہونے والا حکم، جس کے بعد فریق دوبارہ شادی کر سکتے ہیں، مکمل قانونی اثر رکھنے والا قطعی عدالتی فیصلہ، انگلینڈ اور ویلز میں اب عموماً فائنل آرڈر کہلانے والا
sindhiMeaning: عدالت جو آخري حڪم جيڪو شاديءَ کي قانوني طور ختم ڪري، طلاق جو آخري مرحلو، ڊڪري نائسي کان پوءِ جاري ٿيندڙ حڪم، جنهن کان پوءِ ڌريون ٻيهر شادي ڪري سگهن، مڪمل قانوني اثر رکندڙ قطعي عدالتي فيصلو، انگلينڊ ۽ ويلز ۾ هاڻي عام طور فائنل آرڊر سڏجندڙ
examples: The marriage legally ended when the court issued the decree absolute. She applied for the decree absolute several weeks after the earlier order. Neither party could remarry before receiving the decree absolute. Older case files refer to the final divorce order as a decree absolute.
englishMeaning: A final legal order that formally ends a marriage under the former divorce terminology of England and Wales. The final stage of a divorce following a decree nisi, after which the parties are legally free to remarry. A conclusive court decree with full legal effect. Now generally called a final order in England and Wales.

antonyms: Vigor, Strength, Soundness, Youthfulness, Robustness, Renewal, Good condition
sindhiMeaning: پوڙهائپ سبب ڪمزوري ۽ زوال جي حالت، تمام جهونو ۽ جهيڻو هجڻ، عمارت اداري نظام يا شيءِ جي خراب ۽ زبون حالت، شديد ناتواني، ڀڃ ڊاهه ۽ بوسيدگي
examples: Years of neglect left the mansion in a state of decrepitude. Despite his physical decrepitude, his mind remained sharp. The report exposed the decrepitude of the city’s water system. The old bridge showed clear signs of decrepitude.
synonyms: Dilapidation, Decay, Deterioration, Feebleness, Infirmity, Senility, Frailty
urduMeaning: بڑھاپے کے باعث کمزوری اور زوال کی حالت، نہایت پرانا اور کمزور ہونا، عمارت ادارے نظام یا چیز کی خراب اور خستہ حالت، شدید ناتوانی، ٹوٹ پھوٹ اور بوسیدگی
englishMeaning: The state of being old, weak, worn out, or in serious disrepair. Physical weakness and decline caused by old age. A condition of deterioration in a building, institution, system, or object. Extreme feebleness or dilapidation.

synonyms: Reduce, Decline, Diminish, Lessen, Drop, Fall, Shrink, Reduction
examples: Temperatures will decrease after sunset. The new system should decrease waiting times. The report shows a sharp decrease in road accidents. There was a ten percent decrease in monthly expenses.
urduMeaning: کم ہونا یا کم کرنا، مقدار تعداد حجم طاقت قیمت یا شدت میں کمی آنا، کسی چیز کو چھوٹا یا کم بنانا، شرح درجے یا سطح میں گراوٹ، کمی کی مقدار
sindhiMeaning: گهٽجڻ يا گهٽ ڪرڻ، مقدار انگ ماپ طاقت قيمت يا شدت ۾ ڪمي اچڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي ننڍو يا گهٽ بڻائڻ، شرح درجي يا سطح ۾ لاٿ، گهٽتائيءَ جو مقدار
antonyms: Increase, Rise, Grow, Expand, Enlarge, Escalate, Addition
englishMeaning: To become smaller or fewer in size, amount, number, strength, value, or intensity. To make something smaller or less. A reduction or downward change in quantity, rate, degree, or level. The amount by which something becomes smaller.

synonyms: Grow, Rise, Expand, Enlarge, Escalate, Multiply, Augment, Addition
urduMeaning: بڑھنا یا بڑھانا، مقدار تعداد حجم طاقت قیمت یا شدت میں اضافہ ہونا، کسی چیز کو زیادہ یا بڑا کرنا، شرح درجے یا سطح میں اضافہ، بڑھوتری کی مقدار
examples: Food prices may increase during the winter. Regular exercise can increase your energy levels. The school reported an increase in enrollment. We received a five percent increase in salary.
sindhiMeaning: وڌڻ يا وڌائڻ، مقدار انگ ماپ طاقت قيمت يا شدت ۾ واڌ اچڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي وڌيڪ يا وڏو ڪرڻ، شرح درجي يا سطح ۾ چاڙهه، واڌاري جو مقدار
englishMeaning: To become greater in size, amount, number, strength, value, or intensity. To make something greater or more numerous. A rise or upward change in quantity, rate, degree, or level. The amount by which something becomes greater.
antonyms: Decrease, Decline, Reduce, Diminish, Lessen, Shrink, Reduction

urduMeaning: کسی عمل سے فوجداری سزا ختم کرنے کا عمل، کسی کام کو جرم کے درجے سے نکالنا، ایسی قانونی تبدیلی جس کے بعد عمل پر ضابطہ یا دیوانی جرمانہ باقی رہ سکتا ہو، مکمل قانونی اجازت کے بغیر مجرمانہ سزا کم کرنے کی پالیسی
englishMeaning: The act or process of removing criminal penalties from an action or conduct. A legal change under which an act is no longer treated as a crime, although it may still be regulated or subject to civil penalties. The policy of reducing criminal punishment without necessarily making an activity fully legal.
antonyms: Criminalization, Prohibition, Penalization, Outlawing, Ban
synonyms: Depenalization, Legal reform, Deregulation, Reclassification, Liberalization
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن عمل تان فوجداري سزا هٽائڻ جو عمل، ڪنهن ڪم کي ڏوهه جي درجي مان ڪڍڻ، اهڙي قانوني تبديلي جنهن کان پوءِ عمل تي ضابطو يا ديواني سزا رهڻ ممڪن هجي، مڪمل قانوني ڪرڻ کان سواءِ ڏوهاري سزا گهٽائڻ واري پاليسي
examples: The council debated the decriminalization of minor offenses. Decriminalization does not always mean that an activity becomes completely legal. Supporters say decriminalization could reduce pressure on the courts. The study examined the effects of drug decriminalization on public health.

sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن عمل ملڪيت يا ورتاءَ تان فوجداري سزا هٽائڻ، قانون بدلائي ڪنهن ڪم کي ڏوهه نه سمجهڻ، ڏوهاري سزا بدران ضابطو ديواني ڏنڊ يا علاج لاڳو ڪرڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي لازمي طور مڪمل آزاد يا قانوني نه بڻائڻ
examples: Several groups want the government to decriminalize the minor offense. The proposal would decriminalize possession of a very small amount. Lawmakers voted to decriminalize conduct that had rarely been prosecuted. To decriminalize an act is not always to permit it without regulation.
urduMeaning: کسی عمل ملکیت یا رویے سے فوجداری سزا ہٹانا، قانون بدل کر کسی کام کو جرم نہ سمجھنا، مجرمانہ سزا کی جگہ ضابطہ دیوانی جرمانہ یا علاج نافذ کرنا، کسی چیز کو لازماً مکمل طور پر قانونی یا غیر محدود نہ بنانا
englishMeaning: To remove criminal penalties from an action, possession, or conduct. To change the law so that something is no longer treated as a criminal offense. To replace criminal punishment with regulation, civil penalties, treatment, or no penalty. Not necessarily to make something fully legal or unrestricted.
synonyms: Depenalize, Reclassify, Liberalize, Legalize partially, Remove penalties
antonyms: Criminalize, Penalize, Prohibit, Outlaw, Ban

urduMeaning: رشوت یا بدعنوانی سے نہ بدلنے والا، انتہائی ایماندار اور اصولوں کا پکا، بے ایمانی پر آمادہ نہ ہونے والا، نہ سڑنے یا فنا ہونے والا، مذہبی معنی میں جسمانی زوال سے معجزانہ طور پر محفوظ
antonyms: Corrupt, Bribable, Dishonest, Venal, Unprincipled, Decaying, Perishable
englishMeaning: Not capable of being bribed, morally corrupted, or persuaded to act dishonestly. Completely honest and guided by strong principles. Unable to decay, perish, or be physically corrupted. In religious usage, miraculously preserved from bodily decay.
synonyms: Honest, Upright, Principled, Unbribable, Virtuous, Uncorrupted, Imperishable
sindhiMeaning: رشوت يا بدعنوانيءَ کان نه بدلجندڙ، انتهائي ايماندار ۽ اصولن جو پڪو، بي ايمانيءَ لاءِ راضي نه ٿيندڙ، نه سڙندڙ يا فنا نه ٿيندڙ، مذهبي معنيٰ ۾ جسماني زوال کان معجزاڻي طرح محفوظ
examples: The judge was respected as an incorruptible public servant. They needed an incorruptible officer to lead the investigation. The legend describes the saint’s body as incorruptible. Her incorruptible commitment to justice inspired the entire team.

antonyms: Decreased, Reduced, Lowered, Diminished, Lessened, Contracted
sindhiMeaning: وڌايل يا اڳ کان وڌيل، مقدار انگ ماپ درجي طاقت قيمت يا شدت ۾ وڌيڪ ٿيل، اڳ کان وڌيڪ بار بار وسيع يا شديد، پوئين سطح کان مٿي آندل، وڌائڻ فعل جي ماضي ۽ مڪمل صورت
urduMeaning: بڑھایا گیا یا پہلے سے بڑھا ہوا، مقدار تعداد حجم درجے طاقت قیمت یا شدت میں زیادہ، پہلے سے زیادہ بار بار وسیع یا شدید، سابقہ سطح سے اوپر کیا گیا، فعل بڑھانا کی ماضی اور اسم مفعول صورت
examples: Increased demand has pushed prices higher. The clinic reported an increased number of patients this week. We increased the budget after reviewing the costs. Increased security helped visitors feel safer.
synonyms: Raised, Greater, Enlarged, Expanded, Enhanced, Heightened, Augmented
englishMeaning: Made or having become greater in size, amount, number, degree, strength, value, or intensity. More frequent, extensive, or severe than before. Raised above a previous level. Past tense and past participle of increase.

urduMeaning: رشوت یا اخلاقی بدعنوانی سے محفوظ ہونے کی صفت، مکمل ایمانداری دیانت اور ناجائز اثر کی مزاحمت، نہ سڑنے یا فنا نہ ہونے کی حالت، مذہبی تناظر میں جسم کا معمول کی تحلیل سے محفوظ رہنا
synonyms: Integrity, Honesty, Uprightness, Probity, Virtue, Unbribability, Imperishability
englishMeaning: The quality of being impossible or extremely difficult to bribe or morally corrupt. Complete honesty, integrity, and resistance to improper influence. The condition of being unable to decay or perish. In religious contexts, preservation of a body from normal decomposition.
sindhiMeaning: رشوت يا اخلاقي بدعنوانيءَ کان محفوظ هجڻ جي صفت، مڪمل ايمانداري ديانت ۽ غلط اثر جي مزاحمت، نه سڙڻ يا فنا نه ٿيڻ جي حالت، مذهبي حوالي سان جسم جو عام گلڻ سڙڻ کان محفوظ رهڻ
examples: Her incorruptibility made her a trusted leader. The commission praised the investigator’s proven incorruptibility. Voters valued his incorruptibility more than his popularity. The tradition treats the body’s incorruptibility as a sacred sign.
antonyms: Corruption, Dishonesty, Venality, Bribability, Decay, Decomposition

englishMeaning: A handheld eating utensil combining features of a spoon and a fork. A spoon-shaped implement with short fork-like points at its tip. An informal verb meaning to eat, serve, or handle food with a spork.
antonyms: Spoon, Fork, Separate utensils, Chopsticks
sindhiMeaning: چمچي ۽ ڪانٽي جي گڏيل شڪل وارو کائڻ جو اوزار، اڳيان ننڍن ڪانٽي جهڙن ڏندن وارو چمچو، اسپارڪ سان کاڌو کائڻ يا پيش ڪرڻ جو غير رسمي فعل
urduMeaning: چمچ اور کانٹے کی ملی جلی شکل والا کھانے کا آلہ، سرے پر چھوٹے کانٹے جیسے دندانے رکھنے والا چمچ، اسپارک سے کھانا کھانے یا پیش کرنے کا غیر رسمی فعل
examples: I used a spork to eat the rice and vegetables. The camping set includes a metal spork. She packed a reusable spork in her lunch bag. He sporked the soft noodles straight from the bowl.
synonyms: Spoon-fork, Combination utensil, Eating utensil, Splayd

antonyms: Pocketless garment, No direct antonym
englishMeaning: A pouch worn in front of a Scottish kilt. A traditional part of Scottish Highland dress used because a kilt has no pockets. A decorative or practical leather or fur pouch suspended from a belt or chain around the waist.
examples: He wore a leather sporran with his kilt. The ceremonial sporran was decorated with silver. She placed the small key inside the sporran. A chain held the sporran securely at the front of his waist.
sindhiMeaning: اسڪاٽش ڪلٽ جي اڳيان پاتل ٿيلهو، اسڪاٽش هاءِ لينڊ لباس جو روايتي حصو، کيسن جي بدران استعمال ٿيندڙ ننڍو ٿيلهو، چمڙي يا کل مان ٺهيل سينگاريل يا ڪارائتو ڪمر وارو ٿيلهو
urduMeaning: اسکاٹش کلٹ کے سامنے پہنا جانے والا تھیلا، اسکاٹش ہائی لینڈ لباس کا روایتی حصہ، جیبوں کی جگہ استعمال ہونے والی چھوٹی تھیلی، چمڑے یا فر سے بنا سجاوٹی یا عملی کمر کا تھیلا
synonyms: Pouch, Purse, Belt pouch, Highland pouch, Kilt pouch

englishMeaning: Saying that a statement, person, or claim is wrong or untrue. Asserting the opposite of what someone else has said. Being inconsistent with or in conflict with another fact, statement, or action. Present participle of contradict.
urduMeaning: کسی بیان شخص یا دعوے کو غلط کہنا، پہلے کہی گئی بات کے برعکس کہنا، کسی حقیقت بیان یا عمل سے مطابقت نہ رکھنا، اختلاف یا تضاد میں ہونا، فعل کانٹراڈکٹ کی جاری صورت
antonyms: Agreeing, Confirming, Supporting, Corroborating, Affirming, Consenting
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن بيان ماڻهو يا دعويٰ کي غلط چوڻ، اڳ ڪيل ڳالهه جي ابتڙ چوڻ، ڪنهن حقيقت بيان يا عمل سان نه ٺهڪڻ، تڪرار يا تضاد ۾ هجڻ، ڪنٽراڊڪٽ فعل جي جاري صورت
synonyms: Denying, Disputing, Opposing, Challenging, Conflicting, Gainsaying, Refuting
examples: The witness kept contradicting his earlier statement. She apologized for contradicting the teacher so sharply. Two reports are contradicting each other on the key issue. The evidence is contradicting the company’s public claim.

synonyms: Contradictory, Conflicting, Opposing, Inconsistent, Denying, Contrary
urduMeaning: تردید یا مخالفت کرنے والا، تضاد ظاہر کرنے والا، کسی دوسرے بیان حقیقت یا خیال سے مطابقت نہ رکھنے والا، باہم متضاد، کانٹراڈکٹری کے معنی میں کم استعمال ہونے والی صفت
sindhiMeaning: ترديد يا مخالفت ڪندڙ، تضاد ظاهر ڪندڙ، ڪنهن ٻئي بيان حقيقت يا خيال سان نه ٺهڪندڙ، پاڻ ۾ ابتڙ، ڪنٽراڊڪٽري جي معنيٰ ۾ گهٽ استعمال ٿيندڙ صفت
examples: His contradictive reply confused the entire committee. The two clauses have a contradictive effect when read together. She adopted a needlessly contradictive tone during the discussion. Contradictive evidence weakened the original argument.
antonyms: Consistent, Compatible, Agreeing, Supporting, Confirmatory, Harmonious
englishMeaning: Tending to contradict, deny, or oppose. Expressing or involving contradiction. Inconsistent with another statement, fact, or idea. A rare adjective more commonly expressed as contradictory.

examples: The researchers tested the compound for a possible contrasedative effect. A contrasedative agent may reduce excessive drowsiness in carefully controlled conditions. The paper uses contrasedative to describe activity opposing sedation. Doctors did not administer any contrasedative treatment without monitoring the patient.
synonyms: Antisedative, Stimulant, Analeptic, Awakening agent, Sedative antagonist
urduMeaning: سکون آور دوا کے اثر کو کم یا ختم کرنے والا، زیادہ غنودگی یا بے ہوشی کا مقابلہ کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہونے والا مادہ، سکون یا نیند آور اثر کے مخالف، ایک نادر طبی یا فنی اصطلاح جس کا مفہوم سیاق پر منحصر ہے
englishMeaning: Acting against or reducing the effects of a sedative. An agent used or intended to counter sedation or excessive drowsiness. Opposed to sedation or calming effects. A rare medical or technical term whose meaning depends on context.
antonyms: Sedative, Tranquilizer, Depressant, Hypnotic, Calming agent
sindhiMeaning: سڪون آور دوا جي اثر کي گهٽائڻ يا ختم ڪرڻ وارو، گهڻي ننڊ يا بيهوشيءَ جي مقابلي لاءِ استعمال ٿيندڙ مادو، سڪون يا غنودگيءَ جي اثر جي ابتڙ، هڪ ناياب طبي يا فني اصطلاح جنهن جي معنيٰ حوالي تي دارومدار رکي

synonyms: Counterfactual, Factuality-opposed, Untrue, Contrary-to-fact, Fictitious, Inaccurate
englishMeaning: Contrary to actual fact or to what really happened. Describing a statement, belief, or representation that conflicts with the facts. Counterfactual or factually opposite. A rare adjective used in logic, linguistics, and academic discussion.
examples: The article rejects the contrafactive claim that no warning was given. Her contrafactive account conflicts with the recorded evidence. The scholar examined contrafactive statements in political speeches. A contrafactive assumption can lead the entire argument astray.
sindhiMeaning: حقيقي حقيقت جي ابتڙ، جيڪو اصل ۾ ٿيو تنهن سان نه ٺهڪندڙ، حقيقتن سان ٽڪراءُ رکندڙ بيان عقيدو يا پيشڪش، فرضي ۽ واقعي جي خلاف، منطق لسانيات ۽ علمي بحث ۾ استعمال ٿيندڙ ناياب صفت
antonyms: Factual, True, Actual, Accurate, Veridical, Fact-based
urduMeaning: اصل حقیقت کے خلاف، جو واقعی ہوا اس سے مطابقت نہ رکھنے والا، حقائق سے ٹکرانے والا بیان عقیدہ یا پیشکش، فرضی اور واقعے کے برعکس، منطق لسانیات اور علمی بحث میں استعمال ہونے والی نادر صفت

englishMeaning: A very large double-reed woodwind instrument pitched an octave below the bassoon. One of the lowest-pitched instruments in the orchestra. A musician who plays the contrabassoon, by occasional metonymic use.
sindhiMeaning: باسون کان هڪ آڪٽيو هيٺ آواز وارو تمام وڏو ٻٽي ريڊ وارو ڪاٺي وڄت ساز، آرڪيسٽرا جي سڀ کان هيٺين سُرن وارن سازن مان هڪ، ڪڏهن مجازي طور ڪنٽراباسون وڄائيندڙ موسيقار
synonyms: Double bassoon, Contra-bassoon, Bass woodwind, Contrafagotto
examples: The contrabassoon added a deep rumble to the final movement. She began studying the contrabassoon after years of playing bassoon. The orchestra placed the contrabassoon near the other woodwinds. A quiet contrabassoon solo introduced the mysterious scene.
urduMeaning: باسون سے ایک آکٹیو نیچی آواز والا بہت بڑا دوہرے ریڈ کا لکڑی کا ساز، آرکسٹرا کے سب سے پست آواز والے سازوں میں سے ایک، کبھی مجازی طور پر کانٹراباسون بجانے والا موسیقار
antonyms: Piccolo, High-pitched woodwind, Treble instrument

englishMeaning: The lowest-pitched instrument or voice in a family of instruments. A double bass, especially in orchestral or jazz contexts. Relating to an instrument pitched below the bass range, often an octave lower. A performer who plays a contrabass instrument, in occasional usage.
antonyms: Treble, Soprano, Piccolo, High register
examples: The contrabass provides a warm foundation for the string section. He plays contrabass in a local jazz group. The composer added a contrabass clarinet for extra depth. A contrabass line moved slowly beneath the melody.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن سازي خاندان جو سڀ کان هيٺين سُر وارو ساز يا آواز، ڊبل باس، باس کان به هيٺ آواز وارو ساز، اڪثر هڪ آڪٽيو هيٺ، ڪڏهن ڪنٽراباس ساز وڄائيندڙ موسيقار
urduMeaning: کسی سازوں کے خاندان کا سب سے پست آواز والا ساز یا آواز، ڈبل باس، باس سے بھی نیچی آواز والا ساز، عموماً ایک آکٹیو نیچے، کبھی کانٹراباس ساز بجانے والا موسیقار
synonyms: Double bass, String bass, Upright bass, Bass fiddle, Low bass, Sub-bass

sindhiMeaning: اهڙو سامان جنهن جي درآمد برآمد رکڻ يا واپار تي پابندي هجي، اسمگل ڪيل شيون، جيل اسڪول فوجي علائقي يا ٻي بند جاءِ ۾ لڪائي آندل منع ٿيل شيون، غير قانوني سامان سان لاڳاپيل، آمريڪي گهرو ويڙهه دوران يونين وٽ پهتل فرار ٿيل غلام لاءِ تاريخي اصطلاح
englishMeaning: Goods that are illegal to import, export, possess, or trade. Items smuggled into or out of a place in violation of law or rules. Prohibited articles secretly brought into a prison, school, military area, or other controlled place. Relating to illegal or prohibited goods. Historically, an enslaved person who escaped to Union lines during the American Civil War and was classified as seized enemy property.
urduMeaning: ایسا سامان جس کی درآمد برآمد ملکیت یا تجارت ممنوع ہو، اسمگل شدہ اشیا، جیل اسکول فوجی علاقے یا دوسری محدود جگہ میں چھپا کر لائی گئی ممنوعہ چیزیں، غیر قانونی سامان سے متعلق، امریکی خانہ جنگی میں یونین تک پہنچنے والے فرار شدہ غلام کے لیے تاریخی اصطلاح
antonyms: Legal goods, Permitted items, Lawful merchandise, Authorized property
synonyms: Smuggled goods, Illicit goods, Prohibited items, Black-market goods, Bootleg, Illegal merchandise
examples: Customs officers discovered contraband hidden inside the truck. Mobile phones are considered contraband in the prison. The ship was suspected of carrying contraband weapons. Guards searched every package for contraband items.

urduMeaning: خط و خال یا خم دار شکل والا، قدرتی منحنیات کے مطابق ڈھالا ہوا، جسم یا چیز کے مطابق بنا ہوا، خطوطِ ارتفاع سے نشان زدہ
englishMeaning: Shaped to follow a curved outline or surface. Formed or moulded to fit the natural curves of a body or object. Marked with contour lines showing height, depth, or shape.
antonyms: Flat, Straight, Shapeless, Unshaped
synonyms: Shaped, Curved, Moulded, Sculpted, Form-fitting, Streamlined
sindhiMeaning: خاڪي يا وڪريل شڪل وارو، قدرتي وڪڙن مطابق ٺهيل، جسم يا شيءِ سان ٺهڪندڙ، هم اوچائي ليڪن سان ڏيکاريل
examples: The contoured seat supports the lower back. The road follows the contoured hillside. She used makeup to create a contoured look. Engineers studied a contoured map of the valley.

sindhiMeaning: اهڙي خيالي سماج سان لاڳاپيل جتي ظلم ۽ تڪليف هجي، خوفناڪ ۽ خراب مستقبل وارو، تباهه حال تصوراتي دنيا وارو، ڊسٽوپيائي ادب يا فلم سان واسطو رکندڙ
antonyms: Utopian, Idyllic, Ideal, Paradisiacal
urduMeaning: ایسے خیالی معاشرے سے متعلق جہاں ظلم اور مصیبت ہو، خوفناک اور ناپسندیدہ مستقبل کا، تباہ حال تصوراتی دنیا والا، ڈسٹوپیائی ادب یا فلم سے متعلق
examples: The novel presents a dystopian society under constant surveillance. The film imagines a dystopian future without clean water. She enjoys reading dystopian fiction. The abandoned city gave the landscape a dystopian appearance.
synonyms: Nightmarish, Oppressive, Bleak, Grim, Apocalyptic, Totalitarian
englishMeaning: Relating to an imagined society marked by suffering, injustice, oppression, or environmental ruin. Describing a frightening and undesirable future. Belonging to the literary or cinematic genre that portrays such societies.

urduMeaning: تقابل کے ذریعے ظاہر کیا گیا فرق، متضاد چیزوں کے درمیان واضح امتیاز، تضادی فرق
englishMeaning: A distinction made by contrasting one thing with another. The state of being clearly different when compared with something else.
antonyms: Similarity, Resemblance, Likeness, Sameness
synonyms: Contrast, Distinction, Differentiation, Opposition, Dissimilarity
sindhiMeaning: مقابلي ذريعي ظاهر ڪيل فرق، ابتڙ شين جي وچ ۾ واضح امتياز، تضادي فرق
examples: In contradistinction to his brother, Ali is quiet and reserved. The essay defines liberty in contradistinction to control. Modern practice was discussed in contradistinction to tradition. The teacher explained prose in contradistinction to poetry.

sindhiMeaning: اوچائي تي جهاز يا راڪيٽ جي پٺيان ٺهندڙ پاڻي جي ٻاڦ يا برف جي ذرڙن جي سفيد ليڪ، بخاراتي هوائي پيچرو
synonyms: Condensation trail, Vapour trail, Exhaust trail
examples: A white contrail stretched across the blue sky. The jet left a long contrail behind it. Scientists study how contrails affect climate. The contrail slowly dispersed in the wind.
urduMeaning: بلندی پر جہاز یا راکٹ کے پیچھے بننے والی آبی بخارات یا برف کے ذرات کی سفید لکیر، فضائی بخاری نشان
englishMeaning: A visible line of condensed water vapour or ice crystals formed behind an aircraft or rocket at high altitude. A condensation trail in the sky.
antonyms: No direct antonym

englishMeaning: To show that a drug, treatment, activity, or procedure should not be used because it may be harmful. To make a course of action medically inadvisable under particular conditions.
urduMeaning: یہ ظاہر کرنا کہ کوئی دوا یا علاج نقصان دہ ہو سکتا ہے، کسی علاج یا طریقۂ کار کو طبی طور پر ناموزوں قرار دینا، استعمال سے منع کرنا
antonyms: Indicate, Recommend, Approve, Permit, Endorse
sindhiMeaning: اهو ظاهر ڪرڻ ته ڪا دوا يا علاج نقصانڪار ٿي سگهي ٿو، علاج يا طريقيڪار کي طبي لحاظ کان نامناسب قرار ڏيڻ، استعمال کان منع ڪرڻ
examples: Pregnancy may contraindicate the use of this medicine. His heart condition contraindicates strenuous exercise. A severe allergy can contraindicate certain antibiotics. The test results contraindicated immediate surgery.
synonyms: Preclude, Prohibit, Rule out, Advise against, Forbid

examples: A contraflow system operated during the roadworks. Signs warned drivers about the contraflow ahead. Buses use a contraflow lane in the city centre. Police guided traffic safely through the temporary contraflow.
sindhiMeaning: عارضي ٽرئفڪ نظام جنهن ۾ گاڏيون مخالف رخ واري لين استعمال ڪن، معمول جي ابتڙ وهندڙ ٽرئفڪ، بس يا سائيڪل لاءِ مخالف رخ وارو رستو
synonyms: Reverse flow, Traffic diversion, Opposite-lane system, Counterflow
urduMeaning: عارضی ٹریفک نظام جس میں گاڑیاں مخالف سمت والی لین استعمال کریں، معمول کے برخلاف بہنے والی ٹریفک، بس یا سائیکل کے لیے مخالف رخ کا راستہ
antonyms: Normal flow, Regular traffic pattern
englishMeaning: A temporary traffic arrangement in which vehicles use lanes normally carrying traffic in the opposite direction. Traffic moving against the usual direction. A system in which public transport or cyclists travel opposite to general traffic.
A developmental neurological condition affecting the planning and coordination of movement. Difficulty performing skilled or purposeful movements despite having the physical ability to do them.
antonyms: No direct antonym
sindhiMeaning: حرڪتن جي رٿابندي ۽ هم آهنگي کي متاثر ڪندڙ اعصابي حالت، ارادي واريون جسماني حرڪتون ڪرڻ ۾ ڏکيائي، حرڪتي مهارتن جو عارضو
urduMeaning: حرکات کی منصوبہ بندی اور ہم آہنگی کو متاثر کرنے والی اعصابی حالت، ارادی جسمانی حرکات کرنے میں دشواری، حرکی مہارتوں کا عارضہ
examples: Dyspraxia can make handwriting difficult for some children. An occupational therapist helped him manage his dyspraxia. Dyspraxia may affect balance and fine motor skills. Early support can help people with dyspraxia build confidence.
synonyms: Developmental coordination disorder, Motor-planning disorder, Apraxia

urduMeaning: ڈسپروسیم، Dy علامت اور 66 جوہری عدد والا نایاب ارضی دھاتی عنصر، طاقتور مقناطیسوں اور جدید آلات میں استعمال ہونے والی چاندی جیسی دھات
antonyms: No direct antonym
englishMeaning: A silvery rare-earth chemical element with the symbol Dy and atomic number 66. A highly magnetic metal used in powerful magnets, lasers, nuclear reactors, and other technologies.
synonyms: Dy, Element 66, Rare-earth metal
sindhiMeaning: ڊسپروسيم، Dy نشان ۽ 66 ائٽمي عدد وارو ناياب زميني ڌاتو عنصر، طاقتور مقناطيسن ۽ جديد اوزارن ۾ استعمال ٿيندڙ چاندي جهڙي ڌاتو
examples: Dysprosium is used in some high-performance magnets. The alloy contains a small amount of dysprosium. Scientists value dysprosium for its magnetic properties. Demand for dysprosium has grown with clean-energy technology.

englishMeaning: Existing only in the imagination and not in reality. Invented, fanciful, or fictitious. In mathematics, involving the square root of a negative number.
examples: The child has an imaginary friend. The story takes place in an imaginary kingdom. We considered an imaginary situation to test the idea. Imaginary numbers are essential in complex mathematics.
synonyms: Fictitious, Unreal, Invented, Fanciful, Illusory, Hypothetical
urduMeaning: صرف خیال میں موجود، غیر حقیقی، فرضی، تصوراتی، من گھڑت، ریاضی میں منفی عدد کے جذر سے متعلق
antonyms: Real, Actual, Genuine, Factual, Existing
sindhiMeaning: رڳو خيال ۾ موجود، غير حقيقي، فرضي، تصوراتي، ٺاهيل، رياضي ۾ منفي عدد جي چورس پاڙ سان لاڳاپيل

synonyms: Degeneration, Wasting, Atrophy, Deterioration
sindhiMeaning: عضوي يا بافتي واڌ ۽ غذائيت جي خرابي، عضلن يا بافتن جو آهستي آهستي ڪمزور يا ضايع ٿيڻ، گهڻو ڪري موروثي تنزلي وارو مرض
examples: Muscular dystrophy gradually weakens the muscles. Researchers are testing treatments for inherited dystrophy. Physical therapy helps some patients manage dystrophy. The diagnosis of retinal dystrophy explained her loss of vision.
englishMeaning: A disorder involving defective nourishment, development, or degeneration of an organ or tissue. Progressive wasting or weakening, especially of muscles, often caused by an inherited condition.
urduMeaning: عضو یا بافت کی نشوونما اور تغذیے کی خرابی، عضلات یا بافتوں کا بتدریج کمزور یا ضائع ہونا، عموماً موروثی تنزلی کا مرض
antonyms: Growth, Development, Strengthening, Regeneration

urduMeaning: قابل تصور، خیال میں آنے والا، ممکن سمجھا جانے والا، ہر ممکن قسم کا، انتہائی حد تک سوچا جا سکنے والا
antonyms: Unimaginable, Inconceivable, Unthinkable, Impossible
englishMeaning: Capable of being imagined, conceived, or believed possible. Used for emphasis to mean every possible kind or the greatest possible degree.
synonyms: Conceivable, Thinkable, Possible, Envisionable, Plausible
examples: She tried every imaginable solution. It was the best imaginable outcome. The journey presented every imaginable difficulty. The shop sells furniture in every imaginable style.
sindhiMeaning: تصور ڪري سگهجندڙ، خيال ۾ اچي سگهندڙ، ممڪن سمجهي سگهجندڙ، هر ممڪن قسم جو، حد کان وڌ تصور لائق

antonyms: Unimaginativeness, Literalness, Dullness, Reality
urduMeaning: ذہن میں غیر موجود چیزوں کی تصویریں یا خیالات بنانے کی صلاحیت، تخلیقی سوچ، قوتِ ایجاد، تصور کرنے والی ذہنی قوت، بے بنیاد وہم یا خیالی بات
sindhiMeaning: ذهن ۾ غير موجود شين جا نقش يا خيال ٺاهڻ جي صلاحيت، تخليقي سوچ، ايجاد جي قوت، تصور ڪندڙ ذهني طاقت، بي بنياد وهم يا خيالي ڳالهه
examples: Children use their imagination during play. Her imagination helped her write a vivid novel. Solving the problem required skill and imagination. The strange sound was only his imagination.
englishMeaning: The ability to form mental images, ideas, or concepts not present to the senses. Creative ability and inventiveness. The part of the mind that imagines. An unfounded belief or fanciful idea.
synonyms: Creativity, Fancy, Vision, Inventiveness, Ingenuity, Conception
Carefully, Diligently, Scrupulously, Meticulously, Dutifully, Responsibly
sindhiMeaning: احتياط ۽ ذميواري سان، پوري محنت ۽ ڌيان سان، ايمانداري سان، ضمير موجب صحيح ڪم ڪرڻ جي ارادي سان
urduMeaning: احتیاط اور ذمہ داری سے، پوری محنت اور توجہ سے، ایمانداری سے، ضمیر کے مطابق درست کام کرنے کے ارادے سے
examples: She conscientiously checked every report. He conscientiously followed the safety rules. The nurse conscientiously monitored each patient. They completed the assignment conscientiously and on time.
englishMeaning: In a careful, thorough, and responsible manner. In a way guided by a sincere desire to do what is right.
antonyms: Carelessly, Negligently, Recklessly, Irresponsibly, Sloppily
No direct antonym
sindhiMeaning: شاهي خاندان جي فرد جي خدمت ڪندڙ درٻاري آفيسر، بادشاهه يا راڻي جو ذاتي مددگار، تاريخي طور شاهي گهوڙن ۽ اصطبل جو نگران
urduMeaning: شاہی خاندان کے فرد کی خدمت کرنے والا درباری افسر، بادشاہ یا ملکہ کا ذاتی معاون، تاریخی طور پر شاہی گھوڑوں اور اصطبل کا نگران
englishMeaning: An officer in a royal household who attends a monarch or another royal family member. Historically, an officer responsible for the horses and stables of a royal or noble household.
examples: The equerry accompanied the king at the ceremony. Her equerry arranged the princess’s daily engagements. In earlier times, an equerry supervised the royal stables. The queen thanked her equerry for his assistance.
synonyms: Royal attendant, Aide, Courtier, Stable master, Officer

examples: She competed in an international equestrian event. The park has a long equestrian trail. He is an experienced equestrian. An equestrian statue stands in the square.
urduMeaning: گھوڑوں یا گھڑ سواری سے متعلق، ماہر گھڑ سوار، گھڑ سواری کے کھیل میں حصہ لینے والا، گھوڑے پر سوار دکھایا گیا
englishMeaning: Relating to horses or horse riding. A person who rides horses, especially a skilled rider or participant in riding sports. Mounted on horseback, especially in a statue.
synonyms: Horse rider, Horseman, Horsewoman, Rider, Mounted
sindhiMeaning: گهوڙن يا گهوڙي سواري سان لاڳاپيل، ماهر گهوڙي سوار، گهوڙي سواري جي راند ۾ حصو وٺندڙ، گهوڙي تي سوار ڏيکاريل
antonyms: Pedestrian, Non-rider, Dismounted

examples: Freedom of speech is a basic right. The prisoner finally regained his freedom. The nation fought for freedom from foreign rule. Financial freedom allowed her to choose meaningful work.
urduMeaning: بلا ناجائز پابندی عمل یا اظہار کا حق، قید یا غلامی سے آزادی، سیاسی خود مختاری، بوجھ یا تکلیف سے نجات، حرکت اور اظہار میں کشادگی
synonyms: Liberty, Independence, Autonomy, Emancipation, Release, Self-determination
sindhiMeaning: بنا ناجائز پابندي جي عمل يا اظهار جو حق، قيد يا غلامي کان آزادي، سياسي خودمختياري، بار يا تڪليف کان ڇوٽڪارو، حرڪت ۽ اظهار ۾ کليل پن
englishMeaning: The power or right to act, speak, think, or choose without undue restraint. The state of not being imprisoned, enslaved, or controlled. Political independence or self-government. Release from an unwanted condition, burden, or obligation. Ease and openness in movement or expression.
antonyms: Captivity, Slavery, Oppression, Bondage, Restriction, Imprisonment

synonyms: Nightmare society, Hellscape, Totalitarian state, Wasteland
examples: The novel depicts a dystopia ruled by an oppressive government. In this dystopia, citizens have no privacy. The film’s dystopia warns about unchecked technology. Her story turns a perfect city into a dystopia.
englishMeaning: An imagined society or state in which people suffer greatly because of oppression, injustice, disaster, or deprivation. A frightening and undesirable future world. A work of fiction portraying such a society.
urduMeaning: ایسا خیالی معاشرہ جہاں ظلم اور محرومی کے باعث لوگ مصیبت میں ہوں، خوفناک اور ناپسندیدہ مستقبل کی دنیا، ایسے معاشرے کو دکھانے والی کہانی
antonyms: Utopia, Paradise, Ideal society, Arcadia
sindhiMeaning: اهڙو خيالي سماج جتي ظلم ۽ محرومي سبب ماڻهو تڪليف ۾ هجن، خوفناڪ ۽ ناپسنديده مستقبل جي دنيا، اهڙي سماج کي ڏيکاريندڙ ڪهاڻي

urduMeaning: ایسی طبی حالت یا وجہ جس کے باعث کوئی دوا یا علاج ناموزوں یا خطرناک ہو، علاج یا طریقۂ کار نہ کرنے کی طبی ممانعت، نقصان کا ممکنہ عامل
examples: Pregnancy is a contraindication for this medicine. The doctor checked for contraindications before surgery. A severe allergy may be an absolute contraindication. Age alone is not always a contraindication to treatment.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي طبي حالت يا سبب جنهن ڪري ڪا دوا يا علاج نامناسب يا خطرناڪ هجي، علاج يا طريقيڪار نه ڪرڻ جي طبي ممانعت، نقصان جو امڪاني عامل
synonyms: Medical restriction, Warning, Prohibition, Risk factor, Exclusion
englishMeaning: A condition, symptom, factor, or circumstance that makes a particular drug, treatment, test, or procedure inadvisable or dangerous. A reason not to use or perform something medically.
antonyms: Indication, Recommendation, Suitability, Approval

synonyms: Implantation inhibitor, Early-pregnancy interceptor, Post-fertilization agent
examples: Researchers studied a possible contragestive drug. The doctor explained how a contragestive method differs from contraception. A contragestive agent acts after fertilization. The paper discusses the medical use of contragestives.
sindhiMeaning: بارآور ٿيل آني کي رحم ۾ لڳڻ کان روڪيندڙ، بلڪل شروعاتي حمل کي جاري ٿيڻ کان روڪيندڙ طبي عامل يا طريقو، شروعاتي حمل روڪ دوا
urduMeaning: بارآور بیضے کو رحم میں پیوست ہونے سے روکنے والا، بالکل ابتدائی حمل کو جاری ہونے سے روکنے والا طبی عامل یا طریقہ، ابتدائی حمل روکنے کی دوا
englishMeaning: Relating to or denoting an agent or method intended to prevent implantation of a fertilized egg or interrupt a very early pregnancy. A substance or method with such an effect.
antonyms: No direct antonym
Implantation, Gestation continuation
englishMeaning: The prevention of implantation of a fertilized egg or the interruption of a very early pregnancy. The action or use of a contragestive agent.
urduMeaning: بارآور بیضے کو رحم میں پیوست ہونے سے روکنے کا عمل، بالکل ابتدائی حمل کو جاری ہونے سے روکنا، کنٹراجیسٹو عامل کا استعمال
examples: The article distinguishes contragestion from contraception. Contragestion occurs after fertilization. Researchers examined the timing of contragestion. The clinic provided neutral information about contragestion.
synonyms: Implantation prevention, Early-pregnancy interception, Post-fertilization intervention
sindhiMeaning: بارآور ٿيل آني کي رحم ۾ لڳڻ کان روڪڻ جو عمل، بلڪل شروعاتي حمل کي جاري ٿيڻ کان روڪڻ، ڪنٽراجيسٽو عامل جو استعمال

antonyms: Fertility aid, Conception aid, Procreative
englishMeaning: A drug, device, or method used to prevent pregnancy. Relating to or intended for contraception.
urduMeaning: حمل سے بچانے والی دوا یا آلہ، حمل روکنے کا طریقہ، مانع حمل چیز، حمل کی روک تھام سے متعلق
examples: The clinic offers several contraceptive options. Condoms are a common contraceptive. She discussed contraceptive methods with her doctor. Correct contraceptive use reduces the chance of pregnancy.
sindhiMeaning: حمل کان بچائڻ واري دوا يا اوزار، حمل روڪ طريقو، مانع حمل شيءِ، حمل جي روڪٿام سان لاڳاپيل
synonyms: Birth control, Prophylactic, Preventive, Contraception method

examples: The couple discussed contraception with their doctor. Modern contraception includes pills, implants, and barrier methods. Reliable contraception can prevent unintended pregnancy. Education about contraception supports informed choices.
urduMeaning: دوا آلے یا طریقے سے جان بوجھ کر حمل روکنا، حمل سے بچاؤ، مانع حمل تدبیر، زرخیزی پر قابو
sindhiMeaning: دوا اوزار يا طريقي سان ڄاڻي واڻي حمل روڪڻ، حمل کان بچاءُ، مانع حمل تدبير، زرخيزي تي ضابطو
englishMeaning: The deliberate prevention of pregnancy by using a drug, device, procedure, or method. The practice of controlling conception or fertility.
synonyms: Birth control, Family planning, Fertility control, Pregnancy prevention
antonyms: Conception, Fertilization, Procreation

examples: Sterilization of surgical instruments prevents infection. The laboratory follows strict sterilization procedures. She asked the doctor about permanent sterilization. Steam sterilization can destroy resistant spores.
synonyms: Decontamination, Disinfection, Autoclaving, Purification, Neutering
englishMeaning: The process of destroying or removing all microorganisms, including resistant spores, from an object or environment. A medical or surgical procedure that permanently prevents reproduction. The act of making something sterile or unproductive.
antonyms: Contamination, Infection, Fertilization, Reproduction
sindhiMeaning: سڀني جراثيمن ۽ اسپورن کي ختم ڪرڻ جو عمل، اوزار يا جاءِ کي مڪمل جراثيم کان پاڪ ڪرڻ، مستقل طور اولاد پيدا ڪرڻ جي صلاحيت ختم ڪرڻ، بانجھ ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: تمام جراثیم اور اسپورز کو ختم کرنے کا عمل، آلات یا جگہ کو مکمل جراثیم سے پاک کرنا، مستقل طور پر تولیدی صلاحیت ختم کرنا، بانجھ کرنا

synonyms: Autoclave, Disinfector, Sanitizer, Purifier, Sterilizing agent
englishMeaning: A device, machine, chemical, or person used to make something free of microorganisms. An appliance used to disinfect feeding bottles or medical instruments. An agent or procedure that makes a person or animal infertile.
urduMeaning: جراثیم ختم کرنے والا آلہ یا مشین، جراثیم کش مادہ، بوتلوں یا طبی آلات کو پاک کرنے والا آلہ، بانجھ کرنے والا عامل
examples: The hospital installed a new steam sterilizer. Place the instruments in the sterilizer after use. Parents often use a bottle sterilizer. The technician checked that the sterilizer reached the correct temperature.
sindhiMeaning: جراثيم ختم ڪرڻ وارو اوزار يا مشين، جراثيم ڪش مادو، بوتلن يا طبي اوزارن کي پاڪ ڪندڙ آلو، بانجھ ڪندڙ عامل
antonyms: Contaminator, Infecting agent
No direct antonym
sindhiMeaning: فنگس ٻوٽن يا ٻين جاندارن جو ننڍڙو توليدي ذرو، سخت حالتن ۾ زنده رهندڙ بيڪٽيريا جو آرامي جراثيمي جسم، اسپور پيدا ڪرڻ يا ڇڏڻ
urduMeaning: پھپھوندی پودوں یا دوسرے جانداروں کا چھوٹا تولیدی ذرہ، سخت حالات میں زندہ رہنے والا بیکٹیریا کا خفتہ جرثومی جسم، اسپور پیدا کرنا یا خارج کرنا
examples: The fungus releases spores into the air. Bacterial spores can survive extreme heat. Fern spores spread on the wind. The mould began to spore in the damp room.
englishMeaning: A tiny reproductive unit produced by fungi, algae, mosses, ferns, and some other organisms, capable of developing without fusion with another cell. A resistant dormant body formed by certain bacteria or other organisms to survive harsh conditions. To produce or release spores.
synonyms: Reproductive cell, Germ, Seed-like body, Endospore

examples: The laboratory purchased new equipment. Climbers must carry proper safety equipment. All camping equipment was packed in the van. Her training gave her the equipment needed for leadership.
synonyms: Apparatus, Gear, Tools, Machinery, Supplies, Kit, Outfit
antonyms: Lack, Unpreparedness, Deprivation
urduMeaning: کسی کام کے لیے درکار اوزار مشینیں یا سامان، ضروری چیزیں مہیا کرنے کا عمل، کام کے لیے ذہنی یا عملی تیاری، سازوسامان
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم لاءِ گهربل اوزار مشينون يا سامان، ضروري شيون مهيا ڪرڻ جو عمل، ڪم لاءِ ذهني يا عملي تياري، سازوسامان
englishMeaning: The tools, machines, clothing, or other items needed for a particular activity or purpose. The process of supplying someone or something with necessary items. Mental or practical preparation for a task.

synonyms: Throwaway, Single-use, Expendable, Discardable, Available
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ڀيرو استعمال ڪري اڇلائڻ لاءِ ٺهيل، خرچ يا استعمال لاءِ موجود، آساني سان بدلائي سگهجندڙ يا غير اهم سمجهيل، هڪ ڀيرو استعمال ٿيندڙ شيءِ
examples: The nurse put on disposable gloves. Disposable cameras remain useful at some events. Her disposable income increased this year. Workers should never be treated as disposable.
antonyms: Reusable, Durable, Permanent, Indispensable, Reserved
englishMeaning: Designed to be used once or for a short time and then thrown away. Available for use or spending after necessary commitments, especially income. Considered easily replaceable or unimportant. A product intended to be discarded after use.
urduMeaning: ایک بار استعمال کرکے پھینکنے کے لیے بنایا گیا، خرچ یا استعمال کے لیے دستیاب، آسانی سے بدلنے کے قابل یا غیر اہم سمجھا گیا، یک بار استعمال ہونے والی چیز

synonyms: Contagion, Disease, Contamination, Sepsis, Transmission
sindhiMeaning: جسم ۾ نقصانڪار جراثيمن جو داخل ٿي وڌڻ، جراثيمن سبب ٿيندڙ بيماري، متاثر ٿيڻ جي حالت، خراب خيالن جذبن يا ڪمپيوٽر ڪوڊ جو پکڙجڻ
englishMeaning: The invasion and multiplication of harmful microorganisms in the body. A disease or illness caused by such organisms. The process or state of being infected. The harmful spread of corrupting ideas, feelings, or computer code.
examples: The doctor treated the ear infection. Clean the cut to prevent infection. The virus caused a serious chest infection. Updated software reduced the risk of computer infection.
urduMeaning: جسم میں نقصان دہ جراثیموں کا داخل ہوکر بڑھنا، جراثیم سے پیدا ہونے والی بیماری، متاثر ہونے کی حالت، خراب خیالات جذبات یا کمپیوٹر کوڈ کا پھیلاؤ
antonyms: Health, Immunity, Cure, Disinfection, Recovery

englishMeaning: To enter a body or organism and cause disease. To contaminate something with harmful microorganisms or computer code. To spread a feeling, attitude, or influence to others. To corrupt or adversely affect.
urduMeaning: جراثیم داخل کرکے بیمار کرنا، نقصان دہ جراثیم یا کمپیوٹر کوڈ سے آلودہ کرنا، احساس یا رویہ دوسروں میں پھیلانا، خراب یا متاثر کرنا
antonyms: Disinfect, Cleanse, Purify, Sterilize, Cure, Protect
synonyms: Contaminate, Transmit, Taint, Pollute, Affect, Corrupt
examples: The virus can infect people of any age. Dirty water may infect an open wound. Malware infected several office computers. Her enthusiasm began to infect the whole team.
sindhiMeaning: جراثيم داخل ڪري بيمار ڪرڻ، نقصانڪار جراثيمن يا ڪمپيوٽر ڪوڊ سان آلوده ڪرڻ، احساس يا رويو ٻين ۾ پکيڙڻ، خراب يا متاثر ڪرڻ

examples: The infective agent was identified as a bacterium. Patients remain infective for several days. Scientists measured the virus’s infective dose. The parasite enters its infective stage inside the host.
englishMeaning: Capable of causing or transmitting infection. Relating to infection or an infectious agent. An infective organism, stage, or agent.
synonyms: Infectious, Contagious, Communicable, Transmissible, Pathogenic
antonyms: Non-infectious, Noncontagious, Harmless, Sterile, Benign
urduMeaning: انفیکشن پیدا یا منتقل کرنے کے قابل، متعدی، جرثومی بیماری سے متعلق، انفیکشن پیدا کرنے والا جاندار یا عامل
sindhiMeaning: انفيڪشن پيدا يا منتقل ڪرڻ جي قابل، وچڙندڙ، جراثيمي بيماري سان لاڳاپيل، انفيڪشن پيدا ڪندڙ جاندار يا عامل

antonyms: Clean, Pure, Sterile, Uncontaminated, Sanitized
urduMeaning: نقصان دہ زہریلے یا جرثومی مادے سے آلودہ، ناپاک یا استعمال کے لیے غیر محفوظ، برے اثر سے بگڑا ہوا، غیر معتبر مواد سے ملا ہوا
englishMeaning: Made impure, unsafe, or unsuitable by contact with harmful, poisonous, radioactive, or infectious material. Corrupted or spoiled by an undesirable influence. Marked by unreliable or mixed evidence or data.
examples: Officials closed the contaminated well. Contaminated food can cause illness. The evidence was contaminated during collection. Researchers removed contaminated data from the study.
synonyms: Polluted, Tainted, Impure, Infected, Poisoned, Adulterated
sindhiMeaning: نقصانڪار زهريلي يا جراثيمي مادي سان آلوده ٿيل، ناپاڪ يا استعمال لاءِ غير محفوظ، خراب اثر سان بگڙيل، غير معتبر مواد سان ملايل

urduMeaning: خاص طور پر، واضح اور درست انداز میں، کسی مخصوص شخص چیز مقصد یا وجہ کے لیے، مزید ٹھیک تفصیل بیان کرنے کے لیے
sindhiMeaning: خاص طور تي، چٽي ۽ صحيح نموني، ڪنهن مخصوص ماڻهو شيءِ مقصد يا سبب لاءِ، وڌيڪ درست تفصيل ڏيڻ لاءِ
antonyms: Generally, Vaguely, Broadly, Indefinitely, Ambiguously
synonyms: Particularly, Precisely, Explicitly, Exactly, Especially, Namely
englishMeaning: In a precise, definite, or explicit manner. For one particular person, thing, purpose, or reason. Used to identify a more exact example or detail.
examples: The rule specifically mentions mobile phones. This tool was designed specifically for small spaces. She asked specifically for the blue folder. Several fruits, specifically oranges and lemons, contain vitamin C.

sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن پيداوار خدمت يا تجربي کي فرد جي ضرورتن ۽ پسند مطابق ٺاهڻ، نالو يا خاص تفصيل شامل ڪري ذاتي بڻائڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي انساني يا شخصي خاصيت ڏيڻ
antonyms: Standardisation, Generalisation, Uniformity, Depersonalisation
englishMeaning: The process of adapting a product, service, message, or experience to an individual’s needs, preferences, or behaviour. The act of adding a name or unique detail to make something personal. The attribution of human or personal qualities to something.
examples: The website offers personalisation based on reading habits. Gift personalisation includes engraving a name. Personalisation can make lessons more relevant to students. The campaign used email personalisation to improve responses.
urduMeaning: کسی مصنوع خدمت یا تجربے کو فرد کی ضرورتوں اور پسند کے مطابق بنانا، نام یا منفرد تفصیل شامل کرکے ذاتی بنانا، کسی چیز کو انسانی یا شخصی صفت دینا
synonyms: Customisation, Individualisation, Tailoring, Adaptation, Personification

englishMeaning: The process of changing a product, service, software system, or experience to suit particular needs or preferences. The act of making or altering something to order.
antonyms: Standardization, Uniformity, Generalization, Fixity
urduMeaning: مصنوع خدمت یا سافٹ ویئر کو خاص ضرورتوں یا پسند کے مطابق بدلنا، اپنی مرضی کے مطابق ترتیب دینا، آرڈر کے مطابق خاص تبدیلی کرنا
sindhiMeaning: پيداوار خدمت يا سافٽ ويئر کي خاص ضرورتن يا پسند مطابق بدلائڻ، مرضي موجب ترتيب ڏيڻ، حڪم مطابق خاص تبديلي ڪرڻ
synonyms: Personalization, Modification, Tailoring, Adaptation, Configuration
examples: The software allows extensive customization. Car customization can include new paint and seats. Customers value the customization of their orders. The dashboard offers simple customization options.

englishMeaning: To adapt or design something for a particular individual’s needs, preferences, or identity. To add a name, message, or unique detail to something. To treat or present something in personal rather than general terms.
antonyms: Standardise, Generalise, Depersonalise, Uniformise
examples: You can personalise the bag with your name. Teachers personalise lessons for different learners. She personalised her desk with family photographs. Try not to personalise a general criticism.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي فرد جي ضرورت پسند يا سڃاڻپ مطابق ٺاهڻ، نالو پيغام يا خاص تفصيل شامل ڪرڻ، ڳالهه کي عام بدران ذاتي انداز ڏيڻ
synonyms: Customise, Individualise, Tailor, Adapt, Monogram, Humanise
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو فرد کی ضرورت پسند یا شناخت کے مطابق بنانا، نام پیغام یا منفرد تفصیل شامل کرنا، بات کو عمومی کے بجائے ذاتی انداز دینا

antonyms: Generic, Standard, Impersonal, Mass-produced, Uniform
urduMeaning: ذاتی نوعیت کا بنایا گیا، کسی فرد کی پسند کے مطابق تیار کردہ، شخصی ضروریات کے مطابق ڈھالا گیا، نام یا خاص نشان کے ساتھ مخصوص کیا گیا
examples: She received a personalised gift with her name engraved on it. The company sent personalised recommendations based on his browsing history. He ordered a personalised number plate for his new car. The teacher created a personalised learning plan for each student.
englishMeaning: Made or designed to meet the specific needs, tastes, or identity of a particular person. Adapted or customized for an individual rather than kept generic. Bearing a person's name or other unique details.
synonyms: Customized, Tailored, Individualized, Bespoke, Adapted
sindhiMeaning: ذاتي بڻايل، ڪنهن شخص جي پسند مطابق ٺاهيل، فرد جي ضرورتن مطابق ترتيب ڏنل، نالي يا خاص نشان سان مخصوص ڪيل

examples: You can personalize your phone case with a favorite photograph. The store can personalize each invitation with the guest's name. She personalizes her emails instead of sending generic replies. Many apps let users personalize their home screens.
synonyms: Customize, Individualize, Tailor, Adapt, Modify
sindhiMeaning: ذاتي بڻائڻ، ڪنهن شخص جي پسند مطابق ٺاهڻ، نالو يا خاص نشانيون شامل ڪري منفرد ڪرڻ، ڪنهن معاملي کي ذاتي رخ ڏيڻ
antonyms: Standardize, Generalize, Depersonalize, Homogenize
urduMeaning: ذاتی بنانا، کسی کی پسند کے مطابق ڈھالنا، نام یا خاص نشان لگا کر منفرد بنانا، کسی معاملے کو شخصی رنگ دینا
englishMeaning: To design or alter something to suit an individual's particular needs, tastes, or identity. To make something personal by adding a name, initials, message, or distinctive details. To present or interpret an issue in terms of a particular person.

sindhiMeaning: ذاتي بڻايل، فرد جي نالي يا پسند مطابق ٺهيل، خاص طور هڪ شخص لاءِ ٺاهيل، انفرادي ضرورتن موجب ترتيب ڏنل
examples: He gave her a personalized necklace with her initials on it. The website provides personalized content based on user preferences. They designed a personalized fitness plan for the athlete. The card came with a personalized message from the sender.
synonyms: Customized, Tailored, Individualized, Bespoke, Adapted
englishMeaning: Adapted specifically for a particular person, often including that person's name or preferences. Made unique to reflect individual identity, interests, or requirements. Addressed to or directed at a named individual.
urduMeaning: ذاتی بنایا گیا، کسی فرد کے نام یا پسند کے مطابق تیار کردہ، خاص طور پر ایک شخص کے لیے بنایا گیا، انفرادی ضرورت کے مطابق ڈھالا گیا
antonyms: Generic, Standard, Impersonal, Mass-produced, Uniform

examples: Personalization of marketing emails has increased customer engagement. The app's personalization features let users customize their dashboards. Retailers are investing heavily in personalization technology. Personalization can make a standard product feel unique.
sindhiMeaning: ذاتي بڻائڻ جو عمل، فرد جي پسند مطابق ترتيب ڏيڻ جو طريقو، ڪنهن شيءِ يا خدمت کي خاص شخص لاءِ موزون بڻائڻ، ذاتي تفصيلن جو استعمال
synonyms: Customization, Individualization, Tailoring, Adaptation
englishMeaning: The process of designing or adapting something to fit an individual's needs or preferences. The act of making a product, service, message, or experience unique to a particular person. The use of personal details to make communication more relevant.
antonyms: Standardization, Generalization, Uniformity, Impersonality
urduMeaning: ذاتی نوعیت دینے کا عمل، کسی فرد کی ضروریات کے مطابق ڈھالنے کا طریقہ، کسی چیز یا خدمت کو خاص شخص کے لیے موزوں بنانا، ذاتی تفصیلات کا استعمال

synonyms: Censorship, Editing, Expurgation, Deletion, Blacking-out
examples: The redaction of the classified document hid the informants' names. Journalists criticized the heavy redaction in the government report. The lawyer requested redaction of sensitive financial details. Redaction software automatically conceals personal information in scanned files.
englishMeaning: The act of editing or censoring text by removing or obscuring sensitive or confidential information. The process of preparing a document for publication by revising its content. A version of a text produced through editing or compilation.
urduMeaning: خفیہ یا حساس معلومات مٹانے یا چھپانے کا عمل، دستاویز سے حساس مواد نکالنا، متن کی تدوین و ترتیب، ترمیم شدہ نسخہ
sindhiMeaning: خفيه معلومات ختم ڪرڻ يا لڪائڻ جو عمل، دستاويز مان حساس مواد ڪڍڻ، متن جي ترميم ۽ ترتيب، ايڊٽ ڪيل نسخو
antonyms: Disclosure, Revelation, Publication, Exposure
Impermanence, Transience, Instability, Temporariness, Changeability
englishMeaning: The state or quality of lasting forever or for an indefinitely long time. The condition of remaining fixed, stable, or unchanged. The ability of a material, record, or effect to endure without fading or deterioration.
examples: The permanence of the tattoo made her think carefully before getting it. Scientists study the permanence of climate changes in ecosystems. The artist valued the permanence of oil paint over watercolor. Few things in life have true permanence.
sindhiMeaning: دائميت، هميشه رهڻ جي حالت، مستقل هجڻ جو معيار، تبديل نه ٿيڻ واري ڪيفيت، ڊگهي عرصي تائين قائم رهڻ
synonyms: Durability, Stability, Constancy, Perpetuity, Immutability
urduMeaning: دوام، ہمیشگی، مستقل ہونے کی کیفیت، غیر متغیر رہنے کی حالت، طویل عرصے تک قائم رہنے کی صلاحیت

sindhiMeaning: دائميت، مستقل هجڻ جي حالت، ڊگهي عرصي تائين قائم رهڻ، مستحڪم حيثيت، پڪي نوڪري يا رهائش
antonyms: Impermanence, Instability, Transience, Temporariness
englishMeaning: The state or quality of being permanent, lasting, or enduring without interruption. A condition of long-term stability or fixed legal or employment status. The prospect of remaining in a place or position indefinitely.
examples: The employee sought permanency after years of temporary contracts. The agreement was intended to give the arrangement greater permanency. He wanted the permanency of a stable home for his children. The committee debated the permanency of the new policy.
urduMeaning: استقلال، ہمیشگی، دیرپا رہنے کی حالت، مستقل حیثیت، پکی ملازمت یا رہائش
synonyms: Permanence, Stability, Durability, Constancy, Continuity

examples: She copied the permalink to share the blog post with her friends. Every article on the site has a unique permalink. The permalink remained active after the website was redesigned. He saved the permalink so he could return to the article later.
urduMeaning: مستقل لنک، ویب صفحے یا تحریر کا نہ بدلنے والا پتہ، ہمیشہ درست رہنے کے لیے بنایا گیا ربط، مستقل لنک فراہم کرنا
synonyms: Permanent Link, Direct Link, Fixed URL, Stable Link
englishMeaning: A permanent and stable URL that points directly to a specific web page, post, or item of online content. A hyperlink intended to remain valid even when other parts of a website change. To create or provide such a permanent link.
antonyms: Temporary Link, Dynamic URL, Broken Link, Expiring Link
sindhiMeaning: مستقل لنڪ، ويب صفحي يا تحرير جو نه بدلجندڙ پتو، هميشه صحيح رهڻ لاءِ ٺاهيل ڳنڍڻو، مستقل لنڪ مهيا ڪرڻ
هميشه منجمد زمين، مٽي يا پٿر جي اهڙي پرت جيڪا گهٽ ۾ گهٽ ٻن سالن تائين ڄميل رهي، قطبي يا اوچن علائقن جي ڄميل زمين
urduMeaning: ہمیشہ منجمد زمین، مٹی یا چٹان کی وہ تہہ جو کم از کم دو سال تک جمی رہے، قطبی یا بلند علاقوں کی برف زدہ زمین
antonyms: Unfrozen Ground, Thawed Soil, Seasonally Frozen Ground
examples: Melting permafrost is releasing trapped methane into the atmosphere. Scientists are monitoring permafrost thaw in the Arctic tundra. Buildings on permafrost require special foundations to prevent sinking. The permafrost beneath the soil has remained frozen for thousands of years.
englishMeaning: Ground consisting of soil, sediment, or rock that remains at or below freezing for at least two consecutive years. A permanently frozen layer found mainly in polar and high-altitude regions. Terrain underlain by such frozen ground.
synonyms: Frozen Ground, Permanently Frozen Soil, Tundra Ground

antonyms: Industrial Agriculture, Monoculture, Intensive Farming
urduMeaning: مستقل اور پائیدار زراعت، فطری نظام پر مبنی زرعی و سماجی منصوبہ بندی، خود کفیل ماحول بنانے کا طریقہ، پودوں جانوروں اور انسانوں کو مربوط نظام میں رکھنا
synonyms: Sustainable Agriculture, Agroecology, Eco-farming, Regenerative Farming
sindhiMeaning: مستقل ۽ پائيدار زراعت، فطري نظامن تي ٻڌل زرعي ۽ سماجي رٿابندي، پاڻڀرو ماحول ٺاهڻ جو طريقو، ٻوٽن جانورن ۽ ماڻهن کي گڏيل نظام ۾ رکڻ
englishMeaning: A system of agricultural and social design based on patterns found in natural ecosystems. A holistic approach to land use that seeks sustainable, self-sufficient, and ecologically balanced habitats. The practice of integrating plants, animals, people, water, and structures while minimizing waste.
examples: The farmer redesigned his land using the principles of permaculture. Permaculture encourages diverse crops that support one another naturally. She studied permaculture to create a self-sustaining garden. The community began a permaculture project to reduce waste and improve soil health.

sindhiMeaning: بدلائڻ يا عيوض وٺڻ جي لائق، رقم يا سامان ۾ مٽائي سگهندڙ، سڌاري يا بچائي سگهندڙ، قرض يا بانڊ واپس ادا ڪرڻ جوڳو، تلافي ٿي سگهندڙ
antonyms: Irredeemable, Unexchangeable, Hopeless, Unrecoverable
urduMeaning: قابلِ تبادلہ، رقم یا سامان کے عوض لینے کے قابل، قابلِ اصلاح یا نجات، قرض یا بانڈ کی ادائیگی کے قابل، تلافی کے قابل
synonyms: Exchangeable, Convertible, Reformable, Salvageable, Recoverable
examples: These coupons are redeemable at any branch. He believed that even serious offenders could be redeemable. The bond is redeemable after five years. The flaws are redeemable because the story remains compelling.
englishMeaning: Able to be exchanged for goods, services, money, or something else of value. Capable of being saved, reformed, or restored to a better state. Able to be repaid, bought back, or discharged at a stated time. Capable of being compensated for by a positive quality or action.

urduMeaning: نجات دہندہ، بچانے والا، ظلم یا گناہ سے آزاد کرنے والا، مذہبی معنی میں مسیحا، گروی یا کھوئی چیز واپس لینے والا
antonyms: Destroyer, Oppressor, Captor, Betrayer
sindhiMeaning: نجات ڏيندڙ، بچائيندڙ، ظلم يا گناهه کان آزاد ڪندڙ، مذهبي معنيٰ ۾ مسيحا، گروي يا وڃايل شيءِ واپس وٺندڙ
synonyms: Savior, Liberator, Rescuer, Deliverer, Reclaimer
englishMeaning: A person who saves someone or something from harm, failure, sin, or evil. A savior or liberator, especially a divine figure in religious belief. A person who buys back, reclaims, or discharges something pledged or owed.
examples: Christians refer to Jesus Christ as the Redeemer. The hero was seen as the redeemer of the oppressed village. He hoped to become the redeemer of his family's lost honor. The novel's protagonist acts as a redeemer for his troubled community.

antonyms: Neglect, Leave Unchanged, Dilapidate, Strip
urduMeaning: دوبارہ سجانا، نئے سرے سے آراستہ کرنا، رنگ فرنیچر یا ڈیزائن بدلنا، اندرونی شکل تازہ کرنا
sindhiMeaning: وري سجائڻ، نئين سر سينگارڻ، رنگ فرنيچر يا ڊزائن بدلائڻ، اندروني ڏيک کي تازو ڪرڻ
examples: They decided to redecorate the living room before the holidays. She redecorated her office with fresh paint and new furniture. We plan to redecorate the house before selling it. He redecorated his bedroom to reflect his new style.
englishMeaning: To decorate a room, building, or space again, usually with new paint, furnishings, or design. To refresh or update the appearance of an interior. To change decorative features without necessarily altering the structure.
synonyms: Refurbish, Revamp, Refresh, Remodel, Renovate

sindhiMeaning: وري سجاوٽ، نئين سر سينگارڻ جو عمل، اندروني ڊزائن جي تجديد، رنگ فرنيچر يا ترتيب بدلائڻ
antonyms: Neglect, Disrepair, Deterioration, Dilapidation
urduMeaning: دوبارہ آرائش، نئے سرے سے سجاوٹ کا عمل، اندرونی ڈیزائن کی تجدید، رنگ فرنیچر یا ترتیب کی تبدیلی
examples: The redecoration of the hotel lobby took several weeks. Her plans for redecoration included new curtains and wallpaper. The redecoration transformed the old office into a modern workspace. They funded the redecoration of the community hall.
englishMeaning: The act or process of decorating a room, building, or space again. The result of updating or refreshing an interior design. A renewal of appearance through new colors, furnishings, materials, or arrangement.
synonyms: Refurbishment, Renovation, Remodeling, Makeover, Revamping
Daze, Trance, Stupor, Confusion, Absent-mindedness
urduMeaning: حیرانی یا گم سم ہونے کی حالت، بے خبری کی کیفیت، خواب جیسی ذہنی حالت، توجہ کی عارضی کمی، حواس باختگی
examples: He walked around in a dwaal after the long flight. She seemed to be in a dwaal throughout the meeting. The afternoon heat put everyone into a dwaal. He could not concentrate because he was in a dwaal all morning.
englishMeaning: A dazed, confused, dreamy, or absent-minded state, especially in South African English. A trance-like condition in which someone is not fully aware of the surroundings. A temporary lapse of attention or mental clarity.
sindhiMeaning: منجهيل يا وائڙو حال، بيخبري جي ڪيفيت، خواب جهڙي ذهني حالت، ڌيان جي عارضي کوٽ، حواس گم هجڻ
antonyms: Alertness, Clarity, Awareness, Attentiveness
Natural Fiber, Cotton, Silk, Wool
urduMeaning: کرمپ لین نامی مضبوط مصنوعی پالئیسٹر کپڑا، شکن سے محفوظ کپڑا، ساٹھ اور ستر کی دہائی میں مقبول لباس کا کپڑا، اس کپڑے کا ملبوس
synonyms: Polyester, Synthetic Fabric, Crease-resistant Fabric, Terylene
englishMeaning: A trademark for a durable, crease-resistant polyester fabric. A textured synthetic cloth widely used for clothing in the 1960s and 1970s. A garment made from this type of fabric.
sindhiMeaning: ڪرِمپلين نالي مضبوط مصنوعي پوليسٽر ڪپڙو، گهنج نه پوڻ وارو ڪپڙو، گذريل دور ۾ لباس لاءِ مشهور ڪپڙو، انهيءَ ڪپڙي مان ٺهيل لباس
examples: Her grandmother still owns a Crimplene dress from the 1970s. Crimplene became popular because it was easy to care for. The vintage shop sold several Crimplene skirts. He remembered his mother sewing dresses from Crimplene fabric.

synonyms: Hinder, Disrupt, Hamper, Obstruct, Impede
urduMeaning: کسی کام میں رکاوٹ ڈالنا، منصوبے کو متاثر کرنا، پیش رفت یا کامیابی محدود کرنا، مزہ یا کارکردگی کم کرنا
examples: The sudden rainstorm put a crimp in our picnic plans. Rising costs put a crimp in the company's expansion strategy. His injury put a crimp in the team's championship hopes. The power outage put a crimp in the event schedule.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم ۾ رڪاوٽ وجهڻ، منصوبي کي خراب ڪرڻ، اڳڀرائي يا ڪاميابي محدود ڪرڻ، مزو يا ڪارڪردگي گهٽائڻ
englishMeaning: To interfere with, hinder, or disrupt a plan, activity, or process. To cause a setback that limits progress or success. To reduce the enjoyment, effectiveness, or smooth operation of something.
antonyms: Facilitate, Enable, Assist, Advance, Promote

examples: The new regulations put a crimp on small-business growth. Budget cuts put a crimp on the department's research efforts. The strike put a crimp on the factory's production. Bad weather put a crimp on tourism this season.
synonyms: Restrict, Limit, Curb, Constrain, Hamper
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ تي بندش يا پابندي وجهڻ، ڪم کي محدود ڪرڻ، رفتار يا واڌ گهٽائڻ، منصوبي ۾ رڪاوٽ پيدا ڪرڻ
englishMeaning: To restrict, limit, or hinder the extent or effectiveness of something. To impose a constraint on an activity, process, or plan. To slow or reduce the momentum, growth, or enjoyment of something.
antonyms: Expand, Boost, Enhance, Encourage, Facilitate
urduMeaning: کسی چیز پر پابندی یا قدغن لگانا، کام کو محدود کرنا، رفتار یا ترقی کم کرنا، منصوبے میں رکاوٹ پیدا کرنا

antonyms: Destruction, Neglect, Decay, Deterioration, Loss
urduMeaning: بچاؤ، حفاظت، نگہداشت، اصل حالت میں قائم رکھنا، تباہی یا سڑنے سے بچانا، قدرتی تاریخی یا ثقافتی ورثے کا تحفظ، غذا محفوظ کرنا
sindhiMeaning: بچاءُ، حفاظت، سنڀال، اصل حالت ۾ قائم رکڻ، تباهي يا سڙڻ کان بچائڻ، فطري تاريخي يا ثقافتي ورثي جو تحفظ، کاڌو محفوظ ڪرڻ
englishMeaning: The action of maintaining something in its original or existing state. The act of protecting something from harm, decay, loss, or destruction. The protection of natural, historical, or cultural resources. The treatment of food or biological material to prevent spoilage or decomposition.
examples: The museum is dedicated to the preservation of ancient artifacts. Salt has long been used for the preservation of meat and fish. Environmentalists are fighting for the preservation of the rainforest. Her preservation of family traditions impressed everyone.
synonyms: Conservation, Protection, Maintenance, Safeguarding, Upkeep

antonyms: Developer, Destroyer, Demolisher, Despoiler
examples: The local preservationist campaigned to save the old theater. Preservationists argued that the historic district should remain intact. As a preservationist, she spent years cataloging endangered species. The preservationist society raised funds to restore the mansion.
urduMeaning: تحفظ پسند شخص، تاریخی عمارتوں قدرتی ماحول یا ثقافتی ورثے کی حفاظت کرنے والا، تباہی یا نقصان دہ تبدیلی کا مخالف، تحفظ سے متعلق
sindhiMeaning: تحفظ پسند ماڻهو، تاريخي عمارتن فطري ماحول يا ثقافتي ورثي جي حفاظت ڪندڙ، تباهي يا نقصانڪار تبديلي جي مخالفت ڪندڙ، تحفظ سان لاڳاپيل
synonyms: Conservationist, Protector, Guardian, Custodian
englishMeaning: A person who advocates or works for the preservation of historic buildings, natural environments, or cultural heritage. Someone committed to protecting valued things from destruction or harmful change. Relating to the principles or activities of preservation.

antonyms: Self-sacrifice, Self-destruction, Recklessness, Martyrdom
englishMeaning: The instinctive or deliberate protection of oneself from harm, injury, or death. The desire and effort to keep oneself safe, alive, or secure. An innate drive that motivates protective behavior in danger. The safeguarding of one's own interests or position.
sindhiMeaning: خود حفاظتي، پاڻ کي نقصان يا موت کان بچائڻ، جيئرو ۽ محفوظ رهڻ جي جبلت، خطري وقت حفاظتي رويو، پنهنجي مفادن يا حيثيت جي حفاظت
urduMeaning: خود حفاظتی، خود کو نقصان یا موت سے بچانا، زندہ اور محفوظ رہنے کی جبلت، خطرے میں حفاظتی رویہ، اپنے مفاد یا حیثیت کا تحفظ
examples: Self-preservation is a basic instinct in living creatures. Out of self-preservation, he did not confront the armed robber. Her sense of self-preservation took over when she sensed danger. In business, self-preservation sometimes requires difficult decisions.
synonyms: Survival Instinct, Self-protection, Self-defense, Self-interest

urduMeaning: ضبطِ نفس، اپنے آپ پر قابو، مشکل حالت میں سکون، جذبات اور اعمال پر کنٹرول، اعتماد اور وقار
examples: Despite the chaos, she maintained remarkable self-possession. His self-possession during the interview impressed the panel. It takes great self-possession to remain calm in a crisis. The actor's self-possession on stage made him appear fearless.
synonyms: Composure, Poise, Calmness, Self-control, Equanimity
englishMeaning: Calmness and composure, especially in a difficult or stressful situation. The ability to control one's emotions and actions under pressure. Quiet confidence, poise, and assurance in one's behavior.
sindhiMeaning: ضبط نفس، پاڻ تي قابو، ڏکي حالت ۾ سڪون، جذبات ۽ عملن تي ڪنٽرول، اعتماد ۽ وقار
antonyms: Panic, Agitation, Nervousness, Hysteria, Confusion

englishMeaning: Calm, confident, and in control of one's feelings and behavior. Showing composure and poise under pressure. Assured and not easily disturbed or embarrassed.
synonyms: Composed, Poised, Calm, Collected, Unflappable
sindhiMeaning: پرسڪون، بااعتماد، پاڻ تي قابو رکندڙ، دٻاءَ ۾ به سنجيدگي قائم رکندڙ، آسانيءَ سان نه گهٻرائيندڙ
examples: She remained self-possessed when reporters surrounded her. The self-possessed young man handled the negotiation maturely. He delivered a self-possessed speech despite the hostile audience. Being self-possessed helped her through the stressful interview.
antonyms: Flustered, Anxious, Nervous, Agitated, Distraught
urduMeaning: پرسکون، پراعتماد، خود پر قابو رکھنے والا، دباؤ میں بھی سنجیدگی قائم رکھنے والا، آسانی سے نہ گھبرانے والا

englishMeaning: A portrait that an artist creates of themselves, usually using a mirror, photograph, or memory. A representation in art, photography, or writing that depicts the creator's own image, character, or life. A photograph taken of oneself.
synonyms: Self-image, Self-depiction, Self-study, Autobiographical Portrait
examples: Vincent van Gogh painted many self-portraits. She used a mirror to sketch a detailed self-portrait. The memoir reads like a literary self-portrait. His latest self-portrait captures both exhaustion and hope.
urduMeaning: خود تصویر، فنکار کی اپنی بنائی ہوئی تصویر، اپنے چہرے یا شخصیت کی عکاسی، تحریر میں اپنی زندگی کا خاکہ، اپنی لی ہوئی تصویر
sindhiMeaning: خود تصوير، فنڪار جي پنهنجي ٺاهيل تصوير، پنهنجي چهري يا شخصيت جي عڪاسي، لکڻيءَ ۾ پنهنجي زندگيءَ جو خاڪو، پاڻ ڪڍيل فوٽو
antonyms: Portrait of Another, Group Portrait, External Portrait

synonyms: Self-sympathy, Self-commiseration, Victimhood, Woe
urduMeaning: خود ترسی، اپنے اوپر ترس کھانا، اپنی مصیبتوں پر حد سے زیادہ غم، خود کو مظلوم سمجھنا، اپنی بدقسمتی میں ڈوبے رہنا
examples: Wallowing in self-pity will not solve your problems. After the breakup, he spent weeks lost in self-pity. She refused to give in to self-pity despite her difficulties. His constant self-pity made it hard for friends to sympathize.
