synonyms: Aforesaid, Previously Mentioned, Above-Mentioned, Preceding
antonyms: Following, Subsequent
englishMeaning: Mentioned or referred to previously in a text or speech.
urduMeaning: مذکورہ بالا، پیشتر بیان کردہ، اوپر ذکر کیا گیا
sindhiMeaning: مٿي ذڪر ٿيل، اڳ ۾ بيان ڪيل، مٿي بيان ڪيل شيءِ يا شخص

antonyms: In Accord, Compliant, Conforming
sindhiMeaning: ٽڪراءَ يا تڪرار ۾، قانون يا اصولن جي خلاف ورزي ۾، مشڪل ۾ ڦاٿل
synonyms: In Conflict, At Odds, In Violation, Entangled
englishMeaning: Into conflict or difficulty with. In violation of rules, customs, or the law, especially in the phrase ‘run afoul of’.
examples: The company ran afoul of environmental regulations and faced heavy fines. He ran afoul of the law after failing to pay his taxes. Their new policy ran afoul of local customs and caused public outrage. She was careful not to run afoul of her strict manager.
urduMeaning: تصادم یا تنازع میں، قانون یا قواعد کی خلاف ورزی میں، مشکل میں پھنسا ہوا
پیشگی سوچ، پہلے سے کیا گیا ارادہ، سوچا سمجھا منصوبہ، قانونی طور پر پہلے سے قائم بد نیتی
synonyms: Premeditation, Forethought, Deliberation, Prior Intent
examples: The prosecutor argued that the murder was committed with malice aforethought. The evidence suggested aforethought rather than a sudden impulse. Courts distinguish between an impulsive act and one committed with aforethought. His careful preparations showed clear aforethought.
sindhiMeaning: اڳواٽ سوچ، اڳ ۾ ڪيل ارادو، سوچي سمجهي ڪيل رٿ، قانوني طور اڳواٽ بدنيتي
englishMeaning: Thought, intention, or planning formed in advance, especially before committing an act. Premeditation, chiefly in the legal phrase ‘malice aforethought’.
antonyms: Impulse, Spontaneity, Afterthought

synonyms: Farewell, Goodbye, Valediction, Leave-Taking
examples: She bid adieu to her friends before boarding the plane. With a heavy heart, he said his final adieu to the old house. They exchanged a tearful adieu at the train station. He waved adieu as the ship slowly left the harbor.
urduMeaning: الوداع، خدا حافظ، رسمی یا آخری رخصتی، جدائی کے وقت کہا جانے والا لفظ
englishMeaning: Goodbye, especially a formal, emotional, or final farewell. An expression used when parting.
sindhiMeaning: الوداع، خدا حافظ، رسمي يا آخري موڪلاڻي، جدا ٿيڻ وقت چيو ويندڙ لفظ
antonyms: Greeting, Welcome, Salutation

synonyms: Fatty, Fat, Lipid-Rich, Corpulent
examples: Adipose tissue helps insulate the body and store energy for later use. The scan showed excess adipose tissue around the abdomen. Researchers studied how adipose cells respond to insulin. The fish has a small adipose fin near its tail.
englishMeaning: Relating to, consisting of, or containing animal fat. Fatty connective tissue that stores energy, insulates the body, and cushions organs.
urduMeaning: چربی سے متعلق، چربی پر مشتمل، جسم میں توانائی ذخیرہ کرنے اور اعضا کو تحفظ دینے والا چربی دار بافتہ
antonyms: Lean, Fat-Free, Nonadipose
sindhiMeaning: چرٻي سان لاڳاپيل، چرٻيءَ مان ٺهيل، جسم ۾ توانائي ذخيرو ڪندڙ ۽ عضون کي بچائيندڙ چرٻيءَ وارو بافتو

examples: Many religious traditions teach that the universe was created ex nihilo. Philosophers have long debated whether anything can truly arise ex nihilo. The theologian explained the doctrine of creation ex nihilo to his students. The artist seemed to create an entire imaginary world ex nihilo.
englishMeaning: Out of nothing. Created without pre-existing material, especially in philosophical or theological discussion.
synonyms: From Nothing, Out Of Nothing, Without Prior Material
antonyms: From Existing Matter, From Something
urduMeaning: عدم سے، کسی پہلے سے موجود مادے کے بغیر پیدا کیا گیا، فلسفے یا مذہب میں نیست سے تخلیق
sindhiMeaning: عدم مان، ڪنهن اڳ موجود مادي کان سواءِ پيدا ٿيل، فلسفي يا مذهب ۾ ڪجهه به نه هئڻ مان تخليق

examples: He likes to dabble in painting during his free weekends. She dabbled in stock trading before deciding it was not for her. Many students dabble in different hobbies before finding their true passion. He has dabbled in politics but never pursued it seriously.
englishMeaning: To take part in an activity casually, occasionally, or without serious commitment. To try a subject or pursuit only superficially.
synonyms: Experiment With, Tinker With, Toy With, Sample, Try
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم ۾ هلڪي يا غير سنجيده دلچسپي وٺڻ، ڪڏهن ڪڏهن شوق طور ڪرڻ، ڪنهن موضوع کي رڳو مٿاڇري طور آزمائڻ
antonyms: Specialize In, Master, Commit To, Devote Oneself To
urduMeaning: کسی کام میں سرسری یا غیر سنجیدہ دلچسپی لینا، کبھی کبھار شوق کے طور پر کرنا، کسی موضوع کو محض سطحی طور پر آزمانا

synonyms: Explode At, Snap At, Yell At, Lash Out At, Berate
urduMeaning: اچانک کسی پر شدید غصے سے بھڑک اٹھنا، کسی پر چیخنا، غصے میں سخت باتیں کہنا
examples: She blew up at her coworker after a minor misunderstanding. He rarely loses his temper, but yesterday he blew up at his brother. The coach blew up at the team for their careless mistakes. Try not to blow up at the children when they make small errors.
sindhiMeaning: اوچتو ڪنهن تي سخت ڪاوڙجي پوڻ، ڪنهن تي رڙيون ڪرڻ، غصي ۾ سخت لفظ چوڻ
englishMeaning: To suddenly become very angry with someone and speak or shout harshly at them.
antonyms: Speak Calmly To, Reassure, Console, Praise

examples: She squeezed fresh orange juice for breakfast. The battery ran out of juice halfway through the trip. His connections gave him enough juice to secure a meeting. Juice the lemons before adding the liquid to the sauce.
synonyms: Liquid, Extract, Sap, Nectar, Power, Energy, Influence, Squeeze
sindhiMeaning: ميوي  ڀاڄي يا گوشت ۾ موجود قدرتي رس، ميون يا ڀاڄين جي رس مان ٺهيل مشروب، پچائڻ دوران نڪرندڙ ذائقيدار رس، غير رسمي طور بجلي يا توانائي، اثر رسوخ يا جوش، غير رسمي طور شراب، ٻارڻ يا طاقت وڌائيندڙ اسٽيرائيڊ، رس ڪڍڻ، طاقت يا دلچسپي وڌائڻ
urduMeaning: پھل  سبزی یا گوشت میں موجود قدرتی رس، پھل یا سبزی کے رس سے بنا مشروب، پکانے کے دوران نکلنے والا ذائقے دار عرق، غیر رسمی طور پر بجلی یا توانائی، اثر و رسوخ یا جوش، غیر رسمی طور پر شراب، ایندھن یا کارکردگی بڑھانے والے اسٹیرائیڈ، رس نکالنا، طاقت یا دلچسپی بڑھانا
antonyms: Pulp, Dryness, Powerlessness, Weakness, Drain
englishMeaning: The liquid naturally contained in fruit, vegetables, or meat. A drink made from fruit or vegetable liquid. The flavorful liquid released from food during cooking. Informally, electricity, energy, power, influence, or vitality. Informally, alcohol, fuel, or performance-enhancing steroids. To extract juice from something. To add juice, energy, power, or excitement to something.
To make something more lively, exciting, attractive, powerful, or effective. To increase power, energy, speed, or performance. To stimulate or enliven a person or group.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي وڌيڪ جاندار  دلچسپ يا پرڪشش بڻائڻ، طاقت  توانائي  رفتار يا ڪارڪردگي وڌائڻ، ڪنهن شخص يا ٽولي ۾ جوش پيدا ڪرڻ
antonyms: Weaken, Dampen, Dull, Reduce, Drain
synonyms: Boost, Enhance, Energize, Enliven, Intensify, Amplify
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو زیادہ جاندار  دلچسپ یا پرکشش بنانا، طاقت  توانائی  رفتار یا کارکردگی بڑھانا، کسی شخص یا گروہ میں جوش پیدا کرنا
examples: The designers juiced up the old website with clearer images and livelier language. The mechanic juiced up the engine to improve its performance. A short pep talk juiced up the team before the final. The chef juiced up the bland sauce with fresh herbs and spices.

antonyms: Exclude, Ignore, Disregard, Overlook
urduMeaning: حساب  منصوبے  رائے یا فیصلے میں کسی حقیقت  رقم   امکان یا صورت حال کو شامل کرنا، کسی بات کو مدنظر رکھنا
englishMeaning: To include a fact, amount, possibility, or circumstance when making a calculation, plan, judgment, or decision. To take something into account.
examples: You need to factor in the cost of shipping before setting the final price. The planners factored in bad weather when scheduling the outdoor event. She factored in her commute time when planning her daily routine. Investors must factor in inflation when calculating long-term returns.
sindhiMeaning: حساب  رٿا  راءِ يا فيصلي ۾ ڪنهن حقيقت  رقم  امڪان يا حالت کي شامل ڪرڻ، ڪنهن ڳالهه کي ڌيان ۾ رکڻ
synonyms: Include, Consider, Account For, Incorporate, Allow For

sindhiMeaning: نتيجي ۾ حصو وٺندڙ حالت  حقيقت  اثر يا عنصر، رياضي ۾ اهڙو عدد يا اظهارو جيڪو ٻئي عدد کي پورو ورهائي يا ضرب سان گهربل حاصل ڏئي، واڌ يا پيماني جو درجو، واپاري ايجنٽ يا واجب الادا رقمون خريد ڪندڙ ادارو، عدد يا اظهاريي کي ضربي جزن ۾ ورهائڻ، نتيجي تي اثرانداز ٿيڻ
englishMeaning: A circumstance, fact, influence, or element that contributes to a result. A number or algebraic expression that divides another exactly or is multiplied by another to produce a given product. A level of multiplication or scale. A commercial agent or a business that buys and collects accounts receivable. To express a number or algebraic expression as a product of factors. To act as a factor in a result.
examples: Price was a major factor in her decision to buy the smaller car. Seven is a factor of twenty-one because it divides it exactly. Students learned to factor quadratic expressions in class. The company sold its unpaid invoices to a factor for immediate cash.
synonyms: Element, Component, Cause, Influence, Divisor, Agent, Constituent
urduMeaning: کسی نتیجے میں کردار ادا کرنے والی صورت حال  حقیقت  اثر یا عنصر، ریاضی میں ایسا عدد یا اظہاریہ جو دوسرے عدد کو پورا تقسیم کرے یا ضرب سے مطلوبہ حاصل دے، ضرب یا پیمانے کی مقدار، تجارتی ایجنٹ یا واجب الوصول رقوم خریدنے والا ادارہ، عدد یا اظہاریے کو ضربی اجزاء میں تقسیم کرنا، نتیجے پر اثر انداز ہونا
antonyms: Whole, Result, Product, Irrelevance

urduMeaning: کسی نتیجے کے پیدا ہونے میں حقیقت  صورت حال یا اثر کے طور پر شامل ہونا، حساب  منصوبے  رائے یا فیصلے میں کسی بات کو مؤثر عنصر کے طور پر شامل کرنا
antonyms: Be Irrelevant To, Be Excluded From, Have No Bearing On
englishMeaning: To be one of the facts, circumstances, or influences that help produce a result. To include something as a contributing element in a calculation, plan, judgment, or decision.
examples: Travel time will factor into our choice of office location. The manager factored the extra staff hours into the budget. Experience factored heavily into the committee's final decision. Analysts factored inflation into their forecasts for next year.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن نتيجي پيدا ٿيڻ ۾ حقيقت  حالت يا اثر طور حصو وٺڻ، حساب  رٿا  راءِ يا فيصلي ۾ ڪنهن ڳالهه کي اثرائتي عنصر طور شامل ڪرڻ
synonyms: Contribute To, Enter Into, Influence, Affect, Be Included In

examples: You can factor out two from every term in the expression. Researchers tried to factor out age as a variable in the study. The economist factored out seasonal effects to reveal the underlying trend. We cannot factor human error out of the risk assessment entirely.
englishMeaning: To remove or exclude a factor, variable, or influence from a calculation, analysis, or decision. In mathematics, to take a common factor outside an expression or rewrite an expression as a product of factors.
sindhiMeaning: حساب  تجزيي يا فيصلي مان ڪنهن عنصر  متغير يا اثر کي خارج ڪرڻ، رياضي ۾ مشترڪ عنصر کي اظهاريي کان ٻاهر ڪڍڻ يا اظهاريي کي ضربي جزن جي صورت ۾ لکڻ
synonyms: Exclude, Eliminate, Remove, Extract, Isolate
antonyms: Factor In, Include, Incorporate, Add
urduMeaning: حساب  تجزیے یا فیصلے سے کسی عنصر  متغیر یا اثر کو خارج کرنا، ریاضی میں مشترک عامل کو اظہاریے سے باہر نکالنا یا اظہاریے کو ضربی اجزاء کی صورت میں لکھنا

sindhiMeaning: هلڪو ۽ تڪڙو ٺڪاءُ يا ڇهاءُ ڏيڻ، اسڪرين يا ڪنٽرول کي چونڊڻ لاءِ هلڪو ڇهڻ، ٿانوَ مان مائع يا ذخيري مان وسيلو ڪڍڻ، معلومات  قابليت  پئسي يا توانائي جي ذريعي مان فائدو وٺڻ، ٽيليفون يا رابطي واري لائين سان ڳجهي ڳنڍجڻ، ڪنهن کي عهدي لاءِ چونڊڻ، هلڪو ڌڪ يا ڇهاءُ، پاڻي يا گئس جي وهڪري کي سنڀاليندڙ نلڪو، سپلاءِ مان حصو ڪڍڻ وارو ڳانڍاپو، ڳجهي نگراني هيٺ ٽيليفون لائين، اندروني پيچ ٺاهڻ جو اوزار
antonyms: Strike Hard, Ignore, Seal, Disconnect, Overlook
englishMeaning: To strike or touch something lightly and quickly, once or repeatedly. To touch a screen or control briefly to select or activate it. To draw liquid from a container or resource from a supply. To make use of a source of information, talent, money, or energy. To connect secretly to a telephone or communication line to monitor it. To choose or appoint someone for a role. A light blow or touch. A faucet or valve controlling liquid or gas. A device or connection used to draw from a supply. A secretly monitored telephone connection. A tool for cutting an internal screw thread.
urduMeaning: ہلکی اور تیز ضرب یا چھونا، اسکرین یا کنٹرول کو منتخب یا فعال کرنے کے لیے ہلکا چھونا، برتن سے مائع یا ذخیرے سے وسیلہ نکالنا، معلومات ، صلاحیت  رقم یا توانائی کے ذریعے سے فائدہ اٹھانا، ٹیلی فون یا رابطے کی لائن سے خفیہ طور پر جڑنا، کسی کو عہدے کے لیے منتخب کرنا، ہلکی ضرب یا لمس، پانی یا گیس کے بہاؤ کو قابو کرنے والا نل، رسد سے حصہ نکالنے کا اتصال، خفیہ نگرانی والی ٹیلی فون لائن، اندرونی پیچ بنانے کا اوزار
synonyms: Touch, Knock, Pat, Press, Faucet, Spigot, Draw, Access, Appoint, Monitor
examples: She tapped gently on the door before entering. Turn off the tap so the sink does not overflow. The charity hopes to tap local expertise for the project. Police obtained a warrant to tap the suspect's phone.

antonyms: Ignore, Overlook, Disconnect From, Leave Untapped
urduMeaning: کسی رسد  نظام یا نیٹ ورک سے جڑ کر اس میں سے حصہ لینا، معلومات  رقم  صلاحیت  توانائی  طلب یا جذبات کے ذریعے تک رسائی پا کر فائدہ اٹھانا
synonyms: Access, Draw On, Utilize, Harness, Exploit, Connect To
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن سپلاءِ  نظام يا نيٽ ورڪ سان ڳنڍجي ان مان حصو وٺڻ، معلومات  پئسي  قابليت  توانائي  گهرج يا جذبن جي ذريعي تائين پهچي فائدو وٺڻ
englishMeaning: To connect to a supply, system, or network and draw from it. To gain access to and make use of a source of information, money, talent, energy, demand, or emotion.
examples: The speaker knew how to tap into the audience's emotions. Engineers found a way to tap into the underground water supply. The startup wants to tap into growing demand for electric vehicles. She tapped into her creativity to solve the design problem.

synonyms: Surrender, Submit, Quit, Withdraw, Exhaust, Deplete, Type
examples: The fighter tapped out when the hold became too painful. After ten miles, I was exhausted and had to tap out. The emergency repairs tapped out our savings. She tapped out a quick reply on her phone.
englishMeaning: To signal surrender, especially in combat sports, by tapping an opponent or the floor. To quit or withdraw because of exhaustion, defeat, or inability to continue. To use up or exhaust money, energy, or another resource. To type or beat out words, a rhythm, or a signal by tapping.
antonyms: Persist, Continue, Resist, Replenish, Conserve
sindhiMeaning: خاص ڪري مقابلي واري راند ۾ مخالف يا زمين کي ٿڦڪي ڏئي شڪست مڃڻ، ٿڪاوٽ يا لاچاري سبب هٿ کڻڻ، پئسو  توانائي يا ٻيو وسيلو پورو خرچ ڪري ڇڏڻ، ٿڦڪين سان لفظ  تال يا سگنل لکڻ يا وڄائڻ
urduMeaning: خاص طور پر مقابلے کے کھیل میں حریف یا زمین کو تھپکی دے کر شکست تسلیم کرنا، تھکن یا ناکامی کے باعث دست بردار ہونا، رقم  وانائی یا دوسرے وسیلے کو مکمل طور پر ختم کرنا، تھپکیوں سے الفاظ  تال یا اشارہ لکھنا یا بجانا
مرکزی ذریعے سے مائع  برقی رو  سگنل یا دوسری رسد کا حصہ نکالنا، خارج کرنا یا موڑنا، سفر ختم کرتے وقت ٹرانسپورٹ نظام پر کارڈ یا آلہ چھونا
antonyms: Feed In, Supply, Add, Tap On
examples: Engineers tapped off some power from the main line to run the sensors. The brewer tapped off a small sample from the barrel. Remember to tap off when you leave the tram. The technician tapped off a signal to monitor the circuit.
englishMeaning: To draw, drain, or divert part of a liquid, electric current, signal, or other supply from its main source. To touch a travel card or device when leaving a transport system to record the end of a journey.
synonyms: Draw Off, Divert, Drain, Siphon, Extract, Check Out
sindhiMeaning: مکيه ذريعي مان مائع  برقي وهڪرو  سگنل يا ٻي سپلاءِ جو حصو ڪڍڻ، نيڪال ڪرڻ يا موڙڻ، سفر ختم ڪرڻ وقت ٽرانسپورٽ نظام تي ڪارڊ يا ڊوائيس ڇهڻ

examples: He sat in the corner, tapping away at his laptop for hours. She tapped away on her phone, replying to messages one by one. The writer tapped away at the keyboard late into the night. Rain tapped away steadily on the windowpane.
urduMeaning: کچھ وقت تک مسلسل ہلکی ضربیں یا تھپکیاں دیتے رہنا، کی بورڈ یا آلے پر مسلسل ٹائپ یا کام کرتے رہنا
englishMeaning: To continue tapping, typing, or striking lightly and repeatedly, often for some time. To keep working at a keyboard or device with repeated touches.
synonyms: Keep Typing, Keep Tapping, Peck Away, Continue
sindhiMeaning: ڪجهه وقت تائين لڳاتار هلڪا ٺڪاءَ يا ٿڦڪيون ڏيندو رهڻ، ڪي بورڊ يا ڊوائيس تي مسلسل ٽائيپ يا ڪم ڪندو رهڻ
antonyms: Stop, Pause, Halt, Desist

urduMeaning: جواب میں ہلکی ضرب لگانا یا کسی چیز کو ہلکے لمس سے واپس بھیجنا، آلے پر ٹائپ یا تھپکی دے کر فوراً جواب دینا، سابقہ رابطے یا وسیلے سے دوبارہ جڑنا یا فائدہ اٹھانا
antonyms: Ignore, Withhold, Keep, Disconnect
examples: The midfielder tapped the ball back to the goalkeeper. She tapped back a quick reply as soon as she saw the message. He tapped back on the wall after hearing a faint knock. We tapped back into our former supplier when stock ran low.
sindhiMeaning: جواب ۾ هلڪو ٺڪاءُ ڏيڻ يا ڪنهن شيءِ کي هلڪي ڇهاءَ سان واپس موڪلڻ، ڊوائيس تي ٽائيپ يا ٿڦڪي ڏئي جلدي جواب ڏيڻ، اڳوڻي رابطي يا وسيلي سان ٻيهر ڳنڍجڻ يا ان مان فائدو وٺڻ
englishMeaning: To tap something in return or send it back with a light touch. To reply quickly by tapping or typing on a device. In some contexts, to reconnect with or draw again on a previous contact or resource.
synonyms: Return, Reply, Respond, Send Back, Reconnect

sindhiMeaning: ڌيان ڇڪائڻ لاءِ ڪنهن سطح تي هلڪو ٺڪاءُ ڏيڻ، ٽچ اسڪرين تي آئڪن، لنڪ  بٽڻ يا جاءِ کي مختصر ڇهڻ، سفر شروع ڪرڻ وقت ٽرانسپورٽ ريڊر تي ڪارڊ يا ڊوائيس ڇهڻ
urduMeaning: توجہ حاصل کرنے کے لیے کسی سطح پر ہلکی ضرب لگانا، ٹچ اسکرین پر آئیکن، لنک، بٹن یا جگہ کو مختصر طور پر چھونا، سفر شروع کرتے وقت ٹرانسپورٹ ریڈر پر کارڈ یا آلہ چھونا
antonyms: Avoid, Ignore, Release, Tap Off
synonyms: Touch, Press, Select, Knock On, Check In
examples: Tap on the icon to open the application. She tapped on the window to get her friend's attention. Tap on at the station before boarding the train. He tapped on the table impatiently while waiting.
englishMeaning: To touch or strike a surface lightly, often to attract attention. To press an icon, link, button, or area of a touchscreen briefly. In some transit systems, to touch a card or device to a reader when beginning a journey.

examples: He tapped through the photo gallery to find the right image. She tapped through several menus before finding the settings. The user quickly tapped through the tutorial screens. I tapped through the slideshow to review every image.
synonyms: Navigate, Browse, Flip Through, Click Through, Move Through
sindhiMeaning: ڊوائيس تي بار بار ڇهڻ سان اسڪرينن  تصويرن  اختيارن يا مرحلن مان اڳتي وڌڻ، لڳاتار ٿڦڪين سان ڊجيٽل سلسلي ۾ براؤز يا نيويگيٽ ڪرڻ
antonyms: Stop, Pause, Remain, Exit
englishMeaning: To move through screens, images, options, or steps by tapping repeatedly on a device. To browse or navigate a digital sequence with successive touches.
urduMeaning: آلے پر بار بار چھونے سے اسکرینوں  تصاویر  اختیارات یا مراحل میں آگے بڑھنا، مسلسل تھپکیوں سے ڈیجیٹل سلسلے کو براؤز یا نیویگیٹ کرنا

antonyms: Ignore, Avoid, Leave Alone
urduMeaning: تلاش یا آزمائش کرتے ہوئے کسی سطح یا آلے کی مختلف جگہوں پر تھپکیاں دینا، بار بار چھونے سے انٹرفیس یا جگہ کو سرسری طور پر کھوجنا
sindhiMeaning: ڳولا يا آزمائش ڪندي ڪنهن سطح يا ڊوائيس جي مختلف هنڌن تي ٿڦڪيون ڏيڻ، بار بار ڇهڻ سان انٽرفيس يا جاءِ کي هلڪي نموني جاچڻ
englishMeaning: To tap different places on a surface or device while searching or experimenting. To explore an interface or area casually through repeated touches.
synonyms: Explore, Probe, Search, Poke Around, Experiment
examples: He tapped around the app looking for the settings menu. She tapped around the wall to locate a hollow space. The child tapped around the tablet screen out of curiosity. I tapped around the interface until I found the right button.

synonyms: Abusively, Defamatorily, Slanderously, Scandalously, Obscenely
examples: The tabloid wrote scurrilously about the actor's private life. He spoke scurrilously about his former business partner. The blog scurrilously accused the mayor of taking bribes without evidence. Critics said the pamphlet attacked the senator scurrilously and unfairly.
urduMeaning: انتہائی گالی آمیز  توہین آمیز یا فحش انداز میں، کسی کی ساکھ خراب کرنے کے لیے بدنام کن یا افترا آمیز طریقے سے
sindhiMeaning: تمام گارگند  توهين آميز يا بيهودي انداز ۾، ڪنهن جي ساک خراب ڪرڻ لاءِ بدنام ڪندڙ يا ڪوڙي الزام واري نموني
englishMeaning: In a grossly insulting, abusive, or indecent manner. In a scandalous or defamatory way intended to damage someone's reputation.
antonyms: Respectfully, Courteously, Decently, Fairly

sindhiMeaning: غير رسمي  خاص ڪري آسٽريليا ۽ نيوزيلينڊ ۾، گندو  ميرو  اڻ وڻندڙ، خسته حال يا خراب حالت وارو، ڪنجوس  بخيل يا تنگ دل
synonyms: Grubby, Dingy, Shabby, Squalid, Filthy, Stingy, Miserly
examples: The motel room was scungy and smelled of mildew. He wore a scungy old jacket to the interview. Nobody wanted to rent the scungy flat above the shop. His scungy attitude toward tipping annoyed the waiter.
englishMeaning: Informal, chiefly Australian and New Zealand: dirty, grimy, unpleasant, shabby, or in poor condition. Mean, stingy, or miserly.
urduMeaning: غیر رسمی  خصوصاً آسٹریلیا اور نیوزی لینڈ میں، گندا  میلا  ناگوار  خستہ حال یا خراب حالت والا، کنجوس  بخیل یا کم ظرف
antonyms: Clean, Immaculate, Pristine, Smart, Generous
Cleanliness, Respectable Person, Give, Clean
sindhiMeaning: غير رسمي  خاص ڪري آسٽريليا ۽ نيوزيلينڊ ۾، مير  گندگي  چيڪي مٽي يا اڻ وڻندڙ تهه، گندو  خسته حال  ڪنجوس يا بدنام ماڻهو، منٿ  اوڌر يا جوڳاڙ سان شيءِ حاصل ڪرڻ، سطح تان مير صاف ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: غیر رسمی  خصوصاً آسٹریلیا اور نیوزی لینڈ میں، میل  غلاظت  چکنی گندگی یا ناگوار تہہ، گندا  خستہ حال  کنجوس یا بدنام شخص، مانگ کر  ادھار یا جوڑ توڑ سے چیز حاصل کرنا، سطح سے میل صاف کرنا
examples: There was a layer of scunge on the old cooker. He is a scunge who is always borrowing money and never repaying it. She scrubbed the scunge off the bathroom tiles. The children tried to scunge free tickets from the box office.
synonyms: Grime, Dirt, Slime, Scrounger, Sponger, Beg, Scrounge, Scrub
englishMeaning: Informal, chiefly Australian and New Zealand: dirt, grime, slime, or an unpleasant residue. A dirty, shabby, mean, or disreputable person. To obtain something by begging, borrowing, or scrounging. To clean grime from a surface.

examples: The technician connected the ammeter to measure the current in the wire. A faulty ammeter can give inaccurate readings. The dashboard ammeter showed that the battery was charging. Students used an ammeter in the physics lab to test a simple circuit.
sindhiMeaning: برقي رو کي ايمپيئرن ۾ ماپڻ وارو اوزار، جيڪو عام طور ماپ هيٺ سرڪٽ سان سلسليوار ڳنڍيو ويندو آهي
synonyms: Current Meter, Ampere Meter
antonyms: No Direct Antonym
englishMeaning: An instrument that measures electric current in amperes, normally connected in series with the circuit being measured.
urduMeaning: برقی رو کو ایمپیئر میں ناپنے والا آلہ، جسے عموماً زیر پیمائش سرکٹ کے ساتھ سلسلہ وار جوڑا جاتا ہے
لسانیات اور فلسفے میں ایسے فعل  اظہار یا ذہنی حالت کے لیے جو متعلقہ جملے کی صداقت کو پہلے سے تسلیم کرے یا لازم قرار دے، جیسے جاننا اور احساس کرنا، حقائق سے متعلق یا حقائق پر مبنی
sindhiMeaning: لسانيات ۽ فلسفي ۾ اهڙي فعل  اظهار يا ذهني حالت لاءِ جيڪو لاڳاپيل جملي جي سچائي کي اڳواٽ مڃي يا لازمي بڻائي، جيئن ڄاڻڻ ۽ احساس ڪرڻ، حقيقتن سان لاڳاپيل يا حقيقتن تي ٻڌل
antonyms: Non-Factive, Nonveridical, Counterfactual
synonyms: Presuppositional, Veridical, Fact-Based
englishMeaning: In linguistics and philosophy, describing a verb, expression, or mental state that presupposes or entails the truth of the clause associated with it, as ‘know’ and ‘realize’ do. Concerned with or based on facts.
examples: Linguists classify know as a factive verb because it presupposes the truth of what follows. Unlike believe, a factive predicate implies that the embedded statement is true. Philosophers study factive attitudes to distinguish knowledge from mere belief. The professor contrasted factive and non-factive expressions in class.

antonyms: No Direct Antonym
urduMeaning: کسی مثبت صحیح عدد اور اس سے چھوٹے تمام مثبت صحیح اعداد کا حاصل ضرب، جسے علامت تعجب سے لکھا جاتا ہے، صفر کا فیکٹوریل ایک ہے، عوامل سے متعلق، شماریات یا تجرباتی ڈیزائن میں دو یا زیادہ عوامل کو ملا کر جانچنے والا
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن مثبت صحيح عدد ۽ ان کان ننڍن سڀني مثبت صحيح عددن جو حاصل ضرب، جيڪو عجب جي نشاني سان لکيو وڃي، صفر جو فيڪٽوريل هڪ آهي، عنصرن سان لاڳاپيل، شماريات يا تجرباتي رٿا ۾ ٻن يا وڌيڪ عنصرن کي گڏ آزمائيندڙ
examples: The factorial of five is one hundred and twenty. Students use factorials when solving problems in probability and combinatorics. The researcher designed a factorial experiment to test several variables together. Calculating very large factorials by hand is impractical.
synonyms: Factorial Product, Multifactor, Factor-Based
englishMeaning: The product of a positive integer and every smaller positive integer, written with an exclamation mark; zero factorial equals one. Relating to factors. In statistics and experimental design, involving two or more factors tested in combination.

A place or perch where birds or bats rest or sleep. A group of birds occupying such a place. Informally, a temporary place to sleep or stay. To settle or gather for rest or sleep, especially on a perch.
antonyms: Take Flight, Depart, Leave
synonyms: Perch, Resting Place, Nest, Lodge, Settle
urduMeaning: پرندوں یا چمگادڑوں کے آرام یا سونے کی جگہ یا ڈنڈا، ایسی جگہ پر جمع پرندوں کا جھنڈ، غیر رسمی طور پر عارضی قیام یا سونے کی جگہ، خصوصاً ڈنڈے پر آرام یا نیند کے لیے بیٹھنا یا جمع ہونا
examples: The hens returned to their roost as the sun began to set. Hundreds of bats roost in the cave during the day. The old barn served as a roost for dozens of pigeons. After the long journey, the travelers found a roost for the night.
sindhiMeaning: پکين يا چمگادڙن جي آرام يا سمهڻ جي جاءِ يا ڏانڊو، اهڙي جاءِ تي گڏ ٿيل پکين جو ٽولو، غير رسمي طور عارضي رهائش يا سمهڻ جي جاءِ، خاص ڪري ڏانڊي تي آرام يا ننڊ لاءِ ويهڻ يا گڏ ٿيڻ

synonyms: Be In Charge, Call The Shots, Dominate, Lead, Hold Sway
sindhiMeaning: گهر  ٽولي  ڪم واري هنڌ يا صورتحال ۾ سڀ کان وڌيڪ اختيار  اثر يا ڪنٽرول رکڻ، حاوي رهڻ يا حڪم هلائڻ
examples: In their household, Grandmother clearly rules the roost. Although she is a junior employee, she seems to rule the roost in every meeting. The oldest child ruled the roost while the parents were away. Since the manager left, no one has really ruled the roost in the office.
urduMeaning: گھر  گروہ  کام کی جگہ یا صورت حال میں سب سے زیادہ اختیار  اثر یا کنٹرول رکھنا، حاوی ہونا یا حکم چلانا
englishMeaning: To be the person who has the greatest authority, influence, or control in a household, group, workplace, or situation. To dominate or be in charge.
antonyms: Be Subordinate, Follow, Obey, Take Orders

sindhiMeaning: اهڙو مونجهارو جنهن ۾ ٻه شيون هڪ ٻئي تي دارومدار رکن ۽ اهو طئي ڪرڻ ڏکيو يا ناممڪن هجي ته ڪهڙي پهرين آئي يا ٻيءَ جو سبب بڻي، گول چڪر واري سبب ۽ نتيجي جو مسئلو
synonyms: Circular Dilemma, Causal Loop, Vicious Circle, Catch-22
urduMeaning: ایسی الجھن جس میں دو چیزیں ایک دوسرے پر منحصر ہوں اور یہ طے کرنا مشکل یا ناممکن ہو کہ کون پہلے آئی یا دوسری کا سبب بنی، دائرہ وار سبب اور نتیجے کا مسئلہ
examples: Whether low confidence causes poor performance or the reverse is a chicken-and-egg situation. Startups and investors often face a chicken-and-egg situation over funding and growth. The need for users and the need for content created a chicken-and-egg situation for the platform. Economists debate whether low wages reduce skills or low skills reduce wages, another chicken-and-egg situation.
englishMeaning: A dilemma in which two things depend on each other, making it difficult or impossible to determine which came first or caused the other. A problem of circular cause and effect.
antonyms: Clear Causality, Straightforward Sequence, Definite Cause

synonyms: Reap What You Sow, Pay The Price, Face The Consequences, Catch Up With
examples: Years of ignored maintenance came home to roost when the roof collapsed. His reckless spending came home to roost when the debts piled up. The company's poor labor practices eventually came home to roost in a public scandal. Her habit of missing deadlines came home to roost during the annual review.
urduMeaning: کسی شخص کے گزشتہ اعمال کے نتائج  خصوصاً برے نتائج جو آخرکار لوٹ کر اسی شخص کو متاثر کریں، غلطی یا برائی بالآخر اپنا مناسب نتیجہ دکھائے
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن جي گذريل عملن جا نتيجا  خاص ڪري خراب نتيجا جيڪي آخرڪار موٽي ساڳئي ماڻهو کي متاثر ڪن، غلطي يا غلط ڪم نيٺ پنهنجو جوڳو نتيجو ڏئي
englishMeaning: The consequences, especially harmful ones, of a person's past actions eventually return to affect that person. A mistake or wrongdoing finally produces the result it deserves.
antonyms: Escape The Consequences, Go Unpunished, Avoid Repercussions
Back Down, Concede, Compromise, Withdraw
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي خطرناڪ مقابلي يا ٽڪراءَ ۾ شامل ٿيڻ جنهن ۾ هر ڌر ٻئي جي همت هارڻ ۽ پهرين پوئتي هٽڻ جو انتظار ڪري، پوئتي نه هٽڻ لاءِ سنگين نقصان جو خطرو کڻڻ
synonyms: Engage In Brinkmanship, Face Off, Dare, Hold One's Ground
englishMeaning: To take part in a dangerous contest or confrontation in which each side waits for the other to lose courage and withdraw first. To engage in brinkmanship by risking serious harm rather than backing down.
examples: The two nations seemed to be playing chicken over the disputed border. Both companies played chicken in the negotiations and refused to compromise first. Teenagers who play chicken with oncoming traffic risk their lives. The rival firms played chicken in the price war, each waiting for the other to retreat.
urduMeaning: ایسے خطرناک مقابلے یا تصادم میں شامل ہونا جس میں ہر فریق دوسرے کے حوصلہ ہارنے اور پہلے پیچھے ہٹنے کا انتظار کرے، پیچھے نہ ہٹنے کے لیے سنگین نقصان کا خطرہ مول لینا

sindhiMeaning: نتيجو اچڻ کان اڳ ڪاميابي پڪي نه سمجهڻ، اڻ پڪ فائدي تي اڳواٽ منصوبا نه ٺاهڻ، ڪم مڪمل ٿيڻ کان اڳ خوشي نه ملهائڻ، اميد کي حقيقت سمجهي نه ويهڻ
englishMeaning: Do not assume that a hoped-for result will happen before it actually does. Do not make plans based on success that is still uncertain. Avoid celebrating, spending, or promising future gains too early.
antonyms: Take it for granted, Assume success, Celebrate prematurely, Jump the gun
word: Don't count your chickens before they hatch
synonyms: Do not jump the gun, Do not get ahead of yourself, Wait and see, Do not assume success, Avoid premature celebration
urduMeaning: نتیجہ آنے سے پہلے کامیابی یقینی نہ سمجھنا، غیر یقینی فائدے پر پہلے سے منصوبہ نہ بنانا، کام مکمل ہونے سے پہلے جشن نہ منانا، امید کو حقیقت نہ سمجھ بیٹھنا
examples: Don't count your chickens before they hatch; the loan has not been approved yet. She was already planning a celebration, but I warned her not to count her chickens before they hatch. We may win the contract, though we should not count our chickens before they hatch. He spent his expected bonus early and learned not to count his chickens before they hatch.

urduMeaning: برے اعمال کے نتائج آخرکار خود بھگتنا، ماضی کی غلطیوں کا لوٹ کر مصیبت بننا، کی ہوئی برائی کا بدلہ ملنا، اپنے اعمال کے نتائج سے بچ نہ سکنا
synonyms: Face the consequences, Reap what you sow, Pay the price, Get one's comeuppance, Actions have consequences
englishMeaning: Bad actions eventually bring unpleasant consequences to the person responsible. Past mistakes or wrongdoing eventually return to cause trouble. The results of one's choices, especially harmful ones, cannot be avoided forever.
examples: After years of dishonest dealing, his chickens finally came home to roost. The company ignored safety rules, and now the chickens have come home to roost. Her careless spending caught up with her when the chickens came home to roost. When the scandal became public, the politician's chickens came home to roost.
antonyms: Escape the consequences, Go unpunished, Get away with it, Avoid accountability
sindhiMeaning: خراب عملن جا نتيجا آخرڪار پاڻ ڏانهن موٽڻ، ماضي جون غلطيون نيٺ تڪليف ڏيڻ، ڪيل برائي جو بدلو ملڻ، پنهنجي عملن جا نتيجا ڀوڳڻ

synonyms: Panic, Rush about, Flail around, Act frantically, Be in a tizzy, Be disorganized
examples: I spent the morning running around like a headless chicken before the guests arrived. Without a schedule, the team ran around like headless chickens. Stop running around like a headless chicken and decide what needs to be done first. He was running around like a headless chicken after losing his passport.
urduMeaning: گھبراہٹ میں بے ترتیبی سے بھاگنا، بہت مصروف ہو کر بھی مؤثر کام نہ کرنا، بغیر منصوبے کے افراتفری میں کام کرنا، الجھن میں ادھر ادھر دوڑنا
englishMeaning: To rush about in a confused, panicked, and disorganized way. To be extremely busy without acting effectively. To react to a problem without a clear plan or direction.
word: Run around like a headless chicken
sindhiMeaning: گهٻراهٽ ۾ بي ترتيب ڊوڙڻ، تمام مصروف هوندي به اثرائتو ڪم نه ڪرڻ، بنا منصوبي جي افراتفري ۾ ڪم ڪرڻ، مونجهاري ۾ هيڏانهن هوڏانهن ڀڄڻ
antonyms: Stay calm, Act methodically, Remain composed, Work systematically, Be organized
Hen, Pullet, Female chicken
englishMeaning: An adult male chicken. A male domestic fowl known for crowing, especially at dawn. A proud, confident, or showy man, used informally.
sindhiMeaning: بالغ نر ڪڪڙ، ٻانگ ڏيندڙ نر گهريلو پکي، خاص ڪري صبح جو ٻانگ ڏيندڙ ڪڪڙ، غير رسمي طور مغرور يا ڏيکاءُ ڪندڙ مرد
urduMeaning: بالغ نر مرغ، بانگ دینے والا نر گھریلو پرندہ، خصوصاً صبح کے وقت بانگ دینے والا مرغ، غیر رسمی طور پر مغرور یا دکھاوا کرنے والا مرد
synonyms: Cock, Cockerel, Male chicken, Chanticleer
examples: The rooster crowed just before sunrise. A bright red comb stood on the rooster's head. The farmer keeps one rooster with the hens. He strutted into the room like a proud rooster.

englishMeaning: A person or appliance that roasts food. A pan or container used for roasting food in an oven. An animal or food item suitable for roasting. A person who humorously criticizes or mocks someone at a roast.
urduMeaning: کھانا بھوننے یا روسٹ کرنے والا شخص، کھانا روسٹ کرنے والا آلہ، تندور میں بھوننے کا برتن یا پین، روسٹ کرنے کے لیے موزوں جانور یا غذا، مزاحیہ انداز میں کسی پر تنقید کرنے والا شخص
antonyms: Cooler, Uncooked food, Praiser, Complimenter
sindhiMeaning: کاڌو ڀُڃڻ يا سيڪڻ وارو ماڻهو، کاڌو روسٽ ڪرڻ وارو اوزار، اوون ۾ ڀُڃڻ لاءِ ٿانو يا پان، روسٽ ڪرڻ لاءِ مناسب جانور يا کاڌي جي شيءِ، مذاق ۾ ڪنهن تي تنقيد ڪندڙ شخص
synonyms: Roasting pan, Roasting oven, Roasting appliance, Mocking speaker, Satirist
examples: She placed the chicken in a large roaster. This electric roaster can cook a whole turkey. The chef is an expert coffee roaster. The comedian was the sharpest roaster on the panel.

antonyms: Clear sky, Trail-free sky, Dissipation
urduMeaning: بلندی پر جہاز کے پیچھے بننے والی پانی کے بخارات یا برف کے باریک ذرات کی سفید لکیر، گرم اخراج اور ٹھنڈی ہوا کے ملنے سے بننے والا عارضی بادل نما نشان، تیز رفتار چیز کے پیچھے رہ جانے والی بخاراتی لکیر
englishMeaning: A visible line of condensed water vapour or ice crystals left behind an aircraft at high altitude. A temporary cloudlike trail formed when hot exhaust mixes with cold air. A streak of vapour left by a fast-moving object.
examples: A white vapour trail stretched across the blue sky. The jet left a long vapour trail behind it. Cold air helped the vapour trail remain visible for several minutes. We watched two vapour trails cross above the airport.
sindhiMeaning: اوچائي تي جهاز پٺيان ٺهندڙ پاڻيءَ جي ٻاڦ يا برف جي سنهڙن ذرڙن جي سفيد ليڪ، گرم دونهين ۽ ٿڌي هوا جي ملڻ سان ٺهندڙ عارضي ڪڪر جهڙو نشان، تيز هلندڙ شيءِ پٺيان رهجي ويل ٻاڦ جو نشان
synonyms: Contrail, Condensation trail, Exhaust trail, Vapor streak
Unreleased software, Phantom product, Nonexistent product, Paper product, Unfulfilled promise
examples: The much-advertised game became vapourware after years of delays. Customers were skeptical that the device was more than vapourware. The company denied that its new operating system was vapourware. Investors lost interest when the promised product remained vapourware.
englishMeaning: Software or hardware announced publicly but never released. A technology product promoted long before it becomes available. A promised product that remains unfinished, delayed, or imaginary.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙو سافٽ ويئر يا هارڊويئر جنهن جو اعلان ٿئي پر جاري نه ٿئي، دستيابي کان گهڻو اڳ مشهور ڪيل ٽيڪنالاجي پيداوار، اڻپورو يا لڳاتار دير جو شڪار واعدو ڪيل پراڊڪٽ، خيالي پيداوار
urduMeaning: ایسا سافٹ ویئر یا ہارڈ ویئر جس کا اعلان ہو مگر جاری نہ ہو، دستیابی سے بہت پہلے مشتہر کی گئی ٹیکنالوجی، نامکمل یا مسلسل تاخیر کا شکار وعدہ شدہ پراڈکٹ، خیالی مصنوعہ
antonyms: Released product, Available software, Finished product, Shipping product

englishMeaning: The quality or degree of being likely to change. The amount of difference among values, people, objects, or conditions. In statistics, the extent to which data points differ from one another. The capacity to vary over time or across situations.
antonyms: Uniformity, Stability, Consistency, Constancy, Sameness
synonyms: Variation, Changeability, Fluctuation, Diversity, Dispersion, Inconsistency
urduMeaning: تبدیلی پذیری، بدلنے کی خصوصیت یا درجہ، اقدار افراد اشیا یا حالات میں فرق، اعداد و شمار کا ایک دوسرے سے مختلف ہونا، وقت یا حالات کے ساتھ بدلنے کی صلاحیت
examples: Weather variability makes long-term planning difficult. The study measured variability in students' test scores. Genetic variability helps a species adapt to change. There is considerable variability in the quality of these materials.
sindhiMeaning: تبديلي پذيري، بدلجڻ جي خاصيت يا درجو، قدرن ماڻهن شين يا حالتن ۾ فرق، انگن اکرن جو هڪ ٻئي کان مختلف هجڻ، وقت يا حالتن سان بدلجڻ جي صلاحيت

englishMeaning: Not presupposing or guaranteeing that the statement following a verb or expression is true. Describing a linguistic construction whose complement may be true or false. Not based on an established fact.
examples: The verb “believe” is non-factive because the belief may be false. Linguists classified the expression as non-factive. A non-factive verb does not guarantee the truth of its complement. The paper compares factive and non-factive constructions.
urduMeaning: ایسا لسانی اظہار جو بعد میں آنے والے جملے کی سچائی کو لازم نہ سمجھے، ایسی ساخت جس کا ذیلی جملہ درست یا غلط ہو سکتا ہو، ثابت شدہ حقیقت پر مبنی نہ ہونا
sindhiMeaning: اهڙو لساني اظهار جيڪو پٺيان ايندڙ جملي جي سچائي کي لازم نه سمجهي، اهڙي بناوت جنهن جو ضمني جملو سچو يا ڪوڙو ٿي سگهي، ثابت ٿيل حقيقت تي ٻڌل نه هئڻ
synonyms: Nonveridical, Non-presuppositional, Unverified, Not fact-implying
antonyms: Factive, Veridical, Fact-implying, Truth-presupposing

synonyms: Fat-free, Zero-fat, Skim, Defatted, Lean
examples: She ordered a nonfat yogurt for breakfast. The café offers nonfat milk at no extra charge. This dressing is nonfat but still flavorful. He switched to nonfat dairy products on his doctor's advice.
sindhiMeaning: چرٻي کان خالي، تمام ٿوري يا قانوني حد کان گهٽ چرٻي رکندڙ، گهڻي يا سموري چرٻي ڪڍيل کاڌو، بنا چرٻي واري خوراڪ
englishMeaning: Containing no fat or only a legally insignificant amount of fat. Made after most or all fat has been removed. Describing food marketed as fat-free.
antonyms: Full-fat, Fatty, High-fat, Whole-milk
urduMeaning: چکنائی سے پاک، بہت کم یا قانونی حد سے کم چکنائی رکھنے والا، زیادہ تر یا تمام چکنائی نکالی ہوئی غذا، بغیر چکنائی والی خوراک

examples: She reads more non-fiction than novels. The prize recognizes outstanding works of non-fiction. His latest book is a non-fiction account of the expedition. Our library keeps fiction and non-fiction in separate sections.
sindhiMeaning: حقيقتن حقيقي ماڻهن ۽ سچن واقعن تي ٻڌل لکڻي، معلوماتي يا استدلالي ادب، حقيقي دنيا کي صحيح نموني بيان ڪندڙ ڪتاب يا فلم، غير افسانوي ادب
synonyms: Factual writing, Documentary literature, Informational writing, Prose account, True story
antonyms: Fiction, Fantasy, Fabrication, Imaginary writing
englishMeaning: Writing based on facts, real people, and actual events rather than invented stories. The branch of literature that presents factual information or argument. Books, films, or other works intended to describe reality accurately.
urduMeaning: حقائق حقیقی لوگوں اور سچے واقعات پر مبنی تحریر، معلوماتی یا استدلالی ادب، حقیقی دنیا کو درست طور پر بیان کرنے والی کتاب یا فلم، غیر افسانوی ادب

synonyms: Absence, Nothingness, Nonbeing, Unreality, Void, Lack
sindhiMeaning: وجود نه هجڻ جي حالت، مڪمل اڻهوند، ڪنهن هنڌ يا حقيقت ۾ غير موجودگي، اميد ڪيل شيءِ جي کوٽ يا نه هجڻ
examples: The theory argues for the non-existence of absolute certainty. Investigators confirmed the non-existence of the alleged document. The non-existence of public transport causes problems for villagers. It is difficult to prove the non-existence of something.
urduMeaning: وجود نہ ہونے کی حالت، مکمل عدم موجودگی، کسی جگہ یا حقیقت میں غیر موجودگی، متوقع چیز کی کمی یا نہ ہونا
antonyms: Existence, Presence, Reality, Being, Availability
englishMeaning: The state of not existing. Complete absence from reality or a particular place. The lack of something that might be expected or claimed to exist.

antonyms: Existing, Real, Present, Available, Actual
urduMeaning: غیر موجود، وجود نہ رکھنے والا، حقیقی نہ ہونا، کسی جگہ یا حالت میں ناپید، اتنا کم یا ناکافی کہ گویا موجود ہی نہ ہو
englishMeaning: Not existing or not real. Absent from a place or situation. So scarce, weak, or inadequate that it is effectively absent.
examples: The address he gave us was non-existent. Public transport in the remote village is almost non-existent. Their evidence for the claim was non-existent. She searched for a non-existent file all afternoon.
sindhiMeaning: غير موجود، وجود نه رکندڙ، حقيقي نه هئڻ، ڪنهن جاءِ يا حالت ۾ اڻلڀ، ايترو گهٽ يا ڪمزور جو ڄڻ موجود ئي نه هجي
synonyms: Absent, Imaginary, Unreal, Missing, Unavailable, Fictitious

antonyms: Lubrication, Smoothness, Harmony, Agreement, Cooperation, Ease
englishMeaning: The resistance that occurs when one surface moves against another. Conflict, tension, or disagreement between people or groups. Difficulty that slows a process or makes an interaction less smooth. The rubbing of one object against another.
urduMeaning: دو سطحوں کے ایک دوسرے پر حرکت کرنے سے پیدا ہونے والی مزاحمت، رگڑ، افراد یا گروہوں کے درمیان کشیدگی یا اختلاف، عمل میں رکاوٹ یا دشواری، چیزوں کا ایک دوسرے سے گھسنا
examples: Friction between the tires and the road helps the car stop. Constant friction damaged the moving parts. Political differences created friction within the coalition. The new checkout system reduces friction for customers.
sindhiMeaning: ٻن سطحن جي هڪ ٻئي تي هلڻ وقت پيدا ٿيندڙ مزاحمت، رڳڙ، ماڻهن يا گروهن وچ ۾ ڇڪتاڻ يا اختلاف، ڪم ۾ رڪاوٽ يا ڏکيائي، شين جو هڪ ٻئي سان گسڻ
synonyms: Resistance, Rubbing, Drag, Tension, Conflict, Discord, Obstacle

examples: Air bearings allow nearly frictionless movement. The app aims to provide a frictionless payment experience. Their cooperation made the transition almost frictionless. In the model, the block slides on a frictionless surface.
urduMeaning: رگڑ سے پاک یا بہت کم رگڑ والا، بغیر رکاوٹ تاخیر یا تنازع کے ہموار، آسانی سے چلنے والا، طبیعیات میں رابطے کی مزاحمت سے پاک تصور کیا گیا
synonyms: Smooth, Seamless, Effortless, Unobstructed, Resistance-free
antonyms: Rough, Resistant, Obstructed, Difficult, Conflict-ridden
englishMeaning: Having little or no friction between moving surfaces. Smooth and easy, without obstacles, delays, or conflict. In physics, idealized as operating without resistance caused by contact.
sindhiMeaning: رڳڙ کان خالي يا تمام گهٽ رڳڙ وارو، بنا رڪاوٽ دير يا تڪرار جي هموار، آساني سان هلندڙ، طبعيات ۾ رابطي واري مزاحمت کان پاڪ تصور ڪيل
وات جي سوڙهي رستي مان هوا گذارڻ سان پيدا ٿيندڙ گهسڻ واري تقرير جو آواز، مسلسل هوا سان ٺهندڙ حرف صحيح جهڙوڪ ف س و ز، اهڙي آواز سان لاڳاپيل
englishMeaning: A speech sound made by forcing air through a narrow passage in the mouth, creating audible friction. A consonant such as f, s, v, or z produced with continuous airflow. Relating to this type of speech sound.
urduMeaning: منہ کے تنگ راستے سے ہوا گزار کر رگڑ پیدا کرنے والی تقریری آواز، مسلسل ہوا سے بننے والا حرف صحیح جیسے ف س و ز، ایسی آواز سے متعلق
antonyms: Stop consonant, Plosive, Occlusive
synonyms: Spirant, Friction consonant, Continuant consonant
examples: The sound /f/ is a voiceless fricative. Students practiced producing English fricatives. The word begins with a fricative consonant. Fricative sounds are formed by narrowing the vocal tract.

antonyms: Conduction, Exposure, Connection, Contact, Vulnerability
urduMeaning: حرارت آواز یا بجلی کی منتقلی کم کرنے والا مادہ، حفاظت کے لیے الگ کرنے کا عمل، بیرونی اثر رابطے یا مشکل سے تحفظ، تار عمارت یا چیز کے گرد حفاظتی تہہ
englishMeaning: Material used to reduce the transfer of heat, sound, or electricity. The act or process of protecting something by insulating it. Separation or protection from outside influence, hardship, or contact. A protective layer around a wire, building, or object.
sindhiMeaning: گرمي آواز يا بجلي جي منتقلي گهٽائڻ وارو مادو، بچاءَ لاءِ الڳ ڪرڻ جو عمل، ٻاهرين اثر رابطي يا تڪليف کان تحفظ، تار عمارت يا شيءِ چوڌاري حفاظتي تهه
synonyms: Lagging, Padding, Shielding, Isolation, Protection, Barrier
examples: Good roof insulation keeps the house warm in winter. The electrician found a crack in the cable's insulation. Thick walls provide some insulation from street noise. Wealth can create insulation from everyday hardships.

englishMeaning: A hormone made by the pancreas that helps glucose move from the blood into cells. A medicine containing this hormone used to control blood sugar in people with diabetes. A protein hormone that regulates carbohydrate and fat metabolism.
antonyms: Glucagon, Insulin deficiency, Hyperglycemic hormone
urduMeaning: لبلبے میں بننے والا ہارمون جو خون کی گلوکوز کو خلیوں میں پہنچانے میں مدد دے، ذیابیطس میں خون کی شکر قابو کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہونے والی دوا، کاربوہائیڈریٹ اور چکنائی کے استحالے کو منظم کرنے والا پروٹین ہارمون
sindhiMeaning: لبلبي مان ٺهندڙ هارمون جيڪو رت جي گلوڪوز کي خلين ۾ پهچائڻ ۾ مدد ڪري، ذيابيطس ۾ رت جي کنڊ سنڀالڻ لاءِ استعمال ٿيندڙ دوا، ڪاربوهائيڊريٽ ۽ چرٻي جي ميٽابولزم کي ضابطو ڪندڙ پروٽين هارمون
synonyms: Pancreatic hormone, Blood-sugar-regulating hormone, Antidiabetic hormone
examples: The pancreas releases insulin after a meal. She takes insulin to manage her diabetes. Insulin helps the body's cells absorb glucose. The doctor adjusted his insulin dose carefully.

urduMeaning: حرارت آواز یا بجلی آسانی سے منتقل نہ کرنے والا مادہ یا چیز، برقی تاروں کو محفوظ سہارا دے کر الگ رکھنے والا آلہ، بیرونی اثر یا تبدیلی سے بچانے والا شخص یا چیز
examples: Rubber is a good electrical insulator. Ceramic insulators support the power lines. The foam acts as an insulator against heat. Her close family was an insulator from public pressure.
synonyms: Nonconductor, Dielectric, Barrier, Protector, Shield
antonyms: Conductor, Conduit, Transmitter, Carrier
englishMeaning: A material or object that does not readily conduct heat, sound, or electricity. A device used to support and separate electrical conductors safely. A person or thing that protects another from outside influence or change.
sindhiMeaning: گرمي آواز يا بجلي آساني سان نه هلائيندڙ مادو يا شيءِ، برقي تارن کي محفوظ سهارو ۽ الڳ رکڻ وارو اوزار، ٻاهرين اثر يا تبديلي کان بچائيندڙ ماڻهو يا شيءِ
گرمي آواز يا بجلي جي منتقلي گهٽائيندڙ، ٻاهرين اثر يا رابطي کان بچائيندڙ يا الڳ ڪندڙ، عايق بڻائڻ جو عمل، انسوليٽ ڪرڻ وارو
synonyms: Shielding, Protecting, Isolating, Nonconductive, Heat-resistant
englishMeaning: Serving to reduce the transfer of heat, sound, or electricity. Protecting or separating someone or something from outside influence. The present participle of insulate.
examples: The workers are insulating the attic today. Wool has excellent insulating properties. She wore an insulating layer beneath her coat. The policy is insulating small firms from sudden price changes.
urduMeaning: حرارت آواز یا بجلی کی منتقلی کم کرنے والا، بیرونی اثر یا رابطے سے بچانے یا الگ کرنے والا، عایق بنانے کا عمل، انسولیٹ کرنے والا
antonyms: Conducting, Exposing, Connecting, Transmitting

synonyms: Isolate, Protect, Shield, Separate, Cushion, Weatherproof
examples: We need to insulate the walls before winter. Plastic is used to insulate electrical wires. Parents cannot completely insulate children from disappointment. The fund helps insulate farmers from sudden market losses.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو ایسے مادے سے ڈھانپنا جو حرارت آواز یا بجلی کی منتقلی کم کرے، بیرونی اثر دباؤ یا نقصان سے بچانا، رابطے سے الگ کرنا، عایق بنانا
englishMeaning: To cover or surround something with material that reduces heat, sound, or electrical transfer. To protect someone or something from outside influence, pressure, or harm. To isolate or separate from contact.
antonyms: Expose, Connect, Conduct, Uncover, Endanger
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي اهڙي مادّي سان ڍڪڻ جيڪو گرمي آواز يا بجلي گهٽ منتقل ڪري، ٻاهرين اثر دٻاءَ يا نقصان کان بچائڻ، رابطي کان الڳ ڪرڻ، عايق بڻائڻ

englishMeaning: Covered or protected with material that reduces heat, sound, or electrical transfer. Protected from outside influence, pressure, or harm. Separated from direct contact or communication.
urduMeaning: حرارت آواز یا بجلی روکنے والے مادے سے ڈھکا ہوا، بیرونی اثر دباؤ یا نقصان سے محفوظ، براہ راست رابطے یا تعلق سے الگ، عایق کیا ہوا
examples: The insulated bottle kept the water cold all day. Always use insulated tools near live wires. The village remained insulated from the conflict. His position left him insulated from ordinary financial worries.
synonyms: Protected, Shielded, Isolated, Padded, Nonconductive
sindhiMeaning: گرمي آواز يا بجلي روڪيندڙ مادّي سان ڍڪيل، ٻاهرين اثر دٻاءَ يا نقصان کان محفوظ، سڌي رابطي يا لاڳاپي کان الڳ، عايق ڪيل
antonyms: Exposed, Unprotected, Connected, Conductive, Vulnerable

synonyms: Favorable, Helpful, Beneficial, Supportive, Advantageous, Promoting
examples: A quiet room is conducive to careful study. Regular feedback creates an environment conducive to growth. The warm, wet climate is conducive to mosquito breeding. Mutual respect is conducive to productive discussion.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن نتيجي کي ممڪن يا آسان بڻائيندڙ، گهربل نتيجي لاءِ مددگار يا سازگار، واڌ يا واقعي لاءِ مناسب حالتون پيدا ڪندڙ، موافق
urduMeaning: کسی نتیجے کو ممکن یا آسان بنانے والا، مطلوبہ نتیجے کے لیے مددگار یا سازگار، نشوونما یا وقوع کے لیے مناسب حالات پیدا کرنے والا، موافق
antonyms: Unfavorable, Harmful, Obstructive, Detrimental, Inhibiting
englishMeaning: Making a particular result likely or easier to achieve. Helpful or favorable to a desired outcome. Providing suitable conditions for something to happen or develop.

The ability of a material or component to allow electric current to flow. The reciprocal of electrical resistance, measured in siemens. The capacity to transmit heat, electricity, or another form of energy.
antonyms: Resistance, Impedance, Insulation, Nonconductance
urduMeaning: مادے یا جزو کی برقی رو کو گزرنے دینے کی صلاحیت، برقی مزاحمت کا معکوس جو سیمنز میں ناپا جاتا ہے، حرارت بجلی یا توانائی منتقل کرنے کی قابلیت، موصلیت کے برعکس چالکتا
sindhiMeaning: مادّي يا جز جي برقي وهڪري کي گذرڻ ڏيڻ جي صلاحيت، برقي مزاحمت جو اُلٽو مقدار جيڪو سيمينس ۾ ماپجي، گرمي بجلي يا توانائي منتقل ڪرڻ جي سگهه، چالڪتا
synonyms: Conductivity, Admittance, Electrical conduction, Current-carrying capacity
examples: The technician measured the conductance of the wire. Conductance increases when electrical resistance decreases. The sensor detects small changes in skin conductance. Salt water has greater conductance than pure water.

sindhiMeaning: آمريڪا جو تمام وڏو ڳجهو، اينڊين ڪنڊور يا ڪيليفورنيا ڪنڊور مان ڪو هڪ پکي، ويڪرن پرن وارو مردار خور پکي، مئل جانورن جو گوشت کائيندڙ وڏو پکي
urduMeaning: امریکہ کا بہت بڑا گدھ، اینڈین کونڈور یا کیلیفورنیا کونڈور میں سے کوئی ایک پرندہ، چوڑے پروں والا مردار خور پرندہ، مردہ جانوروں کا گوشت کھانے والا بڑا پرندہ
antonyms: Prey bird, Small songbird, Herbivorous bird
englishMeaning: A very large vulture native to the Americas. Either of two species, the Andean condor and the California condor. A broad-winged scavenging bird that feeds mainly on carrion.
examples: An Andean condor soared above the canyon. The condor uses rising air to remain aloft. Conservationists released a young California condor into the wild. We watched the huge condor spread its wings.
synonyms: Vulture, New World vulture, Andean condor, California condor, Scavenger
Condo, Apartment unit, Strata unit, Commonhold, Residential unit
examples: They bought a condominium near the city center. Residents share the condominium's pool and garden. The condominium association approved the repairs. She rents out her two-bedroom condominium during the summer.
urduMeaning: ایسی عمارت یا رہائشی مجموعہ جس کے گھر الگ مالکان کے اور مشترکہ حصے اجتماعی ملکیت ہوں، ایسی عمارت میں ذاتی ملکیت والا فلیٹ، نجی یونٹوں اور مشترکہ سہولیات پر مبنی ملکیتی نظام، دو یا زیادہ ریاستوں کے مشترکہ اقتدار والا علاقہ
antonyms: Detached house, Single-family home, Sole ownership, Separate property
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي عمارت يا رهائشي مجموعو جنهن جا گهر الڳ مالڪن جا ۽ عام حصا گڏيل ملڪيت هجن، اهڙي عمارت ۾ ذاتي ملڪيت وارو فليٽ، نجي يونٽن ۽ گڏيل سهولتن وارو ملڪيت جو نظام، ٻن يا وڌيڪ رياستن جي گڏيل حڪمراني وارو علائقو
englishMeaning: A building or complex containing individually owned homes and jointly owned common areas. An individually owned apartment or unit in such a development. A system of property ownership combining private units with shared facilities. Joint control of a territory by two or more states, especially historically.

antonyms: Nonconductive, Insulating, Resistive, Dielectric
sindhiMeaning: گرمي بجلي يا آواز منتقل ڪرڻ جي قابل، مادّي مان توانائي جي منتقلي سان لاڳاپيل، عايق ٿيڻ بدران وهڪرو گذاريندڙ، چالڪ
synonyms: Conducting, Transmissive, Current-carrying, Heat-conducting, Electrically active
englishMeaning: Able to conduct heat, electricity, or sound. Relating to the transfer of energy through a material. Tending to transmit rather than insulate.
urduMeaning: حرارت بجلی یا آواز منتقل کرنے کے قابل، مادے کے ذریعے توانائی کی منتقلی سے متعلق، عایق ہونے کے بجائے رو گزرنے دینے والا، موصل
examples: Copper is highly conductive. The conductive coating carries electricity across the surface. Wet soil is more conductive than dry soil. Wear protective gloves when handling conductive materials near live circuits.

antonyms: Resistivity, Resistance, Insulation, Nonconductivity
urduMeaning: کسی مادے کی بجلی حرارت یا آواز منتقل کرنے کی صلاحیت، توانائی کے مادے سے گزرنے کی آسانی کا پیمانہ، مادے کے ابعاد کے مطابق برقی چالکتا، رو گزارنے کی خصوصیت
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن مادّي جي بجلي گرمي يا آواز منتقل ڪرڻ جي صلاحيت، توانائي جي مادّي مان گذرڻ جي آسانيءَ جو ماپ، مادّي جي ماپن مطابق برقي چالڪتا، وهڪرو گذارڻ جي خاصيت
examples: Copper has high electrical conductivity. The lab tested the thermal conductivity of the insulation. Water quality can be estimated by measuring conductivity. Temperature affects the conductivity of many materials.
synonyms: Conductance, Transmission capacity, Electrical conduction, Thermal conduction
englishMeaning: The ability of a substance to conduct electricity, heat, or sound. A measure of how readily energy passes through a material. Electrical conductance adjusted for a material's dimensions.

The transfer of heat or electricity through a substance without movement of the substance as a whole. The act or process of carrying or transmitting something. In physiology, the transmission of impulses through nerves or tissue.
synonyms: Transmission, Transfer, Conveyance, Conducting, Propagation
sindhiMeaning: مادّي جي مجموعي حرڪت کان سواءِ ان مان گرمي يا بجلي جي منتقلي، ڪنهن شيءِ کي کڻي يا منتقل ڪرڻ جو عمل، اعصاب يا بافتن مان تحريڪ جي روانگي، گرمي يا برقي چال
examples: Heat moves through the metal rod by conduction. Copper wires allow efficient electrical conduction. Nerve conduction carries signals to the muscles. Thick gloves reduce the conduction of heat from your hands.
urduMeaning: مادے کی مجموعی حرکت کے بغیر اس میں حرارت یا بجلی کی منتقلی، کسی چیز کو لے جانے یا منتقل کرنے کا عمل، اعصاب یا بافتوں میں تحریک کی ترسیل، حرارتی یا برقی ایصال
antonyms: Insulation, Isolation, Resistance, Interruption
Ignoramus, Anti-intellectual, Knowledge-averse person, Uncurious person
urduMeaning: علم اور سیکھنے سے شدید محبت رکھنے والا شخص، معلومات حاصل کرنے اور سمجھنے کی زبردست خواہش رکھنے والا فرد، بہت زیادہ ذہنی تجسس رکھنے والا انسان، علم کا عاشق
examples: As an epistemophiliac, she is always enrolled in a new course. The library is a natural refuge for an epistemophiliac. His friends call him an epistemophiliac because he asks questions about everything. An epistemophiliac often enjoys exploring subjects far beyond a formal curriculum.
sindhiMeaning: علم ۽ سکيا سان شديد محبت رکندڙ ماڻهو، ڄاڻ حاصل ڪرڻ ۽ سمجهڻ جي زبردست خواهش رکندڙ شخص، تمام گهڻي ذهني تجسس وارو ماڻهو، علم جو عاشق
synonyms: Knowledge lover, Philomath, Inquisitive person, Intellectual, Lifelong learner
englishMeaning: A person with an intense love of knowledge and learning. Someone strongly driven to discover, understand, and acquire information. A person characterized by intellectual curiosity, especially to an unusually high degree.

Relating to the ideas, customs, arts, beliefs, and social behavior of a society. Connected with intellectual and artistic activity. Relating to the cultivation of microorganisms, plants, or cells in controlled conditions. Shared by or characteristic of a particular group.
antonyms: Uncultural, Noncultural, Natural, Biological, Philistine
urduMeaning: معاشرے کے خیالات رسموں فنون عقائد اور سماجی رویوں سے متعلق، علمی اور فنی سرگرمیوں سے وابستہ، کسی خاص گروہ کی مشترکہ شناخت والا، جراثیم پودوں یا خلیات کی قابو شدہ افزائش سے متعلق
sindhiMeaning: سماج جي خيالن رسمن فنن عقيدن ۽ سماجي روين سان لاڳاپيل، علمي ۽ فني سرگرمين سان تعلق رکندڙ، ڪنهن خاص گروهه جي گڏيل سڃاڻپ وارو، جراثيم ٻوٽن يا خلين جي سنڀاليل واڌ سان لاڳاپيل
examples: The festival celebrates the region's cultural heritage. Cultural differences can shape how people communicate. The city offers many cultural events throughout the year. Researchers used cultural methods to identify the bacteria.
synonyms: Social, Ethnic, Traditional, Artistic, Intellectual, Civilizational

examples: The gesture is interpreted differently across culturally diverse communities. The program is culturally appropriate for local families. The two regions are culturally connected through music and trade. The sample was culturally identified as a common bacterial strain.
synonyms: Socially, Traditionally, Ethnically, Artistically, Civilizationally
englishMeaning: In a way that relates to the customs, beliefs, arts, or social behavior of a society. From the perspective of a particular culture. In terms of intellectual or artistic development. By means of laboratory culture, in scientific contexts.
urduMeaning: معاشرے کی رسموں عقائد فنون یا رویوں کے لحاظ سے، کسی خاص ثقافت کے نقطۂ نظر سے، علمی یا فنی ترقی کے اعتبار سے، سائنسی طور پر کلچر کے ذریعے
antonyms: Naturally, Biologically, Individually, Unculturally
sindhiMeaning: سماج جي رسمن عقيدن فنن يا روين جي لحاظ کان، ڪنهن خاص ثقافت جي نظر سان، علمي يا فني ترقي جي حوالي سان، سائنسي طور ڪلچر جي طريقي سان
ڪاروبار کي خرچ ڪٽڻ کان اڳ وڪرو يا عام سرگرمين مان ملندڙ آمدني، حڪومت کي ٽيڪسن فيسن ۽ ٻين ذريعن مان ملندڙ رقم، اداري يا سرگرمي جي ڪل پيدا ڪيل رقم، ملڪيت مان حاصل ٿيندڙ آمد يا پيداوار
antonyms: Expenditure, Expense, Cost, Loss, Outlay
urduMeaning: کاروبار کو اخراجات منہا کرنے سے پہلے فروخت یا معمول کی سرگرمیوں سے حاصل آمدنی، حکومت کو ٹیکس فیس اور دیگر ذرائع سے ملنے والی رقم، ادارے یا سرگرمی سے پیدا ہونے والی کل رقم، جائیداد سے حاصل ہونے والی آمد یا پیداوار
synonyms: Income, Turnover, Sales, Receipts, Proceeds, Earnings, Yield
englishMeaning: Income received by a business from its normal activities, especially sales, before expenses are deducted. Money collected by a government through taxes, fees, and other sources. The total amount of money generated by an organization or activity. Historically, a return or yield from property.
examples: The company reported record revenue this quarter. Ticket sales provide most of the theater's revenue. Tax revenue funds public services. Advertising has become an important revenue stream for the website.

urduMeaning: متن تقریر موسیقی ویڈیو یا کوڈ کا چھوٹا ٹکڑا، مختصر معلومات یا خبر، دوبارہ استعمال ہونے والا کمپیوٹر کوڈ کا حصہ، کسی چیز سے کاٹا یا لیا گیا بہت چھوٹا جز
sindhiMeaning: متن تقرير موسيقي وڊيو يا ڪوڊ جو ننڍڙو ٽڪرو، مختصر معلومات يا خبر، ٻيهر استعمال ٿيندڙ ڪمپيوٽر ڪوڊ جو حصو، ڪنهن شيءِ مان ڪٽيل تمام ننڍڙو حصو
englishMeaning: A small piece or short extract of text, speech, music, video, or code. A brief piece of information or news. A reusable fragment of computer code. A very small part cut or taken from something.
antonyms: Whole, Entirety, Complete work, Full version
synonyms: Extract, Excerpt, Fragment, Clip, Bit, Scrap, Passage
examples: She read a short snippet from the interview. The trailer includes snippets of the film's best scenes. I saved the code snippet for later use. He shared a snippet of news during lunch.

synonyms: Commercialization, Revenue generation, Profit-making, Capitalization, Conversion to cash
examples: The app's monetization relies on monthly subscriptions. Creators discussed monetization options for their videos. Careful monetization can generate revenue without annoying users. The government considered the monetization of certain assets.
urduMeaning: اثاثے مصنوعہ خدمت سامعین یا سرگرمی سے پیسہ کمانے کا عمل، کسی چیز کو آمدنی کا ذریعہ بنانا، اثاثے یا قرض کو نقد رقم میں تبدیل کرنا، کسی چیز کو قانونی کرنسی بنانے کا عمل
englishMeaning: The process of earning money from an asset, product, service, audience, or activity. The conversion of something into a source of revenue. The act of converting an asset or debt into money. The formal adoption of something as legal currency, in economic usage.
antonyms: Demonetization, Decommercialization, Free distribution, Noncommercial use
sindhiMeaning: اثاثي پيداوار خدمت سامعين يا سرگرمي مان پئسا ڪمائڻ جو عمل، ڪنهن شيءِ کي آمدني جو ذريعو بڻائڻ، اثاثي يا قرض کي نقد رقم ۾ بدلائڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي قانوني ڪرنسي بڻائڻ جو عمل

synonyms: Capitalize, Commercialize, Cash in on, Profit from, Exploit, Convert to cash, Generate revenue from
sindhiMeaning: پئسا ڪمائڻ لاءِ استعمال ڪرڻ، آمدني جو ذريعو بنائڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي قانوني ڪرنسي طور مقرر ڪرڻ، قرضي دستاويزن کي نوٽن ۾ تبديل ڪرڻ
examples: The company decided to monetize its mobile app through in-app advertising. Many YouTubers monetize their channels once they reach a certain number of subscribers. The government chose to monetize part of its debt by printing more currency. She monetized her hobby of baking by starting a small online business.
englishMeaning: To convert something into or establish as legal currency. To earn revenue from an asset, product, or activity that was not previously generating income, especially online content or platforms. To generate income from something. In economics, to convert government debt into money by having the central bank purchase government securities.
urduMeaning: کسی چیز سے آمدنی حاصل کرنا، منافع بخش بنانا، کسی چیز کو قانونی کرنسی قرار دینا، حکومتی قرضے کو کرنسی میں تبدیل کرنا
antonyms: Demonetize, Devalue, Write off

urduMeaning: پیسے یا کرنسی سے متعلق، ملک کی رقم کی فراہمی اور معیشت پر اس کے اثر سے متعلق، رقم میں ناپا گیا
examples: The central bank adjusted its monetary policy to control inflation. He suffered significant monetary losses after the stock market crash. The prize came with a monetary award of ten thousand dollars. Monetary stability is essential for a healthy national economy.
synonyms: Financial, Fiscal, Pecuniary, Economic, Cash, Capital, Budgetary
antonyms: Nonmonetary, Nonfinancial, Moral
sindhiMeaning: پئسي يا ڪرنسي سان لاڳاپيل، ملڪ جي پئسي جي فراهمي ۽ ان جي معيشت تي اثر سان لاڳاپيل، پئسي ۾ ماپيل
englishMeaning: Relating to money or currency. Relating to the money supply of a country and its effects on the economy. Consisting of or measured in money.

A person, especially an economist, who advocates monetarism, the theory that a country's money supply is the primary driver of economic growth and stability. Relating to or characteristic of monetarism or its supporters.
urduMeaning: مانیٹرزم کے نظریے کا حامی ماہرِ معیشت، مانیٹرزم سے متعلق
antonyms: Keynesian, Fiscalist
sindhiMeaning: مانيٽرزم جي نظريي جو حامي شخص يا ماهر معاشيات، مانيٽرزم سان لاڳاپيل
synonyms: Monetary economist, Quantity theorist, Free-market economist
examples: Milton Friedman is widely regarded as the most influential monetarist economist. The monetarist approach emphasizes controlling the money supply to manage inflation. As a monetarist, she argued that excessive government spending was not the root cause of the recession. Monetarist policies gained popularity in several countries during the 1980s.

synonyms: Monetary theory, Quantity theory of money, Chicago school economics
examples: Monetarism gained widespread influence in economic policy during the late twentieth century. Central banks influenced by monetarism focus heavily on controlling inflation through money supply. Critics of monetarism argue that it underestimates the role of government spending. Monetarism was a key theoretical foundation for Margaret Thatcher's economic reforms.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ معاشي نظريو جيڪو چوي ٿو ته پئسي جي فراهمي معيشت جو بنيادي محرڪ آهي، پئسي جي فراهمي تي ڪنٽرول وارو معاشي مڪتبِ فڪر
englishMeaning: An economic theory holding that the money supply is the chief determinant of short-term economic activity, and that steady, controlled growth in the money supply is the best way to promote economic stability. A school of economic thought associated with Milton Friedman.
antonyms: Keynesianism, Fiscalism
urduMeaning: ایک معاشی نظریہ جس کے مطابق رقم کی فراہمی معیشت کا بنیادی محرک ہے، رقم کی فراہمی پر کنٹرول کا معاشی مکتبِ فکر

examples: The soldiers took cover to avoid enemy sniping from the rooftops. His constant sniping at coworkers created a tense office atmosphere. Sniping in online auctions can frustrate bidders who lose out at the last second. The documentary examined the psychological toll of sniping on military marksmen.
sindhiMeaning: لڪي ويهي نشانو کڻي فائرنگ ڪرڻ جو عمل، اوچتو تنقيدي يا تلخ تبصرا ڪرڻ، آن لائن نيلامي ۾ آخري گھڙيءَ ۾ بولي لڳائڻ
urduMeaning: چھپ کر نشانہ لے کر فائرنگ کرنے کا عمل، اچانک تنقیدی یا طنزیہ تبصرے کرنا، آن لائن نیلامی میں آخری لمحے پر بولی لگانا
synonyms: Shooting, Potshotting, Carping, Criticizing, Gibing, Last-minute bidding
antonyms: Praising, Complimenting, Supporting
englishMeaning: The act of shooting at people from a hidden position, typically with a long-range rifle. The practice of making sudden critical or harsh remarks. In online auctions, the practice of placing a winning bid at the last possible moment to prevent others from responding.

englishMeaning: The action of depriving someone of land, property, or other possessions. The state of being deprived of possessions, especially by force or law. The loss of ownership or control over one's assets. A historical process of removing people from their ancestral lands.
